abandon.en: She decided to abandon the idea and start afresh.
abandon.zh: 她决定放弃这个想法，重新开始。

ability.en: "He has the ability to make people laugh."

abnormal.en: I felt abnormal this morning, like I was sick.

abolish.en: We should abolish the old rules.

abortion.en: She had an abortion because the baby was severely deformed.
abortion.zh: 她流产了，因为宝宝有严重的畸形。

about.en: I am reading a book about history.
about.zh: 我正在读一本关于历史的书

above.en: The helicopter hovered above the building.
above.zh: 直升机在大楼上空盘旋。

abroad.en: Michael is studying abroad in the UK.

abrupt.en: He made an abrupt turn and walked out of the room.
abrupt.zh: 他突然转身走出了房间。

absence.en: There is an absence of sand in the hourglass.

absent.en: I was absent from school yesterday because I went on a trip with my father.

absorb.en: Plants absorb carbon dioxide and give off oxygen.
absorb.zh: 植物吸收二氧化碳并释放氧气。

abstract.en: He has trouble understanding abstract concepts.
abstract.zh: 他理解抽象概念有些困难。

absurd.en: It's absolutely absurd to suggest that I was responsible for the accident.
absurd.zh: 将我与事故联系起来的想法完全是荒谬的。

abundant.en: Cakes, cookies, and candy were so abundant that the child was very happy.

abuse.en: "She was subject to physical abuse and violence."
abuse.zh: 她遭受了身体的虐待和暴力

academic.en: She has made great academic achievements in her field of study.
academic.zh: 她在她的研究领域取得了很大的学术成就。

academy.en: There are many courses taught at the academy that I go to.

accelerate.en: When he stepped on the gas pedal, the motorcycle accelerated.

accent.en: His Spanish accent is very charming.
accent.zh: 他的西班牙口音非常迷人。

access.en: The manager was the only person with access to the password.

accident.en: He damaged the car in an accident.

accompany.en: "Can I accompany you to the party?"
accompany.zh: 我能陪你一起去舞会吗？

accomplish.en: We have accomplished a great deal today.
accomplish.zh: 我们今天完成了大量的工作。

account.en: I forgot my password and can't access my account.
account.zh: 我忘记了密码，无法进入我的账户。

accountant.en: The accountant helped us keep track of our spending.

accumulate.en: Dust tends to accumulate in corners.
accumulate.zh: 尘土往往在角落里堆积。

accuse.en: The teacher accused the little boy of cheating.
accuse.zh: 老师指控那个小男孩作弊

accustomed.en: I am not accustomed to such treatment.

ache.en: I have a terrible ache in my back.

achieve.en: I was happy that I could achieve my goal.

acid.en: The orange is a bit too acid for my taste.
acid.zh: 这个橙子对我来说稍微有点酸。

acknowledge.en: The teacher acknowledged that the young student was hungry.

acquaintance.en: She is an acquaintance of mine from work.
acquaintance.zh: 她是我工作中的一个熟人

acquire.en: She acquired a good knowledge of Chinese.
acquire.zh: 她获得了良好的中文知识。

acquisition.en: The company is looking for new opportunities for acquisition.
acquisition.zh: 该公司正在寻找新的收购机会。

acre.en: My dream is to own an acre of land in the countryside.
acre.zh: 我梦想在乡下拥有一英亩的土地。

act.en: We need to act immediately to solve this problem.
act.zh: 我们需要立刻采取行动解决这个问题。

action.en: She took prompt action to deal with the problem.
action.zh: 她迅速采取行动处理问题。

active.en: It is important to be active and not sit around all the time.

activity.en: "The club offers a variety of activities."

actor.en: Tom Hanks is a very talented actor.
actor.zh: 汤姆·汉克斯是一位非常有才华的演员。

actress.en: Jennifer Aniston is a well-known actress.
actress.zh: 詹妮弗·安妮斯顿是一位著名的女演员。

actual.en: This is the actual sword that the king owned, not a fake one.

acute.en: She suffered from acute appendicitis and was rushed to the hospital.
acute.zh: 她患有急性阑尾炎，被迅速送到了医院。

ad.en: He worked as an AD on the film project.
ad.zh: 他在这个电影项目中担任音频导演的角色。

adapt.en: When he went to the new town, he had to adapt to all the weather changes.

adaptation.en: Penguins have a number of adaptations that help them live in cold environments.
adaptation.zh: 企鹅有许多适应冷环境的机制。

addition.en: Our company is planning an addition to the existing staff.
addition.zh: 我们公司正在计划增加现有的员工。

address.en: As a noun: "Please write down your address on this form."
address.zh: 请在这个表格上写下你的地址。

adequate.en: "I have adequate supplies to finish the project."
adequate.zh: 我有足够的供应完成这个项目。

adjust.en: "You may need to adjust your sleep schedule to beat jet lag."
adjust.zh: 你可能需要调整你的睡眠时间来克服时差。

adjustment.en: After moving to a new country, it takes time to make adjustments to the different culture and lifestyle.
adjustment.zh: 移居新的国家后，需要时间来适应不同的文化和生活方式。

administration.en: School administration needs to focus on improving the quality of education.
administration.zh: 学校行政部门需要专注于提高教育质量。

admirable.en: You showed admirable restraint when dealing with those difficult customers.
admirable.zh: 你处理那些棘手的客户时表现得十分冷静，这非常值得赞赏。

admission.en: "The admission process for this college is quite competitive."
admission.zh: 这所大学的入学过程相当竞争激烈。

adolescence.en: Adolescence is a time of rapid physical and psychological change.
adolescence.zh: 青春期是身体和心理迅速变化的时期。

adolescent.en: Many **adolescents** feel a sense of invulnerability.
adolescent.zh: 许多青少年都有一种无所不能的感觉。

adopt.zh: 他们已经领养了一个女婴。

adore.zh: 她非常热爱她的儿子们。

adult.en: "He's an adult now and should be responsible for his own actions."
adult.zh: 他现在是个成年人了，应该为自己的行为负责。

advance.en: We need to advance our knowledge in this area.
advance.zh: 我们要在这个领域提高我们的知识。

advantage.en: We have a significant advantage in this game.
advantage.zh: 我们在这场比赛中有明显的优势

adventure.en: Riding in the rough water was an adventure.

advertise.en: They decided to advertise in the newspaper for a sales manager.
advertise.zh: 他们决定在报纸上做广告招聘销售经理

advertisement.en: "The company launched an advertisement for its new product."
advertisement.zh: 这家公司为其新产品发起了一项广告活动。

advice.en: Sophie gave me some good advice before my interview.
advice.zh: 苏菲在我面试前给了我一些好的建议。

advise.en: My teacher advised me to study harder.
advise.zh: 我的老师建议我更努力的学习。

advocate.en: I strongly advocate the use of renewable energy.
advocate.zh: 我强烈建议使用可再生能源。

aeroplane.en: The aeroplane is about to land.

affair.en: My wife and I attended a formal affair over the weekend.

affect.en: The student’s poor attitude affected the other students in the class.

affection.en: Amanda has a lot of affection for her little sister, Sarah.

afford.en: I’ve been saving my money so I can afford to buy a new bike.

africa.en: Africa is known for its diverse wildlife.
africa.zh: 非洲以其多样的野生动物闻名。

african.en: As an African, he felt a deep sense of pride in his heritage.
african.zh: 作为一个非洲人，他对他的遗产感到深深的自豪。

after.en: 介词："I'll see you after school."

afterward.en: We had lunch, and afterward we went for a walk.
afterward.zh: 我们吃过午餐后去散步了。

age.en: She died at the age of 80.

agency.en: I went to a travel agency to help me arrange a flight home.

agenda.en: The meeting's agenda was packed with important issues.
agenda.zh: 会议议程上列满了重要的议题。

agent.en: He is an agent of the famous singer.
agent.zh: 他是那位著名歌星的经纪人。

aggression.en: The problem was only made worse by Mark’s aggression.

aggressive.en: The manager is very aggressive in implementing the new policy.
aggressive.zh: 经理在实施新政策时表现得非常积极主动。

agree.en: The students agree they have too much homework.

agreement.en: I think you’ll get Tom’s agreement to this proposal.

agricultural.en: This region is mainly used for agricultural purposes.
agricultural.zh: 这个地区主要用于农业用途。

agriculture.en: Agriculture greatly contributes to the national economy.
agriculture.zh: 农业对国家经济有很大贡献。

ahead.en: Keep going straight ahead until you see the park.
ahead.zh: 一直向前走，直到你看到公园。

aim.en: "My aim in life is to be a successful entrepreneur."
aim.zh: 我的人生目标是成为一位成功的企业家。

air.en: Clean air is vital for our survival.
air.zh: 我们需要清新的空气才能生存。

aircraft.en: The aircraft is scheduled to land at 3:00 p.m.
aircraft.zh: 这架飞机预计下午三点着陆。

airline.en: The airline has excellent customer service.

airport.en: I will pick you up at the airport.

album.zh: 我买了他们的最新专辑。

alcohol.en: He doesn't drink alcohol at all.

alcoholic.en: He is an alcoholic, so he often feels ill because of drinking too much.
alcoholic.zh: 他是个酒鬼，所以经常因为喝酒过量而感到不适。

algebra.en: My son is learning algebra in school now.
algebra.zh: 我儿子现在在学校学习代数。

alike.en: They are brothers, and they look alike.

alive.en: My grandparents are still alive even though they are over 90.

allergic.en: I'm allergic to cats, so I can't be around them for long.
allergic.zh: 我对猫过敏，所以不能长时间接触它们。

alley.en: I lost my way in the alley.

allocate.en: The government allocated $100 million to aid the disaster relief effort.

allow.en: You are not allowed to smoke in this area.
allow.zh: 你不能在这个区域抽烟。

allowance.en: The company gives each employee a travel allowance to cover their transportation costs.
allowance.zh: 公司给每个员工发放旅行津贴，用以支付他们的交通费用。

almost.en: I almost missed the bus this morning.
almost.zh: 今天早上我差点错过公交车。

alone.en: He is living alone in the big city.
alone.zh: 他独自一人生活在大城市里。

along.en: He walks along the beach every morning.
along.zh: 他每天早上都在海滩上散步。

alongside.en: They were walking alongside the road.

aloud.en: My father often reads stories aloud to me and my sister.

alphabet.en: She's teaching her son the alphabet.
alphabet.zh: 她正在教她的儿子字母表。

already.zh: 我们已经完成了这个项目。

also.en: "He is a teacher, he is also a writer."
also.zh: 他是一位老师，他也是一位作家。

alternative.en: We had no alternative but to fire him.
alternative.zh: 我们没有选择只能解雇他。

although.en: Although she was late, her friends gave her a warm welcome.

altitude.en: "The altitude of Mount Everest is over 8800 meters."
altitude.zh: 珠穆朗玛峰的海拔超过8800米。

altogether.en: "There were seven people at the meeting altogether."

always.en: They always brush their teeth in the morning.

amateur.en: Despite being an amateur, he painted a beautiful landscape.
amateur.zh: 尽管他是个业余者，但他画了一幅美丽的山水画。

amaze.en: The news in the paper amazed Jack.

ambiguous.en: His reply to my question was ambiguous.
ambiguous.zh: 他对我问题的回答含糊不清。

ambition.en: His ambition was to become a pilot.
ambition.zh: 他的志向是成为一名飞行员。

ambulance.en: The ambulance arrived within minutes of the call.
ambulance.zh: 救护车在接到电话几分钟内便赶到。

america.en: America is located in the Western Hemisphere.

among.en: He was standing among the crowds.

amount.en: The amount of money he has is astonishing.他拥有的钱的数量令人惊讶。

ample.en: There was an ample supply of oats to feed the horses.

amuse.en: The singer was very good. She amused the crowd.

analyze.en: I will analyze the data collected from the survey.
analyze.zh: 我将分析从调查中收集的数据。

analysis.en: The professor is giving a detailed analysis of the novel.
analysis.zh: 教授正在给小说做详尽的分析。

anchor.en: When the ship reached its destination, the crew dropped the anchor.

ancient.en: These are the remains of an ancient civilization that existed thousands of years ago.
ancient.zh: 这些是存在于几千年前的古老文明的遗址。

and.en: Tom and Jerry are good friends.

anecdote.en: "Do you want to hear an anecdote about my trip to Paris?"
anecdote.zh: 你想听听我去巴黎的旅行轶事吗？

anger.zh: 他无法掩饰自己的愤怒。

angle.en: The angle between these two lines is 90 degrees.
angle.zh: 这两条线之间的角度是90度。

angry.en: He was very angry at the news.
angry.zh: 他对这个消息非常生气。

ankle.en: He sprained his ankle when he fell off the ladder.
ankle.zh: 他从梯子上摔下来，扭伤了脚踝。

anniversary.zh: 今天是我们的十周年结婚纪念日。

announce.en: The host announced the arrival of the special guest.
announce.zh: 主持人宣布贵宾的到来。

announcement.en: The announcement of the new product generated much excitement.
announcement.zh: 新产品的发布引起了很大的兴趣。

annoy.zh: 你的不断打扰真的让我很烦。

annual.en: The company holds an annual meeting every January.
annual.zh: 公司每年一月都会举行年度会议。

another.en: "Would you like another cup of tea?"

ant.en: The ant is the smallest creature, yet it is diligent.
ant.zh: 蚂蚁是最小的生物，然而它却勤奋。

antarctic.en: The Arctic and the Antarctic are the earth's last wildernesses.
antarctic.zh: 北极和南极是地球上最后的荒野。

antique.en: He collects antiques. 他收藏古董。

anxiety.en: When I have to climb to high places, I’m filled with anxiety.

anxious.en: She was anxious about not making her appointment on time.

anyhow.en: Anyhow, I will finish the project on time.
anyhow.zh: 无论如何，我都会准时完成这个项目。

apart.en: They moved apart and then came back together.

apartment.en: She has a nice apartment in the city.

apology.en: "I owe you an apology for my behavior last night."
apology.zh: 对于我昨晚的行为，我应该向你道歉。

apparent.en: His age is not immediately apparent.
apparent.zh: 他的年龄并不是一看就能确定的。

appeal.en: The charity event was an appeal for funds.
appeal.zh: 这个慈善活动是一个募款的呼吁。

appear.en: She appeared to be sad. She was crying.

appendix.en: The data is included in the appendix at the end of the report.
appendix.zh: 报告的末尾添加了包含数据的附录

appetite.en: After a long day of work, I have a huge appetite.
appetite.zh: 经过一整天的工作，我很有食欲。

applaud.en: The audience began to applaud the dancer's performance.
applaud.zh: 观众开始为舞者的表演鼓掌。

applicant.en: Lots of applicants came into the store when the job position became available.

apply.en: She always applies makeup to her face before going outside.

appoint.en: The president will appoint a new ambassador to France.
appoint.zh: 总统将任命一位新的驻法国大使。

appointment.en: I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow.
appointment.zh: 我明天有个看牙医的预约。

appreciation.en: I want to express my deep appreciation for your help.
appreciation.zh: 我想表达我对你的帮助深深的感激。

approach.en: 动词用法：Can you approach the boss about a raise today?
approach.zh: 你今天能去找老板谈加薪的事情吗？

appropriate.en: It’s appropriate to wear a suit when you go to the office.

approve.en: Her co-workers approved her new plan.

apron.en: She always puts on an apron when she is going to cook something.
apron.zh: 她每次做饭都会穿上围裙。

arbitrary.en: The classroom had many arbitrary rules that confused me.

arch.en: The bridge is an example of a stone arch.
arch.zh: 这座桥是石头拱门的一个例子。

architect.en: The plans for building the new home were drawn by a famous architect.

april.en: April is the fourth month of the year.
april.zh: 四月是一年的第四个月。

arab.en: He is an Arab and speaks Arabic fluently.
arab.zh: 他是阿拉伯人，说得一口流利的阿拉伯语。

arctic.en: "The Arctic region is known for its extremely cold temperatures."
arctic.zh: 北极地区以其极度寒冷的气温而闻名。

area.en: This area is known for its beautiful scenery.
area.zh: 这个区域以其美丽的风景而闻名。

argue.en: They argue about politics all the time.

arithmetic.en: The children are learning the basics of arithmetic in school.
arithmetic.zh: 孩子们在学校里学习算术基础。

army.en: The army protects all the people in the country.

around.en: She wrapped the scarf around her neck.
around.zh: 她把围巾围在了脖子周围。

arrange.en: Please arrange the words in order from A to Z.

arrangement.en: They made an arrangement to meet at the airport.

arrest.en: "The police had a warrant to arrest him."

arrive.en: They will arrive in New York at noon.
arrive.zh: 他们将在中午到达纽约。

arrow.en: The arrow hit the bull's eye.

art.en: She is a student at the School of Art.

article.en: Did you read the article in the newspaper about the soccer game?

artificial.en: "The artificial intelligence could beat the world champion in chess."
artificial.zh: 这个人工智能能打败国际象棋的世界冠军。

artist.en: Michael Jackson was a world-renowned artist.
artist.zh: 迈克尔·杰克逊是一位享誉世界的艺术家。

as.en: She's very talented, as we have seen.
as.zh: 我们已经看到，她是非常有才华的。

ash.en: Ash from the burning wood swirled around us.
ash.zh: 燃烧的木头产生的灰烬在我们周围打转。

ashamed.en: I'm deeply ashamed of my behavior last night.
ashamed.zh: 我对昨晚自己的行为深感羞愧。

asia.en: Asia is the largest continent in the world.
asia.zh: 亚洲是世界上最大的大陆。

aside.en: He set the book aside and started to get up.
aside.zh: 他把书放在一边，开始起身。

ask.en: Can I ask you a question?

aspect.en: I thought about the different aspects of owning two dogs.

assess.en: "We need to assess the impact of these changes."
assess.zh: 我们需要评估这些变化的影响。

assist.en: I need someone to assist me with this task.
assist.zh: 我需要有人协助我完成这项任务。

assistant.en: Jim works as an assistant in a law firm.
assistant.zh: 吉姆在一家法律公司担任助理工作。

associate.en: 我们经常将巧克力与情人节关联起来。
associate.zh: We often associate chocolate with Valentine's Day.

assume.en: I think we can safely assume that she will be here on time.
assume.zh: 我想我们可以放心地假设她会准时到来。

assumption.en: The whole argument is based upon a false assumption.
assumption.zh: 整个论述基于一个错误的假设。

astonish.en: The number of people that came to her party astonished her.

astronaut.en: The astronaut was walking on the moon.

astronomy.en: Astronomy is a subject that fascinates me.
astronomy.zh: 天文学是我着迷的科目。

at.en: The meeting is at the conference room.

athlete.en: Some athletes can play many sports very well.

athletic.en: He is naturally athletic and excels in all sports.
athletic.zh: 他天生就很擅长运动，所有的体育项目他都表现出色。

athletics.en: Her ambition is to excel in athletics.
athletics.zh: 她的愿望是在田径运动中出类拔萃。

atmosphere.en: The party had a festive atmosphere.
atmosphere.zh: 这个派对的气氛很热闹。

atom.en: "An atom of truth can outweigh a world of lies."
atom.zh: 一点真理也能胜过一个谎言的世界

attach.en: I attached a photo to the email.
attach.zh: 我在邮件中附加了一张照片。

attack.en: The soldiers were ordered to attack at dawn.
attack.zh: 士兵们被命令在黎明时分发动攻击。

attain.en: If you want to attain a healthy body, you must exercise every day.

attempt.en: "I will attempt to fix the car by myself."
attempt.zh: 我将尝试自己修理汽车。

attend.en: I will attend the meeting tomorrow.

attention.en: "Pay attention to the teacher during the lecture."
attention.zh: 在讲座期间要注意听老师讲课。

attitude.en: John has a bad attitude. He’s always angry.

attract.en: The bright colors of the flower attract bees.
attract.zh: 花朵的鲜艳色彩吸引了蜜蜂。

attractive.zh: 她是一个有魅力的女人。

audience.en: The play received a warm applause from the audience.
audience.zh: 这部戏剧受到了观众的热烈掌声。

authentic.zh: 这些是真正的设计师的手提包。

author.en: The author was hard at work on his next novel.

authority.en: The teacher is the authority in the classroom.

august.en: August is the hottest month of the year.
august.zh: 八月是一年中最热的月份。

australian.en: "He is an Australian living in New York."
australian.zh: 他是一个生活在纽约的澳大利亚人。

autumn.en: I love when the leaves fall in autumn because I can play in them.

available.en: The book is now available in stores.
available.zh: 这本书现在在书店有售。

avenue.en: She lives in an apartment on Park Avenue.
avenue.zh: 她住在柏克大道上的一栋公寓里。

average.en: The average income in our city is around $50,000 annually.
average.zh: 我们城市的平均收入每年大约为50,000美元。

avoid.en: I try to avoid eating too much sugar.

award.en: The teacher will award a prize to the student with the best essay.
award.zh: 老师会给写的最好的文章的学生授予奖品。

aware.en: We must make everyone aware of the dangers of smoking.
aware.zh: 我们必须让每个人都意识到吸烟的危害。

away.en: He lives away from the city.

awesome.en: The huge military plane was an awesome sight.

awful.en: Her performance last night was awful.

awkward.en: He made an awkward attempt to be humorous.
awkward.zh: 他尽力想幽默一下，但很尴尬

baby.en: The woman is caring for her baby.
baby.zh: 那个女人正在照顾她的婴儿。

bachelor.en: Since he was a bachelor, Jason did his shopping by himself.

background.en: She has a strong background in biochemistry.
background.zh: 她在生物化学方面有很深的底子。

bacon.en: "I usually have eggs and bacon for breakfast."
bacon.zh: 我通常早餐会吃鸡蛋和培根。

bacterium.en: The bacterium E. coli is often used as a model organism in microbiology studies.
bacterium.zh: 细菌大肠杆菌经常被用作微生物学研究的模型生物。

badly.en: He behaved badly at the party.
badly.zh: 他在聚会上的行为举止很不恰当。

badminton.en: I am fond of playing badminton.

bag.en: She rummaged in her bag for her keys.
bag.zh: 她在包里翻找她的钥匙。

bake.en: "Please bake the bread at 400 degrees for 20 minutes."
bake.zh: 请将面包在400度的烤箱中烘烤20分钟。

bakery.en: I will pick up some bread from the bakery on the way home.
bakery.zh: 我回家的路上会从面包店买点面包。

balance.en: In yoga, it's important to find your balance.
balance.zh: 瑜伽中，寻找平衡点是非常重要的。

balcony.en: Judy likes to have morning coffee on her balcony overlooking the city.
balcony.zh: 朱迪喜欢坐在俯瞰城市的阳台上喝早咖啡。

ball.en: "John kicked the ball into the net."

bamboo.en: Bamboo is used in many cultures as a versatile building material.
bamboo.zh: 竹子在许多文化中被视为一种多用途的建筑材料。

ban.en: "The government decided to ban smoking in all public places."
ban.zh: 政府决定在所有公共场所禁止吸烟。

banana.en: I like to eat a banana for breakfast.

band.en: "The band played some really good music at the concert."
band.zh: 乐团在音乐会上演奏了一些非常好听的音乐。

bandage.en: The nurse wrapped the wound with a bandage.
bandage.zh: 护士用绷带包扎了伤口。

bang.en: We heard a bang and then saw smoke.
bang.zh: 我们听到了“砰”的一声，然后看到烟雾。

barbecue.en: "We are planning to have a barbecue this weekend."
barbecue.zh: 我们计划这个周末举办一次烧烤活动。

barber.en: My hair is getting much too long. I’d better go to the barber’s shop.

barbershop.en: The new barbershop opened last weekend.
barbershop.zh: 新的理发店上周末开业了。

bare.en: Sarah applied sunscreen to her bare arms before going outside in the sun.
bare.zh: Sarah在出去晒太阳前在她的裸露手臂上涂了些防晒霜。

bargain.en: This antique vase is a real bargain at $50.
bargain.zh: 这个古董花瓶50美元真是一笔划算的买卖。

bark.en: The dog barked loudly and frighteningly.

barrier.en: Please do not cross the barrier.

base.en: The base of the tower is very sturdy.

baseball.en: He has a dream of becoming a professional baseball player.
baseball.zh: 他有一个成为职业棒球运动员的梦想。

basement.en: They turned their basement into a game room.

basic.en: She learned basic survival skills in the army.
basic.zh: 她在军队里学习了基本的生存技巧。

basin.en: She filled the basin with warm water to wash her face.
basin.zh: 她用温水装满盆子来洗脸。

basis.en: The basis of this argument is a set of data from a recent study.
basis.zh: 这个争论的基础是一份来自最近研究的数据。

basket.en: I placed the fruit in the basket and carried it to the kitchen.
basket.zh: 我将水果放在篮子里，然后把它们带到厨房。

basketball.en: We often play basketball after school.
basketball.zh: 我们经常在放学后打篮球。

bat.en: She swung the bat and hit the ball.

bath.en: "After playing outside all day, the children were filthy and needed a bath."
bath.zh: 孩子们在外面玩了一整天，他们很脏，需要洗澡。

bathe.en: I prefer to bathe in the evening.

bathrobe.en: She slipped on her bathrobe and went to answer the door.

bathroom.en: The bathroom in my apartment is quite small.
bathroom.zh: 我公寓中的浴室非常小。

battery.en: I need to change the battery in my watch.
battery.zh: 我需要更换手表的电池。

battle.en: "The soldiers were ready for the battle."

bay.en: The beautiful bay was blue and tranquil.
bay.zh: 那個美麗的海灣蔚藍又平靜。

be.en: I want to be a teacher.

beach.en: We spent the day at the beach.
beach.zh: 我们在海滩上度过了一天。

beam.en: Modern skyscrapers are made with many beams.

bean.en: "I like to add some black beans in my salad."
bean.zh: 我喜欢在我的沙拉中加些黑豆。

beancurd.en: Jenny is intolerant to milk products, so she uses beancurd as a source of protein.
beancurd.zh: 詹妮对牛奶产品不耐受，所以她用豆腐作为蛋白质来源。

bear.en: The grizzly bear is a powerful predator in the forests of North America.
bear.zh: 北美森林里的灰熊是一种强大的捕食者。

beard.en: He has a long, white beard.

beast.en: The lion is a magnificent beast.
beast.zh: 狮子是一种壮丽的野兽。

because.en: I can't go to the concert because I have to work.
because.zh: 我不能去音乐会，因为我要工作。

become.en: "You need to study hard to become a scientist."
become.zh: 你需要努力学习才能成为一名科学家。

bed.en: He lay in bed all morning.
bed.zh: 他整个上午都躺在床上。

bedclothes.en: She changed the bedclothes once a week.
bedclothes.zh: 她每周换一次床上用品。

beddings.en: I bought new beddings for my room.
beddings.zh: 我为我的房间买了新的床上用品。

bee.en: The bee is extracting nectar from the flowers.
bee.zh: 蜜蜂正在从花朵中提取花蜜。

beef.en: My favorite sandwich is roast beef on rye.
beef.zh: 我最喜欢的三明治是黑麦烤牛肉。

beehive.en: The honey is collected from the beehive by the beekeeper.
beehive.zh: 蜂蜜是由养蜂人从蜂巢中收集的。

beer.en: After work, I like to relax with a cold beer.
beer.zh: 下班后，我喜欢喝一杯冰啤酒来放松。

before.en: "I go to bed before 11 pm every day."
before.zh: 我每天都会在晚上11点前上床睡觉。

beg.en: I beg to differ with your opinion.

beginning.en: This is only the beginning of a long journey.
beginning.zh: 这只是长途旅行的开始。

behalf.en: I am speaking on behalf of my community at the city council meeting.
behalf.zh: 我代表我的社区在市议会会议上发言

behave.en: Children should learn to behave properly.
behave.zh: 孩子们应该学会礼貌行为。

behaviour.en: She was very upset about her son's behaviour.
behaviour.zh: 她对儿子的行为感到非常烦恼。

behind.en: He sat behind me in class.

being.en: Maybe there's a being out there made of energy.
being.zh: 也许有一个由能量构成的存在。

belgium.en: I lived in Belgium for five years.
belgium.zh: 我在比利时生活了五年。

belief.en: A preacher or priest should have a strong belief in God.

believe.en: I believe in your ability to complete the task.
believe.zh: 我相信你有能力完成这个任务。

bell.en: The church bell rings every hour.
bell.zh: 教堂的钟每小时都会敲响。

belly.en: "He lay down on his belly to crawl under the house."
belly.zh: 他趴在地上，爬进房子下面。

bench.en: "She sat on the bench and read a book."

beneath.en: The largest part of an iceberg lies beneath the waterline.

beneficial.en: Drinking milk every day is beneficial for your bones.

bent.en: "The stick was bent into a circle."
bent.zh: 那根棍子被弯成了一个圈。

besides.en: "Besides English, what other languages do you speak?"
besides.zh: 除了英语，你还会说哪些语言？

best.en: I got the best score on the math test.

better.zh: 他现在变成一个更好的人了。

betray.en: His nervous glances at the door betrayed his fear.
betray.zh: 他紧张地看向门口，暴露了他的害怕。

beyond.en: I can see a church beyond the houses.
beyond.zh: 我可以看到房子后面的一个教堂。

bicycle.en: I rode my bicycle down the mountain road.

bid.en: I decided to bid on the antique vase.
bid.zh: 我决定对那个古董花瓶出价。

big.en: This is a big decision for our company.
big.zh: 这对我们公司来说是个大决定。

bill.en: Would you please pay the bill? - 你能请付账单吗？

billion.en: There are billions of stars in outer space.

bingo.en: We usually play bingo at the fair.
bingo.zh: 我们通常在集市上玩宾果游戏。

biochemistry.en: "Biochemistry is vital to both modern agriculture and the pharmaceutical industry."
biochemistry.zh: 生物化学对现代农业和制药行业都至关重要。

biography.en: This book is the latest biography of Abraham Lincoln.
biography.zh: 这本书是关于亚伯拉罕·林肯最新的传记。

biology.en: My favorite subject at school is biology.
biology.zh: 我在学校里最喜欢的科目是生物学。

bird.en: "A bird is known by its feathers."

birth.en: "She gave birth to a baby boy."

birthplace.zh: 波士顿是我出生的地方。

biscuit.en: Would you like a biscuit with your tea?
biscuit.zh: 你想在茶点时吃块饼干吗？

bishop.en: The bishop gave a moving sermon on the importance of love and charity.
bishop.zh: 主教做了一个关于爱和慈善重要性的感人演讲。

bit.en: I ate a bit of chocolate before I went to bed.

bitter.en: He was extremely bitter when his computer crashed.

blackboard.en: The teacher wrote the homework on the blackboard.
blackboard.zh: 老师在黑板上写下家庭作业。

blame.en: Don't blame me for your mistakes.
blame.zh: 不要把你的错误怪罪于我

blank.en: He gave me a blank look when I mentioned his name.
blank.zh: 当我提到他的名字时，他给了我一个空洞的眼神。

blanket.en: "She snuggled under the warm blanket, feeling cozy."
blanket.zh: 她舒适地蜷缩在温暖的毯子下。

bleed.en: The soldier bled to death on the battlefield.
bleed.zh: 士兵在战场上失血过多而死

bless.en: "May God bless you and your family."
bless.zh: 愿上帝祝福你和你的家人。

block.en: They built a large office block in the city centre.
block.zh: 他们在市中心建造了一个大型办公楼。

blouse.en: She wore a white silk blouse to the party.
blouse.zh: 她穿了一件白色丝质的上衣去参加派对。

blow.en: The wind blows the leaves off the trees.

board.en: "He is a member of the board of directors."

boat.en: The children are playing with their toy boat.
boat.zh: 孩子们在玩他们的玩具船。

boating.en: "I spent the whole day boating on the lake with my friends."
boating.zh: 我和朋友们在湖上划船划了一整天。

boil.zh: Wait a moment, the water isn't boiling yet.

bomb.en: The bomb will destroy anything that is nearby.

bond.en: The company issued bonds to raise funds for its expansion.
bond.zh: 该公司发行债券以筹集其扩张的资金。

bone.en: My dog loves to gnaw on a bone.

bookcase.en: Can you help me assemble this bookcase?
bookcase.zh: 你能帮我组装这个书架吗？

bookmark.en: I put a bookmark in my book so I won't lose my place.
bookmark.zh: 我在书中放了个书签，这样就不会找不到我读到的地方了。

bookshop.en: I'm going to the bookshop to purchase a novel.

bookstore.en: She works part-time in a bookstore downtown.
bookstore.zh: 她在市中心的一家书店做兼职。

boom.en: The lightning was followed by a loud boom.

boot.en: I put on my boots before going out in the snow.
boot.zh: "我在出门走雪前穿上了我的靴子。"

border.en: The garden is bordered by a row of tall trees.
border.zh: 花园被一排高大的树木所环绕。

boring.en: I think the Internet is boring.

borrow.en: Can I borrow a pencil to use today? I’ll give it back to you tomorrow.

boss.en: "I have a meeting with my boss tomorrow."
boss.zh: 我明天有个与老板的会议。

botanical.en: This botanical garden is home to a vast range of plants.
botanical.zh: 这个植物园拥有各种各样的植物。

bottle.en: He filled the bottle with water.

bottom.en: The boy fell to the bottom of the stairs.

bounce.en: "The ball will bounce if you drop it."
bounce.zh: 如果你把球掉下来，它会弹起来。

bound.en: We are bound by law to protect the innocent.
bound.zh: 我们受法律约束，要保护无辜者

boundary.en: This fence shows the boundary between our yard and yours.

bow.en: As a violinist, he uses a bow to play the strings.
bow.zh: 作为一位小提琴家，他使用弓来拉弦。

bowl.en: He ate a bowl of rice for lunch.

bowling.en: "Are you free tonight? Let's go bowling."
bowling.zh: 你今晚有空吗? 我们去打保龄球吧。

boy.en: The boy is playing in the park.

boycott.en: Many people are calling for a boycott of the company's products.
boycott.zh: 很多人正在呼吁抵制该公司的产品。

brain.en: You must use your brain to solve the problem.

brake.en: "Please press the brake gently to avoid a sudden stop."
brake.zh: 请轻轻踩下刹车以避免突然停车。

branch.en: The monkey was hanging from a branch on the tree.

brave.en: The brave firefighter saved the girl from the burning building.

bravery.en: His bravery in the face of danger was admirable.
bravery.zh: 他面对危险的勇气令人钦佩。

bread.en: You need two pieces of bread to make a sandwich.

break.en: Don't run with the scissors. You might trip and break the vase.
break.zh: 不要拿着剪刀跑，你可能会绊倒并打碎花瓶

breakfast.en: I had breakfast at seven o'clock this morning.
breakfast.zh: 我今天早上七点吃的早餐。

breathe.en: Don't forget to breathe when you're working out.
breathe.zh: 当你锻炼身体的时候，不要忘记呼吸

brick.en: The house was built of brick.

bride.en: The bride looked stunning in her white dress.
bride.zh: 新娘穿着她的白色婚纱看起来非常迷人。

bridegroom.en: "The bridegroom seemed nervous as he awaited his bride at the altar."
bridegroom.zh: 新郎在祭坛前等待新娘时看似紧张。

bridge.en: They're building a new bridge over the river.

brief.en: He gave me a brief description of the plan.
brief.zh: 他给我简单描述了一下计划。

bright.en: The sun is very bright today.

brilliant.en: "The stars are brilliant in the clear night sky."
brilliant.zh: 清晰的夜空中，星星显得愈发璀璨。

british.zh: 这是一辆英国制造的汽车。

broad.en: The river is very long and broad.

broadcast.en: The radio station will broadcast the concert live tonight.
broadcast.zh: 电台将在今晚直播音乐会。

brochure.en: The travel agency produces a wide range of brochures covering all kinds of vacations.
brochure.zh: 旅行社制作了各种涵盖所有假期类型的小册子。

broom.en: She's in the kitchen, sweeping the floor with a broom.

brother.zh: 我的兄弟是一名工程师。

brunch.en: My favorite Sunday activity is having brunch with my family.
brunch.zh: 我最喜欢的周日活动是和家人一起吃早午餐。

brush.en: _You should brush your teeth twice a day._

bucket.en: "He filled the bucket with water from the well."
bucket.zh: 他从井里打水，将桶装满了。

budget.en: "We need to cut our household budget by 10 percent next month."
budget.zh: 我们下个月需要将家庭预算削减10%。

buffet.en: Let's meet at the buffet for lunch.
buffet.zh: 让我们在自助餐厅见面吃午饭。

bun.en: She bought a cinnamon bun from the bakery.
bun.zh: 她从面包店买了一个肉桂面包。

bunch.en: She gave me a bunch of grapes.

burden.en: The burden of proof is on the prosecutor.

bureaucratic.en: Our attempt to get a permit was slowed down by bureaucratic red tape.
bureaucratic.zh: 我们办理许可证的过程被官僚主义的繁文缛节拖延了。

burial.en: "The burial took place in the local cemetery."
burial.zh: 葬礼在当地的公墓举行。

burst.en: The bomb burst over the city.

bury.en: We decided to bury him in the backyard.
bury.zh: 我们决定在后院埋葬他。

bus.en: I usually take the bus to work.

bush.en: There are many bushes in the park.

business.en: He's in the telephone business - 他从事电话业务。

businessman.en: My father is a successful businessman.
businessman.zh: 我父亲是一个成功的商人。

businesswoman.en: She is a successful businesswoman who runs a large company.
businesswoman.zh: 她是一名成功的女商人，经营着一家大公司。

busy.en: She is too busy to go to the party.
busy.zh: 她太忙了，没有时间去参加聚会。

but.en: "She is pretty but she is not kind."
but.zh: 她很漂亮，但是她不善良。

butcher.en: The butcher is cutting the chops with a keen knife.
butcher.zh: 那位屠夫正在用一把锋利的刀切肉排。

butter.en: Could you pass the butter, please?

butterfly.en: The caterpillar transforms into a butterfly.
butterfly.zh: 毛毛虫变成了一只蝴蝶。

button.en: "He pushed the button to turn on the TV."
button.zh: 他按下按钮打开了电视。

cab.en: Can I catch a cab at this hour?
cab.zh: 这个时间我能打到出租车吗？

cafe.en: Let's meet at the cafe on the corner after work.
cafe.zh: 我们下班后在街角的咖啡馆见面。

cage.en: The bird can't escape from the cage.
cage.zh: 那只鸟无法从笼子里逃脱。

calculate.en: You can use this app to calculate your calorie intake.
calculate.zh: 你可以使用这个应用程序来计算你的热量摄取。

call.zh: 在工作时间请别打电话给我。

camel.en: The camel is an animal that can go for long periods without drinking water.
camel.zh: 骆驼是一种可以长时间不饮水的动物。

camera.en: "I bought a new camera for my photography class."
camera.zh: 我为我的摄影课买了一台新的相机。

camp.en: We set up a camp in the woods for the night.
camp.zh: 我们在森林里扎了一个营地过夜。

campaign.en: The company launched a new ad campaign to promote its brand.
campaign.zh: 公司发起了一场新的广告活动来推广其品牌。

can.en: As a verb: I can swim very well.

canada.en: I have always wanted to visit Canada.
canada.zh: 我一直想要去加拿大旅游。

canal.en: The ship sailed along the canal.

cancel.en: I had to cancel my appointment because of the urgent meeting.
cancel.zh: 因为紧急会议，我不得不取消我的约会。

cancer.en: He is diagnosed with lung cancer.

candidate.en: I believe I am a suitable candidate for the position.
candidate.zh: 我相信我是这个职位的合适人选。

candle.en: I lit a candle and read until dawn.
candle.zh: 我点燃一根蜡烛，读书到天亮。

candy.en: I love eating candy, especially chocolate.
candy.zh: 我喜欢吃糖果，尤其是巧克力。

canteen.en: 在学校的hours，我们通常在canteen吃中午餐。
canteen.zh: 在学校的时间里，我们通常在食堂吃午餐

cap.en: He is putting on a cap.

capital.en: Please write your name in capital letters.
capital.zh: 请用大写字母写你的名字。

capsule.en: He stores the old film in a time capsule.
capsule.zh: 他将旧的胶片存放在时间胶囊中。

captain.en: He was made captain of the ship.
captain.zh: 他成为了这艘船的船长。

caption.en: The caption under the picture identified the people. 图片下的标题标明了人的身份。
caption.zh: 在此，caption 是对图片进行解说的文字

carbon.en: Diamonds and graphite are both forms of carbon.
carbon.zh: 钻石和石墨都是碳的形式。

card.en: He paid for his meal with a credit card.
card.zh: 他用信用卡支付了餐费。

care.en: As a parent, you should take care of your children.
care.zh: 作为父母，你应该照顾你的孩子。

careless.en: You were careless to leave the door unlocked.
careless.zh: 你太粗心，竟然把门忘记锁了。

carpenter.en: We hired a carpenter to make a cupboard.

carpet.en: His white living room carpet was soft.

carriage.en: The royal family arrived in a grand carriage.
carriage.zh: 王室家族乘坐豪华马车抵达。

carrot.en: I bought a bag of carrots at the supermarket.
carrot.zh: 我在超市买了一袋胡萝卜。

cartoon.en: Sometimes, people draw cartoons for the newspaper.

carve.en: My father usually carves the turkey for Thanksgiving.

case.en: A deposit of $1,000 is required, but in this case, we will accept half.

cash.en: I don't have enough cash on me to pay for the dinner.
cash.zh: 我身上没有足够的现金来付餐费。

cast.en: The fisherman cast his line into the water.

castle.en: The castle has stood on this hill for over a thousand years.
castle.zh: 这座城堡已经矗立在这座山上超过一千年了。

casual.en: "I wear casual clothes on the weekends."

cat.en: The cat is playing with a ball.

catalogue.en: The library has a vast catalogue of books.
catalogue.zh: 这个图书馆有一个庞大的图书目录。

catastrophe.en: Thousands have been left homeless by the earthquake catastrophe.
catastrophe.zh: 地震灾祸使成千上万的人无家可归。

category.en: "Books in the library are arranged according to their categories."
category.zh: 图书馆的书按照它们的类别进行排列。

cater.en: Bill was too sick to get out of bed, so his nurse catered to his needs.

catholic.en: "I have a catholic taste in music."
catholic.zh: 我喜欢各种各样的音乐。

cathedral.en: The cathedral in our city is a symbol of hope and unity.
cathedral.zh: 我们城市的大教堂是希望和团结的象征

cause.en: His late arrival was caused by the heavy traffic.
cause.zh: 他的迟到是由于交通堵塞引起的

caution.en: Proceed with caution because the road is slippery.
caution.zh: 在路上小心行驶，因为路面很滑。

cautious.en: He is a cautious driver, always obeying the speed limits.
cautious.zh: 他是一个谨慎的司机，总是遵守速度限制。

cave.en: A crystal blue lake could be found in the underground cave.

cd.en: I bought a new music CD yesterday.
cd.zh: 我昨天买了一张新的音乐光盘。

ceiling.en: He painted the ceiling with a special roller.

celebrate.en: We all celebrated when we heard the great news.

celebration.en: The town held a grand celebration for its 200th anniversary.
celebration.zh: 这个城镇为它的200周年纪念举行了盛大的庆祝活动。

cell.en: "A single human body has millions of cells."
cell.zh: 一个人体有数以百万计的细胞。

centigrade.en: During the spring time, the temperature gets as warm as 26 degrees centigrade.

central.en: The park is central to the city.
central.zh: 那个公园位于城市的中心。

center.en: The city center is full of people.

century.en: Our company is celebrating a century of business in London.

ceremony.en: The university will hold a commencement ceremony for the graduates.
ceremony.zh: 大学将为毕业生举行毕业典礼。

certain.en: I am certain that he will come.

certainly.en: "I will certainly finish my homework tonight."
certainly.zh: 我今晚肯定会完成作业。

certificate.en: I was given a certificate for completing the computer course.

chair.en: Please take a seat on the chair.

chairman.en: He was elected chairman of the committee.

chalk.en: He wrote the equation on the blackboard with a piece of chalk.
chalk.zh: 他用一支粉笔在黑板上写下了这个等式。

challenge.en: This job is a big challenge for him.
challenge.zh: 对他来说，这份工作是一项大挑战。

chance.en: I had a chance to see the Coliseum in Rome last summer.

change.en: Our teacher wants us to change our attitude towards study.
change.zh: 我们的老师希望我们改变对学习的态度。

channel.en: The channel between England and France is called the English Channel.
channel.zh: 英格兰和法国之间的海峡叫做英吉利海峡。

chant.en: The crowd began to chant the team's name.
chant.zh: 人群开始呼喊队伍的名字。

chaos.en: His presentation was in chaos. I couldn’t understand what he meant.

character.en: My sister’s character is fun and very outgoing.

characteristic.en: "One characteristic of the lion is its powerful roar."
characteristic.zh: 狮子的一个特征就是它强大的咆哮。

charge.en: "That restaurant charges too much for their food."
charge.zh: 那家餐厅的食物价格太贵。

chapter.en: "Please read Chapter 3 before the next class."
chapter.zh: 请在下节课前阅读第三章。

chart.en: The professor explained the new concept by drawing a chart.
chart.zh: 教授通过画图表来讲解新的概念。

chat.en: Even though they were far apart, the couple chatted every day.

cheat.en: "He was caught cheating on the test."
cheat.zh: 他在考试中作弊被抓住了。

check.en: You should check your answers before submitting the test.
check.zh: 在交卷前，你应该检查一下你的答案。

cheek.en: Her cheeks turned pink with embarrassment.
cheek.zh: 她因为尴尬而脸颊发红。

cheer.en: The crowd gave a loud cheer when the team scored a goal.
cheer.zh: 球队进球时，人群发出了热烈的欢呼。

cheerful.en: She has a cheerful outlook on life.
cheerful.zh: 她对生活充满了快乐的期待。

chef.en: Tom is a chef at the restaurant near my house.

chemical.en: The factory produces a variety of chemicals.
chemical.zh: 这家工厂生产各种化学品。

chemist.en: "The chemist is testing the ph level of the solution."
chemist.zh: 化学家正在测试溶液的酸碱度。

chemistry.en: In chemistry class, the professor taught us about chemical reactions.

chest.en: He put the jewellery in a small chest.
chest.zh: 他把珠宝放在一个小箱子里。

chew.en: You should chew your food carefully before swallowing.
chew.zh: 吞咽之前你应该仔细咀嚼食物。

chick.en: The mother hen is looking after her chicks.
chick.zh: 母鸡正在照顾她的小鸡。

chicken.en: Chicken is his favorite kind of meat.

chief.en: The chief led the people through the mountains.

child.en: Every child is an artist. The problem is how to remain an artist once he grows up.
child.zh: 每个孩子都是一个艺术家，问题在于他长大后如何仍然保持艺术家的心态。

chimney.en: Smoke was billowing out of the chimney.

chinese.en: I would like to learn Chinese.

chips.en: He bought a bag of potato chips at the convenience store.
chips.zh: 他在便利店买了一袋薯片。

choice.en: You have a choice between tea and coffee.
choice.zh: 你可以在茶和咖啡间做选择。

choir.en: She sings soprano in the church choir.
choir.zh: 她在教堂唱诗班中演唱女高音。

choke.en: He almost choked on a piece of bread.
choke.zh: 他几乎被一块面包闷到。

church.en: On Sundays, people often go to the church for service.
church.zh: 周日，人们常常去教堂做礼拜。

cigar.en: He enjoys a cigar after dinner.
cigar.zh: 他饭后喜欢抽一根雪茄。

cigarette.en: He took a long drag on his cigarette and then exhaled slowly.
cigarette.zh: 他深深地吸了一口香烟，然后慢慢地呼出。

cinema.en: My sister enjoys watching movies at the cinema.

circuit.en: The electrician discovered a fault in the circuit.
circuit.zh: 电工发现电路里有故障。

circulate.en: These coins no longer circulate in the marketplace.
circulate.zh: 这些硬币在市场上已经不再流通。

circumstance.en: Given the circumstances, it was the best decision we could have made.
circumstance.zh: 考虑到当时的情况，那是我们能做出来的最好的决策。

circus.en: A circus is coming to our town next month.
circus.zh: 下个月有一个马戏团要来我们小镇。

citizen.en: Carlos was born in Spain. He is a Spanish citizen.

city.en: New York is a sprawling city.
city.zh: 纽约是一个广袤的城市。

civil.en: The country is on the brink of a civil war.
civil.zh: 这个国家正处于内战的边缘。

civilian.en: The war caused immense suffering to the civilian population.
civilian.zh: 这场战争给平民造成了巨大的痛苦。

civilization.en: "The ancient Roman Empire is often regarded as a pinnacle of civilization."
civilization.zh: 古罗马帝国经常被视为文明的巅峰。

clap.en: Everyone started to clap when the performer finished singing.
clap.zh: 当表演者结束演唱时，所有人开始鼓掌。

clarify.en: Could you clarify your earlier statement?
clarify.zh: 你能澄清本你之前的声明吗？

class.en: I have two classes this afternoon.

classic.en: The athlete made a classic mistake-he started running too soon.

classical.en: Beethoven is a composer of classical music.

classify.en: The biologist classified the plant as a completely new species.

classmate.en: Julie and I are classmates at the University of Chicago.
classmate.zh: 我和朱莉是芝加哥大学的同班同学。

classroom.en: This is the cleanest classroom I have ever seen.
classroom.zh: 这是我见过的最干净的教室。

claw.zh: 那只猫伸出了它的爪子。

clay.en: He molded the figure from clay.
clay.zh: 他用黏土塑造了这个形象。

clean.en: We need to keep our environment clean.
clean.zh: 我们需要保持我们的环境干净。

cleaner.en: Jane took a job as a cleaner in a nearby company.
cleaner.zh: 简在附近的一家公司找到了一份清洁工的工作。

clear.en: I need to clear my desk because it is too messy.

clerk.en: The clerk added up her bill for the groceries.

click.en: Click the left mouse button to open the file.
click.zh: 单击鼠标左键以打开文件。

climate.en: The climate in the desert is very hot.

climb.en: He decided to climb the Mount Everest.
climb.zh: 他决定攀登珠穆朗玛峰。

clock.en: The clock on the wall says it's time to leave.
clock.zh: 墙上的时钟表明是时候离开了。

clone.en: Sheep were the first animals to be cloned in a lab.
clone.zh: 羊是第一種在實驗室裡被克隆的動物。

cloth.en: His shirt is made of a very soft type of cloth.

clothes.en: She has no money to buy new clothes.

clothing.en: He packed some clothing for his trip.
clothing.zh: 他为旅行打包了一些衣物。

cloud.en: The sky was filled with white clouds.

cloudy.en: It's a cloudy day, the sun can't be seen at all.
cloudy.zh: "今天是阴天，一点儿都看不见阳光。"

club.en: He joined the chess club at school.
club.zh: 他在学校加入了象棋俱乐部。

clumsy.en: He is clumsy with his hands.

coach.en: As a coach, he led the team to many victories.
coach.zh: 作为教练，他带领队伍赢得了许多胜利。

coal.en: Many power stations burn coal to produce energy.

coast.en: The boat sank near the coast.
coast.zh: 船在靠近海岸的地方沉没了。

coat.en: She left her coat in the car.
coat.zh: 她把她的外套留在了车里。

cock.en: A full-grown cock has a magnificent plume.
cock.zh: 一只成年的公鸡有华丽的羽冠。

cocoa.en: I like to drink hot cocoa in winter.
cocoa.zh: 我喜欢在冬天喝热可可。

coffee.en: I usually start my day with a cup of coffee.
coffee.zh: 我通常一天开始时会喝一杯咖啡。

coin.en: The coach coined the phrase, “There is no ‘I’ in team.”

coke.en: Could you grab me a can of coke from the fridge?
coke.zh: 能从冰箱里给我拿罐可乐吗？

cold.en: The water in the lake is very cold.

collar.en: He turned up the collar of his coat because of the wind.
collar.zh: 他因为刮风把大衣领子翻了起来。

colleague.en: My colleague helped me on the project.
colleague.zh: 我的同事在项目上帮助我。

collection.en: He has a big collection of vintage cars.
collection.zh: 他有一大堆老式汽车收藏。

college.en: She got accepted into a prestigious college.
college.zh: 她被一所知名大学录取了。

collision.en: "There was a big collision at the intersection, but luckily no one was hurt."
collision.zh: 在十字路口发生了一起严重的碰撞，幸运的是没有人受伤。

color.en: What is the color of your shirt?

comb.en: She picked up her comb and began to comb her hair.

combine.en: We must combine our efforts to finish this project on time.
combine.zh: 我们必须合力完成这个项目。

comfort.en: He tried to comfort her when she lost her job.
comfort.zh: 当她失业时，他试图安慰她。

comfortable.en: Will loves his comfortable new sofa.

comment.en: I'd like to hear your comments on this issue.
comment.zh: 我想听听你对这个问题的评论。

commercial.en: The city's commercial activity is thriving.
commercial.zh: 这个城市的商业活动正在蓬勃发展。

commit.en: Seth wanted to go home, but he had committed to finishing the job.

commitment.en: His commitment to the work is very strong.
commitment.zh: 他对工作的承诺十分坚定。

committee.en: The committee has agreed on the proposal.
committee.zh: 委员会已经通过了这项提案。

common.en: "It's a common practice to greet each other with a handshake."
common.zh: 握手问候是一种常见的做法。

communicate.en: It's important to communicate your ideas clearly in a team meeting.
communicate.zh: 在团队会议上，清晰地交流你的想法非常重要。

communism.zh: 共产主义是一个社会经济政治运动。

communist.en: He is a communist and strongly believes in equality and shared ownership.
communist.zh: 他是一个共产主义者，强烈地信仰平等和共享所有权。

companion.en: I always walk to school with my companion Frank.

company.en: I want to work for a small software company.

compare.en: "Can you compare these two dresses and tell me which one looks better?"
compare.zh: 你能对比一下这两件连衣裙，告诉我哪一件看起来更好吗？

compensate.en: I had to work extra hours to compensate for the time I had taken off last week.
compensate.zh: 我不得不加班以补偿上周请假的时间。

compete.en: All the kids want to compete in the race.
compete.zh: 所有的孩子都想参加那个比赛。

competence.en: The job was easy because the group had enough competence to do it well.

competition.en: "Our team is preparing for the upcoming competition."
competition.zh: 我们的队伍正在为即将到来的比赛做准备

competitor.en: We have several competitors in the smartphone industry.
competitor.zh: 我们在智能手机行业有几个竞争对手。

complete.en: I just need your signature to make the agreement complete.
complete.zh: 我只需要你的签名来使协议生效。

complex.en: A jigsaw puzzle can be complex because it has so many pieces.

component.en: "Each component of this machine must function correctly for it to work."
component.zh: 这台机器的每个部件都必须正常工作才能运行。

composition.en: The composition of the committee has been the subject of intense debate.
composition.zh: 委员会的组成一直是激烈争论的主题。

compromise.en: We made a compromise to stop arguing about it.
compromise.zh: 我们做出了妥协，停止了争吵。

compulsory.en: "It is compulsory for all motorists to wear seatbelts."
compulsory.zh: 所有的驾驶员都必须系安全带。

concentrate.en: I find it hard to concentrate with so much noise around.
concentrate.zh: 我发现在有这么多噪音的环境中很难集中注意力。

concept.en: The concept of infinity is hard to grasp.

concern.en: "She concerns herself with other people's business too much."
concern.zh: 她过于关心别人的事情。

concert.en: I am going to a rock concert tonight.
concert.zh: 我今晚要去看一场摇滚音乐会。

conclude.en: I saw crumbs on my dog’s face, so I concluded that he ate my cookie.

conclusion.en: After much discussion, we came to the conclusion that we should go ahead with the plan.
conclusion.zh: 经过深思熟虑后，我们得出结论应该继续这个计划。

concrete.en: We need a concrete plan to solve this issue.
concrete.zh: 我们需要一个具体的计划来解决这个问题。

condition.en: The patient’s condition was very good.

condemn.en: The mayor was quick to condemn the terrorist attack.
condemn.zh: 市长快速谴责了恐怖袭击。

conduct.en: He was criticized for his unprofessional conduct.
conduct.zh: 他因为不专业的行为而受到批评。

conductor.en: The conductor raised his baton and the orchestra began to play.
conductor.zh: 指挥家举起了指挥棒，乐队开始演奏。

confident.en: She was confident she could climb the mountain due to her training.

confidential.en: She asked me to keep the information confidential.
confidential.zh: 她要求我保密这个信息。

confirm.en: "Could you confirm the time of our meeting tomorrow?"
confirm.zh: 你能确认一下我们明天开会的时间吗？

conflict.en: The siblings were in constant conflict over their inheritance.
conflict.zh: 这几个兄弟姐妹为了继承问题经常发生冲突。

confuse.en: I must confess that I'm rather confused.
confuse.zh: 我必须承认我相当困惑。

congratulate.en: I want to congratulate you on your promotion.

connect.en: Can you connect my phone to the Wi-Fi?
connect.zh: 你能把我的手机连接到 Wi-Fi 吗？

connection.en: She has a strong connection with her homeland.
connection.zh: 她与自己的故乡有着深厚的联系。

conscience.en: I recycle everything I can, so my conscience is clear!

consensus.en: "There seems to be a general consensus that the law should be changed."
consensus.zh: 似乎大家普遍达成共识，认为应该改变这项法律。

consequence.en: As a consequence of missing my bus, I had to find another way to work.

conservative.en: He has conservative views on the role of the family in society.
conservative.zh: 他对社会中家庭的角色持有保守的观点。

consider.en: You should consider all factors before making a decision.
consider.zh: 你在做决定之前应该考虑所有的因素。

considerate.en: The considerate boy gave his girlfriend a present to cheer her up when she was sad.

consideration.en: I need to give this matter further consideration.
consideration.zh: 我需要对这个问题进一步考虑。

consist.en: The meal consists of four courses.

consistent.en: "He was able to deliver consistent results in his job."
consistent.zh: 他能在工作中产生稳定的成果。

constant.en: His constant chattering is really annoying!
constant.zh: 他不停的闲聊真是让人烦躁！

constitution.en: The constitution of the United States was written in 1787.

construct.en: They plan to construct a new shopping mall in the city.
construct.zh: 他们计划在城市中建造一个新的购物中心。

construction.en: The construction of the new airport will be completed next year.
construction.zh: 新机场的建设将在明年完成。

consult.en: I will consult my accountant to find a way to pay my bills.

consume.en: Jack consumed a whole plate of spaghetti.

contain.en: I have to find something to contain these apples.

contemporary.en: "His theories were contemporary with those of Darwin."
contemporary.zh: 他的理论与达尔文的是同期的。

content.en: The content of the book is quite interesting.
content.zh: 这本书的内容非常有趣。

continent.en: Africa is the second largest continent.

contradict.en: Evidence seems to contradict this point of view.
contradict.zh: 这些证据似乎驳斥了这种观点。

contrary.en: Your actions are contrary to your words.
contrary.zh: 你的行为与你的话语相反。

contribute.en: We decided to contribute money to the new hospital.

control.en: "He lost control of the vehicle and crashed into a tree."
control.zh: 他失去了对车的控制，撞向了一棵树。

convenience.en: I love the convenience of having a swimming pool in my back yard.

convenient.en: The hotel is convenient to all public transportation.
convenient.zh: 酒店交通便利，临近所有公共交通设施。

conversation.en: "I had an interesting conversation with Michael yesterday."
conversation.zh: 昨天我和迈克尔有了一次很有趣的谈话。

convey.en: The teacher uses simple language to convey complex ideas.
convey.zh: 老师使用简单的语言传达复杂的思想。

convince.en: "I finally managed to convince him to come to the party."
convince.zh: 我终于说服他来参加派对了。

cook.en: I want to cook dinner for my family tonight.
cook.zh: 我今晚想为我的家人做晚餐。

cooker.en: My new cooker is much more efficient than the old one.
cooker.zh: 我的新炊具比旧的效率高多了。

cookie.en: He took a cookie from the jar and ate it.
cookie.zh: 他从罐子里拿了一块饼干吃

copy.en: I need a copy of your passport.
copy.zh: 我需要你护照的复印件。

coral.en: The diver admired the beautiful coral under the water.

cordless.en: Many people prefer using a cordless mouse because it offers more freedom of movement.
cordless.zh: 许多人更喜欢使用无线鼠标，因为它提供了更大的移动自由。

corn.en: "Could you please add some corn to the salad?"

corner.en: I found a cat hiding in the corner of the room.
corner.zh: 我发现有只猫藏在房间的角落里。

correct.en: Could you please correct my mistakes in the report?
correct.zh: 请你帮我改正报告中的错误好吗？

correction.en: Please make a correction to this error.
correction.zh: 请对这个错误进行修正。

correspond.en: The boy’s story didn’t correspond with his mother’s version.

corrupt.en: The corrupt official was arrested for bribery.
corrupt.zh: 腐败的官员因贿赂被捕。

cost.en: The cost of a new car is beyond my budget.
cost.zh: 购买一辆新车的费用超出了我的预算。

cottage.en: My grandmother has a peaceful cottage in the countryside.
cottage.zh: 我祖母在乡下有一座安静的小屋.

cotton.en: She is wearing a cotton shirt.
cotton.zh: 她穿着一件棉质的衬衫。

cough.en: Verb: You need to cover your mouth when you cough.
cough.zh: 咳嗽时你需要捂住嘴巴。

counter.en: She ordered a cup of coffee from the counter.

country.en: Their wine trade extends to more than 100 countries.
country.zh: 他们的葡萄酒贸易扩展到100多个国家。

courage.en: The man had the courage to touch the lion.

course.en: I'm taking an English course at the community college.
course.zh: 我在社区学院学习英语课程。

court.en: He stood in the court charged with drunk driving.

courtyard.en: During the summer, the courtyard is a nice place to have lunch.

cousin.en: My cousin looks just like me.

cover.en: We need to cover the swimming pool before it rains.
cover.zh: 我们需要在下雨前把游泳池盖起来。

cow.en: My grandfather has a dairy farm; he owns a lot of cows.
cow.zh: 我的爷爷有一个乳品农场,他有很多牛。

crash.en: The stock market crashed, causing a loss of millions.
crash.zh: 股市崩盘，造成数百万的损失。

crayon.en: She scribbled wildly with her crayon.

cream.en: I put cream in my coffee.

create.en: She created an igloo from blocks of snow.

credit.en: His bank account is in credit, so he has money he can spend.

crime.en: **Crime rates** rise sharply in the city.
crime.zh: 这个城市的**犯罪率**急剧上升。

criminal.en: The police are still looking for the criminals behind the theft.
criminal.zh: 警察还在寻找这起偷窃案背后的罪犯。

crew.en: The crew of the ship successfully fought the storm.
crew.zh: 船上的全体船员成功地挺过了暴风雨。

crop.en: The farmer harvested the crop in autumn.

cross.en: Don't cross the road until the traffic light turns green.
cross.zh: 等待交通灯绿灯亮时再过马路。

crossing.en: Be careful at the crossing, the lights are broken.
crossing.zh: 你在交叉路口要小心，交通灯坏了。

crossroads.en: I'm at a crossroads in my career and I need to make a decision.
crossroads.zh: 我在职业生涯的十字路口，我需要做出决定。

crowd.en: There was a large crowd at the concert.

cry.en: He had a good cry and felt better afterwards.
cry.zh: 他哭了一场, 然后感觉好多了。

cube.en: Please get me some ice cubes to put in my soda.

cubic.en: "He filled the cubic box with books."他把立方形的箱子填满了书。

cuisine.en: I've always been fascinated by Indian cuisine.
cuisine.zh: 我一直被印度菜所吸引。

culture.en: Every country has its own unique culture.
culture.zh: 每个国家都有各自独特的文化。

cup.en: He poured tea into the cup.

cupboard.en: He took a five-pound-note from a teapot inside the cupboard.
cupboard.zh: 他从橱柜内的茶壶里取出一张五磅的钞票。

cure.en: "Doctors are unable to find a cure for this disease."
cure.zh: 医生们无法找到治疗这种疾病的方法。

curious.en: He gave me a curious look.
curious.zh: 他给了我一个好奇的眼神。

currency.en: Currency exchange is a common practice for international travelers.
currency.zh: 对国际旅行者来说，货币兑换是常见的做法。

curriculum.en: The curriculum includes math, science, and English.
curriculum.zh: 课程包括数学，科学和英语。

curtain.en: He shut the window and drew the curtains.

cushion.en: He sat down heavily on the cushion.

custom.en: It's a local custom to give gifts to neighbors during the holiday season.
custom.zh: 这是一个当地的风俗，节日期间给邻居送礼物

customer.en: The customer put a few items in a bag.

customs.en: I was stopped at the customs because my luggage was overweight.
customs.zh: 我在海关被拦下，因为我的行李超重了。

cut.en: He cut the cake into three pieces.

cycle.en: They were caught in a cycle of poverty, lack of education, and unemployment.

dam.en: The dam burst under the pressure of floodwaters.
dam.zh: 大坝在洪水的压力下决堤。

damage.en: The car was damaged in the accident.

danger.en: There is a danger of the pipe bursting if the pressure is too high.
danger.zh: 如果压力过大，管道有爆裂的危险。

dangerous.en: The ice is too thin. It's dangerous to walk on.
dangerous.zh: 冰层太薄了，走在上面很危险。

dare.en: He dared to jump out of the airplane and skydive.

darkness.en: After the sunset, the darkness enveloped the city.
darkness.zh: 日落后，黑暗笼罩了整个城市。

dash.en: He made a dash for the door when he saw the doctor coming.
dash.zh: 他看到医生来了就冲向门口。

data.en: The data is still being analyzed.

database.en: The company has a database of all the names and accounts of their customers.

date.en: 做为时间：“The expiry date of this product is two weeks from now.”
date.zh: 这个产品的过期日期是从现在开始的两周后。

dawn.en: The sky began to lighten with the dawn.
dawn.zh: 天空随着黎明开始变亮。

dead.en: His grandfather has been dead for ten years.
dead.zh: 他的爷爷已经去世十年了。

deadline.en: "The deadline for the submission of our project is tomorrow."
deadline.zh: 我们的项目提交截止日期是明天。

deaf.en: Susan uses sign language because she is deaf.

deal.en: We made a deal with the supplier for regular deliveries.
deal.zh: 我们和供货商达成了一个定期供货的协议。

dear.en: "My dear friend, I hope you're doing well."
dear.zh: 我亲爱的朋友，我希望你一切都好。

death.en: After a long illness, his death was not unexpected.
death.zh: 经过漫长的病痛，他的去世并不出人意料。

debate.en: The presidential debate was broadcasted nationwide.
debate.zh: 总统辩论在全国范围内播放。

debt.en: He is in serious debt and needs to find a way out.
debt.zh: 他欠了很多债，需要找到解决的方法。

decade.en: She has been working in this company for a decade.
decade.zh: 她在这家公司工作了十年。

december.en: The last day of the year is December 31st.

decide.en: "I can't decide between the two options."
decide.zh: 我在两个选项之间无法做出决定。

decision.en: I support your decision to go back to school.
decision.zh: 我支持你回学校的决定。

declare.en: I declared my love for him.

decline.en: As a verb: "I decided to decline his invitation to the party."
decline.zh: 我决定拒绝他的聚会邀请。

decorate.en: Have you decorated the room for Christmas yet?

decoration.en: We put up decorations for the Christmas season.
decoration.zh: 我们为圣诞季节布置了装饰品。

decrease.en: The government aims to decrease unemployment by 5% this year.
decrease.zh: 政府计划今年将失业率降低5%。

deed.en: When she bought the car, she was given a deed to show the car was hers.

deep.en: The lake is very deep, be careful.

deer.en: "I saw a deer in the forest."
deer.zh: 我在森林中看见了一只鹿

defeat.en: Our team will never accept defeat.
defeat.zh: 我们的队伍永不接受失败。

degree.en: He has a degree in business administration.
degree.zh: 他有一个工商管理学位。

delay.en: As a verb： "Please don't delay your decision. It's important we act soon."
delay.zh: 请不要推迟你的决定，我们需要尽快采取行动。

delete.en: Please delete my name from the list.
delete.zh: 请把我的名字从名单中删除。

delicate.en: You should hold the baby carefully because she’s very delicate.

delicious.en: I loved the delicious fried chicken I ate for dinner!

delight.en: The children's laughter was a delight to hear.
delight.zh: 听到孩子们的笑声真是一种乐趣。

deliver.en: The man delivered Chinese food to my house.

demand.en: 名词用法："There is a high demand for skilled workers in the tech industry."
demand.zh: 科技行业对技术熟练的工人需求很大。

dentist.en: I have a dentist appointment next week.
dentist.zh: 我下周有一个牙医预约。

department.en: He works in the marketing department.

departure.en: The plane is scheduled for an early morning departure.

depend.en: I depend on you to take care of the kids this weekend.
depend.zh: 这个周末我指望你照顾孩子。

deposit.en: He made a deposit of $1,000 into his account.
deposit.zh: 他在他的账户中存了一千美元。

describe.en: Can you describe him to me?
describe.zh: 你能讲讲他长什么样子吗？

description.en: The artist gave a detailed description of his painting process.
description.zh: 这位艺术家详细描述了他的绘画过程。

desert.en: The Sahara is the largest desert in the world.
desert.zh: 撒哈拉是世界上最大的沙漠。

deserve.en: You deserve a medal for your kindness.
deserve.zh: 你因善良应该得到一枚奖章。

design.en: The sleek design of the phone makes it very appealing.
design.zh: 手机的流线型设计使其非常吸引人。

desire.en: My sister desires a big house and lots of money.

desk.en: She put the books on her desk.

desperate.en: He felt desperate when he lost his job.
desperate.zh: 他在失去工作时感到绝望。

dessert.en: For dessert, we have a choice of fruit or cheese.
dessert.zh: 甜点部分，我们可以选择水果或者奶酪。

destination.en: Our final destination is Paris, but we'll be stopping in London and Berlin on the way.
destination.zh: 我们的最终目的地是巴黎，但我们会在途中停靠伦敦和柏林。

destroy.en: We must destroy all the documents.
destroy.zh: 我们必须销毁所有的文件。

detective.en: He is a detective in the police department.
detective.zh: 他是警察局的一名侦探。

determination.en: Chris is the youngest competitor, but he has the most determination.

determine.en: "The examination results will determine whether she can get into the university."
determine.zh: 考试结果将决定她能否进入大学。

develop.en: We need to develop a marketing strategy for our new product.
develop.zh: 我们需要为我们的新产品开发一种营销策略。

devote.en: She decided to devote her life to helping the poor.
devote.zh: 她决定将自己的生命献给帮助穷人。

devotion.en: His devotion to his wife and family is remarkable.
devotion.zh: 他对妻子和家庭的奉献是惊人的。

diagram.en: By following the diagram, I was able to put the desk together.

dial.en: I looked at the dial to see what time it was.

diamond.en: She admired the diamond necklace in the jewelry store.
diamond.zh: 她在珠宝店里欣赏那条钻石项链。

diary.en: "She writes in her diary every night before bed."
diary.zh: 她每晚睡前都会在日记里写东西。

dictation.en: The teacher gave a dictation to the students.
dictation.zh: 老师给了学生们一个听写。

dictionary.en: I always keep a dictionary at hand for reference.
dictionary.zh: 我总是手边备有一本字典以备查阅。

die.en: He died of a heart attack.

diet.en: I need to go on a diet to lose weight.
diet.zh: 我需要节食以减轻体重。

differ.en: The views of the critics differ regarding this movie.
differ.zh: 对于这部电影，评论家的观点存在分歧。

difference.en: The one difference between the twins is that one has freckles.
difference.zh: 这对双胞胎唯一的不同点是其中一人有雀斑。

different.en: They have different views on the subject.
different.zh: 他们对这个主题有不同的观点。

difficult.en: It's difficult to climb a mountain without any training.
difficult.zh: 没有任何训练就爬山很难。

digest.en: The food was hard to digest.

digital.en: Students prefer to take notes on their laptops and other digital devices.

dignity.en: Everyone deserves to be treated with dignity.
dignity.zh: 每个人都应得到尊严的对待。

dilemma.en: Choosing either the tastier or healthier drink proved to be quite a dilemma.

dimension.en: "The dimensions of the room are 20 feet by 15 feet."
dimension.zh: 房间的尺寸是20英尺乘以15英尺。

dine.en: The young couple dined at their home.

dinner.en: I had a hamburger for dinner.

dinosaur.en: I like to see the dinosaur bones at the museum.

dioxide.en: Carbon dioxide is a greenhouse gas that contributes to global warming.
dioxide.zh: 二氧化碳是一种造成全球变暖的温室气体。

diploma.en: He finally received his high school diploma.
diploma.zh: 他终于拿到了高中毕业证书。

direct.en: The green path is a direct route to my house.

direction.en: "The wind is blowing in a northwestern direction."

director.en: "The director of the movie received a lot of accolades for his work."
director.zh: 电影导演因他的作品受到了很多赞誉。

directory.en: You can find the restaurant's phone number in the directory.
directory.zh: 你可以在目录中找到这个餐厅的电话号码。

dirt.en: Can you wipe the dirt off your shoes before you come in?
dirt.zh: 在你进来前能擦掉鞋上的泥土吗？

disability.en: He suffered an injury that caused a permanent disability.
disability.zh: 他受到的伤导致了永久的残疾。

disabled.en: The disabled man used a wheelchair to move around.

disadvantage.en: Mike had a disadvantage in the race since he hurt his knee.

disagree.en: I disagree with your argument that technology is making society more isolated.
disagree.zh: 我不同意你的观点，即技术正在使社会更加孤立。

disagreement.en: There is a disagreement on the methodology of the research.
disagreement.zh: 关于研究的方法论存在分歧。

disappoint.en: Don't let the bad news disappoint you.
disappoint.zh: 不要让坏消息让你失望。

disaster.en: The earthquake was a disaster, causing loss of life and property.
disaster.zh: 这次地震是一场灾难，导致了人员伤亡和财产损失。

discount.en: "The store offers a 10% discount to all new customers."
discount.zh: 这家店对所有新客户提供10%的折扣。

discourage.en: His failure did not discourage him from trying again.
discourage.zh: 他的失败并没有打消他再次尝试的想法。

discover.en: I hope to discover a new hobby this year.
discover.zh: 我希望今年能发现一个新的爱好。

discovery.en: The discovery of electricity changed the world.

discuss.en: We need to discuss your performance at work.
discuss.zh: 我们需要讨论你的工作表现。

disease.en: He had a disease that caused him to lose his hearing.

disgusting.en: His table manners are absolutely disgusting.
disgusting.zh: 他的餐桌礼仪简直令人作呕。

dish.en: "She cooked a dish of chicken for dinner."
dish.zh: 她做了一个鸡肉菜肴作为晚餐。

dismiss.en: He quickly dismissed my idea about the new project.

disobey.en: You must not disobey your teacher.

distance.en: The distance between New York and Los Angeles is about 2,450 miles.
distance.zh: 新约克和洛杉矶之间的距离大约是2,450英里。

distinction.en: There is a sharp distinction between the rich and the poor in this country.
distinction.zh: 在这个国家里，富人与穷人之间有着明显的区别。

distinguish.en: It's important to distinguish fact from opinion.
distinguish.zh: 重要的是要区分事实和观点。

distribute.en: The organization will distribute food to the poor.
distribute.zh: 这个组织会向穷人分发食物

district.en: This district is known for its rich historical background.
district.zh: 这个地区以其丰富的历史背景而闻名。

disturb.en: The loud noise disturbed me while I was working.

dive.en: I like sky-diving from an airplane.

diverse.en: The students in this school come from diverse backgrounds.
diverse.zh: 这所学校的学生来自多元化的背景。

divide.en: We have to divide the cake into eight pieces.
divide.zh: 我们需要把蛋糕分成八块。

division.en: "The company announced a division of its business."

divorce.en: The couple finally settled their divorce amicably.
divorce.zh: 这对夫妻最终友好地解决了他们的离婚问题。

dizzy.en: He felt dizzy and had to sit down.
dizzy.zh: 他感到头晕，不得不坐下。

do.en: "What do you do for a living?"

doctor.en: My brother is a doctor at the local hospital.
doctor.zh: 我弟弟是我们当地医院的医生。

document.en: You need to sign the document before we can proceed.
document.zh: 你需要在文件上签字，我们才能继续。

dog.en: The dogs are barking loudly in the yard.
dog.zh: 院子里的狗在吠得很响

doll.en: "My little sister has a collection of dolls from different countries."
doll.zh: 我的妹妹有一个来自不同国家的洋娃娃收藏。

dollar.zh: 这件衬衫成本是二十美元。

dormitory.en: I will move into the dormitory at the beginning of the school year.

double.en: You'd better double-check your work before you submit it.
double.zh: 你最好在提交工作之前再检查一次。

doubt.en: I have no doubt about his honesty.

download.en: You can download the application from the App Store.
download.zh: 你可以从App Store下载这个应用。

downtown.en: The downtown area is filled with many tall buildings.

dozen.en: He sent me a dozen roses for my birthday.
dozen.zh: 他在我的生日那天送了我一打玫瑰。

draft.en: He is working on the draft of his speech for the conference.
draft.zh: 他正在准备会议的发言草稿

drag.en: The dog was dragging his owner down the street.

drawback.en: The main drawback of the plan is its cost.
drawback.zh: 计划的主要缺点是其成本。

drawer.en: He searched for his glasses in the drawer. 他在抽屉里找他的眼镜。

drawing.en: She is very good at drawing.

dream.en: I had a strange dream last night.
dream.zh: 我昨晥做了个奇怪的梦。

dress.en: She wore a beautiful dress to the party.
dress.zh: 她穿了一件漂亮的连衣裙去参加派对。

drill.en: The carpenter used the drill to make several holes in the wood.

drink.en: I would like a drink of water.

driver.en: The driver was going too fast.

drop.en: A small amount of water dropped from the bottle.

drown.en: He would have drowned if the sailors had not rescued him.

drum.en: He played a beat on the drum.

drunk.en: I don't like acting silly when I'm drunk.
drunk.zh: 我不喜欢在醉酒时表现得傻傻的。

dry.en: Please don't water the plants too much, they prefer a dry soil.
dry.zh: 请不要过度浇灌这些植物，它们更适应干燥的土壤。

duck.en: \*名词：“The duck swims in the lake.”

due.en: The assignment is due next Monday.

dull.en: The movie was very dull. I fell asleep watching it.

during.en: Did you sleep during the movie?

dusk.en: We finished our work at dusk.
dusk.zh: 我们在黄昏时分完成了工作。

dust.en: (名词)There's a lot of dust on the bookshelf.

dustbin.en: Please put the rubbish in the dustbin.

dusty.en: The road was dry and dusty.

duty.en: It is parents’ duty to take care of their children.

dynamic.en: "This company is dynamic, it is always adapting to the market trends."
dynamic.zh: 这个公司充满活力，总是能适应市场的变化。

dynasty.en: The Han dynasty was noted for its profound influence on Chinese history.
dynasty.zh: 汉朝以其对中国历史的深远影响而著名。

each.en: Each student must submit their own work.
each.zh: 每个学生必须提交他们自己的作品。

eager.en: The man was eager to talk about the good news.

ear.zh: 他在她耳边低语了些什么。

early.en: "He always gets up early in the morning."

earn.en: Mary wants to earn money to pay for her tuition.
earn.zh: 玛丽想要赚钱支付她的学费。

earthquake.en: The city was devastated by a major earthquake.
earthquake.zh: 这个城市遭到了一次大地震的破坏。

ease.en: She felt completely at ease during the interview.
ease.zh: 她在面试期间感觉非常自在。

easily.zh: 他轻而易举地赢得了比赛。

east.en: The sun rises in the east.

easter.en: We gather together with our family every year to celebrate Easter.
easter.zh: 我们每年都与家人聚在一起庆祝复活节。

eastern.en: The sunrise in the eastern sky is spectacular.
eastern.zh: 东方的日出景象壮观无比。

easy.en: Karen is happy because her English homework is easy.

easygoing.en: He's an easygoing person who's fun to be with. 他是个随和的人，和他在一起很有趣。

ecology.en: We study ecology to learn how to help improve the Earth.

edge.en: He ran to the edge of the cliff.

educate.en: It is a parent's duty to educate their children.
educate.zh: 父母有责任教育他们的孩子

educator.en: As an educator, it's important to keep up-to-date with the latest teaching methods.
educator.zh: 作为一个教育者，了解最新的教育方法是很重要的。

education.en: Every child has the right to get education.
education.zh: 每个孩子都有获得教育的权利。

effect.en: The new president will take effect from February.
effect.zh: 新的总统将在二月就职。

effort.en: He made an enormous effort to pass the exam.
effort.zh: 他做出了巨大的努力来通过这场考试。

egg.en: I'm going to make an egg salad for lunch today.
egg.zh: 我今天中午要做个鸡蛋沙拉

eggplant.en: The recipe calls for one eggplant.

egypt.en: I've always wanted to see the pyramids in Egypt.
egypt.zh: 我一直想看埃及的金字塔。

egyptian.en: "Egyptian culture is one of the oldest cultures in the world."
egyptian.zh: 埃及文化是世界上最古老的文化之一。

eight.en: There are eight apples in the basket.

eighteen.zh: 今天是我的十八岁生日。

eighty.en: I bought eighty apples for the party.

either.zh: 两个选项都会带来成功

elder.en: My elder sister is ten years older than me.

elect.en: He was elected as mayor of the city.

electricity.en: Electricity powers our homes and devices.
electricity.zh: 电力供应我们的家园和设备。

electronic.en: This electronic device is very sensitive to temperature.
electronic.zh: 这个电子设备对温度非常敏感。

elephant.en: There's an elephant in the room; we need to address it right now.
elephant.zh: 现在就需要解决如同大象般棘手的问题。

eleven.en: I have eleven apples in my basket.

else.en: I wanted a bike for my birthday, but I got something else.

embarrass.en: He was embarrassed when he couldn’t remember her name.

embassy.en: I had to go to the embassy to renew my passport.
embassy.zh: 我不得不去大使馆续签护照。

emergency.en: She phoned the hospital in an emergency.
emergency.zh: 她在紧急情况下给医院打电话。

emperor.en: Sunshine is the best disinfectant, they say. But Emperor Nero simply didn't care.
emperor.zh: 阳光是最好的消毒剂，他们说。但是，尼禄皇帝就是不在乎。

empire.en: "He built a vast empire that stretched across the globe."
empire.zh: 他建立了横跨全球的庞大帝国。

employ.en: We will employ your services for the duration of the project.
employ.zh: 我们将会在项目期间雇佣你的服务。

encourage.en: My football coach will encourage us when we are losing.

encouragement.en: The mother gives constant encouragement to her son.

end.en: This is the end of the story.

ending.en: The ending of her novel was extremely emotional and left a deep impression on many readers.
ending.zh: 她的小说结尾非常感人，给很多读者留下了深刻的印象。

enemy.en: "In wartime, we always have to be alert to the movments of the enemy."
enemy.zh: 在战时，我们总是要对敌人的动态保持警惕。

energetic.en: He is an energetic young man.
energetic.zh: 他是一个充满活力的年轻人。

energy.en: Solar energy is becoming more and more important as a source of world energy.
energy.zh: 太阳能作为世界能源的重要性越来越高。

engine.en: The engine of the car is overheating.

engineer.en: After engineering the robot, they needed to find the correct parts to build it.

english.en: She is studying English at the university.

enlarge.en: "Can you enlarge this photo for me?"
enlarge.zh: 你能帮我放大这张照片吗？

enquiry.en: I have an enquiry about the flight schedule.
enquiry.zh: 我想咨询一下航班时间。

enter.en: Two guards greeted me as I entered the front door.

enterprise.en: He started his own enterprise right after graduation.
enterprise.zh: 他毕业后就开始了自己的企业。

enthusiastic.en: She was very enthusiastic about the project.
enthusiastic.zh: 她对这个项目充满热情。

entire.en: The entire table was covered with food.

entrance.en: The main entrance to the building is around the corner.
entrance.zh: 大楼的主入口在拐角处。

entry.en: "He made a grand entry at the party."
entry.zh: 他在派对上显眼地登场。

environment.en: We need to take care of our environment.
environment.zh: 我们需要照顾我们的环境。

envy.en: "I couldn't help but feel a twinge of envy when I saw their beautiful new house."
envy.zh: 看到他们美丽的新房子，我情不自禁地感到一丝羡慕。

equal.en: The apple and orange are equal in weight.

equip.en: "The language course aims to equip students with the skills they need for business communication."
equip.zh: 这个语言课程旨在为学生提供他们在商务交流中所需的技能。

equipment.en: The factory produces a wide range of high-tech equipment.

error.en: The computer is showing an error message that I don't understand.
error.zh: 电脑显示出我不明白的错误信息。

erupt.en: The volcano could erupt at any time.

escape.en: She tried to escape from the building.

essay.en: Please write a 200-word essay on this topic.
essay.zh: 请就这个主题写一篇200字的短文。

evaluate.en: Before making a decision, we need to evaluate all the options.
evaluate.zh: 在做决定之前，我们需要评估所有的选择。

event.en: This is a groundbreaking event in the history of science.
event.zh: 这在科学史上是具有划时代意义的事件

eventually.en: He eventually found his keys in the kitchen.
eventually.zh: 他最终在厨房找到了他的钥匙。

ever.en: Have you ever seen a ghost?

every.en: Every child deserves a chance to succeed.
every.zh: 每个孩子都应该有成功的机会。

everybody.en: Everybody is responsible for their own actions.
everybody.zh: 每个人都要对自己的行为负责。

everyone.en: Everyone can make a difference if they try.
everyone.zh: 只要尝试，每个人都可以产生影响。

evidence.en: They found evidence of his innocence in his room.
evidence.zh: 他们在他的房间里发现了他无罪的证据。

evident.en: It's evident that she's not happy with the situation.
evident.zh: 很明显，她对这种情况并不满意。

evolution.en: The evolution of music has led to a variety of new genres.
evolution.zh: 音乐的演进导致了各种新的流派的出现。

exact.en: 形容词："He made an exact copy of the document."
exact.zh: 他做了一份文件的精确复印。

exactly.en: This is exactly what I need.

example.en: Please give me an example of your work.
example.zh: 请举一个你工作的例子。

excellent.en: He has an excellent grasp of the language.

except.en: Everyone went to the party except me.
except.zh: 除了我，大家都去了派对。

exchange.zh: 他们每到圣诞节就互赠礼物。

excite.en: The prospect of a holiday excites me.

excuse.en: He made no excuse for being late. 他对迟到没有借口。

exercise.zh: 常规的运动可以预防心脏病。

exhibition.en: The art gallery is holding an exhibition of Picasso's early works.
exhibition.zh: 那座艺术馆正在举行毕加索早期作品的展览。

existence.en: His doubts cast a shadow over the very existence of the institution.
existence.zh: 他的疑虑给这个机构的存在投下了阴影。

exit.en: The green sign shows where the exit is located.

expand.en: A balloon will expand as you blow air into it.

expect.en: I expect to go to the park this weekend.
expect.zh: 我期待这个周末去公园。

expectation.en: He didn't live up to his parents' expectations.
expectation.zh: 他没有达到父母的期望。

expense.en: She wrote down all the expenses for her trip.

expensive.en: This restaurant is too expensive for my budget.
expensive.zh: 这家餐馆对我的预算来说太贵了。

experience.en: He has five years of teaching experience.

experiment.en: The scientist conducted an experiment to test his hypothesis.
experiment.zh: 科学家进行了一个实验来测试他的假说。

expert.en: The wizard was an expert at magic.

explicit.en: He was explicit in his criticism of the government.
explicit.zh: 他对政府的批评十分直言不讳。

explode.en: "The bomb could explode at any moment."

exploit.en: Many companies are exploiting the intern's cheap labor.
exploit.zh: 许多公司利用实习生的廉价劳动力。

explore.en: We decided to explore the ancient ruins.
explore.zh: 我们决定探索古老的废墟。

export.en: We export a large quantity of coffee to the United States.
export.zh: 我们向美国出口大量的咖啡。

expose.en: "The journalist exposed the scandal in the government."

express.en: The nurse expressed her sympathy for the sick patient.

expression.en: His face was void of any expression.
expression.zh: 他的脸上没有任何表情。

extension.en: "There is an extension to submit the assignment due to the holiday."
extension.zh: 由于假期，作业的提交期限有所延长。

extra.en: "He has an extra ticket to the game."
extra.zh: 他有一张比赛的额外票。

extraordinary.en: The fireman who rescued the girl was extraordinary.

extreme.en: The weather conditions are quite extreme today, with temperatures below zero.
extreme.zh: 今天的天气条件非常极端，气温都在零度以下。

extremely.en: He was extremely tired after the long journey.
extremely.zh: 他在长途旅行后非常疲惫。

eye.zh: 我简直不敢相信我的眼睛。

eyesight.en: He has excellent eyesight, as sharp as an eagle's.
eyesight.zh: 他的视力非常好，尖锐如鹰。

eyewitness.en: I was an eyewitness to the accident.
eyewitness.zh: 我是那场事故的目击者

female.en: She is the only female in her office.
female.zh: 她是办公室里唯一的女性。

facial.en: She has a facial every month to keep her skin healthy.
facial.zh: 她每月都做面部护理，以保持皮肤健康

fact.en: The fact that she was late bothered her deeply.
fact.zh: 她迟到的事实使她深感困扰。

factory.en: The factory produces hundreds of cars each day.
factory.zh: 这个工厂每天生产数百辆汽车。

fade.en: The piece of cloth I found was old and faded.

fail.en: Since he failed to get the job, he was sad.

fair.en: Our teacher is always fair in her grading.
fair.zh: 我们的老师打分总是非常公正。

fairness.en: We should uphold the principle of fairness in every competition.
fairness.zh: 我们应该在每一场比赛中坚守公平的原则。

faith.en: The sick girl had faith in doctors. She knew they would make her better.

false.en: She realized that all his promises were false.
false.zh: 她意识到他所有的承诺都是假的。

familiar.en: The two friends were very familiar with each other.

family.en: There are four people in my family.

famous.en: The Eiffel Tower in Paris is very famous.

fan.en: "She is a big fan of action movies."
fan.zh: 她是动作电影的超级粉丝。

fancy.en: I fancy a cup of coffee.

fantastic.en: The student did a fantastic job on his project and got an award.

fantasy.en: She often escapes from reality into a world of fantasy.
fantasy.zh: 她常常逃离现实，进入幻想的世界。

far.en: It’s far from the east coast to the west coast of America.

fare.en: I don't have enough change for the bus fare.
fare.zh: 我没有足够的零钱支付公车票价。

farmer.en: He's a farmer and spends most of his time in the fields.
farmer.zh: 他是一名农民，大部分时间都在田里度过。

fast.en: "He runs really fast." 他跑得真快。

fasten.en: Please fasten your seatbelts, the flight is about to take off.
fasten.zh: 请系好您的安全带，飞机即将起飞。

fat.en: This cat is too fat, it needs to be on a diet.
fat.zh: 这只猫太胖了，需要节食。

fault.en: It is my fault that the cat ran away. I left the door open.

favour.en: "He did me a great favour by driving me to the airport."
favour.zh: 他开车送我到机场，为我提供了很大的帮助。

favourite.en: Ice cream is my favourite dessert.
favourite.zh: 冰淇淋是我最喜欢的甜点。

fax.en: Could you send the document via fax?
fax.zh: 你能通过传真发送这份文件吗？

fear.en: I fear that we might not get there on time.
fear.zh: 我担心我们可能没有及时到达。

feast.en: We held a grand feast for our guests.
feast.zh: 我们为我们的客人准备了一场盛大的宴会。

feather.en: The bird has beautiful, colorful feathers.
feather.zh: 这只鸟有漂亮的，多彩的羽毛。

federal.en: The federal laws are applicable across the whole country.
federal.zh: 全国范围内都适用联邦法律。

feeling.en: I have a good feeling about this.

ferry.en: The ferry took the people across the lake.

festival.en: The whole town takes part in the annual music festival.
festival.zh: 整个小镇都参加年度音乐节。

fetch.en: "Could you fetch me a glass of water?"

fever.en: He was laid up with a fever.

few.en: I have only a few coins.

fibre.en: High fibre diet helps to prevent constipation.
fibre.zh: "高纤维饮食有助于防止便秘。"

field.en: The farmer ploughed his field for the spring planting.
field.zh: 农民正在犁他的田地，准备春季种植。

fierce.en: The lion is a fierce predator in the jungle.
fierce.zh: 在丛林中，狮子是一种凶猛的掠食者。

fifteen.en: There are fifteen students in class.

fifth.en: John lives on the fifth floor.

fifty.en: There are fifty students in this class.
fifty.zh: 这个班级里有五十名学生。

fighter.en: He's a real fighter and won't give up easily.
fighter.zh: 他是个真正的斗士，不会轻易放弃。

figure.en: The figure was too high for me to afford.
figure.zh: 这个数字对我来说太高了，我负担不起

file.en: Could you please send me the file?

fill.en: Please fill in this form with your details.
fill.zh: 请在此表格上填写你的详细信息。

final.en: The final decision rests with the committee.
final.zh: 最终决定由委员会做出。

finance.en: The world of finance is fast-paced and intense
finance.zh: 金融世界的步伐很快，而且也很激烈。
