fine.en: 形容词：This is a fine piece of artwork.
fine.zh: 这是一幅优良的艺术作品。

finger.en: He cut his finger while chopping vegetables.
finger.zh: 他在切菜时割伤了手指

fingernail.zh: 她把手指甲涂成了红色。

fireplace.en: The room has a cozy fireplace.
fireplace.zh: 这个房间有一个舒适的壁炉。

firewood.en: The firewood is stacked neatly by the fireplace.
firewood.zh: 柴火被整齐地堆放在壁炉边。

firework.en: The night sky was lit up by fireworks.

firm.en: Her decision is firm and she won't change it.
firm.zh: 她的决定很坚定，她不会改变

firmly.en: He firmly believed that he was on the right path.
firmly.zh: 他坚定地相信自己走的是正确的道路。

first.en: This is the first time I've been to New York.
first.zh: 这是我第一次来到纽约。

fisherman.en: The fisherman cast his line into the river.
fisherman.zh: 渔夫把他的鱼线投进了河里。

fist.en: The bully made a fist and threatened to hit the small boy.

fit.en: You need to do exercises everyday to stay fit.
fit.zh: 你需要每天锻炼来保持健康。

fix.en: We need to fix the leaky faucet.
fix.zh: 我们需要修理那个漏水的水龙头。

flag.en: The American flag was flying high in the sky.
flag.zh: 美国国旗在天空中高高飘扬。

flame.en: The candle on the table gave out a bright flame.
flame.zh: 桌子上的蜡烛发出明亮的火焰。

flaming.en: Her hair was a flaming red.

flash.en: A flash of lightning illuminated the sky.

flashlight.en: We took a flashlight when we went camping.

flat.en: The land in this area is really flat.
flat.zh: 这个地区的土地真的很平坦。

flee.en: When the earthquake happened, everyone started to flee for safety.
flee.zh: 地震发生时，每个人都开始逃离以求安全。

flexible.en: The tree branch was so flexible it could be bent into a circle and not break.

flesh.en: Be careful not to cut into the flesh when peeling the apple.
flesh.zh: 削苹果时要小心不要削到果肉

float.en: The boy’s toy boat floated in the pool.

flood.en: Floodwaters inundated the town. 洪水淹没了这个城镇。

flour.en: I need a cup of flour to make this cake.
flour.zh: 我需要一杯面粉来制作这个蛋糕。

flow.en: The water flowed over the rocks and into the lake.

flower.en: She gave pink flowers to her grandmother.

flu.en: Many people get a flu shot before winter.
flu.zh: 很多人在冬天之前打流感疫苗。

fluent.en: She was so fluent in German that you’d have thought she was from Germany.

focus.en: We should focus on the task at hand.
focus.zh: 我们应该专注于手头的任务。

fog.en: The morning fog obscured their view of the lake.
fog.zh: 早晨的雾使他们无法看清湖面。

foggy.en: It's so foggy outside that I can hardly see anything.
foggy.zh: 外面很雾，我几乎看不到任何东西。

fold.en: （动词）Please fold the clothes and put them in the drawer.
fold.zh: 请把衣服叠好，然后放进抽屉。

following.en: 注意看我接下来说的话。
following.zh: Pay attention to what I say in the following.

fond.en: The mother cow was very fond of her lovely little calf.

food.en: We shall have to buy some food for dinner.
food.zh: 我们得买一些晚餐的食物。

football.en: Football is a popular sport in the United States.

forbid.en: I forbid you to go out at night.

force.en: The company used force to acquire the small startup.
force.zh: 这家公司用力量收购了小型创业公司。

forecast.en: The weather forecast says it's going to rain tomorrow.
forecast.zh: 天气预报说明天会下雨。

foreign.en: He has travelled widely in foreign countries.

foreigner.en: As a foreigner, it took me some time to get used to the local customs.
foreigner.zh: 作为一个外国人，我花了一些时间来适应当地的风俗习惯。

foresee.en: The teacher didn’t foresee any problems with his large class.

forever.en: Michelle and Tanya want to be best friends forever.

forget.en: Don't forget your umbrella. It's raining.
forget.zh: 不要忘记你的雨伞，正在下雨。

forgive.en: I find it hard to forgive his rudeness.
forgive.zh: 中文：我发现很难原谅他的粗鲁。

format.en: Our report should be presented in the standard format.
format.zh: 我们的报告应按照标准格式呈现。

former.en: Bob is a former student of this university.
former.zh: Bob 是这所大学的前任学生。

fortnight.en: I will be going on vacation for a fortnight.

fortunate.en: He was fortunate to escape unhurt.

fortune.en: I have good fortune when I play cards.

forward.en: When he saw his mother, the baby crawled forward to her.

found.en: 他在2001年成立了这家公司。

fountain.en: There was a beautiful fountain in the middle of the park.

four.en: There are four seasons in a year.

fourteen.en: He has lived in this city for fourteen years.
fourteen.zh: 他在这个城市已经生活了十四年。

fourth.en: "He arrived on the fourth of May."

france.en: I have always dreamed of visiting France.
france.zh: 我一直梦想着去法国旅游。

fragile.en: "This antique vase is very fragile, so handle it with care."
fragile.zh: 这个古董花瓶非常脆弱，所以要小心把握。

framework.en: The house has a wooden framework.
framework.zh: 这个房子有一个木制的框架。

free.en: "You are free to choose your own path."
free.zh: 你有权选择自己的道路。

freeway.en: We took the freeway to get there faster.
freeway.zh: 我们走高速公路以更快地到达那里。

freeze.en: I forgot to bring my coat and nearly froze to death.
freeze.zh: 我忘了带外套，差点冻死。

french.en: I'm learning French because I want to travel to France someday.
french.zh: 我正在学法语，因为我有一天希望能去法国旅行。

frenchman.en: "He is a Frenchman living in London."
frenchman.zh: 他是一个住在伦敦的法国人。

frequent.en: This bus route is very frequent.
frequent.zh: 这个公交路线非常频繁。

fresh.en: The apples are fresh from the farm.
fresh.zh: 这些苹果是刚从农场送过来的。

friction.en: The friction between the brake and the wheel slows the car.
friction.zh: 刹车和轮胎间的摩擦使车减速了。

friendship.en: Michael and Lisa have a very strong friendship with each other.

fright.en: I had quite a fright when I realized how close I was to the edge. 当我意识到我离边缘有多近时，我吓了一跳。
fright.zh: 情境: 表达突然的害怕

frighten.en: Don't frighten me with your ghost stories.
frighten.zh: 不要用你的鬼故事吓我

from.en: I work from Monday to Friday.

frontier.en: The small town lies on the frontier between the two countries.

frost.en: Frost covered the windows of the car.
frost.zh: 车子的窗户上盖满了霜。

fruit.en: "She picked some fresh fruit from the tree."
fruit.zh: 她从树上摘了一些新鲜的水果。

fry.en: "Could you fry the eggs for breakfast?"
fry.zh: 你能用油煎一些鸡蛋作为早餐吗？

fuel.en: Wood is the fuel that burns to make heat in this fire.

full.en: She is full of energy today.

fun.en: Going on holiday is always a lot of fun.

fundamental.en: Respect for others is a fundamental human right.
fundamental.zh: 尊重他人是一个基本的人权。

funeral.en: They had a funeral for the soldier who died during the war.

funny.en: "You are so funny, I can't stop laughing at your jokes."
funny.zh: 你真的太有趣了，我无法停止对你的笑话大笑。

fur.en: The bear's fur is dense and warm.

furnished.en: This apartment is furnished, you can move in at any time.
furnished.zh: 这个公寓已配好家具，你可以随时搬入。

furniture.en: I bought some new furniture for my apartment.
furniture.zh: 我为我的公寓买了一些新家具。

gain.en: Winning the award will help Steven gain confidence.

gale.en: A gale of wind blew the umbrella out of her hand.
gale.zh: 一阵大风把她手中的伞吹走了。

gallery.en: The art gallery displayed beautiful paintings.

gallon.en: That car gets really good mileage -- almost 30 miles per gallon.
gallon.zh: 那辆车的燃油效率异常高——每加仑油跑近30英里。

game.en: I enjoy playing chess, it's my favorite game.
game.zh: 我喜欢下棋，这是我最喜欢的游戏。

garage.en: Can you help me clean the garage?
garage.zh: 你能帮我清理一下车库吗？

garbage.en: Separate your garbage into recyclable and non-recyclable bins.
garbage.zh: 把垃圾分成可回收和不可回收的放入垃圾桶。

garden.en: I love to sit in the garden and read a book.
garden.zh: 我喜欢坐在花园里读书。

gardening.zh: 园艺是我的最爱的爱好。

garment.en: The businessman had all of his garments cleaned before the important meeting.

gate.en: Open the gate for the guests.

gather.en: "Let's gather at the park at 6 pm."

gay.en: "He came out as gay at the age of 14."

general.zh: "一般门票的入场时间是中午。"

generation.en: My grandparents are from a different generation than me.

generous.en: He made a generous donation to the charity.
generous.zh: 他对慈善机构做了慷慨的捐赠。

gentle.en: He is very gentle with the baby.

gentleman.en: "He is always such a gentleman, always opening doors for me and pulling out my chair at the restaurant."
gentleman.zh: 他总是这样一个绅士，总是为我开门，总是在餐馆帮我把椅子拉开。

geography.en: Geography is a required course in many schools.
geography.zh: 许多学校都要求上地理课。

geometry.en: "He mastered the complex problem of geometry."
geometry.zh: 他掌握了几何学中的复杂问题。

german.en: "My uncle is a German; he was born in Berlin."
german.zh: 我的叔叔是德国人，他在柏林出生。

germany.en: My cousin has been living in Germany for five years.
germany.zh: 我的表兄弟在德国生活已经五年了。

gift.en: He gave a beautiful diamond ring as a gift to his wife.
gift.zh: 他把一枚美丽的钻石戒指作为礼物送给了他的妻子。

gifted.en: As a gifted musician, he could play piano at the age of three.
gifted.zh: 作为一个天赋异禀的音乐家，他在三岁时就可以弹钢琴。

giraffe.en: The giraffe is the tallest animal in the world.
giraffe.zh: 长颈鹿是世界上最高的动物。

girl.en: The little girl is playing with her doll.
girl.zh: 那个小女孩正在玩她的玩偶。

glad.zh: 我很高兴你喜欢那个派对。

glance.en: He took a quick glance at his watch.
glance.zh: 他快速地看了一眼他的手表。

glare.en: The sunlight produced a harsh glare.
glare.zh: 阳光产生了刺眼的光芒。

glasshouse.en: This glasshouse is used for growing exotic plants.
glasshouse.zh: 这个温室用来种植外来植物。

globe.en: Water covers most of the globe.

glory.en: He won the match and basked in the glory.
glory.zh: 他赢得了比赛并沐浴在荣耀之中

glove.en: He wore a pair of gloves to keep his hands warm.
glove.zh: 他戴了一副手套来保暖他的手。

goal.en: Her goal was to become a doctor.

goat.en: A goat is eating grass in the field.

god.en: "Believers have faith that God will always be with them."
god.zh: 相信者们有信念，上帝将永远与他们同在。

golden.en: The golden sun was sinking in the west.

golf.en: People play golf in nice weather.

goodness.en: His goodness is widely appreciated by his community.
goodness.zh: 他的善良深受社区的赞赏。

goods.en: Shoes, hats, dresses, and purses were the goods she wanted to buy.

government.en: The government must implement policies to stimulate the economy.
government.zh: 政府必须实施政策来刺激经济。

gown.en: She wore a beautiful gown to the party.
gown.zh: 她穿了一件美丽的长袍去参加派对。

grade.en: I'm in the third grade at school.

graduate.en: At the end of the spring, my friends and I will graduate from high school.

graduation.en: “After four years of hard work, graduation day finally arrived.”
graduation.zh: 经过四年的努力学习，毕业日终于来临。

grain.en: This type of rice has a very long grain.

grammar.en: Good grammar is essential for effective communication.
grammar.zh: 良好的语法是进行有效沟通的关键。

grand.en: The grand mountain rose high into the sky.

grandchild.en: My grandchild is coming to visit me this weekend.
grandchild.zh: 这个周末我的孙子要来看我。

granny.en: I am going to visit my granny this weekend.
granny.zh: 我这个周末要去看望我奶奶。

grasp.en: He failed to grasp the main point of the lecture.
grasp.zh: 他没能理解课程的主要观点。

grass.en: The grass is always greener on the other side of the fence.

grateful.en: I'm so grateful for your help.

gravity.en: The force of gravity pulls objects towards the Earth.
gravity.zh: 重力的力量将物体拉向地球。

greedy.en: He was so greedy, he ate all the cookies himself. 他实在太贪婪了，他自己把所有的饼干都吃了。

greengrocer.en: "I usually buy my fruits and vegetables from the local greengrocer."
greengrocer.zh: 我通常在当地的蔬果店买水果和蔬菜。

greet.en: When my friend came over, I greeted him at the door.

greeting.en: We exchanged greetings before starting the meeting.
greeting.zh: 在开始会议之前，我们互相问候。

grill.en: Let's fire up the grill and barbeque some steaks.
grill.zh: 让我们点燃烘烤炉，烤一些牛排。

grocer.en: I need to pop into the grocer to get some milk and bread.
grocer.zh: 我需要去杂货店买些牛奶和面包。

ground.en: He was seated on the ground.

group.en: She is part of an online discussion group.
group.zh: 她是一个在线讨论小组的成员。

growth.en: His business has continued its rapid growth.
growth.zh: 他的业务持续快速增长。

guarantee.en: I can give you a guarantee that this will happen.
guarantee.zh: 我可以向你保证这件事会发生。

guard.zh: 我们必须保护我们的秘密。

guess.en: I can't even guess how much it costs.
guess.zh: 我连猜都猜不出它的价格。

guest.en: I am a guest in your country.
guest.zh: 我是你们国家的一位客人。

guidance.en: He provided guidance to the new employees.
guidance.zh: 他为新员工提供了指导。

guide.en: He offered to guide us through the forest.
guide.zh: 他提议带领我们穿过森林。

guilty.en: The court found him guilty of theft.
guilty.zh: 法庭认定他犯了偷窃罪。

guitar.en: He tuned his guitar before starting the concert.
guitar.zh: 他在开始演唱会前调好了他的吉他。

gun.en: He pointed the gun at the thief.

gymnastics.en: I started learning gymnastics when I was five years.
gymnastics.zh: 我五岁时开始学习体操。

ha.en: Ha! I knew I was right.

habit.en: He has a bad habit of biting his nails.

half.en: I've eaten half of the pizza.

hall.en: "The students gathered in the hall for the lecture."
hall.zh: 学生们在大厅聚集以便听讲座

ham.en: We had ham and eggs for breakfast.
ham.zh: 我们早餐吃的是火腿和鸡蛋。

hamburger.en: I'd like to order a hamburger with french fries.
hamburger.zh: 我想点一份汉堡配薯条。

hammer.en: He used a hammer to knock the nail into the wall.
hammer.zh: 他用锤子将钉子敲进了墙。

hand.en: 名词用法："He has a scar on his hand." 他的手上有一道疤。

handbag.en: "She fumbled in her handbag for her car keys."
handbag.zh: 她在她的手提包中翻找她的车钥匙。

handle.en: I can't handle all this work myself.
handle.zh: 我不能独自处理这所有的工作

handtruck.en: I borrowed a handtruck to move my heavy furniture.
handtruck.zh: 我借了一辆手推车来搬我的重家具。

handy.en: It's handy to have a dictionary at your desk when you're studying.
handy.zh: 学习的时候，在你的书桌上有一本词典是很方便的。

happen.en: I happened to meet some new friends at school today.

happily.zh: 他们从此过上了幸福的生活。

happiness.en: "Happiness is not about being immortal nor having food or rights in one's hand. It’s about having each tiny wish come true, or having something to eat when you are hungry or having someone's love when you need love.”
happiness.zh: 幸福不是长生不老，也不是手中有饭，有权。而是每一个微小的愿望都能实现，渴望食物时有东西吃，需要爱时有人爱你。

happy.en: "She looks so happy with her new dress."
happy.zh: 她穿着新衣服看起来很快乐。

harbor.en: There were a few small boats in the harbor.

hardly.en: We hardly ever go to the cinema.
hardly.zh: 我们几乎从不去电影院

hardship.en: "Many students are facing financial hardships due to the rise in tuition fees."
hardship.zh: 许多学生因为学费上涨而面临财务困难。

harm.en: A hot iron can cause great harm if you are not careful.

harmful.en: Smoking is harmful to your health.

harmless.en: "Despite its size, the animal is completely harmless." - 尽管这个动物体型巨大，但它完全是无害的。
harmless.zh: 尽管它的体型巨大，但这个动物完全无害。

harmony.en: The United Nations is struggling to bring peace and harmony to the world.

harvest.en: This year's harvest was a bounty due to favorable weather conditions.
harvest.zh: 今年的收成丰好，主要是因为天气条件优越。

hatch.en: The eggs will hatch in a few days
hatch.zh: 这些蛋将在几天后孵化

hawk.en: As a noun: I saw a hawk soar high in the sky.
hawk.zh: 我看见一只猎鹰在天空中高高飞翔。

hay.en: The farmer stored the hay in the barn for the winter.
hay.zh: 农民把干草储存在谷仓里过冬。

head.en: He hit his head on the low ceiling.
head.zh: 他的头撞到了低矮的天花板上。

headline.en: The headline on the front page was about the economy.

headteacher.en: Mr. Smith, our headteacher, is known for his dedication to quality education.
headteacher.zh: 我们的校长史密斯先生以他对优质教育的执着而知名。

health.en: Your health is the most important thing in your life.
health.zh: 你的健康是生活中最重要的事情。

healthy.en: She looks healthy and full of energy.
healthy.zh: 她看起来很健康，充满活力。

heap.en: There's a heap of work to do before the end of the week.
heap.zh: 这周末之前还有一大堆的工作要做。

hearing.en: I have a hearing test next week.

heart.en: My heart beats fast when I am nervous.

heat.en: We use solar energy to heat our house.
heat.zh: 我们用太阳能给房子加热。

heaven.en: This place is like heaven on earth.
heaven.zh: 这个地方就像人间天堂。

heavy.en: He lifted the heavy box with all his strength.
heavy.zh: 他全力举起了那只重箱子。

heel.en: I have a blister on my heel.

height.en: The height of the mountain is 5000 feet.

helmet.en: Always wear a helmet when you ride a bicycle.
helmet.zh: 骑自行车时总是要佩戴头盔。

help.en: Jane can help Nathan climb up the rock.

herb.en: I couldn’t decide which herb I wanted to buy at the market.

hero.en: He was hailed as a national hero for his actions.
hero.zh: 他因为自己的行为而被誉为国家英雄。

herself.en: She did the whole project herself.
herself.zh: 她自己完成了整个项目。

hibernate.zh: 熊在冬季会进入冬眠状态。

high.en: The birds are flying high in the sky.

highway.en: This highway leads to the city center.
highway.zh: 这条高速公路通向市中心。

hill.en: The hill was covered with wild flowers.
hill.zh: 这个小山坡长满了野花。

hillside.en: The house is located on the hillside, overlooking the entire city.
hillside.zh: 房子位于山坡上，可以俯瞰整个城市。

hilly.en: The hilly landscape is a challenge for farmers here.
hilly.zh: 这个多小山的地形对这里的农民来说是一个挑战。

him.en: I saw him at the park yesterday.
him.zh: 昨天我在公园看见他了。

hire.en: We intend to hire two new teachers for the upcoming school year.
hire.zh: 我们打算在下一学年雇佣两位新的老师。

his.en: His books are on the table.

history.en: History was my favorite subject in school.

hive.en: The honey is harvested from natural beehives.
hive.zh: 从天然蜂巢中采集蜂蜜。

hobby.en: She liked to paint as a hobby.

hole.en: The rabbit disappeared down a hole.

holiday.en: "I look forward to the summer holidays every year."
holiday.zh: 我每年都期待夏天的假期

holy.en: The church is regarded as a holy place.
holy.zh: 教堂被视作神圣的地方。

home.en: I left my home for college last year.
home.zh: 我去年离开家去上大学

homeland.en: She returned to her homeland after many years abroad.
homeland.zh: 她在国外多年后，回到了自己的祖国。

honor.en: It's an honor to meet you.

hook.en: Hang your coat on the hook.
hook.zh: 把你的外套挂到钩子上。

hope.en: My only hope is that my daughter will recover soon.
hope.zh: 我的唯一希望是我的女儿能尽快恢复健康。

horrible.en: The assignment was horrible. I hated it.

horse.en: I went to a farm and saw a horse.

hospital.en: The hospital is equipped with all the latest medical technology.
hospital.zh: 这家医院装备了所有最新的医疗技术。

host.en: Jack is the host of the annual charity event.
host.zh: 杰克是年度慈善活动的主持人。

hot.en: "The soup is too hot to drink."

hotel.en: I booked a room at this hotel through online travel agency.
hotel.zh: 我通过在线旅行社在这家酒店预订了一间房间。

hour.en: I spend an hour on homework every day.
hour.zh: 我每天都会花一小时做家庭作业。

housewife.en: My mother is a dedicated housewife.
housewife.zh: 我的母亲是一个专心致志的家庭主妇。

housework.en: I spend the whole day doing housework.

however.en: He worked hard. However, he failed the exam.
however.zh: 他学习很努力。然而，他还是没通过考试。

howl.en: "The wind howled through the broken window."

hug.en: "They gave each other a big hug before leaving."
hug.zh: 他们在离开前相互拥抱了一下。

huge.en: At work, my father drives a huge truck.

human.en: Every human has the right to be free.

humor.en: He woke up in an ill humor, angry at everyone.

hundred.en: I have read over a hundred books this year.
hundred.zh: 我今年已经读了超过一百本书。

hunger.en: I skipped breakfast, so I'm feeling some serious hunger.
hunger.zh: 我错过了早餐，所以我现在非常饿。

hunt.en: "I'll **hunt** for the photos in the attic."
hunt.zh: 我会在阁楼里找那些照片

hunter.en: The lion has been known as the king of the hunter.
hunter.zh: 狮子一直被认为是猎人之王。

hurricane.en: "The hurricane caused extensive damage to the coastal town."
hurricane.zh: 飓风对沿海小镇造成了广泛的破坏。

hurry.en: I hurried home on my bike.

hydrogen.en: Hydrogen is the lightest and most abundant element in the universe.
hydrogen.zh: 氢是宇宙中最轻，也是最丰富的元素。

iceland.en: "I've always wanted to visit Iceland because of its beautiful landscapes and Northern Lights."
iceland.zh: 我一直想要访问冰岛，因为它美丽的风景和极光。

identity.en: Everyone has their own unique identity.
identity.zh: 每个人都有他们独特的身份。

identification.en: He forgot his identification at home, so he couldn't enter the club.
identification.zh: 他忘了把身份证带出门，所以他不能进入俱乐部。

idiom.en: The idiom “when pigs fly” means that something will never happen.

ignore.en: I ignored the message he was making and kept studying.

illness.en: "He is suffering from a terrible illness."
illness.zh: 他正在遭受一场可怕的疾病。

imagine.en: Sally imagined herself winning lots of money.

immediate.en: I need an immediate reply to this letter.
immediate.zh: 我需要对这封信立刻回复。

immediately.en: Please come to the office immediately.

immigration.en: "The country has a long history of immigration."
immigration.zh: 这个国家有着悠久的移民历史。

import.en: As a verb: We import goods from China.

importance.en: The importance of regular exercise can't be overemphasized.
importance.zh: 锻炼的重要性无法过分强调。

important.en: It's important to eat a balanced diet.

impossible.en: It is impossible to finish the whole project within a day.
impossible.zh: 在一天内完成整个项目是不可能的。

impress.en: He was able to impress the girls with his new dance.

impression.en: _You've made a good impression on my parents._
impression.zh: 你给我的父母留下了好印象。

improve.en: We need to improve our communication skills.
improve.zh: 我们需要提高我们的沟通技巧。

in.en: The cat is in the box.

inch.en: The computer screen is 15 inches wide.

incident.en: The police are now investigating the incident.
incident.zh: 警方正在调查这个事件。

include.en: "Our expenses include rent, utilities, and food."
include.zh: 我们的花费包括租金、公共事业费和食品。

income.zh: 保罗的年收入是5万美元。

increase.en: We need to increase production to meet demand.
increase.zh: 我们需要增加产量以满足需求。

independence.en: After leaving home, Sophia had a great feeling of independence.

independent.en: She has a very independent mind. 她思想非常独立。

indian.en: Indian culture is admired all over the world.
indian.zh: 世界各地都仰慕印度的文化。

indicate.en: The sign indicates the right directions to the museum.
indicate.zh: 这个标志指示去博物馆的正确方向。

industry.en: The tourist industry is doing well all around the world.

influence.en: Your friends have a strong influence on you.
influence.zh: 你的朋友对你有很大影响。

inform.en: The detective informed them of their rights before questioning.
inform.zh: 在质询之前，侦探知会了他们的权利。

information.en: Could you give me more information about the conference?
information.zh: 你能给我提供更多关于这次会议的信息吗？

initial.en: The initial step when writing a paper is to find a good topic.

injure.en: He fell down from the stairs and injured his leg.
injure.zh: 他从楼梯上跌下来，伤了腿。

ink.en: She dipped her pen in the ink.

inland.en: We drove inland to visit some wineries.
inland.zh: 我们驾车向内陆去参观一些酿酒厂。

inn.en: The visitor got a room at the inn.

innocent.en: He was found innocent of the charges.

insert.en: 动词: Please insert your card into the machine.

inside.en: Please stay inside when the weather is stormy.
inside.zh: 当天气狂风骤雨时，请待在室内。

insist.en: I insist on paying for the meal.

inspect.en: She bent down to inspect the damage to her car.
inspect.zh: 她弯腰去查看她的汽车损伤的情况

inspire.zh: 你的故事真的很激励我。

instant.en: A microwave oven cooks food in an instant.

instead.en: Can I have tea instead of coffee?
instead.zh: 我能换杯茶不要咖啡吗？

institute.en: I am going to a lecture about Ancient Rome at the Historical Institute.

institution.en: The government is an important institution in any country.
institution.zh: 政府是任何国家的重要机构。

instruct.en: The manager instructed his employees to finish the report by Friday.
instruct.zh: 经理指示他的员工在星期五之前完成报告。

instruction.zh: 请仔细遵循操作手册的**指示**。

instrument.en: He is learning to play a musical instrument.
instrument.zh: 他正在学习弹奏一种乐器。

insurance.en: She decided to buy some health insurance in case she got sick.
insurance.zh: 她决定购买一些健康保险，以防她生病。

intelligence.en: Because of his high intelligence, he finished school early.

intend.en: I intend to spend the night at my grandmother's house.

international.en: This is a matter of international concern
international.zh: 这是一个引起国际关注的问题

internet.en: Information on the internet travels in chunks called packets.
internet.zh: 互联网上的信息以数据包的形式传播。

interpreter.en: He works as an **interpreter** in the United Nations.
interpreter.zh: 他在联合国担任翻译员。

interrupt.en: "Please don't interrupt me while I am speaking."
interrupt.zh: 我在说话时请不要打断我。

interval.en: I suggest taking a short interval between the two meetings to refresh our minds.
interval.zh: 我建议在两场会议之间休息一下来使我们的思绪更加清晰。

interview.en: I have an interview for a job at a big company tomorrow.
interview.zh: 我明天有一个在大公司的工作面试。

invent.en: He is credited with inventing the first computer.
invent.zh: 他被认为是第一台电脑的发明者。

invention.zh: 电话是一项了不起的发明。

inventor.en: Thomas Edison was the inventor of the light bulb.
inventor.zh: 托马斯·爱迪生是电灯泡的发明者。

invitation.en: I received an invitation to her wedding.
invitation.zh: 我收到了她的婚礼请帖。

invite.en: I would like to invite you to my birthday party next week.
invite.zh: 我想邀请你下周来参加我的生日派对。

ireland.en: I am going to visit Ireland next month.

irrigate.en: In dry climates, it is important to irrigate fields of crops.

island.en: Japan is a group of islands.

italy.en: "I am planning to visit Italy next year."
italy.zh: 我打算明年访问意大利。

jacket.zh: 他穿着一件蓝色的夹克。

jam.en: The jam is made of fresh fruits.
jam.zh: 这种果酱是用新鲜的水果制作的。

japan.en: I've never been to Japan, but I'd like to visit one day.
japan.zh: 我从未去过日本，但我想有一天去看看。

japanese.en: The Japanese restaurant down the street is really good.
japanese.zh: 街道下面的日本餐厅真的很好。

jar.en: He keeps pennies and dimes in a jar.
jar.zh: 他把便士和角硬币装在一个罐子里。

jaw.en: He was punched in the jaw.

jazz.en: She has a real passion for jazz music.
jazz.zh: 她对爵士乐有着真正的热情。

jeans.en: I just bought a new pair of jeans.
jeans.zh: 我刚买了一条新的牛仔裤。

jet.en: The jet made a perfect landing.

jewel.en: "She wore a jewel necklace that sparkled in the sun."
jewel.zh: 她戴着一串在阳光下闪烁的宝石项链。

jog.en: "I jog every morning to stay fit."
jog.zh: 我每天早上慢跑以保持身体健康。

join.en: I would like to join the club.
join.zh: 我想要加入这个俱乐部。

joke.en: Here's a good joke for you!
joke.zh: 这儿有个很好笑的笑话给你听!

journalist.en: The journalist took notes for a story he was writing.

journey.en: I went on a journey across the country with my parents.

joy.en: I love baseball. I feel joy when I play.

judge.en: As a noun: "The judge will deliver his verdict later in the day."
judge.zh: 法官将在今天晚些时候宣判。

judgement.en: He is respected for his sound judgement.
judgement.zh: 他因其明智的判断被人尊敬。

juice.en: "Can I have a glass of orange juice, please?"

juicy.en: This apple is really juicy and sweet.
juicy.zh: 这个苹果非常的多汁和甜。

jump.en: The cat can jump onto the table.

june.en: "In June, the days are long and the weather is warm."
june.zh: 六月份，白天长且天气温暖。

jungle.en: Many kinds of animals, including birds, reptiles, and even elephants live in a jungle.

junior.en: When she started at the company, she was only a junior manager.

junk.en: We decided to clean out our attic and throw away all the junk.
junk.zh: 我们决定清理阁楼，丢掉所有的废旧物品。

justice.en: People turn to the court system when they are seeking justice.

kangaroo.en: The kangaroo is a marsupial from the family Macropodidae.
kangaroo.zh: 袋鼠是来自袋鼠类 Macropodidae 家族的一种有袋哺乳动物。

keeper.en: He is the keeper of the seal.

kettle.en: "The kettle is boiling on the stove."

key.en: Marco is a key player on the country’s national team.

keyboard.en: Paul spilled coffee all over his keyboard.

kick.en: He kicked the ball into the goal.

kid.en: (名词) The kids are playing in the garden.

kilogram.en: The bag of sugar weighs one kilogram.

kilometre.en: The grocery store is just a few kilometres away from here.
kilometre.zh: 这家杂货店距离这里只有几公里。

kindergarten.en: They enrolled their child in the local kindergarten.
kindergarten.zh: 他们把孩子在当地的幼稚园里登记了。

kiss.en: The two lovebirds ended their date with a sweet kiss.
kiss.zh: 这对恋人以一次甜蜜的亲吻结束了约会。

kite.en: He bought a new kite for his son.
kite.zh: 他为他的儿子买了一个新风筝。

knee.en: He suffered a knee injury during the game.
knee.zh: 他在比赛中膝盖受伤了。

knife.en: He cut the apple with a sharp knife.
knife.zh: 他用一把锐利的刀切苹果。

knock.en: I could hear the knock at the door.我可以听到门上的敲击声。

knowledge.en: He has trouble putting his knowledge into practice.

lab.en: The students are performing an experiment in the lab.
lab.zh: 同学们正在实验室做实验。

labour.en: The fishermen were saved after labouring for hours in the stormy sea.
labour.zh: 渔民们在暴风雨的海中艰难地挣扎了几个小时后被救出。

labor.en: Building the house took a lot of labor.

labourer.en: The labourer is worthy of his hire.

lack.en: He lacks confidence in his abilities.
lack.zh: 他对自己的能力缺乏自信。

ladder.en: I leaned the ladder against the wall to paint the house.
ladder.zh: 我把梯子靠在墙上给房子涂漆。

lady.en: The lady in the red dress caught everyone's attention.
lady.zh: 穿红裙子的女士吸引了每个人的注意。

lake.en: The lake is surrounded by mountains.

lamb.en: The shepherd is taking care of the lamb.

lame.en: The dog is **lame** in one leg after the accident.
lame.zh: 那只狗在事故后一条腿走路瘸了。

lamp.en: I switched on the lamp to read my book.
lamp.zh: 我打开了灯来阅读我的书。

land.en: We should protect the land from pollution.
land.zh: 我们应该保护土地不受污染。

language.en: English is a very influential language.
language.zh: 英语是一种非常有影响力的语言

lantern.en: He switched on his lantern to see in the dark.
lantern.zh: 他打开他的灯笼以便在黑暗中看清楚。

large.en: The room is large enough to hold a party.
large.zh: 这个房间足够大，可以举办一个聚会。

laser.en: He pointed a laser pointer at the screen to highlight the key points.
laser.zh: 他用激光指示器指向屏幕勾画出关键点。

lately.en: I haven't been feeling well lately.

later.en: I will go to the supermarket later.

latter.en: In the latter minutes of the game, the visitors scored the winning goal.

laugh.en: You make me laugh even when I don't want to smile.
laugh.zh: 当我不想笑的时候，你能让我发笑。

laughter.en: Her infectious laughter filled the room.
laughter.zh: 她的笑声感染了整个房间。

laundry.en: He folded the clean laundry and put the dirty laundry in a basket.

lavatory.en: There is a lavatory on the right side of the corridor.
lavatory.zh: 走廊的右侧有一个卫生间

law.en: This is the law of the land.

lawyer.en: The lawyer left the courthouse after the judge made her decision.

lazy.en: He is too lazy to clean his room.
lazy.zh: 他太懒了，不愿打扫自己的房间。

leading.en: He is a leading expert in his field.
leading.zh: 他是他领域的领先专家。

learn.en: He is always eager to learn new things.
learn.zh: 他总是渴望学习新知识。

leather.en: He got a new leather jacket for his birthday.

lecture.en: I attended a lecture on Victorian literature yesterday.
lecture.zh: 昨天我参加了一个关于维多利亚文学的讲座。

left.en: He sat on the left side of the classroom.

leftover.en: "I usually take the leftover food for lunch the next day."
leftover.zh: 我通常将剩下的食物留到第二天午餐吃。

leg.en: She broke her leg when she fell off the ladder.
leg.zh: 她从梯子上摔下来，摔断了腿。

legal.en: Smoking is not legal for people under 18 years old.
legal.zh: 18岁以下的人抽烟是不合法的。

lemon.en: Please add some lemon to my tea.
lemon.zh: 请在我的茶中加些柠檬。

length.en: The length of the floor is three meters.

less.en: "I need to spend less time watching TV and more time studying."
less.zh: 我需要花更少的时间看电视，多花一些时间学习。

lesson.en: "Reliability is a lesson learned from experience."
lesson.zh: 课程: 从经验中学到的一课是可靠性。

let.en: You should let him know about the changes.
let.zh: 你应该让他知道这些变化。

level.en: "She is at the top level in management."
level.zh: 她在管理层的最高级别。

liberty.en: To many people, the Statue of Liberty is a symbol of freedom.

liberate.en: The soldiers worked to liberate the occupied city.
liberate.zh: 士兵们努力解放被占领的城市。

liberation.en: The liberation of the prisoners was a momentous event.
liberation.zh: 犯人的释放是一个重大的事件。

library.en: She goes to the library every Wednesday.
library.zh: 她每个星期三都去图书馆。

license.en: He received his pilot's license last year.
license.zh: 他去年拿到了他的飞行执照。

lifetime.en: He's dedicated his lifetime to the study of this subject.
lifetime.zh: 他把一生都献给了对这个主题的研究。

lift.en: Could you give me a lift to the airport?

light.en: 他打开了灯，_照亮_了房间。
light.zh: He turned on the _light_ and illuminated the room.

lightning.en: The lightning lit up the sky.

limit.en: There is a limit to human endurance.

line.en: "Please get in line and wait your turn."

link.en: Could you please send me the link to the online meeting?
link.zh: 你能把网络会议的链接发给我吗？

lion.en: The male lion roared to assert his dominance over the territory.
lion.zh: 雄狮咆哮以证明他对领地的主宰权

lip.en: "She nibbled on her lower lip nervously."

liquid.en: Pure water is a colorless and tasteless liquid.
liquid.zh: 纯水是一种无色无味的液体。

list.en: My mom makes a list of groceries to buy.

listen.en: If you listen carefully, you can hear the birds singing.
listen.zh: 如果你仔细听，你能听到鸟儿在歌唱。

literature.en: "She is a professor of English literature at the university."
literature.zh: 她是大学的英语文学教授。

literary.en: She is studying English literary history at college.
literary.zh: 她在大学学习英文文学历史

liter.en: She bought a liter of milk from the store.
liter.zh: 她从商店买了一升牛奶。

lively.en: "The party was lively and everyone was having a great time."
lively.zh: 这个派对热闹非凡，每个人都玩得非常开心。

living.en: "The only living relative I have is my sister."
living.zh: 我唯一的在世亲戚就是我的姐姐。

load.en: The man loaded the boxes into a truck.

loaf.en: Can you get a loaf of bread at the store?
loaf.zh: 你能在杂货店买一条面包吗?

local.en: The local market in my neighborhood sells all the food we need.

loose.en: The bolt was loose, so I tightened it with the wrench.

lorry.en: He drives a lorry for a living.

loss.en: I feel a profound sense of loss.

lot.en: I bought a lot of apples at the market.
lot.zh: 在市场上我买了很多苹果。

loud.en: The man’s voice was so loud that we all could hear him.

loudly.en: He laughed loudly in the theatre.

lounge.en: You can wait for your flight in the airport lounge.
lounge.zh: 你可以在机场休息室等待你的航班。

love.en: I have a deep love for my family.
love.zh: 我对我的家庭有深深的爱。

low.en: The plane is flying very low.

luck.en: He has no luck with his job.

luggage.en: "Be sure to pack your luggage the night before your flight."
luggage.zh: 航班前一晚一定要打包好你的行李。

lunch.zh: 我们中午出来吃个午餐。

lung.en: The doctor told me to take a deep breath so he could check my lungs.
lung.zh: 医生让我深呼吸，这样他就可以检查我的肺。

machine.en: This machine is designed to automate the bottling process.
machine.zh: 这台机器的设计目的是把装瓶过程自动化

mad.en: Mother got mad when I didn’t listen to her.

magazine.en: She likes to read fashion magazines.

maid.en: Our maid comes in twice a week to clean the house.
maid.zh: 我们的女仆每周来两次打扫房子。

mail.en: I will check the mail when I get home.

mailbox.en: The mailbox is full of junk mail.

main.en: "He is the main character of the story."
main.zh: 他是这个故事的主要角色。

mainland.en: We're flying back to the mainland tomorrow.

major.en: She plays a major role in the play.
major.zh: 她在这个剧中扮演主要角色。

majority.en: A majority of the people voted for Tom Smith in the election.

male.en: He is a male employee in our company.
male.zh: 他是我们公司的一名男员工。

manage.en: We have to learn how to manage our time effectively.
manage.zh: 我们必须学会如何有效管理我们的时间

mankind.en: Mankind must put an end to war before war puts an end to mankind.
mankind.zh: 人类必须终止战争，否则战争将终止人类。

map.en: As a noun: I forgot my map at home.

maple.en: The maple leaves turn red in autumn.
maple.zh: 枫树的叶子在秋天变红。

marathon.en: I've been training for my first marathon for months now.
marathon.zh: 我已经为我的首次马拉松赛事训练了几个月。

marble.en: The large house had floors made of marble.

march.en: March is the third month of the year.
march.zh: 三月是一年中的第三个月。

mark.en: Mark your calendar for our anniversary.
mark.zh: 记在你的日历上我们的周年纪念日。

market.en: "The market price of gold rose quickly."
market.zh: 黄金的市场价格急速上涨。

married.en: They've been happily married for 25 years.
married.zh: 他们已经幸福地结婚了25年。

mask.en: You should wear a mask in the hospital.
mask.zh: 你在医院里应该戴口罩。

mass.en: "The mass of an object can be measured with a scale."
mass.zh: 物体的质量可以用秤来测量。

master.en: He is a master of playing piano.

mat.en: Please wipe your feet on the mat before entering the house.
mat.zh: 请在进房子前在垫子上擦干净你的脚。

match.en: The match between the two teams was intense.
match.zh: 两队之间的比赛非常激烈。

material.en: Brick is a good material for building houses.

matter.en: He is studying the properties of matter in a chemistry class. 他在化学课上学习物质的性质。

mature.en: When they matured, they became as tall as their parents.

maximum.en: The maximum speed for my car is 70 mph.
maximum.zh: 我的车最高速度为70英里每小时。

may.en: "May I help you with your luggage?"

meal.en: I would like to invite you to a meal on Sunday.
meal.zh: 我想邀请你周日来吃一顿饭。

means.en: "By all means, take your time to decide."
means.zh: 你尽可以花时间来决定。

meanwhile.en: He was reading a book, meanwhile, his daughter was playing in the yard.
meanwhile.zh: 他正在看书，同时，他的女儿在院子里玩耍。

measure.en: Would you help me measure the length of this table?
measure.zh: 你能帮我测量一下这张桌子的长度吗？

meat.en: "He likes to grill meat on weekends."

medal.en: He won a gold medal in the long jump.
medal.zh: 他在跳远项目中赢得了金牌。

media.en: Social media has changed the way we communicate.
media.zh: 社交媒体改变了我们的沟通方式。

medical.en: Tyler is a medical student studying to become a doctor.

medicine.en: The doctor gave me medicine for my cold.

medium.en: The internet has become an important medium of communication.
medium.zh: 互联网已成为重要的交流媒介。

meeting.en: We have lots of meetings at our school to plan what to do.

member.en: He is a member of the local golf club.
member.zh: 他是本地高尔夫俱乐部的成员。

memorial.en: The statue was erected as a memorial to those who died in the war.
memorial.zh: 这座雕像是为了纪念在战争中牺牲的人们而建立的。

memory.en: My childhood memories are still vivid.
memory.zh: 我对童年的记忆依然清晰。

memorize.en: I need to memorize all these formulas for the math test.
memorize.zh: 我需要记住数学考试的所有公式。

mend.en: I need to mend my broken bicycle before I can ride it again.
mend.zh: 我需要修理我的破自行车，然后我才能再次骑它。

mental.en: I made a mental picture of the room.

mention.en: I'll mention your ideas to the boss during the meeting later today.
mention.zh: 我会在今天晚些时候的会议中把你的想法提到给老板听。

merchant.en: He was a prosperous merchant in the industry.
merchant.zh: 他在行业里是个富裕的商人

merciful.en: "Despite the thief's numerous offenses, the judge was merciful.
merciful.zh: 尽管小偷犯了很多罪，法官还是宽大处理。

mercy.en: He begged for mercy but his pleas were ignored.
mercy.zh: 他求饶，但他的恳求被忽视了。

merry.en: We wish you a merry Christmas.

mess.en: "After the party, the house was a complete mess."
mess.zh: 派对之后，房子完全乱成一团。

message.en: I left a message for you in the envelope.

messy.en: My room is so messy. I need to clean it up.
messy.zh: 我的房间真乱，我需要收拾一下。

method.en: One method to remember things is to tie a string around your finger.

metre.en: The width of the room is about four metres.
metre.zh: 房间的宽度大约有四米。

meter.en: The water meter is in the basement.

mexican.en: He is a Mexican, having come from Mexico City. 他是墨西哥人，来自墨西哥城。

mexico.en: I'm planning to take a vacation in Mexico next month.
mexico.zh: 我计划下个月去墨西哥度假。

microscope.en: The student examined the bacteria under the microscope.
microscope.zh: 这个学生在显微镜下检查细菌。

microwave.en: Place the pizza in the microwave for two minutes.
microwave.zh: 把披萨放进微波炉热两分钟。

midday.en: "I usually take a lunch break at midday."
midday.zh: 我通常在正午时分吃午餐。

middle.en: He stood in the middle of the room.

midnight.zh: 钟声响起，宣告到了午夜。

might.en: "He might be coming to the party."

mile.en: We have to walk a mile to reach the nearest bus station.
mile.zh: 我们需要走一英里的路程才能到达最近的公交车站。

milk.en: I prefer my coffee with milk.
milk.zh: 我喜欢在咖啡里加牛奶。

million.en: He won a million dollars in the lottery.
million.zh: 他在彩票中赢得了一百万美元。

millionaire.en: He became a millionaire because he was smart with his money.

mineral.en: "This region is rich in minerals like iron and coal."
mineral.zh: 这个地区富含像铁和煤这样的矿物质。

minimum.en: The minimum age for the job is 18.
minimum.zh: 应聘这份工作的最低年龄是18岁。

miniskirt.en: She wore a bright red miniskirt.
miniskirt.zh: 她穿了一条亮红色的超短裙。

minister.en: He was appointed the Minister of Finance.

ministry.en: The Ministry of Health has issued a new advisory on healthy eating.
ministry.zh: 卫生部发布了关于健康饮食的新建议。

minus.en: I have fifteen dollars minus the five I owe you.
minus.zh: 我有15美元，减去欠你的5美元。

mirror.en: He looked at his reflection in the mirror.
mirror.zh: 他在镜子里看自己的倒影。

miss.en: Excuse me, Miss, could you tell me the time?
miss.zh: 对不起，小姐，你能告诉我现在几点吗？

missile.en: The enemy launched a missile attack at dawn.
missile.zh: 敌人在黎明时发动了导弹攻击。

mist.en: The mountains were shrouded in mist.

mix.en: We need to mix the paint before using it.
mix.zh: 我们在使用这个油漆之前需要把它搅拌一下。

mixture.en: Let the cake bake for 20 minutes after you combine the mixture.
mixture.zh: 在你混合好奶油后，让蛋糕烘烤20分钟。

mobile.en: "This mobile clinic provides healthcare services to remote communities."
mobile.zh: 这个流动诊所为偏远地区提供医疗服务。

modern.en: We live in a modern society with advanced technology.
modern.zh: 我们生活在一个科技先进的现代社会中。

modest.en: He's very modest about his achievements.
modest.zh: 他对自己的成就非常谦虚。

monday.en: I start work at 8AM every Monday.
monday.zh: 我每个星期一早上8点开始工作。

monitor.en: My job is to monitor the air quality in the city.
monitor.zh: 我工作的内容就是监测城市的空气质量

monkey.en: "I saw a monkey in the zoo."
monkey.zh: 我在动物园看到了一只猴子。

month.en: January is the first month of the year.

monument.en: The monument was erected in memory of the soldiers who died in the war.
monument.zh: 这个纪念碑是为了纪念在战争中牺牲的士兵而建立的。

moon.zh: 今夜的月亮照耀得非常明亮。

mop.en: I need to mop the kitchen floor before going to bed.
mop.zh: 我需要在睡觉前擦洗厨房地板。

moral.en: As a moral being, we should always consider the consequences of our actions.
moral.zh: 作为有道德的生物，我们应该总是考虑我们行为的后果。

moscow.zh: 我去年夏天去了莫斯科。

mosquito.en: Mosquitoes are more active at dusk and dawn.
mosquito.zh: 蚊子在黄昏和黎明时分比较活跃。

most.en: Most people in the city use public transport.
most.zh: 大多数城市里的人使用公共交通。

mother.zh: 我的母亲正在准备晚餐。

motivation.en: Money is a significant motivation for many people.
motivation.zh: 对很多人来说，钱是重要的动力。

motor.en: He has a small motor boat.
motor.zh: 他有一艘小型的机动艇。

motorbike.en: I used to ride a motorbike to school when I was a student.
motorbike.zh: 我上学时常骑摩托车去学校。

motto.en: My personal motto is "Live and let live."
motto.zh: 我的个人座右铭是"活着并让别人活着"。

mountain.en: Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.

mountainous.en: A mountainous terrain makes farming difficult.
mountainous.zh: 山地地形对农业的发展造成困难

mourn.en: "The whole city mourned the death of their beloved mayor."
mourn.zh: 整个城市都在哀悼他们深受喜爱的市长的去世。

mouthful.en: Your sandwich is so big, it's a mouthful.
mouthful.zh: 你的三明治好大，一口难尽。

move.en: The cat moved slowly towards the mouse.
move.zh: 这只猫慢慢地向老鼠移动。

movement.en: There has been a lot of movement in the housing market recently.
movement.zh: 近期，在房屋市场上有许多变动。

movie.en: I'm a huge fan of Marvel movies.
movie.zh: 我是漫威电影的超级粉丝。

mr..zh: 约翰逊先生教我们物理。

mud.en: After the heavy rain, the road turned into mud.
mud.zh: 经过大雨之后，道路变成了泥泞。

multiply.en: In the past year, the number of people at work has multiplied by ten percent.

museum.en: The Louvre is a famous museum in France.

music.en: I love to listen to music while I work.
music.zh: 我工作的时候喜欢听音乐。

mustard.en: We use mustard as a condiment.

nail.en: "We need a nail to fix the picture on the wall."
nail.zh: 我们需要一颗钉子把画固定在墙上。

narrow.en: The bridge is too narrow for a car to drive across it.

nation.en: Our nation is known for its rich cultural heritage.
nation.zh: 我们的国家以其丰富的文化遗产而闻名。

nationality.en: She changed her nationality from Canadian to American.
nationality.zh: 她将自己的国籍从加拿大改为美国。

native.en: As a native of New York, she knows the city like the back of her hand.
native.zh: 作为一名纽约本地人，她对这个城市了如指掌。

natural.en: We need to take care of the natural world.

nature.en: Man must respect nature in order to maintain ecological balance.
nature.zh: 人必须尊重自然以维持生态平衡。

navy.en: "My brother is serving in the navy."

near.en: The supermarket is near my house.

necessary.en: It is necessary to wear a coat in winter.

necklace.en: Joyce received a lovely pearl necklace for her wedding anniversary.

needle.en: She threaded the needle and began to sew.

negotiate.en: We need to negotiate the terms of the contract.
negotiate.zh: 我们需要谈判合同的条款。

neighbour.en: She has been a good neighbour to us for many years.
neighbour.zh: 她多年来一直是我们的好邻居。

neighbor.en: I like my neighbor because he’s very friendly.

neither.en: I could agree with neither of them.

nephew.en: My nephew has just started school.
nephew.zh: 我的侄子刚刚开始上学。

nervous.en: She's always nervous before an exam.
nervous.zh: 她在考试前总是很紧张。

nest.en: "The bird built a nest in the tree."
nest.zh: 那只鸟在树上筑了一个巢。

net.en: He caught a butterfly with a net.

network.en: Our company is working relentlessly to expand its business network.
network.zh: 我们的公司正在不懈努力来扩大其商业网络。

never.en: I have never been to New York.

news.en: Did you hear the news? Tom got promoted.
news.zh: 你听说这个消息了吗？Tom被提升了。

next.en: We will consider your proposal at our next meeting.
next.zh: 我们将在下次会议上考虑你的提议。

night.en: I usually read books at night.

number.en: There were a great number of people at the concert.

noble.en: He comes from a noble family.

nod.en: John gave a nod of approval when he saw the final design.
nod.zh: 约翰看到最后的设计时点了点头表示赞同。

noise.en: The noise from the street was driving me crazy.
noise.zh: 来自街道的噪音快让我疯了。

noisily.en: The children are laughing noisily in the garden.
noisily.zh: 孩子们在花园里咯咯大笑。

noisy.en: The construction site is very noisy.
noisy.zh: 那个建筑工地非常嘈杂。

none.en: **作为代词**：None of us is perfect.

noodle.en: I love to eat chicken noodle soup when it's cold.
noodle.zh: 当天气寒冷的时候，我喜欢吃鸡肉面条汤。

noon.en: We will meet at the coffee shop at noon.
noon.zh: 我们将在中午时在咖啡馆见面。

nor.en: I have neither been to France nor Italy.
nor.zh: “我既没去过法国，也没去过意大利。"

normal.en: It is normal to feel nervous before a big test.
normal.zh: 在重大考试前感到紧张是正常的。

northeast.en: The cold wind is blowing from the northeast.

northwest.en: The wind is blowing from the northwest.

nose.en: He has a very big nose.

note.en: "Please take a note of the meeting time." 请记下会议的时间。

notebook.en: I need a new notebook for school.
notebook.zh: 我需要一本新的笔记本上学。

notice.en: I didn't notice the sign at the entrance.
notice.zh: 我没有注意到入口处的标示。

novel.en: He wrote a great novel about ancient China.

now.en: Now is the time to start.

nowadays.en: Nowadays, people rely heavily on the internet for information.
nowadays.zh: 现在，人们十分依赖网络获取信息

nowhere.en: We're in the middle of nowhere.

nuclear.en: We need to increase our investment in nuclear energy.
nuclear.zh: 我们需要增加对核能的投资。

numb.en: After holding my hand under the icy water, my fingers were numb.

nurse.en: She works as a nurse in a big hospital.
nurse.zh: 她在一家大医院里作护士。

nursery.en: The wall of the nursery was painted with lovely pink.
nursery.zh: 儿童房的墙面被粉刷成可爱的粉色

nursing.en: She is studying nursing at the university.
nursing.zh: 她在大学里学习护理学。

nut.en: "Walnuts and cashews are types of nuts."
nut.zh: 核桃和腰果是种类的坚果

nutrition.en: Good nutrition is vital for good health.
nutrition.zh: 良好的营养对健康至关重要。

object.en: There are several small objects on the table.

observe.en: Brian observed the sun rising over the mountains.

obtain.en: After I passed the test, I obtained my driver’s license.

obvious.en: It's obvious that he's not telling the truth.

occur.en: It didn't occur to me to check the oil level in the car.
occur.zh: 我没想到要检查车里的油量。

ocean.en: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean in the world.
ocean.zh: 太平洋是世界上最大的海洋。

october.zh: 十月是我最喜欢的月份。

offence.en: Committing such an offence could lead to imprisonment.
offence.zh: 犯下此类罪行可能会导致入狱。

offer.en: He offered me a lift to the station.
offer.zh: 他主动提议送我去火车站。

office.en: Our company has an office in Shanghai.
office.zh: 我们公司在上海设有办公室。

officer.en: The police officer arrested the criminal.

official.en: The official language of China is Mandarin.
official.zh: 中国的官方语言是普通话。

offshore.en: The oil company has an offshore platform in the Atlantic Ocean.
offshore.zh: 这家石油公司在大西洋上有一个离岸平台。

often.en: I don't often go to the cinema.

oil.en: The price of crude oil is soaring.

old.en: My mother is seventy years old now.

olympic.en: "The Olympic athlete trained for hours every day."
olympic.zh: 这位奥运会运动员每天训练好几个小时。

omelette.en: She enjoyed her cheese omelette for breakfast.
omelette.zh: 她很享受早餐时的芝士煎蛋卷。

on.en: The book is on the table.

once.en: 作为副词："I jog in the park once a week."
once.zh: 我每周在公园慢跑一次。

only.en: He is the only son in his family.

open.en: Could you please open the window?

opener.en: This can opener makes it easy to open cans.
opener.zh: 这个开罐器使得打开罐头变得很容易。

opening.en: He made a small opening in the box.
opening.zh: 他在箱子上打了一个小洞。

opera.en: She is a famous opera singer.
opera.zh: 她是一位著名的歌剧演唱家。

operate.en: The machine will not operate properly without oil.
operate.zh: 没有油机器就不能正常运作。

operation.en: The operation of the company was left in the capable hands of his assistant. 公司的运作被交付给了他能力强大的助手。

opinion.en: I respect your opinion, but I disagree.
opinion.zh: 我尊重你的观点，但我不同意。

oppose.en: I want to be a police officer because I oppose crime.

opposite.en: The opposite of black is white.

optional.en: Participation in the training session is optional.
optional.zh: 参加这个训练课程是可选的。

or.zh: 你可以选择喝茶或者咖啡。

orbit.en: The Earth orbits the Sun once each year.
orbit.zh: 地球每年绕太阳运转一圈。

order.en: The general gave an order to advance.
order.zh: 将军下达了前进的命令。

ordinary.en: Today was just an ordinary day. Nothing unusual happened.

organ.en: The heart is a vital organ in our body.
organ.zh: 心脏是我们身体中的一个重要器官。

organise.en: We need to organise our ideas before we start the project.
organise.zh: 我们在启动项目之前需要整理我们的想法。

organize.en: Make a list to help you organize the things you need.

organiser.en: "She was the main organiser of the charity event."
organiser.zh: 她是这个慈善活动的主要组织者。

organization.en: He donated a significant amount of money to a charitable organization.
organization.zh: 他向慈善组织捐赠了大笔金钱。

other.en: Please take the other book on the table.
other.zh: 请拿桌子上的另一本书。

otherwise.en: It’s good to stay active; otherwise, you’ll gain weight.

ottawa.en: I'm planning a trip to Ottawa next month.
ottawa.zh: 我计划下个月去渥太华旅行。

ought.en: I ought to take my library books back.

ourselves.zh: 我们亲眼看到了那个事件。

out.en: As an adverb: He walked out.

outcome.en: The outcome of his latest business plan was a complete failure.

outer.en: The outer layers of the onion are the easiest to peel.

outgoing.en: "John is an outgoing person, he can easily get along with everyone."
outgoing.zh: 约翰是一个外向的人，他能够很容易地与每个人相处好。

outing.en: We plan an outing to the beach this weekend.
outing.zh: 我们计划这个周末去海滩游玩。

outline.en: Before I wrote my essay, I made an outline.

output.en: "The factory has increased its output this year."
output.zh: 今年这家工厂增加了产量。

outspoken.en: She was an outspoken critic about the new banking laws.

outstanding.en: He is an outstanding football player.
outstanding.zh: 他是一个优秀的足球运动员。

outward.en: On the outside, the box was painted in a beautiful outward design.
outward.zh: 表面上，这个盒子被画上了美丽的外部设计。

oval.en: She had an oval face with big blue eyes.
oval.zh: 她有一张带有大蓝眼睛的椭圆形脸庞。

overcome.en: Even though the odds were against her, she managed to overcome her situation.
overcome.zh: 尽管形势对她不利，她还是设法克服了困境。

overlook.en: Brenda overlooked the last step and had a bad fall.

overweight.en: Lisa eats too much, so now she’s overweight.

owner.en: I am the owner of this shop.

ownership.en: "The ownership of the house has been transferred to his eldest son."
ownership.zh: 这个房子的所有权已经转移到他的大儿子名下了。

oxygen.en: She thinks there is more oxygen in the air in the country than in the city.

pace.en: I ran the race at a slower pace than my friend.

pacific.en: The pacific nature of the island is greatly appreciated by tourists.
pacific.zh: 游客们非常欣赏岛上的宁静。

pack.en: I have a pack of gum in my pocket.
pack.zh: 我口袋里有一包口香糖。

package.en: "The mailman delivered a package to my house."
package.zh: 邮递员把一个包裹送到了我的家。

packet.en: I bought a packet of cookies at the store.
packet.zh: 我在商店买了一包饼干。

paddle.en: He used a paddle to row the boat out of the cave.
paddle.zh: 他用桨把船从洞穴中划出来。

page.en: He turned the page to continue reading.
page.zh: 他翻开了一页书继续阅读。

pain.en: She tried to hide her pain, but her tears betrayed her.
pain.zh: 她试图隐藏她的痛苦，但她的眼泪背叛了她。

paint.en: "I need to buy some paint to redecorate my room."
paint.zh: 我需要买些颜料来重新装饰我的房间。

painter.en: "The painter is almost finished with his masterpiece."
painter.zh: 这位画家的杰作快完成了。

pair.en: She bought a new pair of glasses.

palace.en: "The royal family lives in a grand palace."
palace.zh: 皇家家族住在一座豪华的宫殿里。

pale.en: Her face turned pale with fear.

pan.en: I'm making pancakes in the pan.

pancake.en: I often make pancakes for breakfast on Sundays.
pancake.zh: 我通常在周日的早椐时做煎饼。

panda.en: The panda is native to China.
panda.zh: 熊猫是中国的原生物种。

panic.en: The rumor about the layoffs caused a panic among the staff.
panic.zh: 裁员的谣言在员工中引起了恐慌。

paper.en: Could you pass me the paper, please?

paragraph.en: I found the information in the third paragraph of the article.
paragraph.zh: 我在文章的第三段找到了信息。

parallel.en: These two lines are parallel to each other.

parcel.en: I received a parcel from my friend overseas.
parcel.zh: 我收到了一份来自海外朋友的包裹。

pardon.en: I beg your pardon, I didn't catch what you said.
pardon.zh: 对不起，我没听清你说的话。

paris.en: I've always wished to go to Paris for my honeymoon.
paris.zh: 我一直希望去巴黎度蜜月。

park.en: He decided to park his car near the supermarket.
park.zh: 他决定把他的车停在超市附近。

parrot.en: The child parroted everything his teacher said.
parrot.zh: 这个孩子模仿他老师说的每一句话。

participate.en: "I often participate in community service activities on the weekends."
participate.zh: 我经常在周末参加社区服务活动。

particular.en: She has a particular interest in ancient history.
particular.zh: 她对古代历史有特殊兴趣。

partly.en: This book is partly based on the author's childhood.
partly.zh: 这本书部分基于作者的童年经历。

partner.en: He is my partner in crime.

pass.en: "I hope to pass the final exam."
pass.zh: 我希望能通过最后的考试。

passage.en: He made his passage through the crowded market.

passenger.en: One passenger was standing near the subway train.

passive.en: Marcie is so passive that she never solves her own problems.

passport.en: She renewed her passport before her trip to Japan.
passport.zh: 她在去日本之前续了她的护照。

patent.en: As a noun: "He holds the patent for this invention."
patent.zh: 他拥有这项发明的专利。

path.en: "The path to success is not always easy."
path.zh: 成功之路并不总是轻松的

patient.en: Forme adjective: You need to be patient if you want to see significant results in your training.
patient.zh: 你需要有耐心，如果你想在训练中看到显著的结果。

pattern.en: The wallpaper has a lovely floral pattern.
pattern.zh: 这款壁纸有着可爱的花朵图案。

pause.en: Please pause the movie, I need to go to the bathroom.
pause.zh: 请暂停电影，我需要去洗手间。

p.e..en: I have P.E class twice a week, and basketball is my favorite part.
p.e..zh: 我一周有两次体育课，篮球是我最喜欢的部分。

pea.en: I am eating a bowl of pea soup.

peace.en: A white dove is a symbol of peace.

peach.en: She bought a basket of peaches from the market.
peach.zh: 她从市场上买了一篮子桃子。

pear.zh: 她递给我一个熟透的梨子。

peasant.en: The peasant works from dawn to dusk in the fields.
peasant.zh: 这个农民从黎明到黄昏都在田野里工作。

pedestrian.en: As a pedestrian, it's important to follow traffic rules.
pedestrian.zh: 作为一个行人，遵守交通规则非常重要。

pen.en: She is looking for a pen to write a letter.

penny.en: How much is this candy? It's five pennies.
penny.zh: 这个糖果多少钱? 五便士。

people.en: People need food and water to survive.
people.zh: 人们需要食物和水来生存。

per.en: You are allowed 30 minutes per question during the exam.
per.zh: 你在考试中每题有30分钟的时间。

percent.en: She won the election with 56 percent of the vote.
percent.zh: 她以百分之五十六的票数赢得了选举。

perfect.en: She has a perfect grasp of English.
perfect.zh: 她的英语掌握得完美无缺。

perform.en: He will perform a song for the class.

performance.en: Liam’s performance in the race was not his best.

perfume.en: I bought a new perfume with a sweeter note.
perfume.zh: 我买了一款新的带有甜味的香水。

perhaps.en: Perhaps I will eat an apple for lunch.

period.en: I work for a period of six hours every day.

permanent.en: We don’t know if Aunt Mildred’s visit will be a permanent one.

permission.en: "May I have your permission to leave early?"
permission.zh: 我可以得到你的允许早些离开吗？

permit.en: 动词：You need to permit him to enter the room.
permit.zh: 你需要允许他进入房间。

person.zh: 每个人都是独一无二的

personal.en: "She has her personal reasons for that decision."
personal.zh: 她有她的个人原因做出那个决定。

personnel.en: When business increased, we had to hire more personnel.

personally.en: He personally led the team to a victory.
personally.zh: 他亲自带领队伍取得胜利。

persuade.en: Try to persuade him to come along with us.
persuade.zh: 试图说服他和我们一起来。

pest.en: We need to call an exterminator to deal with the pest infestation in our basement.
pest.zh: 我们需要找杀虫工处理我们地下室的害虫问题。

pet.en: "This shop has various pet supplies, like food, toys, and beds."
pet.zh: 这个商店有各种宠物用品，如食物、玩具和床

phenomenon.en: The Northern Lights are a natural phenomenon that is hard to predict.
phenomenon.zh: 北极光是一种难以预测的自然现象。

photograph.en: She keeps an old photograph of her parents in her wallet.
photograph.zh: 她在钱包里保存着她父母的一张旧照片。

photographer.en: The photographer captured the picturesque scenery quite well.
photographer.zh: 摄影师非常好地捕捉到了如画的风景。

phrase.en: "A stitch in time saves nine" is an old English phrase.
phrase.zh: “亡羊补牢，犹未为晚”是一个古老的英语短语。

physical.en: Biking is good for your physical health.

physician.en: The physician worked tirelessly throughout the night to save the patient.
physician.zh: 那位医师彻夜未眠地工作，以挽救病人的生命。

physics.en: I am studying Physics at university.

pianist.en: The world-renowned pianist will give a concert in our city next week.
pianist.zh: 世界闻名的钢琴家下周将在我们城市举办音乐会。

pick.en: We will pick a leader from amongst ourselves.
pick.zh: 我们会从自己当中挑选出一个领导。

picture.en: He took a picture of me with his phone.
picture.zh: 他用手机给我拍了张照片。

pie.en: Would you like a slice of pie?

piece.en: John need a piece of paper to write on.
piece.zh: 约翰需要一张纸来写字。

pile.en: He has a pile of homework to do.

pill.en: She took a pill for her headache.

pilot.en: He's a pilot for a major airline.
pilot.zh: 他是一家大型航空公司的飞行员。

pin.en: She used a pin to fasten the dress together.
pin.zh: 她使用了一个别针来固定裙子。

pine.en: I planted a pine in my backyard.
pine.zh: 我在后院种了一棵松树。

pineapple.en: She likes pineapple, but he doesn't.
pineapple.zh: 她喜欢菠萝，但是他不喜欢。

pink.en: "She dressed in pink to support breast cancer awareness."
pink.zh: 她穿着粉红色服装来支持乳腺癌的宣传活动。

pint.en: He downed a pint of beer in one go.
pint.zh: 他一口气喝掉了一品脱啤酒。

pioneer.en: As a noun: "He was a pioneer in the field of biotechnology."
pioneer.zh: 他是生物科技领域的先驱。

pipe.en: "The plumbers replaced the rusted pipes in my house."
pipe.zh: 水管工人替换了我家里生锈的管子。

pity.en: Because she had pity for the lost boy, she helped him find his parents.

place.en: A library is a place where people can read books.

plain.en: The lion is the king of the plain.

plan.en: I have a plan for the weekend.

plane.en: They took a plane across the ocean to India.

planet.en: The Earth is a planet in the solar system.
planet.zh: 地球是太阳系中的一个行星。

plant.en: （名词）There are many kinds of plants in the rainforest.
plant.zh: 雨林中有很多种类的植物。

plastic.en: Be sure to recycle your plastic bottles.
plastic.zh: 一定要回收你的塑料瓶。

plate.en: I put my plate down so I could put some food on it.

platform.en: "There's a new social media platform that specializes in sharing food reviews."
platform.zh: 有一个新的社交媒体平台，专门分享食品评价。

play.en: She likes to play soccer after school.

playroom.en: The children are playing upstairs in the playroom.
playroom.zh: 孩子们正在楼上的游戏室里玩耍。

pleasant.en: It's always pleasant to meet new people.
pleasant.zh: 总是很愉快去结识新的朋友。

pleased.en: She was very pleased with her new job.
pleased.zh: 她对她的新工作非常满意。

plenty.en: We have plenty of fruit, so help yourself.

plot.en: He has hatched a plot to destroy the ambassador.
plot.zh: 他策划了一个阴谋来铲除大使。

plug.en: I accidentally pulled the plug out of the socket.
plug.zh: 我不小心把插头从插座上拔了下来。

pocket.en: He felt in his pocket for his keys.
pocket.zh: 他在口袋里摸索他的钥匙。

poet.en: "Robert Frost is a famous poet known for his nature-themed poems."
poet.zh: 罗伯特·弗罗斯特是一位以其自然主题的诗歌而闻名的诗人。

point.en: From my point of view, we need a break.
point.zh: 从我的角度来看，我们需要一个休息。

poisonous.en: The berries of this plant are highly poisonous.
poisonous.zh: 这种植物的浆果非常有毒。

pole.en: He leaned against the pole and began to read his book.
pole.zh: 他靠着电杆开始看他的书。

police.en: The police are investigating the case.

policeman.en: "The policeman showed his badge and asked for ID."
policeman.zh: 警察展示了他的警徽并要求见证件。

policy.en: The government's economic policy has been widely criticized.
policy.zh: 政府的经济政策受到了广泛的批评。

polite.en: "It's always polite to say thank you when someone helps you."
polite.zh: 当有人帮助你的时候，说声谢谢总是很有礼貌的。

politician.en: John has always dreamt of becoming a politician.
politician.zh: John 一直梦想成为一名政治家。

politics.en: She is very interested in politics and often debates with her friends.
politics.zh: 她对政治非常感兴趣，经常和朋友们进行辩论。

pollute.en: The factory emissions pollute the air.
pollute.zh: 工厂的排放物污染了空气。

pollution.en: Industrial waste is a major source of soil pollution.
pollution.zh: 工业废物是土壤污染的主要来源

pond.en: The pond was frozen over this morning.
pond.zh: 今天早上那个池塘都结冰了。

pool.en: We had a great time swimming in the pool.
pool.zh: 我们在游泳池里玩得很开心。

poor.en: "He was too poor to afford a car." 他太穷了，买不起车。

popcorn.en: "I enjoy eating popcorn while watching a movie."
popcorn.zh: 我喜欢边看电影边吃爆米花。

popular.en: This is a very popular tourist destination.
popular.zh: 这是一个非常受欢迎的旅游目的地。

population.en: The population of our city is steadily growing.

pork.en: "I love the taste of barbecued pork."
pork.zh: 我喜欢烧烤猪肉的味道。

porridge.en: My favorite breakfast is porridge with a spoonful of honey.
porridge.zh: 我最喜欢的早餐是加了一勺蜂蜜的粥。

port.en: The ship docked at the port.

porter.en: "The hotel porter carried our bags to our room."
porter.zh: 酒店行李员把我们的行李送到了我们的房间。

position.en: She got a position in the sales department.
position.zh: 她在销售部门获得了一个职位。

possess.en: My uncle possesses three sheep, a chicken, a cow, and a dog.

possibility.en: There's a real possibility that he will win the race.
possibility.zh: 他赢得比赛的可能性很大。

possible.en: Anything is possible if you believe in yourself. 如果你相信自己，一切都有可能。
possible.zh: Chinese translation: 如果你相信自己，一切都有可能。

post.en: I received a post from my friend.
post.zh: 我收到了我的朋友的邮件。

postage.en: Remember to include the cost of postage in your budget.
postage.zh: 记得在你的预算中包括邮费。

postbox.en: I dropped the letter into the postbox.

postcard.en: He sent a postcard from Paris.
postcard.zh: 他从巴黎寄来了一张明信片。

postcode.en: "Please enter your postcode to find the nearest store."
postcode.zh: 请输入你的邮政编码以查找最近的商店。

poster.en: She bought a poster of her favorite band.她买了一张她最喜欢的乐队的海报。

postpone.en: They postponed the meeting until Elena arrived.

pot.en: She's boiling the vegetables in a large pot.

potential.en: He shows great potential in music. 他在音乐方面展示出巨大的潜力。

pound.en: I bought a pound of apples this morning.
pound.zh: 今天早上我买了一磅苹果。

pour.en: She began to pour the tea.

powder.en: You need to add some baking powder to the recipe.
powder.zh: 你需要在食谱中加入一些发酵粉。

power.en: "She has the power to change the company's direction."

powerful.en: The lion is a powerful animal.
powerful.zh: 狮子是一种强大的动物。

practical.en: This is a very practical solution to our problem.
practical.zh: 这是我们问题的一个非常实际的解决方案。

prairie.en: The prairie was perfect for a farm because there were hills and trees.

praise.en: The teacher gave praise to the student for his hard work.
praise.zh: 老师称赞了这个学生的勤奋努力。

pray.en: "Pray tell me, what is the secret to your success?"
pray.zh: 请告诉我，你的成功秘诀是什么？

prayer.en: Every night before bed, he said a prayer for his loved ones.
prayer.zh: 每晚临睡前，他都为他的亲人祈祷。

precious.zh: 在沙漠中，水是非常宝贵的。

precise.en: The builder was very precise about where he placed the nails.

predict.en: Economists predict that house prices will rise by 3% this year.
predict.zh: 经济学家们预测今年的房价将上涨3%。

prefer.en: I prefer listening to music over watching television.
prefer.zh: 我更喜欢听音乐，不喜看电视。

pregnant.en: She is pregnant with her first child.

prejudice.en: The company’s rules against gender prejudice must be enforced.

preparation.en: The teacher's careful preparation for lessons impressed her students.
preparation.zh: 老师严谨的备课给她的学生留下了深刻的印象。

prescription.en: "The doctor gave me a prescription for my cough."
prescription.zh: 医生为我的咳嗽开了处方。

present.en: 名词: He bought a present for his mother's birthday.
present.zh: 他为母亲的生日买了一个礼物。

presentation.en: She is preparing for her presentation on climate change.
presentation.zh: 她正在为她关于气候变化的演讲做准备。

preserve.en: We need to preserve our natural resources for future generations.
preserve.zh: 我们需要为未来的一代保护我们的自然资源。

president.en: "The president will give a speech tonight."
president.zh: 总统将在今晚发表演讲。

press.en: As a verb: "Please press the button to start the machine."

pressure.en: They put pressure on him to change his mind.

pretend.en: I had to pretend I didn't know you.

prevent.en: The handcuffs prevented me from moving my hands.

preview.en: The band played us a preview of their new song.

price.en: The price of the house is beyond our reach.
price.zh: 这所房子的价格超出了我们的负担。

pride.en: His eyes were full of pride when he accepted the award.
pride.zh: 他接受奖项时眼神满是自豪。

primary.en: "He finished the investigated the primary cause of the accident." - 他完成了对事故的主要原因的调查。

primitive.en: The computers of the 1980s are primitive compared to those of today.

principle.en: To maintain principles, it’s vital to watch, listen, and speak carefully.

print.en: Make sure that you print your name clearly.

printer.en: "The printer is out of ink, we need to buy some more."
printer.zh: 打印机缺墨水了，我们需要买一些。

prison.en: He was sentenced to two years in prison.

prisoner.en: He was taken as a prisoner during the war.
prisoner.zh: 他在战争中被俘为囚犯。

privilege.en: Being allowed to go out to play is a privilege, not a right.
privilege.zh: 可出去玩是一种特权，不是一种权利。

prize.en: He won the first prize in the singing competition.
prize.zh: 他在歌唱比赛中赢得了一等奖。

probable.en: It's probable that they will arrive by train.
probable.zh: 他们很可能会坐火车来。

probably.en: It will probably rain later tonight.

problem.en: We need to address the problem of global warming.
problem.zh: 我们需要解决全球变暖的问题

procedure.en: "The lab technician explained the procedure for the experiment."
procedure.zh: 实验室技术员解释了实验的程序。

process.en: The baking process takes about two hours.
process.zh: 烘烤过程大约需要两个小时。

produce.en: Factories produce goods for the global market.
produce.zh: 工厂为全球市场生产商品。

product.en: This is the latest product of our company.
product.zh: 这是我们公司最新的产品。

profession.en: "He decided to follow a profession in medicine."

professor.en: Mike’s science professor knows a lot about physics.

profit.en: The company made a huge profit this year.
profit.zh: 这家公司今年赚了大钱。

programme.en: They have agreed on a programme of reforms.
programme.zh: 他们已经就一系列的改革达成一致。

progress.en: "We made great progress in our discussions."
progress.zh: 我们的讨论取得了很大的进展。

prohibit.en: Smoking is strictly prohibited in this area.

project.en: The construction company has won a lucrative contract for a major project in downtown.
project.zh: 这家建筑公司赢得了市区一项重大项目的合同，这对他们非常有利。

promise.en: "I made a promise to help him."

promote.en: "The government launched a campaign to **promote** healthy eating habits."
promote.zh: 政府发起了一个促进健康饮食习惯的活动。

pronounce.en: Young children often have trouble pronouncing words right.

pronunciation.en: The English pronunciation of the word is quite different from the French.
pronunciation.zh: 这个词的英语发音与法语发音相差甚远。

proper.en: Please use the proper tools for the job.
proper.zh: 请使用适当的工具来做这项工作。

protect.en: We need to protect our environment from pollution.
protect.zh: 我们需要保护环境免遭污染。

protection.en: "The helmet provides protection for the head."

proud.en: I'm very proud of my son's achievements in sports.
proud.zh: 我对我儿子在体育上的成就感到非常骄傲。

prove.en: My teacher proved the answer on the board.

provide.en: She is unable to provide for her family.

province.en: Ontario is the most populous province in Canada.
province.zh: 安大略是加拿大人口最多的省份。

psychology.en: John majored in Psychology at university.
psychology.zh: 约翰在大学主修心理学。

pub.en: Let's meet at the pub after work.
pub.zh: 下班后我们在酒吧见吧。

publicly.zh: 他公开承认了自己的错误。

pull.en: Pull the rope and the bell will ring.

pulse.en: He could feel the pulse beating in his temples.
pulse.zh: 他可以感觉到太阳穴处的脉搏跳动。

pump.en: I need to pump up the tires on my bike.
pump.zh: 我需要给自行车胎打气。

punctual.en: "He was always punctual for his appointments."

punctuate.en: I forgot to punctuate my sentence.
punctuate.zh: 我忘记给我的句子加标点符号了。

punish.en: The school does not hesitate to punish students who break the rules.
punish.zh: 学校对于违反规定的学生从不犹豫惩罚。

punishment.en: "She received a severe punishment for her crimes."
punishment.zh: 她因为犯罪，受到了严厉的惩罚。

pupil.en: The teacher praised the pupil for his hard work.
pupil.zh: 老师表扬了这个学生的刻苦学习。

purchase.en: I'd like to purchase a ticket for the concert.
purchase.zh: 我想购买一张音乐会的门票。

pure.en: This drink is made from pure fruit juice.
pure.zh: 这个饮料是用纯果汁制成的。

purple.en: She wore a purple dress to the party.
purple.zh: 她穿了一件紫色的裙子去参加派对。

purpose.en: What is the purpose of your visit?
purpose.zh: 你本次访问的目的是什么？

purse.en: My sister likes to buy designer purses.

puzzled.en: "She had a puzzled look on her face."

qualification.en: She has all the qualifications needed for the job.
qualification.zh: 她具备做这份工作需要的所有资质。

quality.en: The quality of his car is very good.

quantity.en: I have a small quantity of milk in my glass.

quarrel.en: Billy quarreled with his wife about buying a new house.

quarter.en: The apple was cut into quarters.
quarter.zh: 苹果被切成了四分之一。

question.en: Could you answer my question, please?
question.zh: 请你能回答我的问题吗？

questionnaire.en: I'm filling out a questionnaire on customer satisfaction.
questionnaire.zh: 我正在填一份客户满意度调查问卷。

queue.en: She stood at the end of the queue.

quick.zh: 约翰尼做了一个快速的决定。

quilt.en: She made a beautiful quilt from scraps of fabric.
quilt.zh: 她从零星的布料中制作了一床漂亮的被子。

quit.en: I quit running because I got tired.

quite.en: I think typing on a keyboard is quite easy.

rabbit.en: Look at the rabbit in the park.

race.en: 他们正在竞赛中争取首位。
race.zh: They are racing for the first place.

racial.en: Racial discrimination is a severe problem in some countries.
racial.zh: 在某些国家，种族歧视是一个严重的问题。

radio.en: I listen to the news on the radio every morning.
radio.zh: 我每天早晨都在收音机上听新闻。

radioactive.en: Radioactive states can be very bad for anyone’s health.

rag.en: He wiped the dust off the table with a rag.
rag.zh: 他用一块抹布擦掉了桌子上的灰尘。

rail.en: The train moves on the rail.

railway.en: The railway station is right across the street.

rain.en: I forgot my umbrella, and I was caught in the rain.
rain.zh: 我忘记带伞，结果被雨淋了。

rainbow.en: I saw a beautiful rainbow after the rain.
rainbow.zh: 雨后我看到了一道美丽的彩虹。

raincoat.en: Don't forget to pack a raincoat when you go camping.
raincoat.zh: 去露营的时候别忘了带上雨衣

rainfall.en: In the past year, the annual rainfall in this area has exceeded 100 inches.
rainfall.zh: 去年，这个地区的年降雨量超过了100英寸。

rainy.en: It's a rainy day, we'd better stay indoor.
rainy.zh: 今天是个雨天，我们最好待在室内。

raise.en: I decided to raise my hand and ask the teacher a question.
raise.zh: 我决定举手向老师提问。

random.en: The winning lottery numbers are chosen at random.
random.zh: 中彩的号码是随机抽取的

range.en: I saw a range of cars to choose from.

rank.en: His rank in the company is much higher than mine.
rank.zh: 他在公司的职位比我高得多。

rapid.en: His mother was surprised by her son’s rapid growth.

rare.en: Rare birds are often spotted in this area.
rare.zh: 这个地区经常能发现稀有的鸟类。

rat.en: There's a rat in the kitchen.

rate.en: The rate of inflation is increasing.

rather.en: He is rather tall for his age.
rather.zh: 他的个子大于他的同龄人。

raw.en: The sushi is made from raw fish.

ray.en: The morning ray broke through the window.
ray.zh: 早晨的阳光透过窗户照射进来。

razor.en: He cut himself with a razor.

reach.en: The city is within easy reach of the coast.

react.en: James reacted badly to the news.

read.en: I like to read books before bedtime.
read.zh: 我喜欢在睡前阅读书籍。

real.en: Some people don’t believe in aliens from space, but I think they’re real.

realize.en: After I left my house, I realized that I left the light on.

reason.en: The reason why he didn't come is that he was ill.
reason.zh: 他之所以没来，是因为他生病了。

reasonable.en: It's completely reasonable for you to want a day off.
reasonable.zh: 你想要休息一天完全可以理解。

receipt.en: Please keep your receipt for your records.
receipt.zh: 请保留您的收据作为记录。

receive.en: "Did you receive the letter I sent you?"
receive.zh: 你收到我寄给你的信了吗？

recent.en: I have a recent interest in photography.
recent.zh: 我最近对摄影产生了兴趣。

reception.en: We held a warm reception for our foreign friends.
reception.zh: 我们热情地招待了我们的外国朋友。

receptionist.en: The receptionist greeted us as we entered the hotel.
receptionist.zh: 当我们进入酒店时，接待员向我们打招呼。

recipe.en: Do you use a recipe when you make that sauce?

recite.en: He can recite the entire poem from memory.
recite.zh: 他能够凭记忆背诵整首诗。

recognise.en: He didn't recognise me at first.

recognize.en: I recognized an old friend from many years ago.

recommend.en: His doctor will recommend the best medicine for her cough.

record.en: He has a good academic record.

recorder.en: As the recorder of the meeting, he had to write down the important points discussed.
recorder.zh: 作为会议的记录员，他必须记录下讨论的重要内容。

recover.en: He is recovering from a serious illness.
recover.zh: 他正在从严重的疾病中恢复。

recycle.en: We should recycle plastic bottles to reduce waste.
recycle.zh: 我们应该回收利用塑料瓶以减少废物。

rectangle.zh: 这个花园是一个完美的矩形。

red.en: Jack is wearing a red shirt.

reduce.en: When the store reduced its prices, people wanted to shop there.

refer.en: Mr. Cid referred to the time to show Bill that he was late for class.

referee.en: The soccer player didn’t agree with the referee.

reference.en: You can find more information in the reference section of the library.
reference.zh: 在图书馆的参考部分，你可以找到更多的信息。

reflect.en: The sun's rays reflect off the surface of the water.

refrigerator.en: Can you get me a bottle of milk from the refrigerator?
refrigerator.zh: 你能从冰箱里给我拿瓶牛奶吗？

refuse.en: The dog refused to play with the cat.

regard.en: The boy regarded the girl as a good friend.

regards.en: I'm writing with regards to your recent job application.
regards.zh: 关于你最近的求职申请，我写信来联系你。

register.en: At a wedding, there is register for all of the guests to sign.

regret.en: I regret saying those things to him.

regular.en: Our regular lunch time is around noon.

regulation.en: "The company operates under strict regulation from the government."
regulation.zh: 公司在政府的严格监管下运营。

reject.en: He rejected my offer of help.

relate.en: A company’s plan usually relates to how much profit it can make.

relationship.en: The teacher was proud of her good relationship with the students.

relative.en: She is a distant relative of mine.

relax.en: Nicole likes to relax by reading books.

relevant.en: The 30-year-old book about politics is still relevant to our society today.

reliable.en: He is a reliable friend you can always count on.
reliable.zh: 他是一个你总是可以依靠的可靠朋友。

relief.en: The medicine gave me instant relief from my headache.
relief.zh: 药立刻缓解了我的头痛。

religion.en: Her family is very strict about religion.
religion.zh: 她的家庭对宗教很严格

religious.en: The holy man spoke about religious topics.

rely.en: You can't rely on the weather in summer, it changes so quickly.
rely.zh: 你不能依赖夏天的天气，它变化如此之快。

remain.en: "Even after the fire, the structure of the building remained intact."
remain.zh: 即使火灾过后，建筑物的结构仍然完整。

remark.en: Her remark about the music was completely out of place.
remark.zh: 她对音乐的评论完全不合时宜。

remind.en: Nick’s dad reminded him to do his homework.

remote.en: I live in a remote village in the mountains.
remote.zh: 我住在山里的一个偏远的村庄。

remove.en: Could you please remove your shoes at the door?

rent.en: I need to pay my rent at the beginning of each month.
rent.zh: 我需要在每个月初交房租。

repair.en: I plan to repair my broken bicycle this weekend.
repair.zh: 我打算这个周末修理我的破自行车。

replace.en: Please replace the book on the shelf when you're finished.
replace.zh: 当你看完书后，请把书放回书架。

reply.en: She didn't reply to my e-mail.
reply.zh: 她没有回复我的电子邮件。

report.en: He delivered his report to the manager.

reporter.en: The reporter asked the politician about his plans for education reform.
reporter.zh: 这位记者询问了政治家关于他的教育改革计划。

represent.en: The union represents the interests of all workers.
represent.zh: 工会代表所有工人的利益。

republic.en: The United States is a republic.

reputation.en: His reputation for honesty is widely recognized.
reputation.zh: 他的诚实名声广为人知。

require.en: We require teachers to have a university degree.

requirement.en: The job has a requirement for proficiency in Microsoft Office.
requirement.zh: 这份工作要求熟练使用 Microsoft Office。

rescue.en: The firefighter rescued the man from the burning building.

research.en: We need to conduct some **research** into the cause of the problem.
research.zh: 我们需要对问题的原因进行一些**研究**。

reserve.en: He has a reserve of energy that never seems to run out. 他有源源不断的能量储备。

resign.en: "Due to personal reasons, I have decided to resign from my position."
resign.zh: 由于个人原因，我决定放弃我的职位。

resist.en: He resisted the treatment at the hospital.

respect.en: We should show respect to our teachers.
respect.zh: 我们应该尊重我们的老师。

respond.en: "When I asked him how his day was, he didn't respond."
respond.zh: 当我问他今天过得怎么样，他没有回应。

responsibility.en: "Being a teacher carries a heavy responsibility."
responsibility.zh: 作为老师承担了很大的责任.

rest.en: As a verb: "After a long day of work, I needed to rest."
rest.zh: 经过一整天的工作后，我需要休息。

restaurant.en: "She enjoys dining out at a fancy restaurant with her friends."
restaurant.zh: 她享受和朋友们在一家豪华餐厅里用餐。

restrict.en: Some areas are restricted to authorized personnel only.
restrict.zh: 某些区域只限于授权人员进入。

restriction.en: There are no restrictions on the amount of money you can deposit in this account.
restriction.zh: 你在这个账户里存款没有限制。

result.en: The result of the test was not what we expected.
result.zh: 测试的结果并不是我们所期待的。

retell.en: He likes to retell his adventures in Africa.
retell.zh: 他喜欢重新讲述他在非洲的冒险经历。

retire.en: He will retire from his position next month.

return.en: He returned home after five years abroad.
return.zh: 他在国外待了五年后回家了。

review.en: We need to review our plans before we can proceed.
review.zh: 我们需要在进行之前回顾我们的计划。

reviewer.en: As a book reviewer, her reviews are published in various newspapers.
reviewer.zh: 她是一名书评人，她的书评在各种报刊上发表。

revision.en: The teacher expects the revision of my essay by tomorrow.
revision.zh: 老师期望我明天完成对我的论文的修改。

revolution.en: The French Revolution changed the course of history.
revolution.zh: 法国大革命改变了历史的进程。

reward.en: The teacher gave me a reward for being the best student in class.
reward.zh: 老师因为我是班上最好的学生而给予我奖励。

rhyme.en: “Humpty Dumpty” is an old rhyme that children learn in school.

rice.en: I had rice and vegetables for lunch.
rice.zh: 我中午的饭是米饭和蔬菜。

rich.en: The rich aroma of coffee filled the room.
rich.zh: 房间里充满了咖啡的浓郁香气。

rid.en: I finally got rid of my old car.
rid.zh: 我终于把我那辆旧车处理掉了。

riddle.en: The book is filled with riddles and puzzles.
riddle.zh: 这本书充满了谜语和难题。

ridiculous.en: Steve looked ridiculous with those huge blue sunglasses.

rigid.en: Societies often have rigid rules about the way that people are supposed to act.

ripe.en: The apples on the tree are ripe now.

ripen.en: "Wait for the bananas to ripen before you eat them."

risk.en: There's always a risk in starting a new business.
risk.zh: 开创新业务总是有风险的。

road.en: There's a long, winding road ahead of us.
road.zh: 前方是一条蜿蜒曲折的路。

roast.en: Mom roasted a turkey for the holiday dinner.

rob.en: The bank was robbed by two men with masks.
rob.zh: 那个银行被两个戴着面具的男子抢劫了。

robot.en: The robot can perform surgery more accurately than human hands.
robot.zh: 这个机器人能比人的手进行更精确的手术。

rock.en: He collected some rocks at the beach.
rock.zh: 他在海滩上收集了些岩石。

rocket.en: The rocket launched into space with a roar.
rocket.zh: 那枚火箭轰鸣着升入太空。

role.en: He played a key role in the negotiation process. 他在谈判过程中起了关键的作用。

roll.en: The car rolled into the ditch.

room.en: There is no room for error in this task.
room.zh: 这项任务没有出错的余地。

rooster.en: The rooster crowed at the break of dawn.

rope.en: I bought a piece of rope from the hardware store.
rope.zh: 我从五金店买了一根绳子。

rot.en: The food left in the fridge began to rot.
rot.zh: 放在冰箱里的食物开始腐烂了。

roundabout.en: He gave me a roundabout answer when I asked him about his career plans.
roundabout.zh: 他在我询问他关于职业计划时给我一个含糊其辞的答复。

routine.en: My father’s daily routine includes shaving right before breakfast.

row.en: There is a row of trees lining the street.

royal.zh: 她的皇家殿下马上就要到了。

rubber.en: He is manufacturing a car tire made of rubber.
rubber.zh: 他正在制造一只橡胶制的汽车轮胎。

rubbish.en: Don't throw rubbish in the street.

rugby.en: 我喜欢看橄榄球比赛，特别是鲁格比联盟赛。
rugby.zh: I enjoy watching rugby games, especially the Rugby League matches.

ruin.en: Our walk in the park was ruined by the sudden rain.

rule.en: Wearing a helmet while riding a bicycle is a rule in some cities.

ruler.en: I used a ruler to draw the line.

russia.en: I am planning a trip to Russia this winter.
russia.zh: 我计划今年冬天去俄罗斯旅行。

russian.en: As a noun: "He is a Russian."

sacred.en: One religion in India will not harm cows because it believes that they are sacred.

sacrifice.en: To achieve her goal, she made a great sacrifice and gave up her comfortable life.
sacrifice.zh: 为了实现她的目标，她做出了巨大的牺牲，放弃了她舒适的生活。

safe.en: We need to find a safe place to hide.
safe.zh: 我们需要找一个安全的地方躲藏。

safety.en: The safety of the passengers is our primary concern.
safety.zh: 乘客的安全是我们的首要关心事项。

sail.en: The sail of the boat fluttered in the wind.

salad.en: "I ordered a Caesar salad with my steak."
salad.zh: 我在我的牛排旁点了一个凯撒沙拉。

salary.en: He got a new job with a better salary.

salesgirl.en: The salesgirl showed me where the dressing rooms are.
salesgirl.zh: 这个销售员告诉我更衣室在哪。

saleswoman.en: The saleswoman persuaded me to buy the dress.
saleswoman.zh: 销售员说服我买了这件裙子。
