salt.en: She put some salt in the soup to make it more flavorful.
salt.zh: 她在汤里加了一些盐，使其更加美味。

same.en: We are in the same class.

sand.en: The waves washed up onto the sand.

sandwich.en: "Can I have a chicken sandwich, please?"
sandwich.zh: 我能点一个鸡肉三明治吗？

satellite.en: The satellite was traveling around the Earth.

satisfaction.zh: 我从帮助别人中获得了满足

satisfy.en: It will satisfy my teacher if I finish all my homework.

sausage.en: "I bought some sausage at the butcher's."
sausage.zh: 我在肉贩那里买了点香肠。

savage.en: The lion's savage roar could be heard miles away.
savage.zh: 狮子凶猛的吼叫声可以听到好几英里之外。

save.en: Remember to save money for a rainy day.
save.zh: 记得为难得的日子存钱。

saying.en: "Where there's smoke, there's fire." is a famous saying.
saying.zh: 烟云之下必有点火，是一个著名的谚语。

scan.en: "She scanned the room for familiar faces."
scan.zh: 她扫视了一眼房间，寻找熟悉的面孔。

scar.en: The man had horrible scars on his cheek and forehead.

scare.en: Don't **scare** the children with your ghost stories.
scare.zh: 不要用你的鬼故事**吓**孩子们。

scene.en: A movie is made up of many short pieces or scenes.

schedule.en: The meeting is scheduled for 10 a.m.

school.en: Mary's children go to the school down the street.
school.zh: 玛丽的孩子们在街头上的那所学校上课。

scholar.en: The scholar knew much about art history.

scholarship.en: "She was awarded a scholarship for her outstanding academic performance."
scholarship.zh: 她因优秀的学业表现而获得奖学金。

schoolbag.en: "John forgot his schoolbag at home this morning."
schoolbag.zh: 约翰今早把书包忘在家里了。

science.en: Science is a systematic pursuit of knowledge.
science.zh: 科学是对知识的系统追求。

scientific.en: The laws of physics are fundamental to numerous scientific disciplines.
scientific.zh: 物理定律是诸多科学领域的基础

scold.en: 打破玻璃杯后，她受到妈妈的指责。
scold.zh: After breaking the glass cup, she was scolded by her mother.

score.en: Our team is leading by one score.

scores.en: The conductor is studying the score.

scotland.en: Scotland is famous for its beautiful highlands.
scotland.zh: 苏格兰以其美丽的高地而闻名。

scratch.en: Don't scratch your insect bites, or they will get worse.
scratch.zh: 不要抓你的蚊虫叮咬处，否则会更糟糕。

scream.zh: 我听到了一个大尖叫声。

screen.en: Could you please clean the fingerprints off the screen?
screen.zh: 你能清理一下屏幕上的指纹吗？

sea.en: The ship sailed across the sea.

seagull.en: 1.  A seagull is flying over the sea.
seagull.zh: 一只海鸥正在海上飞翔。

seal.en: The seal lay on the ice, basking in the sun.
seal.zh: 那只海豹躺在冰上，沐浴在阳光中。

search.en: I normally search for information on the Internet.
search.zh: 我通常在网上搜索信息。

seaside.en: "We traveled to the seaside during the summer vacation."
seaside.zh: 我们在暑假期间去了海边。

season.en: Fall is a warm season, while winter is very cold.

seaweed.en: I collected some seaweed at the beach this morning.
seaweed.zh: 我今早在海滩上收集了一些海藻。

secondhand.en: She bought a secondhand dress from the thrift shop.
secondhand.zh: 她从旧货店购买了一条二手裙子。

secret.en: She told me her secret in confidence.
secret.zh: 她信任我，因此告诉我了她的秘密。

secretary.en: Rebecca asked her secretary to type a report.

section.en: This is the historical section of the library.
section.zh: 这是图书馆的历史部分。

secure.en: I was able to secure a good grade on my test after weeks of studying.

security.en: For your security, please don't share your password with anyone.
security.zh: 为了你的安全，请不要与任何人共享你的密码。

seed.en: I planted the seed in the dirt, hoping that it would grow into a tree.

seem.zh: 这个任务看起来不可能完成。

seize.en: The police had to seize the suspect.
seize.zh: 警察不得不逮捕这个嫌犯。

seldom.en: It seldom rains in southern Arizona.

select.en: They had to select textbooks for each class.

selfish.en: Don't be so selfish. Think about others for once!
selfish.zh: 不要如此自私。偶尔考虑一下别人！

senior.en: Because he got his job first, Bob is the senior chef.

sense.en: She has a great sense of humor.

sensitive.en: His skin is very sensitive to the sun.
sensitive.zh: 他的皮肤对阳光十分敏感。

separate.en: New York and Los Angeles are in two separate parts of America.

separation.en: After several years of marriage, they decided to have a separation.
separation.zh: 经过多年的婚姻，他们决定分手。

serve.en: I used to serve in the military.

service.en: His dedication to public service is truly admirable.
service.zh: 他对公共服务的奉献令人钦佩。

settle.en: Let's settle this dispute once and for all.
settle.zh: 我们一劳永逸地解决这个争端吧。

settlement.en: The two parties reached a settlement out of court.
settlement.zh: 两方在法庭外达成和解。

seven.en: I have seven colored pencils on my desk.

seventy.en: My grandmother is seventy years old today.
seventy.zh: 我的祖母今天七十岁了。

several.en: I have read several books on this topic.
several.zh: 我阅读了几本关于这个主题的书。

severe.en: After hitting his hand with the hammer, Sam was in severe pain.

sew.en: I learned to sew when I was a little girl.

shade.en: "He sat in the shade of a large tree."
shade.zh: 他坐在一棵大树的阴影下。

shadow.en: The tree cast a long shadow on the grass.
shadow.zh: 树在草地上投下了长长的影子。

shallow.en: The kids were playing in the shallow water.

shanghai.en: Shanghai is one of the most vibrant cities in China.
shanghai.zh: 上海是中国最有活力的城市之一

shape.en: The shape of this diamond is outstanding.

share.en: Jimmy shared his apple with me.

shark.en: The surfer was attacked by a shark.

sharp.en: That knife is very sharp. Be careful not to hurt yourself.

sharpen.en: Can you sharpen the pencil for me?
sharpen.zh: 你可以帮我削一下铅笔吗？

sharpener.en: My pencil is blunt, could you pass me the sharpener?
sharpener.zh: 我的铅笔变钝了，能把削笔机递给我吗？

shave.en: My father shaves his face every day because he doesn’t want a beard.

shaver.en: I need to buy a new **shaver**, mine just broke.
shaver.zh: 我需要买个新的**剃须刀**，我的刚坏掉。

sheep.en: The sheep are grazing in the field.

sheet.en: I need a clean bed sheet.
sheet.zh: 我需要一条干净的床单。

shelter.en: The woods provided a perfect shelter from the rain.

shine.en: The sun shines brightly in the sky.

ship.en: The ship sailed across the Pacific Ocean.

shirt.en: He put on his shirt and tie.

shock.en: The news gave her a shock.

shoe.en: I bought a new pair of shoes.

shoot.en: He learned how to shoot when he joined the army.
shoot.zh: 他在参军后学会了如何射击。

shooting.en: He won a gold medal in the shooting event.
shooting.zh: 他在射击比赛中赢得了金牌。

shop.en: I need to go to the shop to buy some milk.
shop.zh: 我需要去商店买些牛奶。

shopkeeper.en: The shopkeeper is arranging goods on the shelves.
shopkeeper.zh: 店主正在货架上摆放商品。

shore.en: They are walking along the shore.
shore.zh: 他们正在沿着海岸行走。

short.en: He has a short temper. 他脾气暴躁。
short.zh: 这里的"short"是形容他的脾气很容易就爆发

shorts.en: Do you need a new pair of shorts for your vacation?
shorts.zh: 你假期需要一条新的短裤吗?

should.en: You should study hard to pass the exam.
should.zh: 你应该努力学习以通过考试

shoulder.en: He carried his bike on his shoulder.

shout.en: He had to shout to make himself heard.
shout.zh: 他必须大声喊叫以让别人能听见他。

shuttle.en: The shuttle bus runs between the hotel and the airport.
shuttle.zh: 穿梭车在酒店和机场之间运行。

shy.zh: 约翰对陌生人比较害羞。

sick.en: I am sick and I need to see a doctor.
sick.zh: 我生病了，我需要看医生。

side.en: He sat on the side of the bed.

sideways.en: Jim turned sideways in order to slow down and stop his snowboard.

sigh.en: He sighed with relief when he saw that his car was still there.
sigh.zh: 他发现车还在，于是叹了口气。

sightseeing.en: We went sightseeing in Rome for the day.
sightseeing.zh: 我们花了一天时间在罗马观光。

sign.en: The sign indicated that today would be a bad day.

signal.en: The traffic signal turned red, so he put his foot on the brake.
signal.zh: 交通信号变红了，于是他踩下了刹车。

signature.en: "Please provide your signature at the bottom of the form."

significance.en: "We need to understand the full significance of these results."
significance.zh: 我们需要理解这些结果的全部意义。

silence.en: I can only sleep in complete silence.

silent.en: Since no one was home, the house was silent.

silk.en: She's wearing a beautiful silk dress.
silk.zh: 她穿着一条漂亮的丝绸裙子。

similar.en: These two pictures are very similar.

simplify.en: We need to simplify the process to increase efficiency.
simplify.zh: 我们需要简化流程以提高效率。

singer.en: He is a famous rock singer.
singer.zh: 他是一位著名的摇滚歌手。

single.en: I have a single key in my hand.

sink.en: Don't load the boat too much, or it will sink.
sink.zh: 荷载过重就会使船沉下去

sister.en: My sister and I get along very well.
sister.zh: 我和我的姐妹关系很好。

situation.en: "I am not happy about my current situation."
situation.zh: 我对我现在的情况不满意。

sixth.en: She is the sixth person to join the team.
sixth.zh: 她是第六个加入团队的人。

sixteen.en: "She celebrated her sweet sixteen with a big party."
sixteen.zh: 她用一场大型派对庆祝了自己的16岁生日。

ski.en: "She is going to ski down the hill."

skill.zh: 她拥有出色的烹饪技巧。

skillful.en: The carpenter is very skillful at building houses.

skillfully.en: He skillfully managed to avoid all the obstacles.
skillfully.zh: 他巧妙地避开了所有的障碍。

skin.en: "His skin is very smooth and soft."
skin.zh: 他的皮肤非常光滑柔软。

skip.en: She often skips around in the garden.
skip.zh: 她经常在花园里跳来跳去。

sky.en: The sky is full of stars tonight.

sleep.en: "I had a good sleep last night."

sleepy.en: I'm feeling sleepy; it's time for me to go to bed.
sleepy.zh: 我感到困了，我该去睡觉了。

sleeve.en: He rolled up his sleeves and started to work.

slice.en: The girl enjoyed a slice of cake at her birthday party.

slide.en: Watch your step or you might slide on the ice.
slide.zh: 小心你的脚步，否则你可能会在冰上滑倒。

slight.en: There's a slight chance of rain tonight.
slight.zh: 今晚有轻微的下雨概率。

slim.zh: 每个人都看起来苗条又好看。

slip.en: The man slipped on the wet floor.

slow.en: "The traffic is slow during rush hour."
slow.zh: 在高峰时段，交通状况很糟糕。

smell.en: I could smell the flowers from a distance.
smell.zh: 我能从远处闻到花的香味。

smelly.en: She threw out the smelly garbage.
smelly.zh: 她扔掉了散发恶臭的垃圾

smog.en: The city was enveloped in smog.

smoke.en: He was coughing from the smoke.

smoker.en: He is a heavy smoker, smoking two packs of cigarettes a day.
smoker.zh: 他是一个重度吸烟者，每天抽两包香烟。

smooth.en: The marble is smooth and cool to the touch.
smooth.zh: 大理石触感光滑且凉爽。

snack.en: "I often have a snack in the mid-afternoon to keep my energy up."
snack.zh: 我通常在下午吃点小食品来保持精力.

snake.en: The snake slithered across the grass.
snake.zh: 那条蛇在草地上蜿蜒爬行。

sneeze.en: I need to sneeze, but it got away.
sneeze.zh: 我需要打喷嚏，但它没有出来。

snow.en: The snow is falling softly outside.
snow.zh: 外面雪花轻轻地飘落下来。

snowball.en: We made a giant snowball and rolled it down the hill.
snowball.zh: 我们做了一个巨大的雪球，把它从山上滚下来。

snowy.en: "We had a snowy winter last year."
snowy.zh: 我们去年度过了一个白雪皑皑的冬天。

soap.en: He dropped the bar of soap in the shower. 他在淋浴时把肥皂掉了。

sob.en: As he realized the depth of his mistake, he began to sob.
sob.zh: 当他意识到错误的严重性，他开始抽泣

social.en: People should come together and fix the world’s social problems.

socialism.en: He was advocating socialism to minimize the economic disparity in the country.
socialism.zh: 他倡导社会主义以减少国内的经济差距。

socialist.en: He is a member of a socialist party.
socialist.zh: 他是社会主义党派的一员。

society.en: Society expects people to be good and honest.

sock.en: He bought a pair of socks.

socket.en: Please unplug the lamp from the socket.
socket.zh: 请把灯从插座上拔下来。

sofa.en: Please take a seat on the sofa.

software.en: The new accounting software has made our job much easier.
software.zh: 新的会计软件使我们的工作变得轻松许多。

softball.en: Our school has a very strong girls' softball team.
softball.zh: 我们学校的女子垒球队很强。

soil.en: Without healthy soil, plants cannot grow properly.
soil.zh: 没有健康的土壤，植物无法正常生长。

solar.en: "Solar panels convert the sunlight into electricity."
solar.zh: 太阳能板将阳光转化为电力。

soldier.en: He enlisted as a soldier when he turned 18.
soldier.zh: 他18岁时参军成为了一名士兵。

somebody.en: **Somebody** left their umbrella in the classroom.
somebody.zh: 有人在教室里落了雨伞。

sometimes.en: Sometimes I like to read books in the park.
sometimes.zh: 我有时喜欢在公园里看书。

son.en: My son is going to school.

soon.en: I'll call you as soon as possible.

sorrow.en: The girl felt sorrow after her best friend moved away.

sorry.en: I'm sorry that I forgot your birthday.
sorry.zh: 对不起，我忘记了你的生日。

sort.en: I need to sort out my closet.

soul.en: "He is the soul of the company."

sound.en: I enjoy the sound of rain on the roof.
sound.zh: 我喜欢雨打在屋顶上的声音。

soup.en: I'd like a bowl of tomato soup, please.

south.en: The flowers always turn towards the south.
south.zh: 那些花朵总是朝向南方。

southwest.en: "Texas is in the southwest of the United States."
southwest.zh: 德克萨斯位于美国的西南部

souvenirs.en: Every time we go on vacation, we bring back souvenirs.
souvenirs.zh: 每次我们去度假，我们都会带回一些纪念品。

sow.en: Let's sow these seeds before it gets too cold.
sow.zh: 我们在天气变冷之前将种子播下。

space.en: I don’t have much space for things in my small house.

spaceship.en: Astronauts aboard the spaceship are conducting scientific experiments.
spaceship.zh: 太空船上的宇航员正在进行科学实验。

spade.en: The gardener used her spade to make a hole for the new plant.

spain.en: I went to Spain for my summer vacation.
spain.zh: 我去西班牙度过了我的夏假。

spare.en: Could you spare me a moment?

spear.en: The soldier was holding a spear in his hand.

specialist.en: He is a specialist in computer science.
specialist.zh: 他是计算机科学的专家。

specific.en: "He gave me specific instructions on how to do it."
specific.zh: 他给了我具体的操作指示。

speech.en: He made a moving speech about the need for peace.
speech.zh: 他做了一个关于需要和平的感人演讲

speed.en: The car is running at a high speed on the highway.
speed.zh: 这辆车在高速公路上高速行驶。

spell.en: Can you spell "accommodate" for me? 你能为我拼出“accommodate”吗？

spelling.en: "You need to improve your spelling." 你需要提升你的拼写能力。
spelling.zh: 表达能力或技术提升的场景

spin.en: The boy kept spinning until he fell down.

spirit.en: "Her spirit was strong, but her body was frail."
spirit.zh: 她精神饱满，但体格羸弱

spit.en: He spat out the seeds. 他吐出了那些种子。

splendid.en: From his head down to his shoes, his clothes looked splendid.

split.en: "The company decided to split into three smaller companies."
split.zh: 公司决定分裂成三家小公司。

spokesman.en: "The Prime Minister's spokesman issued a statement this morning."
spokesman.zh: 总理的发言人今天早上发表了一份声明。

sponsor.en: The tournament was sponsored by a local company.
sponsor.zh: 这场比赛是由一家当地公司赞助的。

spoon.en: Would you pass me the spoon, please?

sport.en: Soccer is a popular sport in many countries.
sport.zh: 足球在很多国家都是一项热门运动

spot.en: As a noun: There is a coffee spot on my shirt.

spray.en: 她喜欢在房间里喷一些香水。
spray.zh: She likes to spray some perfume in her room.

spread.en: The news spread quickly throughout the city.
spread.zh: 这个消息迅速在城市中传播开

square.en: 名词：There is a beautiful fountain in the center of the square.
square.zh: 广场中心有个漂亮的喷泉。

squeeze.en: She squeezed the orange to get the juice.

squid.en: "Divers encountered a giant squid while exploring the deep sea." —— 潜水员在探索深海时遇到了一只巨大的鱿鱼。
squid.zh: Translation in Chinese: 潜水员在深海探险时遇到了一只巨型鱿鱼。

squirrel.en: The squirrel is gathering nuts for the winter.
squirrel.zh: 那只松鼠正在为冬天储备坚果。

stable.en: The chair is stable. Its legs are strong.

stadium.en: The football match will be held in the stadium.
stadium.zh: 足球比赛将在体育场举行。

staff.en: The staff at the hospital were very professional.

stage.en: The play is on stage tonight.
stage.zh: 今晚的舞台剧已经开始

stain.en: Be careful not to stain your shirt when you're eating spaghetti.
stain.zh: 吃意面的时候注意别把衬衫弄脏。

stainless.en: This knife is made of stainless steel.
stainless.zh: 这把刀是由不锈钢制成的。

stair.en: I nearly slipped on the bottom stair.
stair.zh: 我几乎在最下面的那个楼梯上摔跤。

stand.en: "She can't stand for long periods because of her age."
stand.zh: 因年龄原因，她不能长时间站立。

standard.en: This is the standard procedure for doing these experiments.
standard.zh: 这是做这些实验的标准程序。

star.en: The stars come out at night.

starvation.en: The little boy died of starvation.

starve.en: We must find food, or we will starve.
starve.zh: 我们必须找到食物，否则我们会饿死。

state.en: The state has a responsibility to ensure justice for all its citizens.
state.zh: 国家有责任确保所有公民的正义。

station.en: "I will meet you at the train station."
station.zh: 我会在火车站和你见面。

statesman.en: "Throughout his career, Mr. Smith gained a reputation as a skilled statesman."
statesman.zh: 在他的职业生涯中，史密斯先生赢得了作为一个熟练的政治家的声誉。

statue.en: The statue stands in the middle of the square.
statue.zh: 雕像矗立在广场的中间。

status.en: She had achieved the status of being the smartest girl in the class.

stay.en: "Please stay quiet while the teacher is talking."
stay.zh: 当老师讲话时，请保持安静。

steady.en: His health condition remained steady after the treatment.
steady.zh: 他的健康状况在治疗后保持稳定。

steak.en: Would you like your steak rare, medium, or well-done?
steak.zh: 你想要你的牛排是生的、五分熟还是全熟？

steam.en: The kettle is letting off some steam.

steel.en: The building is reinforced with steel beams.
steel.zh: 这座建筑物由钢梁加固。

steep.en: As a mountaineer, he is used to climbing steep hills.
steep.zh: 作为⼀名登山者，他习惯了爬陡峭的⼭坡。

steward.en: "The steward on the plane offered me a beverage."
steward.zh: 飞机上的乘务员给我提供了一杯饮料。

stomach.en: I have a stomach ache after that meal.

stone.en: This wall is made of stone.
stone.zh: 这个墙是由石头建成的。

stopwatch.en: The coach used a stopwatch to time the sprinter's lap.
stopwatch.zh: 教练使用秒表计时短跑运动员的圈速。“

storm.en: The storm is about to hit our city.
storm.zh: 暴风雨即将袭击我们的城市

stout.en: He is a stout man with a ruddy complexion.
stout.zh: 他是一个面色红润的壮实男人。

stove.en: Our new stove helps us to cook food much faster than before.

straightforward.en: The instructions are simple and straightforward.
straightforward.zh: 说明书是简单而直白的。

strange.en: "His behavior seems a bit strange today."
strange.zh: 他今天的行为有些奇怪。

straw.en: I drank the orange juice through a straw.

strawberry.en: She bought a punnet of strawberries.

stream.en: "Trout thrive in this clear mountain stream."
stream.zh: 鳟鱼在这清澈的山间小溪里生活得很好

strength.en: Eating good food builds up your strength.

strengthen.en: We need to strengthen our defenses to prevent any possible attacks.
strengthen.zh: 我们需要加强我们的防御能力以防止任何可能的攻击。

stress.en: I'm under a lot of stress from work.

strict.en: He is very strict with his children about their homework.
strict.zh: 他对孩子们的作业要求非常严格

strike.en: "He decided to strike while the iron was hot and ask his boss for a raise."
strike.zh: 他决定趁热打铁，向老板要求加薪。

string.en: She tied the package with string.
string.zh: 她用绳子捆起这个包裹。

strong.en: He is stronger than I thought.

stubborn.en: He's as stubborn as a mule.
stubborn.zh: 他倔强得就像一头骡子。

studio.en: She rented a small studio to paint in.
studio.zh: 她租了一个小工作室用来画画。

study.en: She goes to the library to study.

stupid.zh: 他问了一些愚蠢的问题。

subject.en: The officers subjected everyone to a careful search before they left the plane.

subscribe.en: "I subscribe to a daily newspaper to keep up with the news."
subscribe.zh: 我订阅了一份每日报纸，以了解新闻。

substitute.en: When I ran out of juice, I had to substitute water to drink in the morning.

succeed.en: With determination and hard work, anyone can succeed.
succeed.zh: 只要有决心和肯努力，任何人都可以成功。

success.en: "Success is not final, failure is not fatal: It is the courage to continue that counts."
success.zh: 成功不是终点，失败不是末路：重要的是持之以恒的勇气。

such.en: I have never seen such a large cat in my life!
such.zh: 我生平从未见过这么大的猫！

suck.en: The nursing baby can suck milk from its mother.
suck.zh: 这个正在哺乳的婴儿可以从它母亲那里吸奶。

sudden.en: He felt a sudden pain in his chest.

suffer.en: Many people in the area suffer from malnutrition.
suffer.zh: 该地区的很多人都患有营养不良。

suffering.en: "Her suffering was apparent to everyone who saw her."
suffering.zh: 看到她的人都能感觉到她的痛苦。

sugar.en: Could you please pass me the sugar?

suggest.en: He suggested that I should apply for the job.
suggest.zh: 他建议我去申请这份工作。

suggestion.en: I have a suggestion on how we can fix this problem.
suggestion.zh: 我有一个关于如何解决这个问题的建议。

suit.en: He is in a navy blue suit.
suit.zh: 他穿着一套深蓝色的西装。

suitable.en: This book is not suitable for children.
suitable.zh: 这本书不适合儿童阅读。

suitcase.en: "He lugged a heavy suitcase down the stairs."
suitcase.zh: 他把一个沉重的手提箱拖下楼梯。

summary.en: Could you give me a summary of the book?
summary.zh: 你能给我这本书的摘要吗？

sunburnt.en: After a whole day outdoors, she got terribly sunburnt.
sunburnt.zh: 在户外待了一整天后，她严重晒伤了。

sunday.en: We usually go to church on Sunday.
sunday.zh: 我们通常在星期天去教堂.

sunglasses.en: Her sunglasses make her look mysterious.
sunglasses.zh: 她的太阳镜让她看起来神秘。

sunlight.en: The sunlight shines through the trees.

sunny.en: What a beautiful and sunny day!
sunny.zh: 多么美妙，阳光明媚的一天啊！

sunset.en: They watched the sunset from the hill and it was a sight to behold.
sunset.zh: 他们在山上观看日落，那景色美不胜收。

sunshine.en: I like to feel the warm sunshine on my skin.
sunshine.zh: 我喜欢感受阳光温暖地洒在我的皮肤上。

super.en: I had a super time at the party.
super.zh: 我在聚会上玩得特别开心。

superior.en: His skills are superior to mine.

superman.en: He saved the little girl from the fire, like a real superman. 他像超人一样从火中救出了小女孩。
superman.zh: 体现了 superman 的正面超能英雄形象

supply.en: The water heater supplied the house with warm water.

support.en: As a verb: "She supports her family with her full-time job."
support.zh: 她通过全职工作支持她的家庭。

suppose.en: Suppose it rains tomorrow, what will you do?
suppose.zh: 假设明天下雨，你会怎么办？

supreme.en: The Supreme Court is the highest judicial body in the country.
supreme.zh: 最高法院是国家最高的司法机构。

sure.en: I'm sure that you will like this book.
sure.zh: 我确定你会喜欢这本书的。

surgeon.en: The surgeon performed a complicated surgery successfully.
surgeon.zh: 这位外科医生成功地进行了一次复杂的手术。

surplus.en: The store sold their surplus items on sale.

surprise.en: His sudden arrival was a surprise to everyone.
surprise.zh: 他的突然来访让大家都感到惊讶。

surround.en: The castle is surrounded by a moat.

surrounding.en: The police closed off the surrounding area for investigation.
surrounding.zh: 警察封锁了周围区域以便调查

survival.en: Our survival in the wild depends on our ability to adapt.
survival.zh: 我们在野外的生存依赖于我们适应的能力。

survive.en: Many businesses may not survive in the competitive market.
survive.zh: 许多企业可能在竞争激烈的市场中无法生存下去。

suspect.en: I suspect that those kids stole the money.

suspension.en: Due to his misconduct, he was given a suspension from school.
suspension.zh: 由于他的行为不端，他被学校暂时开除。

swallow.en: I find it hard to swallow the pill.
swallow.zh: 我觉得药片很难吞下去。

sweat.en: I wiped the sweat from my brow.
sweat.zh: 我擦去了额头上的汗珠。

sweater.zh: 她穿了一件红色的毛衣。

swift.en: 形容词：The swift runner crossed the finish line first.
swift.zh: 跑得快的运动员首先冲过了终点线。

swim.en: "After work, I often go to swim in the local pool."
swim.zh: 下班后，我经常去当地泳池游泳。

swimming.en: 这是一种很好的运动：“Swimming is a good exercise.”
swimming.zh: 游泳是一种很好的运动。

swing.en: She enjoys the swing in the park.
swing.zh: 她喜欢在公园里的秋千。

swiss.en: I have a Swiss friend who loves skiing.
swiss.zh: 我有一位喜欢滑雪的瑞士朋友。

switzerland.en: "I spent my summer vacation in Switzerland."
switzerland.zh: 我在瑞士度过了我的暑假。

switch.en: I flipped the switch and the room was suddenly bright.
switch.zh: 我按了开关，房间突然亮了起来。

symbol.en: The dove is a universal symbol of peace.
symbol.zh: 鸽子是和平的普世象征。

sympathy.en: Your sympathy will give the boy the strength to move forward.
sympathy.zh: 你的同情会给这个男孩前进的力量。

symptom.en: Sneezing and a high fever are symptoms of the common cold.

system.en: I have a system for sorting out the bills.
system.zh: 我有一套整理账单的系统。

systematic.en: We need a systematic approach to solving this problem.
systematic.zh: 我们需要系统地解决这个问题

table.en: "Can you set the table for dinner?"

tailor.en: The tailor is making a suit for him.
tailor.zh: 这位裁缝正在为他制作一套西装。

tale.en: She told her two friends about the wild tale of her day.

talent.en: Maria has a talent for playing the piano.

talk.en: They went someplace to talk to each other.

tap.en: "She tapped on the window to get his attention."
tap.zh: 她敲了敲窗户以引起他的注意。

target.en: Our first target is to win the championship.
target.zh: 我们的首要目标是赢得冠军

task.en: He was given the task of sorting out the files.
task.zh: 他被分配了整理文件的任务。

taste.en: 品尝：“He took a small taste of the soup to test the seasoning.”
taste.zh: 他尝了一小口汤，尝一下调味。

tasteless.en: This soup is rather tasteless, it needs some salt.
tasteless.zh: 这个汤很淡，需要加点盐。

tax.en: My income tax is too high this year.
tax.zh: 我今年的所得税太高了。

taxi.en: Gary drives a taxi, so he knows the roads very well.

tea.en: I like to start my day with a cup of tea.
tea.zh: 我喜欢用一杯茶开始我的一天。

team.en: Our team is working on the project.
team.zh: 我们的团队正在进行这个项目。

teapot.en: Please fill the teapot with hot water.

tear.en: It is easy to tear paper.

technical.zh: 这是一个高度技术化的操作。

technique.en: There are a lot of teaching techniques that are well supported by research.

technology.en: He loves technology such as laptop computers.

teenager.en: The book is primarily aimed at teenagers and young adults.
teenager.zh: 这本书主要是针对青少年和年轻人的。

telegraph.en: As a noun: He sent a telegraph to notify his family of his safe arrival.
telegraph.zh: 他发了一个电报通知家人他已经安全到达。

telephone.en: I left my telephone at home.

telescope.en: The shiny telescope on the balcony called to all those who love the stars.
telescope.zh: 阳台上的闪亮望远镜对所有热爱星星的人发出邀请

television.en: She turned on the television to watch the news.

temperature.en: In the winter, the temperature can drop below 0 degrees.

temple.en: I will go to the temple to pray for good luck.
temple.zh: 我会去寺庙为好运祈祷

temporary.en: This car is only temporary; I’ll get a new one soon.

temptation.en: The bakery's sweet treats were a temptation too strong for him to resist.
temptation.zh: 面包店的甜点是他无法抗拒的诱惑。

tend.en: "The road tends to the right at the top of the hill."

tendency.en: There is a tendency for people to eat more when they are stressed.
tendency.zh: 当人们压力大的时候，他们有更多吃东西的倾向。

tense.en: The verb in that sentence is in the past tense.
tense.zh: 那个句子里的动词是过去时态。

tension.en: The political tension in the country is growing.
tension.zh: 该国的政治紧张局势正在加剧。

tentative.en: This is a tentative schedule and might be subject to change.
tentative.zh: 这是一个暂定的时间表，可能会有改变。

term.en: The medical term for a heart attack is myocardial infarction.
term.zh: 心脏病发作的医学术语是心肌梗死。

terminal.en: Disconnect the terminal before working on the wiring.
terminal.zh: 在线路作业前拔掉接线端。

terrify.en: The loud noise in the middle of the night terrified me.
terrify.zh: 半夜的巨大噪音把我吓到了。

terror.en: I felt a sense of terror when the tiger chased me.

test.en: His job is to test the electricity to make sure it works correctly.

text.en: The text of the document was carefully examined by the lawyer.
text.zh: 律师仔细审查了文档的正文。

textbook.en: This is a textbook of advanced mathematics, which can be daunting for beginners.
textbook.zh: 这是一本高级数学教科书，对初学者来说可能有些吓人。

thank.en: I want to thank you for all your help.
thank.zh: 我想对你所给予的所有帮助表示感谢。

theatre.en: I love going to the theatre to watch plays.

theater.en: He took her to see a comedy show at the theater.

theft.en: The theft of my car was a distressing experience.
theft.zh: 我的汽车被偷是一次令人痛苦的经历。

theirs.en: This is your pen, and that one is theirs.
theirs.zh: 这是你的笔，那个是他们的。

theme.en: "The theme of the conference is environmental conservation."
theme.zh: 会议的主题是环境保护。

themselves.en: They have to depend on themselves.

then.en: We had lunch and then we went to the park.
then.zh: 我们午餐后就去了公园。

theoretical.en: His conclusion was only theoretical and not meant to be publicized.

theory.en: Albert Einstein is famous for his theory of relativity.
theory.zh: 爱因斯坦以他的相对论而闻名。

therefore.en: You were late. Therefore, you missed the bus.
therefore.zh: 你来晚了，所以你错过了公交车。

these.en: "These are my friends, John and Maria."
these.zh: 这些是我的朋友，约翰和玛丽亚

thick.en: "He wore a thick jacket to keep out the cold."
thick.zh: 他穿了一件厚厚的夹克以抵挡住寒冷。

thin.en: He was a thin man with sharp features.
thin.zh: 他是一个瘦弱的男人，五官尖锐。

thing.en: "Could you pass me that thing over there?"
thing.zh: 你能把那个东西递给我吗？

thinking.en: He sat there, deep in thought.
thinking.zh: 他坐在那里，陷入深深的思考。

third.en: "She finished the race in third place."
third.zh: 她在比赛中获得了第三名

thirsty.en: I am really thirsty, can you give me some water?
thirsty.zh: 我真的很渴，你能给我一些水吗？

thorough.en: Tina did a thorough job of cleaning the stains out of the carpet.

though.en: Even though it was raining, he did not carry an umbrella.
though.zh: 尽管正在下雨，他还是没有带伞。

thousand.en: There are a thousand stars in the sky.

thread.en: He pulled at a loose thread on his shirt.
thread.zh: 他拽了下衬衫上的一根松线。

thrill.en: The surfer enjoys the thrill of surfing a big wave.

throat.en: My throat is sore from shouting.
throat.zh: 我大喊大叫喉咙都疼了

throughout.en: The supermarket is open throughout the day.

thunder.en: The thunder was so loud that it shook the house.
thunder.zh: 雷声如此震耳欲聋，以至于房子都在震动。

thunderstorm.en: "The city experienced a severe thunderstorm last night."
thunderstorm.zh: 昨晚该城市经历了一次剧烈的雷暴

thursday.en: I have a meeting scheduled on Thursday morning.
thursday.zh: 我在星期四早上有一个预定的会议。

thus.en: Victor wants to lose weight; thus, he’ll go on a diet and start exercising.

tibet.en: I have always longed to visit Tibet and experience its unique culture.
tibet.zh: 我一直渴望去西藏旅行，体验它独特的文化。

tick.en: The tick of the clock was the only sound in the room.
tick.zh: 房间里唯一的声音是钟的滴答声。

ticket.en: I bought a ticket for the concert.
ticket.zh: 我买了一张音乐会的票。

tidy.en: Please tidy your room before you go out.
tidy.zh: 请在出门前整理你的房间。

tie.en: He learned to tie his shoes all by himself.

tight.en: The lid is very tight and I cannot open this jar.
tight.zh: 盖子太紧了，我打不开这个罐子。

time.en: Can you tell me the time?
time.zh: 你可以告诉我现在几点了吗？

timetable.en: The university will post the exam timetable next week.
timetable.zh: 大学将于下周公布考试时间表。

tin.en: Soup is a food that is often sold in tin cans.

tiny.en: He gave me a tiny smile.

tip.en: The tip of this arrow is very sharp.
tip.zh: 这支箭的尖端非常锐利

tire.en: He was beginning to tire of the constant interruptions.
tire.zh: 他开始对连续不断的打断感到厌烦。

tired.en: I'm really tired after a long day at work.
tired.zh: 我在工作了一整天之后真的很累。

tiresome.zh: 他不断的抱怨真是令人烦透了。

tissue.en: There was a box of tissue on the table.

title.en: The title of the book is “To Kill a Mockingbird”.
title.zh: 这本书的标题是《杀死一只知更鸟》。

tobacco.en: "Smoking can be harmful because tobacco contains nicotine, which is addictive."
tobacco.zh: 抽烟可能有害健康，因为烟草里含有会让人上瘾的尼古丁。

tokyo.en: Tokyo is one of the most populous cities in the world.
tokyo.zh: 东京是世界上人口最多的城市之一。

tolerate.en: He can't tolerate laziness in his team.
tolerate.zh: 他无法容忍他的团队里的懒散。

tomato.en: I like to add fresh tomatoes to my salad.
tomato.zh: 我喜欢在沙拉里加新鲜的西红柿。

ton.en: This shipment weights twenty metric tons.
ton.zh: 这批货物重达二十公吨。

tongue.en: She burned her tongue on the hot soup.
tongue.zh: 她的舌头被热汤烫伤了。

tool.en: "She uses special tools for her work."
tool.zh: 她在工作中使用特殊的工具。

toothache.en: I suffered from a severe toothache last night.

toothbrush.en: Remember to replace your toothbrush every three months.
toothbrush.zh: 记得每三个月更换一次牙刷。

toothpaste.en: Can you remember to pick up some toothpaste from the store?
toothpaste.zh: 你能记住从商店里带些牙膏回来吗？

topic.en: What's the main topic of the meeting?
topic.zh: 会议的主要议题是什么？

tortoise.en: The life span of the tortoise can exceed 100 years.
tortoise.zh: 乌龟能活到超过一百年。

total.en: The total duration of the movie is three hours.
total.zh: 电影的总时长为三小时。

totally.en: I'm totally in support of your decision.

tough.en: The man passed his driving test even though it was very tough.

tour.en: I took a tour of Asia and Europe.

tourism.en: Many small businesses in the area depend on tourism.
tourism.zh: 该地区有很多小企业都依赖于旅游业。

tourist.en: This city is a popular destination for tourists.
tourist.zh: 这个城市是游客的热门目的地。

tournament.en: "The football tournament was really exciting, and our team took the second place."
tournament.zh: 这个足球比赛非常激动人心，我们队获得了第二名。

toward.en: He took a step toward the door.

towel.en: After showering, she reached for a towel.

tower.en: This is a very famous tower in Italy.

town.en: My hometown is a small, quiet town in the countryside.
town.zh: 我的家乡是乡村里的一个小而安静的城镇。

toy.en: She bought a toy for her son.
toy.zh: 她为她的儿子买了一个玩具。

track.en: Please keep off the track during the race.
track.zh: 请在比赛期间远离跑道。

trade.en: Trade between the two countries has increased over the years.
trade.zh: 这两个国家之间的贸易在过去的几年中一直在增加。

tradition.en: Marriage is a tradition all over the world.

traditional.en: This is a traditional Chinese ceremony.
traditional.zh: 这是一个传统的中国仪式。

traffic.en: There's always a lot of traffic in the city centre.

train.en: The train is running on the track.

trainer.en: As a personal trainer, John helps others achieve their fitness goals.
trainer.zh: 作为一名私人教练，John帮助他人实现他们的健身目标。

training.en: I am in charge of training new employees.

tram.en: I took the tram to Eighth Avenue.

transform.en: The furniture was transformed by a coat of paint.
transform.zh: 一层漆让家具焕然一新。

translation.en: She does the translation of literary works from English to Chinese.
translation.zh: 她负责从英语到汉语的文学作品翻译。

translator.en: My friend works as a translator in a multinational company.
translator.zh: 我的朋友在一家跨国公司担任翻译员。

transport.en: We need to transport the goods to the warehouse.
transport.zh: 我们需要把货物运到仓库。

trap.en: The hunter set a trap to catch the wild animals.
trap.zh: 猎人设下陷阱捕捉野生动物。

travel.en: They will travel to Argentina this summer.

traveler.en: He is a frequent traveler, and he's always on the go.
traveler.zh: 他是一个经常旅行的人，总是在路上。

treasure.en: They became very rich when they found the buried treasure.

treatment.en: His treatment of the disease was successful.

tree.en: There is a big apple tree in our backyard.
tree.zh: 我们后院有一棵大苹果树。

tremble.en: The child trembled in the cold wind.

trend.en: Lucy likes to think she started this fashion trend.

trial.en: He went on trial for robbing the bank.

triangle.en: "The flag of the Bahamas has a black triangle on the left."
triangle.zh: 巴哈马的国旗左边有一个黑色的三角形。

trip.en: Ken took a trip to the city yesterday.

trouble.en: "Tom is in trouble with his teacher."
trouble.zh: 汤姆招惹了他的老师，现在有麻烦了。

troublesome.en: The troublesome task took me three days to finish.
troublesome.zh: 这个令人头疼的任务花了我三天的时间才完成。

trousers.en: He wore a suit and tie with grey trousers.
trousers.zh: 他穿着西装领带，搭配灰色裤子。

truck.en: The truck was loaded with furniture.

true.en: Is it true that you're moving to New York?

truly.en: "I am truly sorry for what happened."
truly.zh: 我真的对发生的事情感到抱歉。

trunk.en: The elephant picked up the peanut with its trunk.
trunk.zh: 大象用它的长鼻子捡起了花生

truth.en: The truth is, I never loved him.

t-shirt.en: I bought a new T-shirt online.
t-shirt.zh: 我在网上购买了一件新的T恤衫。

tube.en: The pile of tubes was going to be put in the ground.

tune.en: He was humming a tune as he walked down the street.
tune.zh: 他一边走下街一边作一曲子。

turkey.en: We are planning a trip to Turkey next summer.
turkey.zh: 我们计划明年夏天去土耳其旅行。

turn.en: "Turn the key to start the car."

tutor.en: John has hired a tutor to help him with his algebra.
tutor.zh: 约翰雇了一个家教来帮助他学习代数。

twelfth.en: Mark is the twelfth person to arrive at the party.
twelfth.zh: 马克是第十二个到达派对的人。

twelve.en: "There are twelve eggs in a dozen."

twentieth.en: This is the twentieth time you've made the same mistake.
twentieth.zh: 这是你第二十次犯同样的错误了。

twice.zh: 我已经看过那部电影两次了。

twin.en: They're twin boys and look exactly alike.
twin.zh: 他们是一对双胞胎男孩，看起来非常相像。

twist.en: "She twisted her ankle while playing basketball."
twist.zh: 她打篮球的时候扭伤了脚踝。

type.zh: 她是我喜欢的那型女孩。

typewriter.en: He bought an old typewriter from a flea market.
typewriter.zh: 他从跳蚤市场买了一台旧打字机。

typical.en: This is a typical example of a Medieval castle.
typical.zh: 这是一个中世纪城堡的典型例子。

typhoon.en: The typhoon caused massive damage to the city.
typhoon.zh: 这场台风对该城市造成了巨大的破坏。

tyre.en: "He got a puncture in his front tyre."

umbrella.en: She opened her umbrella to ward off the rain.
umbrella.zh: 她打开了雨伞以挡住雨水。

unable.en: I was unable to attend the meeting because of the traffic.
unable.zh: 由于交通原因，我无法参加会议。

uncomfortable.en: The tight shoes made her feel uncomfortable.
uncomfortable.zh: 鞋子太紧，她感到不舒服。

unconscious.en: He was knocked unconscious by a fall. 他由于跌倒而昏迷不醒。

underline.en: Please underline the important points in the text.
underline.zh: 请在文本中的重要部分划线。

understanding.en: I have a deep understanding of the subject matter.
understanding.zh: 我对这个主题有深入的理解。

unemployment.en: Unemployment rates have been soaring during the pandemic.
unemployment.zh: 疫情期间，失业率一直在上升。

unfair.en: "It's unfair to blame her for the mistake."
unfair.zh: 把错误怪罪于她是不公平的。

unfold.en: "Watch how the story unfolds." 在这个例子中，unfold被用来描述一个故事的发展进程。
unfold.zh: 观看故事是如何展开的。

unfortunate.en: You have had an unfortunate experience.
unfortunate.zh: 你经历了一件不幸的事。

unfortunately.en: Unfortunately, the weather was not good for a picnic.
unfortunately.zh: 不幸的是，天气并不适合野餐。

uniform.en: "The rules apply uniformly to all members."
uniform.zh: 这些规则对所有成员都一视同仁。

unique.en: His style of painting is very unique.
unique.zh: 他的绘画风格非常独特。

unite.en: We must unite to fight against the injustice.
unite.zh: 我们必须团结起来反对不公正。

universal.en: The desire for peace is universal.

university.en: My dream is to go to a good university.

unless.en: "You won't pass the test unless you study harder."
unless.zh: 除非你更努力地学习，否则你不会通过这个测试。

unlike.en: Unlike his brother, John is very outgoing.
unlike.zh: 与他的哥哥不同，约翰非常外向

unrest.en: The city was plagued by civil unrest.

unsafe.en: This bridge is unsafe for heavy vehicles.
unsafe.zh: 这座桥对于重型车辆来说不安全。

unsuccessful.en: His attempt to convince his boss was unsuccessful.
unsuccessful.zh: 他试图说服他的老板，但是没有成功。

unusual.en: "It is rather unusual to see that kind of animal in this area."
unusual.zh: 在這个區域看到那種動物實屬罕見。

up.en: He looked up at the sky.

upper.en: The upper floors of the building are for offices.
upper.zh: 这个楼的上层是办公区。

urban.en: It is common to see tall buildings in urban areas.

urge.en: I feel an urge to travel.

urgent.en: He had to leave at that moment; it was urgent.

user.en: The user manual is in the box.

usual.en: "As usual, she was the last to arrive."
usual.zh: 照常，她是最后一个到达。

usually.en: I usually get up at six.

vague.en: I have a vague memory of our first family trip.
vague.zh: 我对我们第一次全家旅行的记忆模糊不清。

vain.en: "She was so vain that she looked in every mirror she passed."
vain.zh: 她如此虚荣，走过每个镜子都会看一下。

valid.en: The expert’s opinion on the subject was more valid than others.

valley.en: We took a trip through the beautiful valley.
valley.zh: 我们驱车穿越美丽的山谷。

value.en: The value of the house has doubled in the last ten years.
value.zh: 这座房子在过去的十年里价值翻倍了。

vanilla.en: I ordered a vanilla ice cream.

variety.en: There are a variety of flowers at the shop.

various.en: I've read various books on the subject.
various.zh: 我阅读了关于这个主题的各种各样的书。

vase.en: She put fresh flowers in the vase.
vase.zh: 她把新鲜的花放在花瓶里。

vast.en: The wealthy man bought a vast amount of land in the countryside.

veal.en: I just cooked some veal for dinner.
veal.zh: 我刚做了一些小牛肉作为晚餐。

vegetable.en: We should eat a variety of fruits and vegetables to stay healthy.
vegetable.zh: 我们应该吃各种各样的水果和蔬菜以保持健康。

version.en: "Do you have the latest version of this software?"
version.zh: 你有这个软件的最新版本吗?

via.en: We'll be flying via Dubai to get to Australia.
via.zh: 我们将经由迪拜飞往澳大利亚。

vice.en: His main vice is drinking too much.

victim.en: "The hapless victim of a practical joke."
victim.zh: 一个恶作剧的无辜受害者。

victory.en: Our team tasted victory in the final match.
victory.zh: 我们的队伍在决赛中品尝到了胜利的滋味。

video.en: He posted a video of his vacation on social media.
video.zh: 他在社交媒体上发布了他的假期视频。

videophone.en: John used the videophone to call his family while he was traveling on business.
videophone.zh: 约翰在出差时用视频电话给家人打电话。

view.en: "In my view, we should continue with the plan."
view.zh: 在我看来，我们应该继续实施这个计划。

village.en: There are only a few houses in my village.

vinegar.en: Add two tablespoons of vinegar to the salad.
vinegar.zh: 把两汤匙醋加到沙拉里。

violate.en: You must not violate the traffic rules.
violate.zh: 你一定不要违反交通规则。

violence.en: The boy hit his brother in an act of violence.

violinist.en: He is a renowned violinist and has performed at many concerts.
violinist.zh: 他是一位知名的小提琴手，在许多音乐会上演出过。

virus.en: The flu is caused by a virus.

visa.en: I have applied for a visa to go to the United States.
visa.zh: 我申请了去美国的签证。

visit.en: I usually visit my grandmother every Sunday.
visit.zh: 我通常每个星期日都去看望我的祖母。

visitor.en: A visitor left this package for you this morning.
visitor.zh: 今天早上有个访客给你留下了这个包裹。

visual.en: The presentation was incredibly visual, filled with images and videos.
visual.zh: 演讲非常形象，充满了图片和视频。

vital.en: The heart is a vital organ.

voice.en: She has a beautiful singing voice.

volcano.en: The volcano erupted three days ago.

volleyball.en: Sally is a member of the college volleyball team.
volleyball.zh: 莎莉是大学排球队的一员

voluntary.en: Many people attended the voluntary boat safety class.

volunteer.en: She is an active community volunteer. 她是活跃的社区志愿者。

vote.en: Every citizen has the right to vote.

voyage.en: "They embarked on a long voyage across the Pacific."
voyage.zh: 他们开始了横跨太平洋的长途航行。

wage.en: The wages I receive from my job are really great!

wait.en: Can you wait for me at the library?

waiter.en: The waiter brought us the menu.

walk.en: The children walk to school in the morning.

walkman.en: "I am looking for my old Walkman in my attic."
walkman.zh: 我在阁楼找我的旧 Walkman。

wall.en: You can't go through the wall.

wallet.en: I left my wallet at home.
wallet.zh: 我把我的钱包忘在家里了。

wander.en: He likes to wander through the woods on his days off.
wander.zh: 他喜欢在休息日在森林里闲逛。

war.en: Many young men died in the war.

warehouse.en: The warehouse stores all kinds of consumer goods.
warehouse.zh: 这个仓库存放了各种消费品。

warm.en: I like the warm weather in spring.
warm.zh: 我喜欢春天的暖和天气。

warmth.en: The warmth of the sun made her feel sleepy.
warmth.zh: 阳光的温暖让她感到困乏。

warning.en: "He gave me a warning about the difficulties of the job."
warning.zh: 他警告我这份工作的困难。

wash.en: "Can you wash the dishes after dinner?"

washroom.en: I need to go to the washroom.

waste.en: Do not waste your time on trivial matters.
waste.zh: 不要在琐事上浪费你的时间。

watch.en: I forgot to wind my **watch** yesterday.
watch.zh: 我昨天忘了上我的手表。

water.en: Mary boiled the water to make coffee.

watermelon.en: I enjoy a chilled watermelon in the summer heat.
watermelon.zh: 在夏日的炎热里，我喜欢享受冰凉的西瓜。

wave.en: The water was filled with large blue waves.

wax.en: She decided to schedule a waxing appointment.
wax.zh: 她决定预约一个脱蜡的时间。

way.en: I like her way of thinking.

web.en: "The web has transformed the way we work and communicate."
web.zh: 网络改变了我们工作和交流的方式。

website.en: This is a website for learning English.
website.zh: 这是一个学习英语的网站。

weak.en: She is still weak after the illness.

wealth.en: His wealth was obtained through years of hard work.
wealth.zh: 他的财富是多年努力工作得来的。

wealthy.en: "He was born into a wealthy family."
wealthy.zh: 他出生在一个富有的家庭。

weather.en: Today’s weather is rainy and cloudy.

weatherman.en: The weatherman predicts a major storm coming this weekend.
weatherman.zh: 天气预报员预测这个周末将有一场大风暴。

wedding.en: We are invited to their wedding.
wedding.zh: 我们被邀请参加他们的婚礼。

week.en: I see my parents once a week.

weekday.en: I usually work out on weekdays.
weekday.zh: 我通常在工作日做运动。

weekend.en: I usually go hiking on the weekend.
weekend.zh: 我通常在周末去徒步旅行。

weekly.en: As an adjective: I have weekly meetings with my supervisor.
weekly.zh: 我每周都会和我的主管开会。

weigh.en: The little dog weighed exactly 3 kilograms.

weight.en: I gained weight because I ate a lot of pizza.

welcome.en: As a verb: "They welcomed their guests into their home."
welcome.zh: 他们欢迎客人到家里来。

welfare.en: In the Scandinavian countries, the welfare of the citizens is given high importance.
welfare.zh: 在斯堪的纳维亚国家，公民的福利受到了高度重视。

well.en: You are doing well in your job.

well-known.en: She is a well-known authority on birds.

west.en: I moved to the west coast for a new job.
west.zh: 我搬到西海岸就职新工作。

western.en: Western countries have developed rapidly in the past few centuries.
western.zh: 西方国家在过去的几个世纪里发展迅速。

westerner.en: He felt like an alien in a strange country as a westerner in the east.
westerner.zh: 作为一个在东方的西方人，他感到自己像是在一个陌生的国家里的外星人。

wet.en: The grass is still wet with dew.

whale.en: Blue whale is the largest animal on the planet.
whale.zh: 蓝鲸是地球上最大的动物。

whatever.en: You can do whatever you want.
whatever.zh: 你可以做任何你想做的事。

wheat.en: The field of golden wheat was ready to be harvested.

whether.en: I could not decide whether to go left or right.

whichever.en: You can take whichever book you like.
whichever.zh: 你可以拿你喜欢的任何一本书。

whisper.en: She leaned over to whisper something in his ear.
whisper.zh: 她弯下腰对他耳语了几句。

whistle.en: The referee blew his whistle to start the game.

whole.en: He spent the whole morning reading a book.
whole.zh: 他花了整个上午来阅读一本书

wide.en: The door was as wide as my arms.

widespread.en: It is a widespread belief that colds are caused by cold weather.

wife.en: My wife and I have been married for ten years.
wife.zh: 我和我妻子已经结婚十年了。

wild.en: Dandelions grow wild in the cracks of the streets.

window.en: She opened the window to let in some fresh air.
window.zh: 她打开窗户让新鲜空气进来。

windy.en: It's too windy to play outside.
windy.zh: 外面风太大，不适合玩耍。

wine.en: He prefers red wine to white wine.
wine.zh: 他更喜欢红酒而不是白酒。

wing.en: The bird flapped its wings and flew away.

winner.en: He is the winner of the marathon race.
winner.zh: 他是马拉松比赛的获胜者。

winter.en: I always look forward to winter because I love snow.
winter.zh: 我总是期待冬天的到来，因为我喜欢雪。

wipe.en: Can you wipe the table down once you're finished eating?
wipe.zh: 你吃完饭可以擦一下桌子吗？

wire.en: The wires were connected to towers that brought electricity to the city.

wisdom.en: He admired the wisdom of keeping silent in such a situation.
wisdom.zh: 他欣赏在这种情况下保持沉默的智慧。

with.en: My bottle is filled with water.

withdraw.en: You can withdraw money from your bank account at any time.
withdraw.zh: 你可以在任何时候从你的银行账户里取款。

within.en: The keys are within the drawer.

witness.en: The woman was the only witness of the horrible crime.

wonder.en: The young mother wondered if she’d have a boy or a girl.

wonderful.en: "It's a wonderful day for a picnic."

wood.en: I put the pieces of wood in a pile.

wooden.en: My mother gave me a wooden spoon.

woo.en: He's been wooing her for months, but she's just not interested.
woo.zh: 他已经追求她好几个月了，但她就是对他不感兴趣。

word.en: I've just received word that our flight has been cancelled.
word.zh: 我刚收到一条消息，说我们的飞行已经被取消。

worker.en: The worker is repairing the road.

workplace.en: The manager wants to create a positive workplace for her employees.
workplace.zh: 经理希望为她的员工创造一个积极的工作环境。

works.en: I have many works to do today.
works.zh: 我今天有很多工作要做。

world.en: Our world is full of beauty if we have the eyes to see it.
world.zh: 如果我们愿意去发现，我们的世界充满了美丽。

worm.en: Worms are often used to help catch fish.

worried.en: I'm a little worried about my grades this semester.
worried.zh: 我对这个学期的成绩有点担忧。

worse.en: Business was worse this month than last month.

worst.en: This is the worst weather we've had all year.
worst.zh: 这是我们全年最糟糕的天气。

worth.en: The diamond is worth a lot of money.

worthwhile.en: On his visit to Canada, he realized studying English was worthwhile.

would.en: "I would go, but I'm really tired."
would.zh: 我本来会去的，但我实在太累了。

wound.en: The boy knew he might wound his knees if he didn’t wear pads on them.

wounded.en: He was wounded in the battle.

wrestle.en: "The children enjoy wrestling with each other in the yard."
wrestle.zh: 孩子们喜欢在院子里打摔跤。

wrinkle.en: My grandfather has some wrinkles on his face.

write.en: I need to write a letter to my parents.

writing.en: "His writing is heavily influenced by his life experiences."
writing.zh: 他的写作受到他的生活经历的深深影响

x-ray.en: The doctor decided to take an X-ray to check for broken bones.
x-ray.zh: 医生决定拍摄X光片以检查是否有骨折。

yawn.en: The child yawned and stretched her arms before going to bed for the night.

year.en: The New Year begins on January 1st.

yell.en: The coach yelled at his team to play harder.
yell.zh: 教练大声呵斥他的队伍要更努力地去比赛。

yesterday.en: I met him in the park yesterday.
yesterday.zh: 我昨天在公园遇到了他。

yet.en: I've done most of the work, but not all of it yet.
yet.zh: 我已完成大部分工程，但还没有全部做完。

yoghurt.zh: 这种酸奶真的非常好吃。

young.en: "She is a young lady with much to offer."
young.zh: 她是一个能提供许多的年轻女士。

zebra.en: "The zebra is recognized by its unique black and white stripes."
zebra.zh: 斑马由其独特的黑白条纹所辨认。

zero.en: The final score was three to zero.

zip.en: She zipped up her dress and left the room.
zip.zh: 她拉上了连衣裙的拉链，然后离开了房间。

zipper.zh: 请拉上你的夹克的拉链。

zone.en: "This area is a no-smoking zone."— 这个区域是禁止吸烟的。

zoom.en: The cars zoomed along the road.

explosive.en: The bomb was made with explosive materials.
explosive.zh: 这个炸弹是用易爆物质制造的。

numerous.en: It was hard to drive fast since there were numerous holes in the road.

wreck.en: The storm wrecked the ship and all on board are missing.
wreck.zh: 风暴破坏了船只，所有在船上的人都失踪了。

persistent.en: She made persistent efforts to lose weight.
persistent.zh: 她坚持不懈地努力减肥。

sake.en: "I hope you do it for my sake."
sake.zh: 我希望你为了我而做这件事。

conceal.en: You should conceal your money so no one can take it from you.

competent.en: "Nick is very competent at his job."

investment.en: My investment in this project has finally paid off.
investment.zh: 我投入这个项目的投资终于得到了回报。

neutral.en: The country remained neutral during the war.
neutral.zh: 这个国家在战争期间保持中立。

fashionable.en: It is very fashionable to wear a hat.

devise.en: "Can you devise a better method to solve this problem?”
devise.zh: 你能设计出一个更好的方法来解决这个问题吗？

exposure.en: Over exposure to the sun can damage the skin.
exposure.zh: 长时间暴露在阳光下会损害皮肤。

temper.en: "He has a really bad temper when things don't go his way."
temper.zh: 当事情不按他的方式进行时，他会非常暴躁。

multicultural.en: We live in a multicultural society.
multicultural.zh: 我们生活在一个多元文化的社会。

humble.en: He is a humble man, who never shows off.
humble.zh: 他是一个很谦逊的人，从不炫耀。

cliff.en: The hiker nearly fell off the cliff.
cliff.zh: 这位徒步者几乎从悬崖上摔下来。

concede.en: After a lengthy debate, he finally conceded that her point was valid.
concede.zh: 经过长时间的辩论，他最终承认她的观点是正确的。

commission.en: He earned a 20% commission on all merchandise he sold.
commission.zh: 他销售的所有商品，他都可以获得20%的佣金。

editorial.en: As a journalist, I often have to write editorial pieces for the newspaper.
editorial.zh: 作为记者，我经常需要为报纸写社论。

resume.en: After the interruption, they resumed their conversation.
resume.zh: 被打断后，他们恢复了他们的谈话。

artistic.zh: 这幅画显示出艺术天赋。

halt.en: The soldiers were ordered to halt at the edge of the woods.
halt.zh: 士兵们被命令在树林边缘停步。

illustration.en: "The book was filled with colorful illustrations."
illustration.zh: 这本书充满了色彩斑斓的插图。

disguise.en: She often wears costumes as a disguise.
disguise.zh: 她经常穿戴服装作为伪装。

wrap.en: Please wrap this gift for me.

surgery.en: I needed surgery to repair my leg after the accident.

liberal.en: His liberal views on gay marriage caused some controversy.
liberal.zh: 他对同性婚姻的开放观念引发了一些争议。

resolve.en: She resolved the problem with her children by giving them both a toy.

chill.en: "You should wear a coat to ward off the chill."
chill.zh: 你应该穿上外套抵挡寒冷。

confront.en: I confronted him as he left the meeting and told him I thought he was wrong.

dominate.en: The loud man dominated the conversation.

imitate.en: He imitated his favorite superhero by putting on a costume.

reproduce.en: Animals reproduce and bring forth new life.
reproduce.zh: 动物们繁殖并带来新生命

pad.en: I need a new mouse pad for my computer.
pad.zh: 我需要一个新的电脑鼠标垫。

provocation.en: "His remarks were taken as a provocation by the nationalists."
provocation.zh: 他的话引起了民族主义者的挑衅。

exceed.en: Our expenses exceeded our income last year.
exceed.zh: 我们去年的支出超过了收入。

preposition.en: The cat is on the table.

implement.en: 科学实验室里挤满了各种精密的实施设备。
implement.zh: The science lab was packed with sophisticated implements.

pat.en: He gave the dog a pat on the head. 他轻轻拍了拍狗的头。

visibility.en: Due to the thick fog, visibility on the road was severely reduced.
visibility.zh: 由于浓雾，路上的能见度严重降低。

paw.en: The lion raised its paw to swipe at the fly.
paw.zh: 那只狮子升起它的爪子去拍打苍蝇。

enormous.en: It took an enormous amount of work to complete the project.
enormous.zh: 完成这个项目需要大量的工作。

moisture.en: This cream will help retain the moisture in your skin.
moisture.zh: 这种护肤霜将有助于保持你肌肤的水分。

external.en: It is warm inside my house, but the external temperature is freezing.

revise.en: "You need to revise your essay before you hand it in."
revise.zh: 你需要在上交之前修改你的论文。

provided.en: "I will support your plan provided it is reasonable."
provided.zh: 只要你的计划合理，我就会支持。

gasoline.en: He fills the tank with gasoline every week.
gasoline.zh: 他每周给车加一次汽油。

lens.en: The camera lens is dirty. I need to clean it.
lens.zh: 相机镜头脏了，我需要清理它。

fatal.en: Being shot by the attacker proved fatal to the victim.

motive.en: His motive for committing the crime was money.

romantic.en: "He had a romantic relationship with her."
romantic.zh: 他和她有一段浪漫的关系。

motivate.en: "Teachers need to find ways to motivate their students."
motivate.zh: 老师需要找到激励他们学生的方法。

spoil.en: We left the fruit out too long, and it spoiled.

ridge.en: We hiked along the ridge of the mountain.
ridge.zh: 我们沿着山脊徒步行走。

multiple.en: "She's capable of doing multiple tasks at the same time."
multiple.zh: 她有能力同时处理多个任务。

peak.en: There is snow on the peaks of those mountains.

portrait.en: The artist painted a beautiful portrait of my grandmother.
portrait.zh: 那位艺术家为我奶奶画了一幅美丽的肖像画。

magnet.en: Magnets have north and south poles.

up-to-date.en: "He likes to keep his equipment up-to-date."
up-to-date.zh: 他喜欢保持他的设备最新。

complaint.en: I've made a complaint to the manager about the noise.
complaint.zh: 我已经向经理投诉了噪音问题。

outlook.en: He has a positive outlook on life.
outlook.zh: 他对生活持积极的态度

offense.en: "The offensive remark caused a lot of offense among the audience."
offense.zh: 令人冒犯的言论在听众中造成了极大的冒犯。

breadth.en: The river reaches a maximum breadth of 500 metres here.
breadth.zh: 这条河在这里的最大宽度达到了500米。

catalog.en: She glanced through the mail and set aside a catalog for later.
catalog.zh: 她翻看了邮件，把一个目录留到后面看。

myth.en: The book is based on ancient Greek myths.
myth.zh: 这本书是基于古希腊的神话。

bump.en: I **bumped** my head on the doorframe.

proceed.en: "You may proceed with your project once the manager gives approval."
proceed.zh: 一旦经理批准，你就可以进行你的项目了。

bulb.en: The tulip bulbs must be planted in the fall.
bulb.zh: 郁金香的球茎必须在秋天种植。

propose.en: My grandmother proposed that we have our picture taken with Santa.

draught.en: I felt a draught on my back.

install.en: I need to install a new application on my phone.
install.zh: 我需要在我的手机上安装一个新的应用程序。

integration.en: The integration of data from various sources can increase the overall value of information.
integration.zh: 从各种来源整合数据可以增加信息的整体价值

indication.en: The red sky was an indication of good weather to come.
indication.zh: 红色的天空是即将到来好天气的迹象。

bulk.en: He was troubled by the sheer bulk of the problem.
bulk.zh: 他被这个问题的庞大规模困扰。

despair.en: 名词用法："In the midst of war, many people were filled with despair."
despair.zh: 在战争中，许多人充满了绝望。

magnificent.en: "The ancient cathedral was a magnificent sight to behold."
magnificent.zh: 那座古老的大教堂壮观的景象令人瞩目。

guy.en: I met a guy at the party who works in IT.
guy.zh: 我在派对上遇到了一个在 IT 行业工作的家伙。

conjunction.en: Subordinating conjunctions are used to join a subordinate dependent clause to a main clause, like in the sentence, "Since I love cheese, I will have another slice."
conjunction.zh: 由于我喜欢奶酪，我还要再来一片。

peer.en: As a noun: "She is competing with her peers for the promotion."
peer.zh: 她正在和同仁竞争晋升。

costly.en: Buying a new car can be quite costly.
costly.zh: 购买一辆新车可能会相当昂贵。

succession.en: The King's eldest son is next in line of succession.
succession.zh: 国王的长子是下一个继承者。

accordingly.en: He's an expert in his field. Accordingly, his advice is highly valued.
accordingly.zh: 他在其领域内是专家。因此，他的建议很有价值。

dominant.en: The gorilla is one of the dominant animals in the jungle.

heading.en: Please create a heading for the report.

lover.en: She's my lover, we have been together for two years.
lover.zh: 她是我的情人，我们已经在一起两年了。

intellectual.en: We’ve always considered my Uncle Max to be the intellectual of the family.

undoubtedly.en: Undoubtedly, this is the best movie I have ever seen.
undoubtedly.zh: 毫无疑问，这是我看过的最好的电影。

infect.en: The common cold infects hundreds of millions of people each year.

bacteria.en: Some bacteria are beneficial to human health.
bacteria.zh: 有些细菌对人类健康有益处。

minor.en: The damage to the car was minor and it was still drivable.
minor.zh: 车辆的损坏较小，仍然可以驾驶。

cop.en: "The cop chased the thief down the alley."
cop.zh: 警察在小巷里追赶小偷。

hostile.en: He gave me a hostile look.
hostile.zh: 他对我投来敌意的目光

employee.en: He is an employee of Microsoft.

crawl.en: The baby is starting to crawl on the floor.
crawl.zh: 婴儿开始在地板上爬行。

identical.en: Their views on the subject are identical.
identical.zh: 他们在那个问题上的观点是完全一致的。

lag.en: The girl on rollerblades lagged behind the little girl on the bicycle.

charity.en: The billionaire made a substantial charity to the hospital.
charity.zh: 亿万富翁向医院进行了大额慈善捐赠。

employer.en: My employer decided to give all employees a pay raise.
employer.zh: 我的雇主决定给所有员工加薪。

pit.en: Watch out for the pit in the ground.

stock.en: I own a considerable amount of stock in that company.
stock.zh: 我在那家公司有相当数量的股票。

suspend.en: The game has been suspended due to heavy rain.
suspend.zh: 因为大雨比赛已被暂停。

pigeon.en: A pigeon was pecking at crumbs on the pavement.
pigeon.zh: 一只鸽子在人行道上啄食面包屑。

comparison.en: The comparison between the two cars shows the new one is more efficient.
comparison.zh: 两辆车的比较显示新的那辆更有效率

surge.en: All at once, there was a surge of runners at the finish line.

lest.en: Speak softly, lest they hear us.
lest.zh: 说话小声一点，以防他们听见我们。

senator.en: The president called a meeting with the senators.
senator.zh: 总统召集参议员们开会。

obligation.en: I have an obligation to take care of my family.
obligation.zh: 我有责任照顾我的家人。

gym.en: I'm going to the gym to exercise after work.
gym.zh: 我下班后要去健身房锻炼。

evil.en: An evil wizard cast a curse on the entire kingdom.
evil.zh: 一位邪恶的巫师对整个王国施加了诅咒。

governor.en: "The governor of California has declared a state of emergency due to the wildfires."
governor.zh: 加利福尼亚州的州长由于野火已宣布进入紧急状态。

locate.en: I can't locate the office on this map.
locate.zh: 我在这张地图上找不到那个办公室。

exterior.en: "The car looks great from the exterior."
exterior.zh: 从外观来看，这辆车非常好看。

combat.en: Our soldiers are always ready for combat.
combat.zh: 我们的士兵总是准备好应对战斗。

effective.zh: 她是一位非常有成效的教师。

pursue.en: The mother pursued her young child down the hill.

muscle.en: She has a pulled muscle in her back.

lane.en: The car is in the right lane.

accord.en: 动词：I cannot accord with your plan.

despite.en: We still played the game despite the cold weather.

industrial.en: Industrial development has progressed rapidly in the last decade.
industrial.zh: 在过去的十年中，工业发展进展迅速。

harness.en: The horse was saddled and harnessed.
harness.zh: 马已经装好了马鞍和马具。

sketch.en: She made a sketch of the new design.
sketch.zh: 她为新设计画了一个草图。

decay.en: The dentist said that I have tooth decay.

liable.en: If you don't dress warmly, you're liable to catch a cold.
liable.zh: 如果你不穿得暖和，你就可能会感冒。

cargo.en: The ship was loaded with cargo.

drift.en: The boat began to drift out to sea.

element.en: "Water is made up of the elements hydrogen and oxygen."
element.zh: 水是由氢和氧两种元素组成的。

uncover.en: "The detective was able to uncover the truth behind the crime."
uncover.zh: 侦探能够揭示出犯罪背后的真相

input.en: Name and address are the necessary inputs for this form.
input.zh: 姓名和地址是这个表格的必填项。

cue.en: I took my cue from her facial expression.
cue.zh: 我从她的面部表情得到了提示。

volt.en: The battery is running low, it's only outputting one volt.
volt.zh: 电池电量不足，只能输出一伏电压。

stereotype.en: His actions are completely against the stereotype of a policeman.
stereotype.zh: 他的行为完全颠覆了我对警察的刻板印象。

enroll.en: The students had to enroll in the class one semester in advance.

offend.en: They were both offended by what they had said to each other.

molecule.en: Every molecule of water is made up of two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.
molecule.zh: 每一个水分子由两个氢原子和一个氧原子组成。

sophisticated.en: The science experiment was quite sophisticated.
sophisticated.zh: 这个科学实验相当复杂精细。

chase.en: As a verb: "The police chased the thief through the city."
chase.zh: 警察在城市中追赶小偷。

marine.en: A healthy ocean is full of marine animals.

convict.en: They were convicted on evidence that was later proved to be false.
convict.zh: 他们因后来被证明是假的证据而被定罪。

legislation.en: The government is considering new legislation to prohibit the sale of firearms.
legislation.zh: 政府正在考虑新的立法来禁止销售火器。

ingredient.en: The chef carefully measured each ingredient before adding it to the mixture.
ingredient.zh: 厨师在将每种材料加入混合物之前都仔细测量。

correspondence.en: We kept up a constant correspondence throughout the years.
correspondence.zh: 这些年来我们一直保持着经常的联系。

intimate.en: I only tell my secrets to my most intimate friends.

disclose.en: "The company has yet to disclose its financial results."
disclose.zh: 这家公司还未公开其财务业绩。

torture.en: His confession was extracted by torture.

tragedy.en: It was a tragedy when his house was struck by lightning and burned.

charm.en: Gail charmed everyone with her humorous stories.

economical.en: "She found a more economical way to heat the house."
economical.zh: 她找到了一个更节约的方式给房子供暖。

prosperous.en: We wish you a prosperous New Year.

cabinet.en: She put the dishes back in the cabinet.
cabinet.zh: 她把盘子放回了橱柜里。

fashion.en: The latest fashion in hairstyles is to let your hair grow naturally.
fashion.zh: 发型的最新时尚是让你的头发自然生长。

preface.en: The preface of the book gives a brief summary of the author's life.
preface.zh: 书的序言部分给出了作者生平的简要总结。

tedious.en: This is the most tedious job I've ever had.
tedious.zh: 这是我做过的最无聊的工作。

source.en: The river was the source of drinking water for the village.

domestic.en: She is busy with her domestic chores.

deception.en: The act of deception was discovered by the authorities.
deception.zh: 这种欺骗行为被当局发现了。

basically.zh: 基本上，这个项目进行得很顺利。

donation.en: "She made a generous donation to the cancer research charity."
donation.zh: 她向癌症研究慈善机构做了一笔慷慨的捐赠。

immense.en: The universe is immense and contains countless stars.
immense.zh: 宇宙是巨大的，包含了无数的星星。

given.en: As a verb: 'The teacher given the book to the student.'

definite.en: There is a definite connection between hard work and success.

reflection.en: The mirror gave a perfect reflection of the room.
reflection.zh: 镜子完美地反射了房间的景象。

ultimate.en: This decision will have ultimate influence on the future of the company.
ultimate.zh: "这个决定将对公司的未来产生最终影响。"

solicitor.en: The solicitor prepared all the necessary documents for the house sale.
solicitor.zh: 这位律师准备了所有卖房所需的文件。

merit.en: His novel is of great merit.

overall.en: Overall, the party was a huge success.

plural.en: Cats are the plural form of cat.

doctoral.en: He is working on his doctoral dissertation.
doctoral.zh: 他正在撰写他的博士论文。

resistant.en: The material is heat-resistant, meaning it can withstand high temperatures.
resistant.zh: 这种材料是耐热的,意味着它可以承受高温

weapon.en: "He was accused of carrying a concealed weapon."

enhance.en: Amy’s blue shirt really enhances the color of her eyes.

enclose.en: The cows in the field were enclosed by a fence.

convention.en: The annual trade convention will be held next week.
convention.zh: 下周将举行年度贸易大会。

suspicion.en: I have a suspicion that he's not telling the truth.

generic.en: The supermarket has its own brand of generic products.
generic.zh: 超市有自己的未注册商标产品品牌。

genius.en: Albert Einstein was often considered a genius.
genius.zh: 艾伯特·爱因斯坦经常被认为是一个天才。

fund.en: We set up a fund for our children's education.
fund.zh: 我们为孩子的教育设立了基金。

quotation.en: I always start my day with a motivational quotation.
quotation.zh: 我总是用一句激励人心的名言来开始我的一天。

tray.en: He carried a tray of drinks into the room.
tray.zh: 他把一个装满饮料的托盘拿进房间。

regulate.en: "The government body regulates the pharmaceutical industry to maintain a standard in medication production."
regulate.zh: 政府机构管控药品行业以保持药品生产的标准。

palm.en: He held the tiny bird gently in his palm.
palm.zh: 他轻轻地在手掌中握着这只小鸟。

infant.en: "The mother was cradling an infant in her arms."
infant.zh: 母亲在怀中抱着一个婴儿。

unload.en: "The truck drivers are unloading the goods from the truck."
unload.zh: 卡车司机正在从卡车上卸货。

payment.en: I made the last payment on my car yesterday. Now I am really the owner.

priority.en: Health and safety are our top priority.
priority.zh: 健康和安全是我们的头等大事。

slope.en: The hill had a steep slope, which made it challenging to climb.
slope.zh: 这座山的坡度很大，爬起来很有挑战性。

philosophy.en: My philosophy is “live and let live.”

creative.en: The artists were asked to produce a creative piece for the exhibition.
creative.zh: 艺术家们被要求为展览创作一个富有创意的作品。

worship.en: They worship in this church every Sunday.
worship.zh: 他们在这个教堂里每个星期天都参加礼拜。

lawn.en: The children are playing soccer on the lawn.
lawn.zh: 孩子们正在草坪上玩足球。

log.en: He kept a detailed log of his travels.
log.zh: 他详细记录了他的旅行。

formation.en: Geological events led to the formation of the mountains.
formation.zh: 地质活动导致了山脉的形成。

layer.en: Peel back the outer layer of the onion.

assure.en: I assure you that everything will be alright.
assure.zh: 我向你保证一切都会好起来的。

smash.en: He smashed the glass on the floor.
smash.zh: 他把玻璃杯摔在地板上。

contradiction.en: There seems to be a contradiction in your statements.
contradiction.zh: 你的陈述中似乎有矛盾。

fuss.en: He always makes a fuss over minor problems.
fuss.zh: 他总对一些小问题大惊小怪。

barrel.en: He filled the barrel with water.

efficient.en: My car is very efficient. I rarely have to buy gas.

reverse.en: We reversed out of the parking place and then drove away.

barely.en: I barely had enough money to pay for my bus ticket.

facility.en: There are many educational facilities in big cities.

alliance.en: Our company has formed an alliance with a leading software corporation.
alliance.zh: 我们的公司已经和一个领先的软件公司结成了联盟。

pessimistic.en: Despite the early success, he remains pessimistic about the outcome of the deal.
pessimistic.zh: 尽管初步的成功，他对交易的结果仍然持悲观态度。

commander.en: The commander issued strict orders for the immediate retreat of all forces.
commander.zh: 指挥官下达了立即撤退所有部队的严格命令。

emphasis.en: The teacher put the emphasis on the importance of hard work.
emphasis.zh: 老师强调了努力工作的重要性。

prescribe.en: The doctor prescribed some medication for my cough.
prescribe.zh: 医生为我的咳嗽开了些药。

combination.en: The combination of sweet and sour flavors is really refreshing in this dish.
combination.zh: 这道菜中甜与酸的组合真的使人耳目一新。

turbine.en: The use of wind turbines in power generation has been growing rapidly over the past decade.
turbine.zh: 过去十年间，风力涡轮机在发电中的应用得到了快速发展。

gross.en: His gross income is over 100,000 dollars a year.
gross.zh: 他的总收入一年超过10万美元。

workshop.en: John attended a writing workshop to improve his skills.
workshop.zh: 约翰参加了一个写作研讨会以提高他的技能

stimulate.en: Bright colors can stimulate the senses.
stimulate.zh: 明亮的颜色可以刺激感官

formal.en: It was a formal dinner, so we wore our best clothes.

soak.en: He had a long soak in the bath.

interference.en: His interference in my work is very annoying.
interference.zh: 他对我的工作的干扰让我很烦。

sustain.en: Wind power is a clean way to sustain a city with energy.

entertain.en: I like to entertain my friends at my apartment.
entertain.zh: 我喜欢在我的公寓里招待朋友。

critical.en: He has a very critical eye when it comes to art.
critical.zh: 他对于艺术有非常挑剔的眼光

colony.en: He migrated to a British colony in Africa.
colony.zh: 他移居到了非洲的一个英国殖民地。

mathematics.en: "She is pursuing a degree in Mathematics."

wagon.en: They loaded up the wagon and headed west.
wagon.zh: 他们装满马车，然后朝西出发。

principal.en: My school’s principal can be very strict with the rules.

specimen.en: He collected the blood specimen for testing.
specimen.zh: 他收集了血液样本用于检测。

restore.en: The damaged photo was skillfully restored.
restore.zh: 那张破损的照片被巧妙地恢复了。

therapy.en: "After the accident, she had to undergo intensive physical therapy."
therapy.zh: 事故后，她需要接受密集的物理治疗。

banner.en: "The company logo is displayed on the banner across the top of the website."
banner.zh: 公司的标志被显示在网站顶部的横幅上。

encounter.en: As a noun: I had an unexpected encounter with an old friend in the street.
encounter.zh: 我在街上意外遇到了一个老朋友。

gratitude.en: The kids showed Aunt Tess much gratitude for visiting them.

interfere.en: Parents should not interfere in their children's marriages.
interfere.zh: 父母不应干预孩子的婚姻。

uneasy.en: He felt uneasy about the whole situation.
uneasy.zh: 他对整个情况感到不安。

developmental.en: This is a developmental stage for children.

stack.en: There was a stack of paperwork on his desk to complete.

parliament.en: Parliament is debating the new tax proposal.
parliament.zh: 议会正在辩论新的税收提议。

crack.en: The old window was covered with cracks.

bind.en: Bind the twine around the package tightly.
bind.zh: 将麻线紧紧地绑在包裹上。

trim.en: "Could you trim the bushes in the garden?"
trim.zh: 你能修剪一下花园里的灌木吗？

predictable.en: The outcome of the game was predictable.
predictable.zh: 这场比赛的结果可以预测。

rally.en: The school had a rally in the gym to support the basketball team.

prime.en: Dirty air is a prime cause of illness.

profile.en: He has a unique profile, easily recognizable in a crowd.
profile.zh: 他的侧面轮廓很独特，在人群中容易辨认。

loyal.en: He is a loyal supporter of the team, and never misses a single game.
loyal.zh: 他是队伍的忠实支持者，一场比赛都不错过。

impact.en: The teacher's words had a huge impact on me.
impact.zh: 老师的话对我产生了很大的影响。

opportunity.en: I had an opportunity to take pictures in the jungle.

venture.en: As a noun: Investing in the stock market is always a venture.
venture.zh: 投资股市总是一场冒险。

mill.en: The farmer took his wheat to the mill to make it into flour.

dose.en: The doctor prescribed a dose of antibiotics to fight the infection.
dose.zh: 医生为治疗感染开了抗生素的剂量。

route.en: I saw many new houses along the route to the city.

enthusiasm.en: "She shows great enthusiasm for her work."

pluralism.en: This country was built on the principles of pluralism and democracy.
pluralism.zh: 这个国家是建立在多元主义和民主原则之上的。

shiver.en: I got shivers on my way home because it was so cold.

bible.en: The Bible is the holy book of Christianity.

interior.en: We decorated the interior of our house.
interior.zh: 我们装修了我们房子的内部。

rouse.en: The noise outside roused him from his deep sleep.
rouse.zh: 外面的噪音将他从深深的睡眠中唤醒。

journal.en: I write in my journal every night before going to bed.
journal.zh: 我每晚临睡前都会在日记本上写一些东西。

involvement.en: His involvement in the project was crucial to its success.
involvement.zh: 他在项目中的参与对于项目的成功至关重要。

spark.en: There was a spark in his eyes.

assembly.en: Assembly of the bookcase was surprisingly straightforward.
assembly.zh: 组装这个书架意外的简单。

so-called.en: "He is a so-called expert, but his advice was not helpful at all."
so-called.zh: 他是个所谓的专家，但他的建议一点也不有用。

chip.en: Can you pass me a bag of chips?
chip.zh: 你能递给我一袋炸薯片吗？

chin.en: Luke pointed to the hair on his chin.

involve.en: The entire operation involves many hours of preparatory work.
involve.zh: 整个操作涉及许多小时的预备工作。

noticeable.en: There is a noticeable difference in temperature between the two rooms.
noticeable.zh: 两个房间的温度有明显的差别。

assemble.en: The crowd started to assemble in the square.
assemble.zh: 人群开始在广场上集合。

blast.en: There was a loud blast as the rocket launched into space.
blast.zh: 火箭发射进入太空时发出了一声巨大的爆炸声。

series.en: We have a series of meetings scheduled for next week.
series.zh: 我们下周有一系列的会议安排。

complicated.en: The situation is much more complicated than you think.
complicated.zh: 你认为的情况比实际上要复杂得多。

cultivate.en: A research company is cultivating new kinds of rice to aid poor countries.

thrive.en: He may be an old man, but he continues to thrive.

dialect.en: She speaks in a southern American dialect.

recreational.en: Camping is one of my favorite recreational activities.
recreational.zh: 露营是我最喜欢的娱乐活动之一。

faculty.en: The faculty of this university is highly educated.
faculty.zh: 这所大学的教员都非常有教育背景。

trail.en: She walked slowly along the forest trail.
trail.zh: 她沿着森林小路慢慢地走。

prior.en: "She had to finish her prior work before starting the new task."
prior.zh: 在开始新任务之前，她必须完成之前的工作。

clue.en: The detective found a crucial clue at the crime scene.
clue.zh: 侦探在犯罪现场找到了一个关键的线索。

vanish.en: All the passengers vanished from the train station.

finally.en: Finally, after hours of waiting, our turn came.
finally.zh: 终于，经过几小时的等待，轮到我们了。

exhaust.en: We've nearly exhausted our supply of firewood for the winter.
exhaust.zh: 我们几乎已经耗尽了今年冬天的柴火供应。

creep.en: "The kid creeps into the room to avoid waking up his parents."
creep.zh: 孩子悄悄进入房间，避免唤醒他的父母。

strap.en: She put the strap of her purse over her shoulder and walked out the door.

regarding.en: The principal talked to the students regarding the school rules.
regarding.zh: 校长和学生们谈论了关于校规的问题。

acceptance.en: Her acceptance into the team was an important step in her career.
acceptance.zh: 她被团队接受是她职业生涯的重要一步。

relativity.en: Relativity teaches that light travels at the same speed throughout the universe.

tackle.en: He decided to tackle the problem head on.
tackle.zh: 他决定正面对付这个问题。

reckon.en: I reckon we'll be on time if traffic is light.
reckon.zh: 我认为如果交通畅通的话，我们会准时到达。

confusion.en: The sudden outburst of the crowd caused confusion.
confusion.zh: 群众的突然暴动导致了混乱。

occasion.en: "This is a special occasion for all of us."
occasion.zh: 这是我们所有人的特殊时刻。

loan.en: The bank approved the car loan.

virtual.en: Virtual reality technology is becoming more advanced.
virtual.zh: 虚拟现实技术正在变得越来越先进。

landlord.en: "The landlord is responsible for making major repairs to the house."
landlord.zh: 房东负责对房子做大修。

additional.en: Additional resources were allocated to complete the project.
additional.zh: 分配了额外的资源来完成项目。

duration.en: The girls watched television for the duration of the evening.

plantation.en: In the 1800s, there were many cotton plantations in the southern US.

vapour.en: The warm sun causes the rainfall to turn into vapour.
vapour.zh: 热阳使雨水转化为蒸汽。

sole.en: "She was the sole beneficiary of her father's will."
sole.zh: 她是她父亲遗嘱的唯一受益人。

jury.en: The jury listened closely to the attorney before they made their decision.

priest.en: The priest delivered a moving sermon.
priest.zh: 牧师发表了一篇感人的讲道。

tame.en: The tame bird rested in his hand.

spectacular.en: There was a spectacular fireworks display in the park at New Year.

inherit.en: My brother and I are set to inherit our parent's house.
inherit.zh: 我和我哥哥将要继承我们父母的房子。

peculiar.en: He has the most peculiar habit of biting his nails whenever he's nervous.
peculiar.zh: 他有个非常奇特的习惯，每当他紧张时就会咬指甲。

grant.en: I grant you permission to leave early.

injection.en: "James received an injection for his hay fever."
injection.zh: 詹姆斯接受了治疗花粉病的注射。

hut.en: They constructed a small hut on the deserted island.
hut.zh: 他们在荒岛上建了一个小屋。

convert.en: The man converted his messy field into a garden of flowers.

executive.en: After twenty years at the company, he finally became the executive.

navigation.en: The new car has built-in navigation.

melt.en: The ice cream will melt if you don't put it in the freezer.
melt.zh: 如果你不把冰淇淋放冰箱里，它会融化。

stale.en: The cookies sat on the table so long that they became stale.

whereas.en: He enjoys reading, whereas his brother prefers sports.
whereas.zh: 他喜欢阅读，而他的兄弟偏爱体育运动。

adoptive.en: "She has a close relationship with her adoptive parents."
adoptive.zh: 她和她的领养父母有很亲密的关系。

chop.en: "You need to chop the onions finely for the salad."
chop.zh: 你需要把洋葱剁成细末以备沙拉使用。

classification.en: The books in the library are arranged according to the classification system.
classification.zh: 图书馆里的书是按照分类系统来排列的。

inference.en: "Based on the clues given in the story, my inference is that the character is hiding something."
inference.zh: 根据故事中给出的线索，我推断这个角色隐藏了什么。

curve.en: The road curves around the lake.

skim.en: "The stone skims across the surface of the lake."

notify.en: The teacher notified us about a change to our assignment.

heave.en: "He had to heave the bag onto his shoulder."
heave.zh: 他不得不把包扔到肩上

nourish.en: Teachers should nourish a love of learning in their students.
nourish.zh: 老师们应该在学生中培养对学习的热爱。

torch.en: She shone the torch into the dark room.
torch.zh: 她将电筒照向黑暗的房间。

positive.en: She has a positive future ahead of her after finishing college.

prospect.en: "There is little prospect of a thaw in relations between the two countries."
prospect.zh: 两国关系出现缓和的可能性甚微

radar.en: The fighter jet was not detected on the enemy's radar.
radar.zh: 那架战斗机并没有被敌人的雷达检测到。

comparable.en: Their strengths are comparable to ours.
comparable.zh: 他们的优势与我们的相当

specialize.en: "He decided to specialize in pediatric medicine."

rotate.en: Please rotate the handle to unlock the door.

instance.en: For instance, we can use solar power instead of coal.
instance.zh: 比如，我们可以用太阳能代替煤炭。

presumably.en: He's presumably very busy with the project.
presumably.zh: 他大概正忙于这个项目。

recognition.en: The teacher gave me a certificate in recognition of my hard work.
recognition.zh: 老师给了我一份证书以表彰我辛勤的工作。

blade.en: The knife has a very sharp blade.
blade.zh: 这把刀的刀片非常锋利。

revenue.en: The company's annual revenue was over 10 million dollars.
revenue.zh: 公司的年度收入超过了1000万美元。

strip.en: 动词意义：He decided to strip the old paint off the walls.
strip.zh: 他决定把墙上的旧漆剥掉。

solution.en: Make sure you mix the solution thoroughly. 请确保彻底混合溶液。

continuous.en: The continuous noise from the construction site is disturbing.
continuous.zh: 来自建筑工地的连续噪音很扰人。

opponent.en: He is my opponent in the final game.

alter.en: They had to alter the course of the ship to avoid collision.
alter.zh: 他们不得不改变船的航线以避免碰撞。

ideal.en: She is an ideal candidate for the job.
ideal.zh: 她是这份工作的理想候选人。

illustrate.en: The teacher used a story to illustrate the point.
illustrate.zh: 老师用一个故事来阐明这个观点。

establishment.en: The establishment of a new government was welcomed by the people.
establishment.zh: 人民欢迎新政府的建立。

breeze.en: The trees were swaying gently in the breeze.
breeze.zh: 树木在轻风中轻轻摇曳。

trash.en: Please take out the trash; it smells bad.

horn.en: The deer has grown a new pair of horns.
horn.zh: 那只鹿已经长出了新的一对角。

infer.en: By the position of the sun in the sky, she inferred that it was noon.

sore.en: After lifting the heavy box, Mona’s back was sore.

dispose.en: He disposed of the can by throwing it into the recycle bin.

glow.en: The street lamps cast a golden glow on the snow.
glow.zh: 街头灯将雪地照成了金黄色。

blend.en: My wife blended together all of the ingredients to make a delicious stew.

genuine.en: After the painting was determined to be genuine, it sold for a million dollars.

fulfil.en: He fulfilled his duty as a father.
fulfil.zh: 他履行了作为父亲的职责。

wicked.en: She is a wicked woman who has no ethics.
wicked.zh: 她是一个没有道德的恶女人。

equation.en: The solution of the equation is x = 2.

impressive.en: Her performance in the ballet was truly impressive.
impressive.zh: 她在芭蕾舞中的表现真的赞叹不已。

compound.en: His financial troubles were compounded by a sudden illness.
compound.zh: 他的财务困难因病情加重而复杂化。

structure.en: There are big differences in family structure in different cultures.

intensity.en: The intensity of the sun can cause a burn.
intensity.zh: 太阳的强烈可以导致晒伤。

stake.en: As a noun (赌注；利害关系): They have a stake in the success of the business.
stake.zh: 他们对这个商业的成功有着切身利害关系。

concerning.en: She wrote to me concerning that issue.
concerning.zh: 她给我写了封关于那个问题的信。

mere.en: "The mere thought of him makes me nervous."

suburb.en: I grew up in the suburbs, only a few minutes outside of the city.

lodge.en: During our ski trip, we stayed at a lodge.

threat.zh: 你的威胁并不能吓到我。

writer.en: "She is a famous writer in my country."
writer.zh: 她是我的国家里的一位著名作家。

curl.en: She used a curling iron to curl her hair.
curl.zh: 她用烫发棒卷曲她的头发。

patch.en: "A patch of oil can be seen on the water."
patch.zh: 在水面上可以看到一块油斑。

observer.en: He is an observer of human behaviors.
observer.zh: 他是一个人类行为的观察者

marxist.en: He is doing a Marxist analysis of the play.
marxist.zh: 他正在对这个剧本进行马克思主义的分析。

brow.zh: 她紧锁的眉头显示出她正在专心。

ignorant.en: I’m a bit ignorant about his theories. Can you explain them to me?

magnetic.en: "He has this magnetic personality that everyone is drawn to."
magnetic.zh: 他有一种吸引人的性格，每个人都被他吸引。

comprise.zh: 这个委员会由八名成员组成。

moderate.en: As a moderate eater, he is in greater control of his health.
moderate.zh: 他食量适度，对自身的健康更加有控制力。

substantial.en: The bank said that he owed it a substantial amount of money.

execute.en: The computer is to execute the command.

vitamin.en: Our nutritionist suggested us to take vitamin supplements.
vitamin.zh: 我们的营养师建议我们补充维生素。

thereby.en: He didn’t score a goal, thereby ending his chance at setting a record.

boost.en: Lowering prices boosts customers’ interest in shopping.

fireman.en: The fireman bravely fought the blaze to rescue the trapped people.
fireman.zh: 消防员勇敢地与火势搏斗，救出了被困的人群。

sincere.en: Your sincere apology is much appreciated.
sincere.zh: 我们很感激你真诚的道歉

nevertheless.en: He was feeling unwell. Nevertheless, he decided to go to work.
nevertheless.zh: 他觉得身体不适，然而，他还是决定去工作。

prominent.en: He played a prominent role in the campaign.
prominent.zh: 他在这次活动中发挥了重要的作用。
