eliminate.en: We need to eliminate the possibility of failure.
eliminate.zh: 我们需要消除失败的可能性。

entitle.en: His golden ticket entitled him to sit in the front row at the concert.

excess.en: An excess of enthusiasm can be as dangerous as a lack of it.
excess.zh: 过于热情有时会跟缺乏热情一样危险。

perspective.en: Your perspective on life changes as you grow older.
perspective.zh: 随着年龄的增长，你对生活的看法也会发生改变。

destruction.en: The tornado left a trail of destruction through the town.
destruction.zh: 龙卷风在小镇上留下了一片破坏的痕迹。

invade.en: The enemy troops invade the territory.

wolf.en: The wolf is known for its eerie howl.
wolf.zh: 狼以其恐怖的嚎叫声闻名。

accordance.en: In accordance with company policy, employees must wear business casual attire.
accordance.zh: 依照公司政策，员工必须穿商务休闲装。

democracy.en: "The United States is often cited as an example of a democracy."
democracy.zh: 美国常被举为民主制度的例子。

transportation.en: Public transportation is a convenient and eco-friendly option for commuting.
transportation.zh: 公共交通是环保且方便的通行方式。

dye.en: Can you tell me where to find hair dye?
dye.zh: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到染发剂吗?

evolve.en: Many people think that humans evolved from animals.

extensive.en: She has conducted extensive research on this subject.
extensive.zh: 她对这个主题进行了广泛的研究。

definitely.en: He will definitely come to the party.

marvelous.en: The view of the sunset at the sea was marvelous.
marvelous.zh: 海上日落的景色真是美妙无比。

household.en: Our household is made up of my father, my mother, and me.

ratio.en: The ratio of men to women in the company is 2:3.

wool.en: "There's nothing warmer than a wool sweater in the winter."
wool.zh: 冬天里没有比羊毛毛衣更温暖的了

wholly.en: She was wholly convinced that it was the right decision.
wholly.zh: 她完全相信那是正确的决定。

instinct.en: The mother's instinct to protect her child is very strong.
instinct.zh: 母亲保护孩子的本能非常强。

approximate.en: The approximate cost of the repair is $100.
approximate.zh: 修理的大约费用是100美元。

invest.en: I decided to invest my savings in a mutual fund.
invest.zh: 我决定把我的储蓄投资到一家共享基金中。

shrug.en: When I asked him about the missing money, he just shrugged.
shrug.zh: 当我问他关于丢失的钱时，他只是耸了耸肩。

diameter.en: The diameter of the circle is 10 cm.

barn.en: My grandparents keep hay in their red barn.

loop.en: He made a loop with the rope and placed it over the post.

restrain.en: Mike restrained Allen from reaching the door.

crane.en: The crane lifted the container onto the ship.
crane.zh: 起重机将集装箱吊到了船上。

impatient.en: He was getting impatient waiting for the bus.
impatient.zh: 他等公交车等得有些不耐烦了。

spill.en: Be careful not to spill the water.

gardener.en: "My grandfather worked as a gardener all his life."
gardener.zh: 我祖父一生都是一名园丁。

conquest.en: The territory was brought under his conquest.

finding.en: The finding of the court is that the defendant is not guilty.

dense.en: I easily became lost in the dense forest.

laboratory.en: The new laboratory is at the cutting edge of scientific research.
laboratory.zh: 这个新的实验室处于科学研究的前沿。

farewell.en: "He gave a touching farewell speech at the graduation ceremony."
farewell.zh: 他在毕业典礼上发表了感人的告别演讲。

appliance.en: Many homes have appliances like ovens, toasters, and refrigerators.

lord.en: She was presented to the Queen and the Lord Mayor.
lord.zh: 她被介绍给了女王和市长。

detect.en: The system can detect errors in the programming code.
detect.zh: 这个系统能在编程代码中察觉到错误。

commerce.en: The rapid expansion of global commerce has increased the demand for shipping services.
commerce.zh: 全球商业的迅速扩展增加了对航运服务的需求。

gulf.en: The Persian Gulf is rich in oil resources.

definition.en: The professor gave a clear definition of the term.
definition.zh: 教授给了这个术语一个清晰的定义。

organic.en: The organic carrots are more expensive, but they’re better for you.

inferior.en: His technical knowledge is inferior to mine.

incredible.en: I have an incredible story to tell you about my vacation.

dramatic.en: The movie has a dramatic ending which left the audience in suspense.
dramatic.zh: 这部电影的结局充满戏剧性，让观众悬念重重。

layout.en: "We will have to change the entire layout of the apartment."
layout.zh: 我们将需要改变整个公寓的布局。

removal.en: The removal of the old furniture took the whole day.
removal.zh: 移走老旧的家具花了整整一天。

disgust.en: His filthy habits fill me with disgust.
disgust.zh: 他肮脏的习惯让我感到恶心。

stem.en: The rose had a long thin stem.

mechanic.en: As a mechanic, he's an expert in engine repair.
mechanic.zh: 作为一个修理工，他是发动机修理方面的专家。

critic.en: "The critic gave the movie a good review."
critic.zh: 评论家对这部电影的评价很好。

enable.en: "The donations enable us to continue our work."
enable.zh: 这些捐款让我们能够继续我们的工作。

preliminary.en: The runners must do well in the preliminary races to qualify for the final race.

obstacle.en: Climbing over the giant rock was the biggest obstacle for the hikers.

calculator.en: I need a scientific calculator for my math class.
calculator.zh: 我需要一个科学计算器来上数学课。

van.en: He loaded the boxes into the van.
van.zh: 他把箱子装进了面包车。

compress.en: We should compress the files to save space in the disk.
compress.zh: 我们应将文件压缩以节省磁盘空间。

arise.en: The sun arises in the east.

collaborative.en: "This task requires a collaborative effort from our entire team."
collaborative.zh: 这项任务需要我们整个团队的共同努力。

constitute.en: These events constitute a turning point in global history.
constitute.zh: 这些事件构成了全球历史的转折点

underneath.en: He found the book lying underneath the bed.
underneath.zh: 他在床下找到了那本书。

prolong.en: Sandy walked slowly across the beach, trying to prolong her lunch break.

distress.en: We were in great distress when our home was destroyed during the last hurricane.

flock.en: A flock of birds flew overhead.

internal.en: The internal structure of the building is very complex.
internal.zh: 这个建筑的内部结构很复杂。

thumb.en: He held the tiny bird gently in his thumb and forefinger.
thumb.zh: 他用拇指和食指小心翼翼地握着那只小鸟。

republican.en: "He is a staunch republican, always advocating for the power to lie in the hands of the people." - 他是一个坚定的共和主义者，总是主张权力掌握在人民手中。

foundation.en: The foundation raised money to give scholarships to students.

flexibility.en: Yoga improves both your flexibility and balance.
flexibility.zh: 瑜伽能够改进你的灵活性和平衡性。

mysterious.en: She found his behaviour very mysterious.
mysterious.zh: 她觉得他的行为很奇怪。

moreover.en: Marianne likes to walk to work to save money; moreover, it is good exercise.

scatter.en: Scatter the seeds in the garden.

installation.en: "The installation of the software was quick and easy."
installation.zh: 这个软件的安装快速而简单。

verify.en: Julian called the movie theater to verify that the movie started at nine.

excursion.en: We went on an excursion to the beach.

steer.en: I steered the car to the left to avoid the pedestrian.
steer.zh: 我把车向左转，避开了行人。

undergo.en: The cancer patient undergoes treatments twice a week.

sympathize.en: I sympathize with those who lost their homes in the earthquake.
sympathize.zh: 我对在地震中失去家园的人表示同情

railroad.en: The busy railroad connects the east coast to the west coast.
railroad.zh: 这条繁忙的铁路连接了东海岸和西海岸。

nucleus.en: The nucleus contains the genetic material of the cell.
nucleus.zh: 细胞核包含了细胞的遗传物质。

sting.en: "He was stung by a bee while picking apples."
sting.zh: 他采苹果时被蜜蜂蛰了。

haste.en: He made haste to finish the job before the deadline.
haste.zh: 他急忙地赶在期限前完成了工作。

anonymous.en: An anonymous donor gave a thousand dollars to the museum.

stir.en: Mom stirred the batter until it was smooth.

span.en: His work at the bakery has spanned twenty years.

insult.en: He hurled an insult at me.

craft.en: She crafted the bookcase out of solid pine wood and then painted it.

poll.en: The poll showed that many people support the plan to stop gang violence.

spite.en: He quit his job out of spite.
spite.zh: 他因为恨意而辞掉了他的工作。

chamber.en: He was sitting in his chamber and reading a book.
chamber.zh: 他正在他的房间里坐着读书。

coarse.en: This fabric has a coarse texture, which is not very comfortable to touch.
coarse.zh: 这块布料的质地粗糙，触感不太舒适。

publicity.en: She received a lot of publicity after her performance in the film.

depart.en: The train will depart in ten minutes.
depart.zh: 火车将在十分钟后出发。

exaggerate.zh: 别夸大其词，事情没有那么糟

imply.en: The man implied that he wanted the job, but he didn’t say so.

capture.en: The police were able to capture the criminal.
capture.zh: 警察成功地捕获了罪犯。

manufacture.en: The company plans to manufacture a new model of car next year.
manufacture.zh: 这家公司计划明年生产新的汽车模型。

sequence.en: I lost my place in the sequence of events.
sequence.zh: 我对事件的顺序弄混了。

provision.en: Provision of clean water is crucial in disaster relief.
provision.zh: 在灾害救援中，提供干净的水是至关重要的。

recruit.en: "We are trying to recruit more members for our club."
recruit.zh: 我们正在为我们的俱乐部招募更多的成员。

thrust.en: He thrust his hands into his pockets.

fame.en: He rose to fame through hard work and determination.
fame.zh: 他通过努力和决心走向了名声。

replacement.en: The company is planning a replacement of the old equipment.

according.en: "According to the schedule, the meeting starts at 10:00 AM."
according.zh: 根据日程安排，会议将在上午10:00开始。

membership.en: Your gym membership expires in one week.
membership.zh: 你的健身房会员资格将在一周内到期。

jealous.en: Miriam was jealous because Sue was paying too much attention to Jim.

rust.en: The old metal gate would not swing because the hinges were covered in rust.

trace.en: There's a trace of sadness in his eyes.
trace.zh: 他的眼神中有一丝伤感。

grave.en: We visit our grandfather’s grave each year.

criminology.en: She is studying criminology at the university.

controversy.en: "The decision to build the airport has caused considerable controversy."
controversy.zh: 建造机场的决策引发了很大的争议

newsstand.en: We bought some magazines at the newsstand.
newsstand.zh: 我们在报摊上买了一些杂志。

ambassador.en: He is the newly appointed US ambassador to China.
ambassador.zh: 他是新任命的美国驻中国大使。

anticipate.en: Carrie anticipated the arrival of her baby.

variable.en: The weather is highly variable in this country.
variable.zh: 这个国家的天气变化无常。

landscape.en: The landscape of the village surrounded by mountains is breathtaking.
landscape.zh: 被群山环绕的村庄的景色令人屏息。

weave.en: She learned how to weave a basket in her craft class.
weave.zh: 她在手工课上学会了如何编制篮子。

exception.en: The system will throw an exception if there is a problem with the input data.
exception.zh: 如果输入数据有问题，系统将抛出一个异常。

resolution.en: As a New Year resolution, I promised to quit smoking.
resolution.zh: 作为新年决心，我承诺要戒烟。

setting.en: "You can change the setting of the computer game according to your preferences."
setting.zh: 你可以根据自己的喜好改变电脑游戏的设置。

quote.en: He quoted a famous line from Shakespeare in his speech.
quote.zh: 他在演讲中引用了莎士比亚的名句。

famine.en: The farmers couldn’t grow any food in the dry soil, so there was a famine.

gramme.en: A kilogramme is equal to a thousand gramme.

mayor.en: The Mayor will open the new library next week.
mayor.zh: 市长将在下周开放新的图书馆。

virtually.en: It's virtually impossible to predict the outcome.

proportional.en: The punishment should be proportional to the crime.

economy.en: The global economy is experiencing a serious recession.
economy.zh: 全球经济正在经历严重衰退。

community.en: The local community was devastated by the hurricane.
community.zh: 当地的社区被飓风严重破坏。

endure.en: Despite the pain, he endured and finished the race.
endure.zh: 尽管痛苦，他忍耐下来并完成了比赛。

detail.en: We need to pay attention to every detail of the project.
detail.zh: 我们需要关注项目的每一个细节。

fate.en: Some people believe that the lines on a person’s hand can tell his or her fate.

utility.en: This tool has great utility in our daily life.
utility.zh: 这个工具在我们日常生活中非常实用。

measurement.en: I've taken all the measurements for the dress.
measurement.zh: 我已经把裙子的所有尺寸测量出来了。

particle.en: There was not a particle of evidence to suggest they were guilty.
particle.zh: 没有一点证据表明他们有罪

behavior.en: His behavior at the party was unacceptable.
behavior.zh: 他在派对上的行为不可接受。

minimize.en: I checked my homework twice to minimize errors I might have made.

descend.en: I descended the stairs to get out of the building.

density.en: This material has a high density.

oblige.en: I feel obliged to write and thank you for your help.
oblige.zh: 我觉得我有责任写信感谢你的帮助。

slam.en: The door slammed shut behind him.

characterize.en: Their work is characterized by a great attention to detail.
characterize.zh: 他们的工作以对细节的高度关注为特点。

invasion.en: The country braced itself for an impending invasion.
invasion.zh: 这个国家正在为即将到来的侵略做准备。

emerge.en: After a long winter, the flowers began to emerge.
emerge.zh: 冬天过后，花儿开始破土而出。

lease.en: When the family first leased the apartment, the rent was very low.

slap.en: Out of anger, Helen slapped Eunice on the face.

scout.en: Our military often send scouts into enemy territory to gather information.
scout.zh: **我们的军队经常派遣侦察员进入敌人领土收集信息。**

restless.en: He seemed to be restless, always looking for something new.
restless.zh: 他似乎总是不安分，总在寻找新鲜事物。

fleet.en: The fleet of ships spent a few days at the dock.

saddle.en: He put the saddle on the horse.

rural.en: The most fascinating part about travelling is experiencing the rural lifestyle.
rural.zh: 旅行中最吸引人的部分就是体验乡村生活。

historical.en: This book provides a historical perspective on the economic growth of the country.
historical.zh: 这本书从历史的角度提供了关于国家经济增长的观点。

transmission.en: The transmission of data over the internet has become faster over the years.
transmission.zh: 随着岁月的流逝，通过互联网传输数据的速度变得越来越快。

shortage.en: During the dry season, there was a shortage of water.

surrender.en: "The general ordered his troops to surrender."

faint.en: Carol fainted because she hadn’t eaten in over a day.

world-wide.en: The company has world-wide recognition for its innovative products.
world-wide.zh: 这家公司因其创新产品在全世界范围内得到了认可。

pose.en: The new policy poses a problem for us.
pose.zh: 这项新政策给我们带来了一个问题。

remedy.en: The best remedy for a headache is a good long sleep.
remedy.zh: 头疼的最佳疗法是好好地睡一觉。

jail.en: He was sentenced to two years in jail for theft.
jail.zh: 他因盗窃被判入狱两年。

consent.en: "She gave her consent to the proposal."

helpless.en: She felt helpless when she could not find her lost child.
helpless.zh: 她找不到失踪的孩子时感到很无助。

volume.en: The volume of traffic has increased enormously in recent years.
volume.zh: 近些年来交通流量显著增长.

retreat.en: The army retreated because they were losing the battle.

mutual.en: Robert likes Sarah, and she likes him. The feeling is mutual.

shell.en: The snail retreated into its shell when it sensed danger.
shell.zh: 当蜗牛感受到危险时，它会缩回壳里去。

guideline.en: "The teacher provided the students with a guideline for their homework."
guideline.zh: 老师为学生们提供了一套作业指引。

hesitate.en: She didn't hesitate before jumping into the freezing water.
hesitate.zh: 她跳入冰冷的水中时并不犹豫。

rifle.en: The soldier was cleaning his rifle.
rifle.zh: 士兵正在清洁他的步枪。

breakdown.en: My car had a breakdown on the highway.
breakdown.zh: 我的车在公路上抛锚了。

paste.en: My son needed some paste for a school project.

overtake.en: The runner from Canada has overtaken all his competitors.
overtake.zh: 加拿大的选手已经超过了所有的竞争者。

overnight.en: An overnight frost had made the pavements slippery.
overnight.zh: 整夜的霜使人行道变得滑

stretch.en: After sitting for a long time, I needed to stretch.
stretch.zh: 坐久了，我需要伸一下身子。

responsible.en: Peter is responsible for leading his department.

scope.en: The scope of this project includes designing a new building.
scope.zh: 这个项目的范围包括设计一栋新的大楼。

bullet.en: The police found a bullet in the wall.
bullet.zh: 警察在墙上发现了一颗子弹。

identify.en: You must carry a document that can identify you.
identify.zh: 你必须携带一份可以确认你身份的文件。

embrace.zh: 他们亲切地拥抱了对方。

label.en: The label on the dress says it's made of pure silk.
label.zh: 这件裙子的标签上说是纯丝制成的

slippery.en: The ground is slippery due to the rain, so we must watch our step.
slippery.zh: 由于雨水，地面很滑，所以我们必须小心走路。

modify.en: I modified my outfit by adding a belt to it.

horizon.en: I gazed out over the blue sea melting into the sky at the horizon.
horizon.zh: 我凝视着蔚蓝的海水在地平线处融入天空。

pledge.en: Pledge as a verb: "I pledge to work harder in the future."
pledge.zh: 我承诺将来会更努力工作。

reservoir.en: The city's water supply comes from a reservoir in the mountains.
reservoir.zh: 城市的水源来自山上的一个水库。

deliberate.en: Bernie made a deliberate attempt to injure Andy.

swear.en: I will put my hand on the Bible and swear to do my best for the country.

biotechnology.en: "Biotechnology has made significant contributions to medicine and agriculture."
biotechnology.zh: 生物技术在医药和农业方面做出了重大贡献。

career.en: He has made a successful career in finance.
career.zh: 他在金融行业取得了成功的职业生涯。

release.en: The zoo decided to release the bear into the wild.
release.zh: 动词，译为：动物园决定把熊释放到野外。

charter.en: The company charter explained that all employees had to pay a tax.

rib.en: He broke a rib in the accident.
rib.zh: 他在事故中折断了一根肋骨。

faulty.en: The accident was caused by faulty brakes.
faulty.zh: 事故是由于刹车故障引起的。

defect.en: All these bottles have a defect and must be sent back to the warehouse.

reinforce.en: Peter reinforced his opinion with information from a book.

succeeding.en: He is succeeding in his plan. 他正在他的计划中取得成功。

specify.en: Please specify what you mean by 'imminent'.
specify.zh: 请详述你所说的'即将发生'是什么意思。

forth.en: He went forth into the town to buy some groceries.
forth.zh: 他走出去进城买一些食品杂货。

script.en: He read the script of the play three times.

submerge.en: The boat started to submerge into the water.
submerge.zh: 这艘船开始下沉到水中。

compose.en: Tony composed his report using many sources of information.

tone.en: I don't like the tone of your voice.
tone.zh: 我不喜欢你说话的语气。

retain.en: Please retain your ticket for the duration of your journey.
retain.zh: 请在整个旅程中保留你的车票

swell.en: Her ankle started to swell after she tripped and fell.
swell.zh: 她跌倒后，脚踝开始肿大。

crude.en: These are just crude estimates, we will do another round of calculation to ensure accuracy.
crude.zh: 这些只是粗略的估计，我们会做进一步的计算以确保准确性。

manufacturer.en: The car manufacturer has announced a large recall due to a defect in the steering.
manufacturer.zh: 汽车制造商宣布召回大量汽车，因为发现了转向系统的缺陷。

vacuum.en: The experiment must be conducted in a vacuum to avoid any interference.
vacuum.zh: 这个实验必须在真空中进行以避免任何干扰。

bubble.en: Look at the bubbles in the soda.
bubble.zh: 看那瓶苏打水里的气泡。

era.en: During the medieval era, knights wore protective armor.

yield.en: He had to yield his turn because he was in checkmate.

tender.en: He gave her a tender kiss.

meantime.en: I'll make dinner, and in the meantime, you can set the table.
meantime.zh: 我做晚餐，其间你来布置餐桌。

species.en: There are 21 different species of butterfly in this forest.

preceding.en: The preceding events left everyone in shock.
preceding.zh: 之前的事件让每个人都感到震惊。

cite.en: "The professor always cites examples from the book in his lectures."
cite.zh: 教授总是在他的演讲中引用书籍的例子。

logic.en: The result can be proved by logic.
logic.zh: 可以通过逻辑推理证明此结果。

shed.en: Store your gardening tools in the shed.
shed.zh: 将你的园艺工具储存在小屋里。

spur.en: She kicked her horse with her spurs.

perception.en: Her perception of the world has been profoundly affected by her mother's death.
perception.zh: 她母亲的去世深深地影响了她对世界的感知。

rear.en: The man loaded the rear of his truck with boxes.

undertake.en: "I have decided to undertake a new project." 让我们理解“开始新的项目”这种含义。
undertake.zh: 我决定开始一个新项目。

bureau.en: He works in the planning bureau of the city.

moist.en: The soil in the garden is still moist from the morning's rain.
moist.zh: 园子里的土壤因为早晨的雨水还是湿的。

cable.en: The TV is connected by a cable to the antenna.
cable.zh: 电视通过电线与天线相连。

qualify.en: He qualified to go to the final match by beating the opponent.

intense.en: She has an intense fear of flying.
intense.zh: 她对飞行有极度的恐惧。

estate.en: He lived on his father’s estate in the country.

applicable.en: This law is applicable to all citizens.
applicable.zh: 这个法律适用于所有公民。

brass.en: The doorknob is made of brass.
brass.zh: 门把手是由黄铜制成的。

rumour.en: There is a rumour going around that the president is going to resign.
rumour.zh: 有一种传言，总统将要辞职。

gear.en: "The gears in the watch keep it running accurately."
gear.zh: 手表里的齿轮保证了它运行的准确性。

elderly.en: The government is planning to improve health care services for the elderly.
elderly.zh: 政府计划提高老年人的医疗服务。

financial.en: I need to make a _financial_ decision about renewing my lease.
financial.zh: 我需要就续租的事宜作出财务决定。

rod.en: He cut the rod into pieces.
rod.zh: 他把棒状物切成了好几段。

dumb.en: He made a dumb decision, leading to a big loss. 他做出了愚蠢的决定，导致了大失所得。

respective.en: They went to their respective homes after the meeting.
respective.zh: 会议结束后，他们各自回到了自己的家。

harden.en: "The mud had hardened in the sun."

eve.en: _We spent Christmas eve at my grandparents' house._
eve.zh: 我们在我祖父母的家里度过了圣诞节前夜

pronoun.en: "He" and "she" are examples of personal pronouns.

dictate.en: I will not let anyone dictate my life for me.
dictate.zh: 我不会让任何人为我规定我的生活。

dump.en: Don't dump litter here, it's against the law.
dump.zh: 不要在这里丢垃圾，这是违法的。

render.en: The artist rendered the landscape with great skill.
render.zh: 这个艺术家极具技巧地描绘了这片风景。

radical.en: The president is planning to make some radical changes to the law.

engage.en: We need to engage a new teacher for our school.
engage.zh: 我们需要为我们的学校聘约一位新老师。

strategy.en: The team came up with a strategy to win the game.

collapse.en: The building might collapse at any moment.
collapse.zh: 这栋楼随时都有可能倒塌。

territory.en: This area is my dog's territory.
territory.zh: 这个区域是我狗的领地。

concession.en: China gave Hong Kong to Britain as a concession after the war.

accurate.en: The watch is accurate to the second.

echo.en: I heard an echo in the cave.
echo.zh: 我在洞穴里听到了回声。

erect.en: We need to erect a monument in memory of the heroes.
erect.zh: 我们需要为英雄们立一座纪念碑。

professional.en: If you want to be a pilot, you must have professional training.

elective.en: I decided to take music as my elective.
elective.zh: 我决定选择音乐作为我可选的课程。

accusation.en: He denied all the accusations against him.
accusation.zh: 他否认了所有对他的指控。

protein.en: "Our bodies need adequate protein to maintain health."
protein.zh: 我们的身体需要充足的蛋白质以维持健康。

exclusive.en: The golf course was so exclusive that most people hadn’t even heard of it.

poverty.en: Childhood poverty can affect lifelong mental health.
poverty.zh: 儿时的贫困可以影响终生的心理健康。

resort.en: I hope they don’t resort to violence to end the argument.

margin.en: The text should be written with a one-inch margin.
margin.zh: 文本应该以一英寸的边距写就。

refine.en: The principal refined his method of controlling students over the years.

mount.en: Mount Himalaya is the highest peak in the world.
mount.zh: 喜马拉雅山是世界上最高的山峰。

mystery.en: Her sudden disappearance is a complete mystery.
mystery.zh: 她的突然失踪完全是个谜。

atomic.en: Atomic energy has been widely used in the modern world.
atomic.zh: 原子能在现代世界中被广泛使用。

rotten.en: Don't eat that apple; it's rotten.
rotten.zh: 别吃那个苹果，它烂掉了。

devil.en: I met the devil in my dreams last night.
devil.zh: 我昨晚在梦中遇到了魔鬼。

fertile.en: The farmer grew many vegetables in the fertile soil.

automobile.en: "I need to get my automobile serviced this weekend."
automobile.zh: 这个周末我需要将我的汽车做保养。

notion.en: I had a notion that this route would get us to the beach.

diversity.en: Our company values diversity in the workplace.
diversity.zh: 我们公司重视工作场所的多样性

grace.en: As a dancer, she moved with grace and precision.
grace.zh: 作为一名舞者，她的动作充满优雅和精确。

attribute.en: His wicked sense of humour is one of his best attributes.
attribute.zh: 他那恶俏的幽默感是他最好的一种属性

mechanism.en: The clock has a wooden mechanism.
mechanism.zh: 这个钟表的机制是木制的。

triumph.en: His victory in the competition was a personal triumph.
triumph.zh: 他在比赛中的胜利是个人的一次瑞雄。

horror.en: The horror film gave me a good scare.
horror.zh: 那部恐怖片给我留下了深刻的印象。

thoughtful.en: He's always so thoughtful, always remembering our anniversary.
thoughtful.zh: 他总是这么贴心，记得我们的周年纪念日。

empower.en: The new law is intended to empower women in society.
empower.zh: 这项新法律旨在赋予女性在社会中的权力。

riot.en: A riot broke out after the candidate lost the election.

arouse.en: The politician’s words were meant to arouse the protestors’ anger.

metric.en: Our key success metric was revenue.
metric.zh: 我们的关键成功指标是收入。

grab.en: She made a grab for the fruit.

rub.en: Mom’s feet were sore, so she rubbed them.

presently.en: Presently, our profits are good, but by next year we can do even better.

rug.en: Please take off your shoes before stepping on the rug.
rug.zh: 请在踏上地毯前脱掉你的鞋子。

occasional.en: I only make occasional visits to the city.

boast.en: We all became tired of listening to him boast about himself all day.

spacecraft.en: The unmanned spacecraft will land on the moon tomorrow.
spacecraft.zh: 无人驾驶的太空船将于明天登陆月球。

stripe.en: The flag of the United States has red and white stripes.

statistic.en: The statistic shows that a large portion of young people prefer online shopping.
statistic.zh: 统计数据显示大部分年轻人更青睐网上购物。

mold.en: Using a cupcake mold will ensure that they come out just right.

significant.en: Your support plays a significant role in our project's success.
significant.zh: 你的支持对我们项目的成功起着重大的作用。

bold.en: He is a bold man who is unafraid of change.
bold.zh: 他是一个不怕改变的勇敢人。

ignorance.en: Ignorance of the law is no excuse for breaking it.
ignorance.zh: 对法律的无知不能成为触犯它的借口。

senate.en: Everybody liked Caroline and chose her to speak for them in the senate.

trumpet.en: He plays the trumpet in the school band.
trumpet.zh: 他在学校乐队里吹小号。

bolt.en: As a verb: "As soon as the teacher walked in, he bolted out of the room."
bolt.zh: 一看到老师走进来，他就冲出了房间。

occupy.en: Kevin and Alice occupied the chairs and had a long discussion.

simplicity.en: We were able to find the house thanks to the simplicity of the directions.

summit.en: Snow covered the summit of the mountain even during the summer.

negative.en: The doctor told him that his test was negative.
negative.zh: 医生告诉他，他的检测结果是阴性的。

impose.en: The government decided to impose a tax on luxury goods.
impose.zh: 政府决定对奢侈品征税。

ally.en: We consider them as our strongest ally in the region.
ally.zh: 我们认为他们是我们在该地区最坚强的盟友。

hence.en: We were hungry, hence we decided to eat.
hence.zh: 我们饿了，所以我们决定吃东西。

factor.en: "Her ability is a vital factor in her success."
factor.zh: 她的能力是她成功的关键因素。

pinch.en: I pinched my nose so I couldn’t smell the odor from the garbage.

rack.en: He stored his tools on a rack.

election.en: The presidential election will be held in November.

conquer.en: The soldiers were trying to conquer the world.

substance.en: The ring is made of a strange substance.
substance.zh: 这个戒指是用一种奇特的物质制造的。

frown.en: Don't frown at me like that, it's not my fault.
frown.zh: 不要那样皱眉头看我，这不是我的错。

grind.en: We grind wheat to make flour.

furthermore.en: "I don't like the color of the dress. Furthermore, it's too expensive."
furthermore.zh: 我不喜欢这件衣服的颜色。而且，它太贵了。

discard.zh: 我们应该抛弃过时的观念。

rebel.en: The rebel was angry about the government’s unfair policies.

usage.en: The computer is available for public usage.

experimental.en: The experimental data supports our hypothesis.
experimental.zh: 实验数据支持我们的假设。

cart.en: The little boy was sitting in the shopping cart.

hatred.en: I have a hatred for the taste of medicine.

crush.en: Selena’s new car was crushed when the tree fell on top of it.

electron.en: Scientists use a device called an electron microscope to view tiny things.
electron.zh: 科学家们使用名为电子显微镜的设备来观察微小的事物。

incline.en: I incline to agree with you.

item.en: There were some items of clothing found at the crime scene.

gene.en: Gene therapy is sometimes used to treat an illness.

liver.zh: 我的肝脏被酒精损害了。

suicide.en: Some people feel so sad that they think suicide is the only answer.

violet.en: That dress in violet fits you perfectly.
violet.zh: 那件紫罗兰色的裙子非常适合你。

hollow.en: The cave was dark and hollow.

saving.en: "We've made significant savings by buying in bulk."
saving.zh: 我们通过批量购买节省了大量资金。

hospitalize.en: After the accident, the man was hospitalized for three months.
hospitalize.zh: 那场事故后，那个男人住院了三个月。

utilize.en: The team can utilize the lab equipment to complete the experiment.

sticky.en: Place the sticky part of the tape against the paper, so it will cling to the wall.

prevail.en: Unfortunately, injustice still prevails in the country’s court system.

excessive.en: Her excessive enthusiasm for work led to burnout.
excessive.zh: 她对工作的过度热情导致了疲劳过度。

portion.en: I only ate a small portion of the pizza.

harsh.en: The desert is a harsh environment for humans to live in.
harsh.zh: 沙漠对人类来说是个严酷的环境。

connexion.en: "This event has a close connexion with the one we discussed yesterday."
connexion.zh: 这个事件和我们昨天讨论的那个事件有紧密的联系。

scrape.en: Be careful not to scrape your knee on the pavement.
scrape.zh: 注意别让你的膝盖擦在路面上。

glorious.en: The soldiers were received with glorious acclaim upon their return.
glorious.zh: 士兵们返回时受到了盛大的欢迎。

display.en: They display no awareness of the problems. 他们没有展现出对问题的意识。

bore.en: As a verb - boring a hole: He is boring a hole in the wall.

crust.en: The crust of this bread is really hard.

disorder.en: The room was in a state of disorder after the party.
disorder.zh: 派对结束后，房间一片混乱。

criticize.en: He criticized his wife for spending too much money.

rage.en: Joan flew into a rage when she discovered the broken vase.
rage.zh: 琼发现花瓶破碎时勃然大怒。

width.en: The width of the table is two meters.
width.zh: 这张桌子的宽度是两米。

dairy.en: Things like milk and cheese are dairy foods.

economic.en: Economic growth is a key factor in reducing poverty.
economic.zh: 经济增长是减少贫困的关键因素。

stuff.en: We gave a lot of stuff to the charity.

widow.en: She became a widow at the age of 35.
widow.zh: 她在35岁的时候成了一个寡妇。

whip.en: He cracked his whip and the horse started to move.
whip.zh: 他抽了一鞭，马开始跑起来。

protocol.en: The introduction of the guests followed the normal protocol.

provoke.en: Don't provoke the dog. It might bite.
provoke.zh: 不要去惹那只狗，它可能会咬人。

strain.en: Be careful not to strain your eyes by reading in poor light.
strain.zh: 不要在光线不足的地方看书，以免眼睛过度疲劳。

remonstrate.en: "The citizens remonstrated against the new law."

visible.en: The moon is visible in the sky tonight.
visible.zh: 今夜的月亮在天空中可见。

crisis.en: The world is facing an energy crisis.
crisis.zh: 世界正在面临能源危机。

germ.en: Germs are on everything that you touch.

inner.en: He keeps his thoughts in his inner world.
inner.zh: 他把自己的想法保持在内心世界里。

keen.en: He has always been keen on basketball.
keen.zh: 他一直对篮球非常热衷。

glimpse.en: I caught a glimpse of him from the car window.

transfer.en: Can you transfer the call to Mr. Smith, please?
transfer.zh: 你能把电话转接给史密斯先生吗？

footstep.en: "I heard the echo of his footsteps as he walked away."
footstep.zh: 我听到他走远的脚步声的回音。

veteran.en: After twenty years in the police force, he was a veteran officer.
veteran.zh: 在警队服务了二十年后，他已经是一名老练的警官。

indifferent.en: Lisa is indifferent toward school. She doesn’t care what her final grades are.

nerve.en: The pain is caused by a pinched nerve in my back.
nerve.zh: 我的背部有个神经被压迫所致的疼痛。

cruise.en: I plan to cruise the Mediterranean this summer.
cruise.zh: 我计划今年夏天在地中海上游览。

elementary.en: Children go to elementary school before high school.

solemn.en: The professor preferred a solemn relationship between him and his students.

perceive.en: I could perceive a ship far away.

omit.en: The news report seems to omit some important details.
omit.zh: 这篇新闻报道似乎遗漏了一些重要的细节。

option.en: The children were given the option of three houses to pick from.

erroneous.en: The child held the erroneous belief that time machines were real.

raid.en: The police made a raid on the drug dealer's house.
raid.zh: 警察对毒贩的房子进行了突袭。

unexpected.en: I received an unexpected gift on my birthday.
unexpected.zh: 我在生日那天收到了一个意外的礼物。

crucial.en: "Getting enough sleep is crucial for good health."
crucial.zh: 获取足够的睡眠对保持良好的健康至关重要。

highlight.en: I read my vocabulary list and highlighted the most difficult words.

cashier.en: The cashier is tallying the day's receipts.
cashier.zh: 收银员正在清点当日的收款。

sheer.en: "The sheer size of the country is staggering."
sheer.zh: 这个国家的面积之大令人震惊。

miracle.en: It's a miracle that nobody was seriously injured in the crash.
miracle.zh: 在那场事故中竟然没有人受重伤，真是个奇迹。

original.en: This is the original design of the building.
original.zh: 这是这栋建筑的原始设计。

wit.en: He is known for his sharp wit.
wit.zh: 他以其敏锐的智慧而闻名。

assignment.en: He was given a difficult assignment but he felt he could succeed in doing it.

depression.en: Living alone can lead to feelings of depression.
depression.zh: 独自一人生活可能会引发抑郁感。

extent.en: He ate to such an extent that he became overweight.

equivalent.en: These two fabrics are rough equivalents.
equivalent.zh: 这两种布料大致是相同的。

gaol.en: The hardened criminal was sent to the gaol.
gaol.zh: 那个惯犯被送进了监狱。

fascinate.en: The mystery novels always fascinate him.
fascinate.zh: 他总是被那些神秘小说深深吸引。

diplomatic.en: As a boss, he often adopts a diplomatic approach to dealing with his staff.
diplomatic.zh: 作为老板，他常常以外交手腕处理员工关系。

giant.en: The giant truck got in my way.

fluid.en: His movements were smooth and fluid.

outlet.en: Make sure you unplug the device from the outlet when it's not in use.
outlet.zh: 在不使用设备时，请确保将其从电源插座上拔下。

neglect.en: William neglected his room, so it is a complete mess.

textile.en: The blue textile was going to be used to make blouses.

extend.en: Can we extend the meeting for another 30 minutes?
extend.zh: 我们能将会议延长30分钟吗？

ax.en: She used an ax to cut some wood for the fire.

intermediate.en: He has an intermediate knowledge of Spanish.
intermediate.zh: 他的西班牙语水平为中等。

applause.en: The performer received wild applause from the crowd.
applause.zh: 表演者收到了观众的热烈掌声。

frank.en: Tom is always frank with his friends.
frank.zh: 汤姆总是对朋友十分坦诚。

scheme.en: They hatched a scheme to rob the bank.

drain.en: The drain is blocked with leaves.

isolate.en: The teacher isolated the bad child from the class before talking with her.

inward.en: He took an inward breath and proceeded.
inward.zh: 他吸了一口气，然后继续进行。

subsequent.zh: 随后发生的事情是不可预测的。

scarcely.en: We had scarcely arrived when the bell rang.

panel.en: The antique oak panel was beautiful.
panel.zh: 那块古董橡木面板非常漂亮。

column.en: "The ancient Greeks were famous for their marble columns."
column.zh: 古希腊人因他们的大理石柱子而闻名。

sample.en: 名词：Can I have a sample of your product?
sample.zh: 我可以试一下你们的产品样品吗？

integrate.en: We need to integrate the existing systems into a single unified one.
integrate.zh: 我们需要将现有的系统整合成一个统一的系统。

survivor.en: He is the sole survivor of the plane crash.
survivor.zh: 他是这次飞机失事的唯一幸存者。

tropical.en: The tropical rainforest is home to many unique species.
tropical.zh: 热带雨林是许多独特物种的家园。

plunge.en: He suddenly jumped up and plunged into the pool.
plunge.zh: 他突然跳起来，跳进了游泳池。

diagnose.en: The doctor needs to diagnose the patient's condition before prescribing any medication.
diagnose.zh: 医生在开药前需要先诊断病人的状况。

earnest.en: He is earnest about wanting to help others.

spider.en: "Look, there's a spider on the wall!"

essential.zh: 水对生命来说是必不可少的。

furnace.en: The furnace in our house is very old and needs to be replaced.
furnace.zh: 我们家的供暖炉非常老旧，需要更换。

ditch.en: When the car slid off of the road, it fell into the ditch.

deck.en: He was standing on the deck of his boat. 他站在他的船甲板上。

furnish.en: Can you furnish us with the necessary information?
furnish.zh: 你能为我们提供必需的信息吗？

bet.en: I bet you won't believe what happened today.
bet.zh: 我敢肯定你不会相信今天发生的事情。

contact.en: Please maintain regular contact with your supervisor.
contact.zh: 请定期和你的主管保持联系。

discharge.en: The doctor gave him a discharge.

exclude.en: "Children under 16 are excluded from the cinema after 9 pm."
exclude.zh: 9点后16岁以下的儿童不能进入电影院。

criticism.en: She had a lot of criticism about their new plan.

image.en: Can you see the image on the screen?
image.zh: 你能看到屏幕上的图像吗？

complain.en: He often complains about the noise in the street.
complain.zh: 他经常抱怨街头的噪音。

homogeneous.en: All of the houses on Victor’s block were boring and homogenous.

popularize.en: The government has been trying to popularize the use of solar energy.
popularize.zh: 政府一直尝试推广使用太阳能。

necessity.en: Water is a basic necessity of life.
necessity.zh: 水是生活的基本必需品。

frame.en: He is building a wooden frame for the mirror.
frame.zh: 他正在为镜子制作一个木制的框架。

clash.en: Their opinions clashed on just about everything.
clash.zh: 他们在几乎所有的事情上都有不同的观点。

compel.en: Traffic signs compel drivers to drive safely.

capable.en: He is capable of running a mile in four minutes.
capable.zh: 他有能力在四分钟内跑完一英里。

depress.zh: 持续的下雨会让任何人感到沮丧。

parade.en: The town held a parade to celebrate the national holiday.
parade.zh: 镇上举行了游行以庆祝国家假日。

precaution.en: Wear your seat belt as a precaution against car accidents.

personality.en: He has a very outgoing/personable personality.
personality.zh: 他有一种非常外向/亲和的性格。

sanction.en: The government has sanctioned the use of the premises as a school.
sanction.zh: 政府已批准该地点用作学校。

alert.en: The soldiers were on high alert.
alert.zh: 士兵们处于高度戒备状态

await.en: The players awaited the referee’s decision.

sin.en: In many religions, it is considered a sin to steal.
sin.zh: 在许多宗教中，偷窃被视为一种罪恶。

client.en: She has many clients who enjoy coming to her salon.

prosperity.en: "Our business continues to go from strength to strength, bringing prosperity to all stakeholders."
prosperity.zh: 我们的业务持续强劲增长，为所有股东带来繁荣。

lump.en: He has a lump on his head.

historic.en: This is an historic moment for our country.
historic.zh: 这对我们国家而言是个历史性的时刻。

oven.en: I baked the bread in the oven.
oven.zh: 我在烤箱里烘烤了面包。

rhythm.en: She dances to the rhythm of the music.
rhythm.zh: 她随着音乐的节奏跳舞。

stroke.en: She had a stroke and was taken to the hospital.
stroke.zh: 她中风了，被送去了医院。

breed.en: I like small dog breeds, such as terriers.

management.en: The management of the company is in the hands of the directors.
management.zh: 公司的管理权在董事们手中。

realm.en: The new technology opens up a whole new realm of possibilities.
realm.zh: 这项新技术开启了一整个全新的可能性领域。

correspondent.en: "The problem was first discovered by our correspondent in the technical department."
correspondent.zh: 我们技术部的代表首次发现了这个问题。

renew.en: Please renew your library books before they are due.
renew.zh: 请在到期之前续借你的图书馆书籍。

prompt.en: "The alarm prompted him to leave the house quickly."
prompt.zh: 警报促使他快速离开房子。

comprehensive.en: The teacher gave us a comprehensive review for the exam.

tunnel.en: The tunnel will lead you to the next city.

assign.en: I was assigned the job of making sure everyone had plenty to drink.

elaborate.en: She gave a very elaborate description of the party.
elaborate.zh: 她给出了关于聚会的非常详细的描述。

corridor.en: She walked quickly down the corridor.

fulfill.en: We will do our best to fulfill your expectations.
fulfill.zh: 我们会尽力满足你的期待。

advanced.en: She's taking an advanced English course.
advanced.zh: 她正在参加高级英语课程

mechanical.en: She has a mechanical job on the assembly line.
mechanical.zh: 她在流水线上做一份机械工作。

flourish.en: Verb Example：The plants flourish in the greenhouse.

fatigue.en: I was overcome by fatigue after the long journey.
fatigue.zh: 经过长途旅行后，我感到非常疲劳。

striking.en: The girl has striking green eyes.
striking.zh: 那个女孩有一双引人注目的绿色眼睛。

vessel.en: The chemical reaction takes place in a sealed vessel.
vessel.zh: 这个化学反应在封闭的容器中进行。

crown.en: The queen wore the crown on her head.

inquire.en: I would like to inquire about your course offerings.
inquire.zh: 我想咨询一下你们的课程详情。

gymnasium.en: When I go to the gymnasium, I use the treadmill for twenty minutes.

issue.en: The safety issue of the car needs to be addressed.
issue.zh: 这款汽车的安全问题需要解决。

lower.en: They decided to lower the price of the product.
lower.zh: 他们决定降低该产品的价格。

index.en: If you look in the index, you’ll find the right page number.

youngster.en: The youngster is engrossed in reading a comic book.
youngster.zh: 这个少年全神贯注地在看一本漫画书。

odd.en: He had an odd way of doing things.
odd.zh: 他做事的方式有点奇怪。

supplement.en: "He took vitamin supplements to stay healthy."
supplement.zh: 他吃维他命补充剂以保持健康。

contrast.en: There is a sharp contrast between her fiction and her non-fiction.
contrast.zh: 她的小说和非小说类作品之间存在着鲜明的对比。

proportion.en: The kitchen takes up a large proportion of the house.
proportion.zh: 厨房占了房子的大部分。

widen.en: We should widen the scope of our investigation.
widen.zh: 我们应该扩大我们调查的范围。

crystal.en: "They found the quartz to be a kind of crystal."
crystal.zh: 他们发现石英是一种晶体。

inflation.en: The government introduced policies to combat inflation.
inflation.zh: 政府引入了抗击通货膨胀的政策。

delegate.en: As a noun: "The United Nations held a meeting attended by delegates from all over the world."
delegate.zh: 联合国举行了一场会议，来自世界各地的代表都出席了。

sphere.zh: 地球并不是一个完美的球体。

inquiry.en: "The police are making an inquiry into the incident."
inquiry.zh: 警方正在对这个事件进行调查。

dissolve.en: I dissolved the pill in a glass of water.

immigrant.en: Many immigrants move to the United States in search of a better life.
immigrant.zh: 许多移民搬到美国寻找更好的生活。

bundle.en: He collected a bundle of firewood.

generally.en: The suburbs are generally viewed as a good place to raise children.

likewise.en: If Joe is not going to school so he can go swimming, I want to do likewise.

slender.en: She is a slender woman with delicate features.
slender.zh: 她是一个纤细的女人，有着精致的面孔。

transaction.en: Because the clerk was new at the job, the simple transaction took a long time.

conscious.en: The new student was conscious of the other students staring at her.

pants.en: "He wore blue pants and a white shirt."
pants.zh: 他穿蓝色裤子和白色衬衫。

mislead.en: The coach's advice might mislead the player.
mislead.zh: 教练的建议可能会误导球员。

orchestra.en: She auditioned and got a place in the school orchestra.
orchestra.zh: 她试音成功并得到了在学校乐队的位置。

publication.en: The writer's first publication received widespread acclaim.
publication.zh: 那位作家的首部作品广受赞誉。

sufficient.en: I have sufficient funds to purchase the car.
sufficient.zh: 我有足够的资金来购买这辆车。

claim.en: He claimed to know why the country’s laws were weak.

petroleum.en: The petroleum at that factory is used to make gasoline.

tolerance.en: It's important to teach our children about the value of tolerance.
tolerance.zh: 我们教育孩子接纳他人的价值是很重要的。

kneel.en: Daryl kneeled down on one knee and asked Nina to marry him.

contest.en: The girls had a contest to see who could jump higher.

greenhouse.en: We have a small greenhouse in our backyard where we grow plants.

establish.en: He wanted to establish a club for people to help the Earth.

expansion.en: The company is planning an expansion of its overseas market.
expansion.zh: 公司正在计划扩大其海外市场。

synthetic.en: Clothing made out of synthetic fabrics is very effective at keeping people warm.

headquarters.en: He took the long route to the headquarters because it was a nice day.

gaze.en: "He gazed out the window at the snow-covered scenery."
gaze.zh: 他透过窗户凝视着被雪覆盖的景色。

survey.en: "I am conducting a survey on consumer behavior."
survey.zh: 我正在对消费者行为进行调研。

thermometer.en: The thermometer indicates that it is thirty-eight degrees.
thermometer.zh: 温度计显示温度为三十八摄氏度

decent.en: Eric did a decent job painting the fence.

investigate.en: The police are investigating the matter.

considerable.en: They paid a considerable amount of money for that car.

auxiliary.en: "The hospital has an auxiliary power system in case of a blackout."
auxiliary.zh: 医院备有一个辅助电源系统以防止电力中断。

heal.en: This ointment will help heal your wounds.

cripple.en: He became a cripple after the car accident.
cripple.zh: 他在车祸后成为了一个残疾人。

initiative.en: "Tom took the initiative to propose a solution to the problem."
initiative.zh: 汤姆主动提出了解决问题的办法。

medication.en: The doctor gave me medication to treat my illness.

intelligent.en: My sister is very intelligent, she always gets good grades.
intelligent.zh: 我的姐姐非常聪明，她总是取得好成绩。

lobby.en: We met in the hotel lobby.

luxury.en: Their house is a modern build filled with luxury goods.
luxury.zh: 他们的房子是现代建筑，充满了奢侈品

mould.en: He poured the jelly into a mould.

elbow.en: The doctor asked me to bend my elbow.
elbow.zh: 医生让我弯曲我的手肘。

strategic.en: 我们需要一个战略性的计划来保证我们的销售目标。
strategic.zh: We need a strategic plan to ensure we meet our sales targets.

vary.en: The heights of the people in my class vary by a large amount.

stoop.en: He had to stoop down to fit through the door.
stoop.zh: 他必须弯下腰才能通过门口。

county.en: He wanted to represent the citizens of his county.

respondent.en: The respondent failed to appear in court.

episode.en: We saw the final episode of the series last night.
episode.zh: 我们昨晚看了这个系列的最后一集。

discipline.en: One of the teacher’s jobs is to teach her students discipline.

evidently.en: He was evidently very upset about the whole situation.
evidently.zh: 他显然对整个情况非常沮丧。

objective.en: My objective this week is to finish my homework by 7:30 every night.

exert.en: You exert a lot of energy when you lift weights.

estimate.en: As a verb: "I estimate that the journey will take two hours."
estimate.zh: 我估计这次旅行会需要两小时。

drip.en: Drops of water drip from the leaves after the rain.
drip.zh: 雨后，水滴从叶子上滴落。

exhibit.en: My painting will be exhibited at the fair.

proposal.en: John's proposal for reforming the school system was very well-received.
proposal.zh: 约翰关于改革学校制度的提案得到了广泛的好评。

inevitable.en: Change is an inevitable part of life.
inevitable.zh: 生活中的变化是不可避免的。

miserable.en: He was miserable after his dog died.

subtract.en: We learned how to subtract numbers in class.

secondary.en: Secondary sources are less reliable than primary sources.
secondary.zh: 次级来源比主要来源不可靠。

mission.en: "My mission is to help you understand English better."
mission.zh: 我的任务是帮助你更好的理解英语

attorney.en: My father recommended his attorney to me.
attorney.zh: 我爸爸把他的律师推荐给我。

device.en: A thermometer is a device that tells temperature.

mainframe.en: The banking industry still largely relies on mainframes for transaction processing.
mainframe.zh: 银行业仍主要依赖大型计算机进行交易处理。

cooperate.en: We should all cooperate to solve this problem.
cooperate.zh: 我们应该共同合作解决这个问题。

cabin.en: We rented a cozy cabin in the mountains for our vacation.
cabin.zh: 我们租了一间舒适的小木屋在山里度假。

current.en: The current situation in the company is tense.
current.zh: 公司当前的情况很紧张。

copper.en: Ancient hunters melted copper to make knives and spears.

persist.en: Even though the lesson was difficult, he persisted until he understood.

audio.en: He forgot to turn on the audio during the online meeting.
audio.zh: 他在线上会议中忘记打开音频了。

calendar.en: I need to check my calendar for tomorrow's schedule.
calendar.zh: 我需要查看我的日历来确认明天的安排。

offensive.en: His remarks were deeply offensive to her.
offensive.zh: 他的话深深地冒犯了她。

speculate.en: 推测：We can only speculate as to the reasons for his resignation.
speculate.zh: 我们只能推测他辞职的原因。

launch.en: The boat launched from the dock and foated down the river.

amid.en: The bee was busily flying amid the flowers in the garden.

beloved.en: The boy took a nap next to his beloved cat.

cement.en: We will use cement to build the wall.
cement.zh: 我们将用水泥来建造那堵墙。

subway.en: I take the subway to work every day.
subway.zh: 我每天都坐地铁去上班。

acquaint.en: It's important to acquaint yourself with the local laws and regulations.
acquaint.zh: 你需要熟悉当地的法律法规。

elastic.en: He attached the elastic bungee to his legs before he jumped of the platform.

intervene.en: The police had to intervene in the fight. - 警察不得不出面干预这场争斗。

undergraduate.en: "I am an undergraduate student studying business administration at New York University."
undergraduate.zh: 我是纽约大学商务管理专业的大学本科生。

joint.en: The joint between the pipe and the wall is leaking water.
joint.zh: 管子和墙之间的接头在漏水。

confine.en: I confined my remarks to the subject at hand.
confine.zh: 我局限我的讲话在手头的主题上。

frequency.en: The frequency of rainstorms is very high, especially during the spring.

horizontal.en: The paintings should be hung at a horizontal level.

satisfactory.en: "The performance of the team was satisfactory, but there is still room for improvement."
satisfactory.zh: 团队的表现令人满意，但还有提升空间。

military.en: He is considering a career in the military.
military.zh: 他正在考虑从军作为职业。

reluctant.en: He was reluctant to leave the party.

generate.en: The new policy will generate a lot of new jobs.
generate.zh: 新政策将产生很多新的工作岗位。

sector.en: We learned about just a few of the factories within the manufacturing sector.

coil.en: He wound the rope into a coil. 他把绳子卷成了一圈。

ensure.en: Saving now will ensure we have enough money for our retirement.

coordinate.en: I have been chosen to coordinate the project.

organism.en: We studied the organism under the microscope.

epidemic.en: The flu epidemic of 1918 killed millions of people worldwide.
epidemic.zh: 1918年的流感大流行造成了全世界数百万人的死亡。

upright.en: He sat upright in his chair.

naval.en: The naval base was sprawling with activity today.
naval.zh: 今天的海军基地活动频繁。

solve.zh: 让我们一起解决这个问题。

hint.en: Could you give me a hint about the answer?
hint.zh: 你能对答案给我一点提示吗？

knot.en: He tied the knot tightly to make sure it wouldn't come undone.
knot.zh: 他紧紧地打了个结，以确保它不会松开。

demonstrate.en: The teacher will demonstrate how to solve the problem to the students.
demonstrate.zh: 老师将为学生示范如何解决这个问题。

region.en: This is the wheat-growing region of the country.

deceive.en: "Do not deceive yourself into thinking that you can avoid the consequences of your actions."
deceive.zh: 不要欺骗自己认为你可以避免自己行为的后果。

donkey.en: He was so stubborn as a donkey.

learning.en: Immersive learning is an effective method to language acquisition.
learning.zh: 身临其境的学习是语言习得的有效方法。

misconception.en: "There is a common misconception that healthy food is always expensive."
misconception.zh: 常有一种误解，健康食品总是很贵。

gap.en: You need to mind the gap between the train and the platform.
gap.zh: 你需要注意火车与站台之间的间隙

emphasize.en: We must always emphasize that safety comes first.
emphasize.zh: 我们必须始终强调安全第一。

gradual.en: The gradual decline of the industry has caused unemployment to rise.
gradual.zh: "工业的逐渐衰退导致了失业率的上升。"

ore.en: The factory melted the ore and used it to make iron products.

previous.en: He turned back to the previous page to read the paragraph again.

transmit.en: "The radio station transmits the late news every night at 10 pm."
transmit.zh: 这个广播电台每晚10点播送晚间新闻。

consumption.en: These apples are too rotten for consumption.

weaken.en: Overeating can weaken the immune system.
weaken.zh: 过度饮食会削弱免疫系统。

damn.en: Damn, I forgot my keys at home.
damn.zh: 该死，我把钥匙忘在家里了。

location.en: The location of the hotel is very convenient for tourists.
location.zh: 这家酒店的地理位置对游客来说非常方便。

compensation.en: His diligent work warrants a higher compensation from the company.
compensation.zh: 他的勤奋工作应从公司得到更高的报酬。

bankrupt.en: After his company went bankrupt, he couldn't repay the loans.
bankrupt.zh: 在他的公司破产后，他无法偿还贷款。

comparative.en: The money that John has is comparative to that of most other adults.

fruitful.en: Our meeting was very fruitful, we decided on a lot of key issues.
fruitful.zh: 我们的会议非常成功，我们决定了很多关键问题。

dragon.en: "The dragon breathed fire at the knight."

hesitant.en: Although he knew the answer, he was hesitant to say it because he might be wrong.

hell.en: "The criminal was sentenced to hell for eternity."
hell.zh: 这个罪犯被判处永世地狱的刑罚。

feedback.en: We appreciate your feedback on our service.
feedback.zh: 我们很感谢您对我们服务的反馈。

hazard.en: Every time you drive under the influence of alcohol, you're posing a hazard to yourself and others.
hazard.zh: 每次你酒后驾驶，你都给自己和他人造成了风险。

justify.en: The government tried to justify its decision to bring the country into a war.

proof.en: "We need more proof to convict him of the crime"
proof.zh: 我们需要更多证据来证明他的犯罪。

timber.en: The house was built using timber from the nearby forest.
timber.zh: 房子是使用附近森林的木材建造的。

roar.en: The lion let out a loud roar.
roar.zh: 狮子发出了巨大的吼声。

presence.en: The researcher discovered the presence of bacteria in the water sample.

phase.en: The project is entering its final phase.
phase.zh: 项目正在进入最后阶段。

contract.en: 名词用法：We drafted a contract for the sale of the house.
contract.zh: 我们起草了一份关于房子销售的合同。

beggar.en: As a beggar, he lived on the charity of the public.
beggar.zh: 他作为一个乞丐，靠公众的慈善活动过活。

innovative.en: He is known for his innovative thinking.

insight.en: The physics textbook gave the student a new insight about gravity.

fabric.en: This skirt is made of fine silk fabric.
fabric.zh: 这条裙子是用上等丝绸面料制作的。

revolutionary.en: These new technologies are revolutionary to the industry.
revolutionary.zh: 这些新技术对行业影响深远。

sympathetic.en: She was sympathetic when her friend lost her job.
sympathetic.zh: 当她的朋友失去工作时，她表示同情。

freight.en: The ship was loaded with freight.

derive.en: The student derived her information from the internet.
derive.zh: 学生从互联网上获取了她的信息

capacity.en: The capacity of the fuel tank in my car is 50 liters.
capacity.zh: 我的汽车的油箱容量是50公升。

cope.en: She's learned to cope with the stress of her job.
cope.zh: 她学会了应对工作压力。

confess.en: The woman confessed that she had stolen the money.

ghost.en: I saw a ghost in the old house.
ghost.zh: 我在那座老房子中见到了一个鬼。

feature.en: This computer has several new features.
feature.zh: 这台电脑有几个新的特性。

lean.en: He had to lean the ladder against the wall to reach the top.
lean.zh: 他必须要把梯子靠在墙上才能够到顶部。

recall.en: "The lady recalled her happy childhood spent in the countryside."
recall.zh: 那位女士回忆起她在乡下度过的快乐童年。

leap.en: The deer took a huge leap over the fence.
leap.zh: 那只鹿跳过了篱笆，跳得非常高。

sensible.en: It was sensible for her to save some money each month.

dispute.en: The two politicians were in a dispute over tax reforms.
dispute.zh: 两位政治家在税收改革问题上发生了争执。

observation.en: The police are keeping the house under observation.
observation.zh: 警察正在监视那幢房子。

inhabitant.en: The number of inhabitants in the countryside is increasing.

fraction.en: Only a fraction of the cake was gone.

filter.en: Please replace the water filter every three months.
filter.zh: 请每三个月更换一次水过滤器。

site.en: We found the perfect site for our picnic.

emotion.en: Anger is a common emotion that we all feel.

massive.en: The earthquake caused massive damage to the city.
massive.zh: 这次地震对城市造成了巨大的损害。

cease.en: The rain will cease in the afternoon.

asset.en: Real estate is usually a stable asset.
asset.zh: 房地产通常是稳定的资产。

scarce.en: When gasoline was scarce, we rode our bike to school instead of driving.

reveal.zh: 这个事件揭示了他的真实性格。

utter.en: As a verb: "He didn't utter a word during the whole journey."
utter.zh: 他在整个旅途中一句话都没说。

vibrate.en: The machine made his whole body vibrate as he broke up the ground.

tremendous.en: The Earth’s oceans are filled with a tremendous amount of water.

condense.en: The cool air made tiny drops of water condense on the tops of the grass.

realistic.en: "He gave a realistic estimate of the project's cost."
realistic.zh: 他对项目的成本做出了现实的预估。

tag.en: This shirt still has the price tag on it.

indirect.en: Her indirect reference to his past mistakes made him uncomfortable.
indirect.zh: 她对他过去的错误的间接提及让他感到不安。

individual.en: Each individual is responsible for themselves.

resource.en: The Internet is a valuable resource for learning.
resource.zh: 互联网是学习的宝贵资源。

nuisance.en: The teenager considered her noisy little brothers to be quite a nuisance.

excitement.en: There was a sense of excitement in the air.

nightmare.en: I was awakened by a nightmare.

core.en: Earth has a solid inner core.

council.en: The council met to discuss the new laws for the city.

enforce.en: Police enforce traffic laws to keep everyone safe.

sociology.en: "James is majoring in sociology at the university."
sociology.zh: 詹姆斯在大学里主修社会学。

scale.en: This map has a scale of 2cm to 5km.
scale.zh: 这张地图的比例尺是2厘米等于5公里。

hedge.en: 这座花园用绿篱做了隔离。
hedge.zh: The garden is hedged in by shrubs.

drama.en: "The movie creates drama through strong performances and atmospheric cinematography."
drama.zh: 电影通过强烈的表演和富有氛围的摄影创造了戏剧张力。

limp.en: Because of his broken leg, he had to limp to the car.
limp.zh: 他因为腿受伤，只得跛行到车旁。

limb.en: He broke his limb in the accident.
limb.zh: 他在事故中折断了四肢。

motion.en: "He made a motion to adjourn the meeting." 他提议结束会议。
motion.zh: 在议会或正式场合，motion 指的是“提议”

idle.en: The factory had been lying idle for years.
idle.zh: 这个工厂已经闲置了好多年了。

fearful.en: I was fearful of the dark when I was a kid.

fertilizer.en: Farmers add fertilizer to the soil to promote plant growth.
fertilizer.zh: 农民往土里加化肥促进植物生长。

fragment.en: He picked up a fragment of broken glass.
fragment.zh: 他捡起一块破碎的玻璃片

response.en: He asked if I was sad. My response was “No.”

treaty.en: The treaty was signed by the two countries to end the war.
treaty.zh: 这个条约是由两国签署的，以结束战争。

emit.en: The sun emits light and heat.

rival.en: The three rivals were all competing for the same job.

snap.en: The tree branch could snap if you climb on it.
snap.zh: 如果你爬上这个树枝，它可能会断。

spontaneous.en: The audience burst into spontaneous applause.
spontaneous.zh: 观众爆发出自发的掌声。

gloomy.en: The room was dark and gloomy.

reproach.en: "He reproached me for not thinking of the consequences."
reproach.zh: 他因我没想到后果而责备我

warrant.en: The police have a warrant for his arrest.

triple.en: The ice cream shop offers a triple scoop cone.
triple.zh: 冰淇淋店提供三勺冰淇淋蛋卷。

rejoice.en: "Let us rejoice at the good news."

statute.en: The new statute made it illegal to walk dogs in the park.

evaporate.en: Water evaporates quickly under the hot sun.
evaporate.zh: 在炎热的太阳下，水会很快蒸发。

staircase.en: The child is too young to climb the staircase without assistance.
staircase.zh: 这个孩子太小，没有帮助不能爬楼梯。

posture.en: It's important to have good posture when sitting at a desk all day.
posture.zh: 坐在办公桌前一整天时，拥有良好的坐姿非常重要。

spiral.en: A strand of DNA looks like two interlocking spirals.

vocation.en: Teaching is not merely a job, but also a vocation.
vocation.zh: 教学不仅仅是一份工作，更是一种天职。

huddle.en: The teammates huddled to discuss the next play.
huddle.zh: 队友们聚集在一起讨论下一步的比赛策略。

skeleton.en: "The human skeleton is made up of 206 bones."
skeleton.zh: 人的骨骼由206块骨头组成。

intersection.en: There is a large department store at the intersection.
intersection.zh: 在交叉路口有一家大型百货公司

disperse.en: "After the protest, the police had to disperse the crowd."
disperse.zh: 警方在抗议活动之后需要驱散人群。

gorgeous.en: The girl picked out a gorgeous dress to wear to the dance.

erosion.en: Soil erosion is a serious problem in the mountain areas.
erosion.zh: 土壤侵蚀在山区是一个严重的问题。

ascend.en: The hikers took three hours to ascend the mountain.
ascend.zh: 登山者花了三个小时爬上了山。

embody.en: His paintings embody the spirit of the American West.
embody.zh: 他的画作体现了美国西部的精神。

pasture.en: The cows are grazing in the pasture.

versatile.en: Emily is a versatile athlete, proficient in numerous sports.
versatile.zh: Emily是一名全能的运动员，擅长许多运动。

versus.en: Manchester United versus Chelsea will be an exciting match.
versus.zh: 曼联对切尔西的比赛将会非常精彩。

splash.en: Don't splash water on the floor.

romance.en: They read a lot of romances.
romance.zh: 他们阅读了很多爱情小说。

porcelain.zh: 她收藏了许多古董瓷器杯子。

cordial.en: Their relationship was cordial but not close.
cordial.zh: 他们关系和善，但并不亲密。

timid.en: The timid child hides behind her mother whenever she sees a stranger.

successor.en: He was chosen as the successor to the throne.
successor.zh: 他被选为皇位的继承者。

irony.en: The irony of the situation is that the more we try to save money, the less we seem to have.
irony.zh: 讽刺的是，我们越是努力节省钱，却越是感觉没有钱。

scrap.en: Chris liked to use many scraps of paper when thinking up ideas.

syndrome.en: Doctors have identified a new syndrome related to excessive computer use.
syndrome.zh: 医生们已经确定了过度使用电脑相关的新型症状。

tow.en: The broken car was towed to the garage.

haul.en: As a verb: "They hauled the boat out of the water."

avail.en: "No amount of struggle would avail." - 无论怎么挣扎都没有用。

reclaim.en: We need to reclaim these lost territories.
reclaim.zh: 我们需要收回这些失去的领土。

disable.en: "Please disable the alarm before you open the door."
disable.zh: 在你开门之前，请关闭闹钟。

witch.en: People think that witches fly around on broomsticks.

bruise.en: As a noun： I have a bruise on my arm from playing football.
bruise.zh: 我胳膊上足球踢打时淤了个血。

plead.en: He pleaded for his parents to let him go to the soccer game.

automation.en: The automation of this production line has increased efficiency.
automation.zh: 这条生产线的自动化提高了效率。

ambitious.en: "He is ambitious for success in his career."
ambitious.zh: 他对自己的职业成功怀揣雄心勃勃。

longitude.en: We need to figure out the precise longitude and latitude to know our position.
longitude.zh: 我们需要确定精确的经度和纬度才能了解我们的位置。

paperback.en: I bought the paperback edition of the book because it was cheaper than the hardcover.
paperback.zh: 我买了这本书的平装版，因为它比精装版便宜。

shorthand.en: She is fluent in shorthand and typing.
shorthand.zh: 她在速记和打字方面很熟练。

levy.en: The government plans to levy a tax on luxury goods.
levy.zh: 政府计划对奢侈品征税。

intimidate.en: He tried to intimidate his opponents with aggressive behavior.
intimidate.zh: 他试图通过侵略性行为来恐吓对手。

probe.en: The scientist is using a probe to sample the ocean's depth.
probe.zh: 科学家正在用探针测量海洋深度。

tub.en: She filled the tub with water.

cluster.en: She held a large cluster of grapes in her hand.

prey.en: The lion stalked its prey through the tall grass.
prey.zh: 狮子在高草丛中悄悄接近它的猎物。

expedition.en: They got into their spaceship to begin their expedition.

integrity.en: The principal had a lot of integrity.

refrain.en: Please refrain from smoking in the public areas.
refrain.zh: 请避免在公共区域抽烟。

pact.en: We entered into a pact of non-aggression with our neighboring countries.
pact.zh: 我们与邻国签订了一份互不侵犯的协定。

merge.en: Two companies will merge into one.
merge.zh: 两个公司将合并为一个。

dock.en: The ship was safely docked in the port.

courtesy.en: "Common courtesy dictates that we should at least reply to the email."
courtesy.zh: 常规礼貌规定我们至少应该回复电子邮件。

dread.en: I dread the possibility that I will not get into college.

graphic.en: "The report provided a graphic illustration of the problem."
graphic.zh: 该报告形象地说明了问题。

consolidate.en: When we moved in together, we had to consolidate our belongings.

shove.en: She shoved him out of the way.

lyric.en: I enjoy reading and creating my own lyric poetry.

dazzle.en: The rising sun did dazzle my eyes.
dazzle.zh: 日出的阳光让我的眼睛感到刺目

thigh.en: He suffered from a serious thigh injury.

participant.en: There were thousands of participants in this year’s marathon.

compile.en: The author compiled a book of short stories.
compile.zh: 作者编辑了一本短篇小说集。

bias.en: The mothers had a natural bias for their own child’s picture.

fume.en: The engine put unpleasant, black fumes into the air.

radiate.en: The sun radiates heat and light.

prosecute.en: 1.  "The district attorney decided to prosecute the case."
prosecute.zh: 地区检察官决定对此案进行起诉。

verbal.en: He gave a verbal agreement to finish the work by Friday.
verbal.zh: 他口头同意星期五之前完成这项工作。

calcium.en: You need to consume enough calcium for the health of your bones and teeth.
calcium.zh: 你需要摄入足够的钙来保持你的骨齿健康。

silicon.en: Silicon is used in the production of computer chips.
silicon.zh: 硅被用于电脑芯片的生产。

recipient.en: She's the recipient of numerous academic awards.
recipient.zh: 她是众多学术奖项的获得者。

commonwealth.en: Australia is a member of the Commonwealth.
commonwealth.zh: 澳大利亚是英联邦的成员。

incur.en: If we continue to cut trees, we will incur the wrath of Mother Nature.
incur.zh: 如果我们继续砍树，我们会招致大自然的愤怒

premise.en: The research project is based on the premise that not all diseases are caused by bacteria.
premise.zh: 那个研究项目建立在一个前提之上，即并非所有的疾病都是由细菌引起的。

tenant.en: The new tenants moved into the house across the street.

judicial.en: The judicial system is the system of courts that interprets and applies the law in the name of the state.
judicial.zh: 司法制度是一个解释并代表国家应用法律的法庭体系

pant.en: He was panting by the time he reached the top of the hill.
pant.zh: 他爬到山顶的时候已经气喘吁吁了。

dome.en: "The dome of the church is very beautiful."

fuse.en: The boy lit the fuse on the rocket and waited for it to burst in the sky.

premium.en: You have to pay premiums to the insurance company every month.
premium.zh: 你需要每月向保险公司支付保险费。

solidarity.en: The workers were in solidarity with each other against the factory owners.
solidarity.zh: 工人们在对抗工厂主的问题上保持团结一致。

tumble.en: "The books tumbled to the floor as she bumped the shelf."
tumble.zh: 她撞到书架,书籍纷纷落到地上。

hound.en: The hound has a keen sense of smell.
hound.zh: 这只猎犬的嗅觉非常敏锐。

orphan.en: The orphan frequently cried during the night.

eternal.en: "The stars are eternal; they have remained unchanged for centuries."
eternal.zh: 星星是永恒的；它们几个世纪以来一直未曾改变。

cling.en: Physically: The dress clings to her body.
cling.zh: 这件裙子紧紧贴着她的身体。

satire.en: This book is a satire of what life was like in the army.

prevalent.en: Growing a beard is more prevalent in some countries than in others.

diabetes.en: Overweight people are more likely to suffer from diabetes than slimmer ones.

clip.en: "I used a clip to hold the papers together."
clip.zh: 我用夹子把纸张固定在一起。

invaluable.en: Her advice has been invaluable to me.
invaluable.zh: 她的建议对我来说无比宝贵。

compact.en: This car has a compact design, making it perfect for city driving.
compact.zh: 这辆车设计很紧凑，非常适合在城市里开。

doom.en: The prophecy predicted doom for the city.
doom.zh: 预言预测这座城市的毁灭。

denote.en: Her facial expression denotes that she is angry.
denote.zh: 她的面部表情表示她很生气。

majesty.en: Your Majesty, I'm at your service.
majesty.zh: 陛下，我随时听候您的差遣。

necessitate.en: The extreme weather necessitated a change of plans.
necessitate.zh: 极端的天气迫使我们改变了计划。

correlate.en: The research showed that poverty correlates with shorter lifespan.
correlate.zh: 这份研究显示贫穷与较短的寿命有关系。

radiant.en: The sun was radiant in the clear sky.
radiant.zh: 阳光普照在清朗的天空中。

exotic.en: This dish has an exotic flavor, unlike anything I've tasted before.
exotic.zh: 这道菜有一种异国情调的味道，不同于我以前吃过的任何东西。

revenge.en: She swore to take revenge on her enemies.
revenge.zh: 她发誓要报复她的敌人。

distill.en: This oil refining company is distilling crude oil to make gasoline.
distill.zh: 这家炼油公司正在精炼原油以制造汽油。

fitting.en: "The dress was a perfect fitting on her." - 这件连衣裙非常适合她。

siren.en: Upon seeing the accident, he immediately dialed the police and soon the siren of a police car could be heard from afar.
siren.zh: 他一看见事故就立即拨打了警察，不一会儿，就可以从远处听到警车的警笛声。

resent.en: 我很生她的气，因为她没邀请我去派对。
resent.zh: I really resent her for not inviting me to the party.

dew.en: "The morning dew glittered in the sunrise."
dew.zh: 早晨的露水在日出时闪烁。

crisp.en: The apple is crisp and juicy.

census.en: The government carries out a census every ten years to gather information about the population.
census.zh: 政府每10年进行一次人口普查以收集关于人口的信息。

pave.en: "The road to the farmhouse is paved with gravel."
pave.zh: 向农舍的路是由碎石铺成的。

advent.en: During the advent of radio, very few programs actually played music.

medieval.en: "The castle is a typical medieval fortress."
medieval.zh: 这座城堡是典型的中世纪要塞。

masterpiece.en: Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa is a true masterpiece.
masterpiece.zh: 达芬奇的《蒙娜丽莎》是一幅真正的杰作

tolerant.en: She is very tolerant of other people's faults.
tolerant.zh: 她对别人的错误十分宽容。

paralyze.en: The sudden news may paralyze him with shock.
paralyze.zh: 这个突如其来的消息可能会让他因为震惊而无法动弹。

midst.en: She was in the midst of cleaning when the telephone rang.

impair.en: Long time exposure to loud noises might impair your hearing.
impair.zh: 长时间暴露在噪音中可能会损害你的听力。

thereafter.en: "He graduated in 1980, and thereafter started his own business."
thereafter.zh: 他在1980年毕业，此后开始了他自己的生意。

paradise.en: "He described the island as a paradise for birdwatchers."
paradise.zh: 他形容这个岛是观鸟者的天堂。

distract.en: "The noise outside started to distract me from my study."
distract.zh: 外面的噪音开始让我无法专心学习。

hemisphere.en: In the northern hemisphere, the weather is usually warmest in July and August.

lunar.en: The cycles of the moon greatly affect the lunar calendar.
lunar.zh: 月亮的周期对阴历有着重要影响。

prince.en: The prince fell in love with a commoner, shocking the whole kingdom.
prince.zh: 王子爱上了一个平民，全王国都感到震惊。

arrogant.en: He is an arrogant boss who never listens to his employees' suggestions.
arrogant.zh: 他是一个目中无人的老板，从不听取员工的建议。

permeate.en: The water will eventually permeate through the concrete.
permeate.zh: 水最终会渗透过混凝土。

feat.en: The elephant’s standing up on one leg was a feat.

oriental.en: This book provides a comprehensive understanding of oriental philosophy.
oriental.zh: 这本书提供了对东方哲学的全面理解。

stall.en: She has a fruit and vegetable stall in the local market.
stall.zh: 她在当地市场有一个水果和蔬菜摊位。

menace.en: The rapid spread of the virus is a menace to public health.
menace.zh: 病毒的快速传播对公共健康构成威胁。

invalid.en: The way to winning debates is to avoid invalid arguments.

legitimate.en: The police searched his house but found no legitimate evidence.
legitimate.zh: 警察搜索了他的房子，但没有找到合法的证据。

recur.en: The theme of love recurs throughout the book.
recur.zh: 整本书中，爱的主题一再出现。

herald.en: He is seen as the herald of a new age in fashion.
herald.zh: 他被视为时装新时代的预兆。

coalition.en: The two smaller parties joined in a coalition against the leading party.
coalition.zh: 两个小党联手对抗领导党。

brim.en: 作为名词：“My new hat has a wide brim。”
brim.zh: 我新买的帽子有个宽宽的帽檐。

assimilate.en: When the family moves to the US they will assimilate into American culture.

addict.en: He is an addict to video games.

marvellous.en: The cave was filled with marvellous stalactites.
marvellous.zh: 这个洞内满是了不起的钟乳石。

bait.en: He used big worms as bait to catch fish.
bait.zh: 他用大虫作为诱饵去钓鱼。

aisle.en: They were told to clear the aisle because the plane was about to land.

monopoly.en: The company had a monopoly on the software market, so they could set their prices quite high.
monopoly.zh: 这家公司对软件市场具有垄断地位，所以它们可以将价格设定得很高。

paralyse.en: The disease can paralyse the limbs and the body.
paralyse.zh: 这种疾病能使四肢和身体瘫痪。

originate.en: The idea of democracy originated in Ancient Greece.

nonetheless.en: It was a predictable, but nonetheless funny, story.
nonetheless.zh: 这是一个可以预见的，但是仍然有趣的故事。

cocaine.en: Cocaine is a highly addictive drug.
cocaine.zh: 可卡因是一种上瘾性很强的毒品。

conceive.en: Even the greatest scientists couldn't conceive how the universe was made.
conceive.zh: 即使是最伟大的科学家也设想不出宇宙是如何形成的。

napkin.en: Could you please pass me a napkin?
napkin.zh: 能否请你递我一张餐巾？

reckless.en: The reckless driver posed a threat to everyone else on the road.

paradox.en: "This is the famous paradox of freedom : real freedom is only possible where there is real restraint."
paradox.zh: 这就是著名的自由悖论：只有在真正的约束存在的地方，才能有真正的自由。

bald.en: John is going bald in his mid-twenties.
bald.zh: 约翰在他二十多岁的时候就开始变秃了。

masculine.en: American football is usually considered a masculine sport.

conform.en: "You must conform to the rules of the game."
conform.zh: 你必须按照游戏规则行事

empirical.en: "His conclusions were based on empirical data collected from various sources."
empirical.zh: 他的结论基于从多个来源收集的实证数据。

curb.en: The government has to curb the increasing crime rate.
curb.zh: 政府应抑制日益增长的犯罪率。

reassure.en: \*\*He reassured her that he would be home soon.\*\*
reassure.zh: 他让她放心，他很快就会回家。

module.en: This new computer model is made up of several separate modules that can be replaced individually.
module.zh: 这款新的电脑模型由几个独立的模块组成，每个模块都可以单独更换。

sober.en: After the funeral, everybody felt very sober.

expel.en: He was expelled from school for fighting.
expel.zh: 他因为打架被学校开除。

latitude.en: "The city is located at a high latitude."
latitude.zh: 这个城市位于较高的纬度。

uproar.en: The fans made a great uproar when their team lost the game.

prosper.en: People can prosper in a stable society.
prosper.zh: 在稳定的社会环境中，人们可以繁荣昌盛

swamp.en: There are lots of wild animals living in the swamp.

entrepreneur.en: He is a very successful entrepreneur with a flair for marketing.
entrepreneur.zh: 他是一位对营销有天赋的非常成功的创业家。

dedicate.en: The nun dedicated herself to helping people in need.

stab.en: He was stabbed to death in a bar fight.
stab.zh: 他在酒吧斗殴中被刺死了。

bureaucracy.en: The teacher complained about the bureaucracy of the school system.
bureaucracy.zh: 老师抱怨学校系统的官僚主义。

glide.en: The ice skater seemed to glide effortlessly across the rink.
glide.zh: 那位冰上滑行者看起来在溜冰场中毫不费力地滑行。

nominate.en: The president will nominate a new ambassador to the United Nations.
nominate.zh: 总统将会任命新的联合国大使。

loom.en: As a verb: The final exams are looming over the students.
loom.zh: 期末考试正在学生们心里形成压力。

stationary.en: The car remained stationary in the traffic jam.
stationary.zh: 车辆在交通堵塞中一直处于静止状态。

invert.en: In photography, we sometimes invert colors to create unique effects.
invert.zh: 在摄影中，我们有时会倒转颜色来创造独特的效果。

disrupt.en: The loud crash disrupted the class lecture.

defer.en: The girl was very sleepy, so she chose to defer her bath until morning.

alloy.en: Brass is an alloy of copper and zinc.

renaissance.en: The Italian Renaissance is often labelled as the beginning of the "modern" epoch.
renaissance.zh: 意大利的文艺复兴常常被标签为"现代"纪元的开始。

auction.en: The house is up for auction.

propel.en: The new evidence will propel the case into the spotlight.
propel.zh: 新的证据将把这个案件推入公众的视线。

patrol.en: The police regularly patrol the streets of the city to maintain law and order.
patrol.zh: 警察经常在城市的街道上巡逻，以维护法律和秩序。

patron.en: "The art exhibit was funded by a wealthy patron."
patron.zh: 这次艺术展览由一位富有的赞助人资助。

tribute.en: In some countries, people wear poppies as a tribute to veterans.

mob.en: A mob of protesters were causing chaos in the city.
mob.zh: 一群抗议者在城市中制造混乱。

subordinate.en: As a subordinate, she had to obey her manager's decision.
subordinate.zh: 作为一个下级，她必须服从经理的决定。

incentive.en: The chance of winning a prize was an incentive to get people to play the game.

terminate.en: The trip was terminated after the car broke down.

gender.en: Do you know the gender of her new baby?

mortgage.en: She took out a mortgage on her house to start her own business.
mortgage.zh: 她抵押自己的房子以开办自己的生意。

graze.en: The sheep and goats like to graze on the grass outside the village.

nurture.en: Parents want to nurture their children into responsible adults.
nurture.zh: 父母希望抚养他们的孩子成为负责任的大人。

degenerate.en: As an adjective: "His friends were a degenerate and corrupt group."
degenerate.zh: 他的朋友们是一群堕落腐败的人。

hasty.en: Don't be too hasty in your decision.
hasty.zh: 不要做出过于草率的决定。

escort.en: He agreed to escort her to the ball.
escort.zh: 他答应陪她去参加舞会。

threshold.en: He stepped over the threshold into the house.
threshold.zh: 他跨过门槛走进了房子。

desolate.en: The house has been desolate for years.
desolate.zh: 这所房子已经荒废多年了。

streamline.en: The company's management structure was streamlined under the new CEO.
streamline.zh: 新任CEO对公司的管理结构进行了精简。

offset.en: We can offset the travel costs by doing some part-time work.
offset.zh: 我们可以通过做些兼职来补偿旅行费用。

coward.en: A firefighter cannot be a coward. They have to be able to act quickly.

commence.en: His speech commenced with a “thank you” to all who had helped him succeed.

commonplace.en: It's commonplace for teenagers to be rebellious.
commonplace.zh: 青少年有叛逆期是很常见的。

parameter.en: The parameters of the experiment were strictly controlled.
parameter.zh: 实验的参数被严格控制。

extinct.en: There used to be dinosaurs all over the world, but now they are extinct.

opaque.en: The window is made of opaque glass.
opaque.zh: 这个窗户是由不透明的玻璃制成的。

humid.en: It is very humid inside a sauna.

fabricate.zh: 这家公司制造塑料椅子。

habitat.en: Frogs are often found in a wet habitat, such as near a lake, river, or pond.

ego.en: Kelly’s ego made her think that she was some kind of a superhero.

upgrade.en: You should upgrade your old phone to a newer model.
upgrade.zh: 你应该把你的旧手机升级为新款型号。

orchard.en: The old farmer lives in a small house in the middle of the orchard.
orchard.zh: 那位老农夫住在果园中的一个小房子里。

conception.en: "He doesn't have the slightest conception of teamwork." 他对团队合作没有丁点儿概念。

detain.en: "The police detained the suspect for further interrogation."
detain.zh: 警方将嫌犯扣留下进行进一步的审讯。

beware.en: You should beware of driving fast on wet roads.

eloquent.en: He was an eloquent speaker, always able to persuade people to his point of view.
eloquent.zh: 他是一位雄辩的演讲者，总能说服人们接受他的观点。

submarine.en: The submarine dove deep to avoid the enemy destroyer.
submarine.zh: 潜艇深深地潜入海中以避开敌人的驱逐舰。

naughty.en: The boy had to go to his room because he was being naughty.

weird.zh: 他戴着一顶奇怪的帽子。

descent.en: The descent of the mountain is dangerous.

refute.en: The bank manager has refuted the claims that he lied to his customers.

brandy.en: After dinner, he poured himself a glass of brandy.
brandy.zh: 晚餐后，他给自己倒了一杯白兰地。

fling.zh: He gave a fling of the ball into the sky.

stun.zh: 这个消息震惊了所有人。

exquisite.zh: 厨师烹饪了一顿精致的饭菜。

collide.en: The two cars collided at the intersection.
collide.zh: 两辆汽车在十字路口相撞了。

cardinal.en: 作为形容词：Respecting others is a cardinal rule in society.
cardinal.zh: 尊重他人是社会中的基本规则。

ventilate.en: 窗户需要保持开启，以便房间通风。
ventilate.zh: The window needs to be kept open to ventilate the room.

irritate.en: She was irritated when her brother told her that he had lost her camera.

linen.zh: 昨天她买了新的床上用品。

liner.en: "The trash bag liner needs to be replaced."
liner.zh: 垃圾袋的衬垫需要更换。

illuminate.en: In order to illuminate the stage, the crew turned on the spotlight.

forum.en: The conference provided a forum for discussing environmental issues.
forum.zh: 这次会议提供了讨论环境问题的场所

contempt.en: The judge had contempt for the wicked criminal.

shaft.en: He twisted the shaft of the umbrella.

electrician.en: The electrician is debugging the power system.
electrician.zh: 电工正在调试电力系统。

toll.en: There is a high toll for driving into the city during peak hours.
toll.zh: 在高峰期内开车进城要支付高额的过路费。

aspire.en: George aspired to be a doctor from a young age.

outbreak.en: There has been an outbreak of war in the Middle East.

nap.en: I think I'll take a nap.

manipulate.en: The child was able to manipulate the toy car easily.
manipulate.zh: 孩子能够轻松操控这个玩具车。

practitioner.en: She made an appointment with the practitioner to treat her cough.

converge.en: The roads converge at the downtown area.

inertia.en: Inertia kept her sitting on the sofa, though she knew she should go out.
inertia.zh: 惰性使她坐在沙发上，虽然她知道她应该出去。

administer.en: The teacher’s assistant will administer the test.

transplant.en: The doctors are preparing for a heart transplant.
transplant.zh: 医生们正在为心脏移植做准备。

deficit.en: The company has been running a deficit for the past three years.
deficit.zh: 过去三年里，这家公司一直处于亏损状态。

linger.en: The smell of her perfume lingered in the room.
linger.zh: 她的香水味在房间里逗留。

slit.zh: He slit open the envelope very carefully.

aerial.en: The eagle is in aerial flight.

nasty.en: "There's a nasty smell in the kitchen."
nasty.zh: 厨房里有一股令人讨厌的气味。

articulate.en: Alfred’s friends loved talking to him because he was so articulate and intelligent.

rigorous.en: We need to conduct a rigorous investigation to find out what really happened.
rigorous.zh: 我们需要进行严格的调查，以确定真正发生了什么。

tribe.en: He belonged to an Amazonian tribe.
tribe.zh: 他属于一个亚马逊的部落。

activate.en: Please activate your new credit card before use.
activate.zh: 请在使用前激活你的新信用卡。

endow.en: The school was endowed by a rich benefactor.
endow.zh: 那所学校是由一个富有的捐赠者赞助的。

slot.en: To operate the machine, put your coins into the slot.

manifest.en: The joy of the holiday season manifested as bright smiles on the faces of the children.

endeavor.en: She endeavored to finish the work before leaving.
endeavor.zh: 她努力在离开之前完成工作。

adjacent.en: Our hotel room was adjacent to the ice machine.
adjacent.zh: 我们的酒店房间紧邻冰块机。

remainder.en: He took a bite of the apple and then gave me the remainder of it.

summon.en: We summoned the doctor as soon as we noticed she was sick.

flare.en: The fire flared up as the wind grew stronger.

couch.en: I fell asleep on the couch while watching TV.
couch.zh: 我在看电视时在沙发上睡着了。

expertise.en: His expertise in finance was well recognized in the company.
expertise.zh: 他在财务方面的专长在公司内得到了广泛的认可。

pearl.en: She wore a necklace with a single pearl.
pearl.zh: 她戴了一串只有一颗珍珠的项链。

disturbance.en: "I apologize for any disturbance I may have caused."
disturbance.zh: 对于我可能引起的任何打扰，我深感抱歉。

default.en: If a borrower defaults on their mortgage, the bank can seize the property.
default.zh: 如果借款人违约不支付抵押款，银行可以没收该物业。

tropic.en: The Tropic of Cancer passes through Mexico.

beverage.en: The waiter brought our beverages first. Then he brought our food.

cemetery.en: The city built a new cemetery on its outskirts.
cemetery.zh: 城市在边缘地带新建了一座公墓。

genetic.en: The color of one’s eyes is genetic.

gossip.en: Don't spread gossip about your colleagues.
gossip.zh: 不要传播关于同事的闲话。

foam.en: The soap will foam up when you add water.

dwell.en: Before he was a successful writer, Mark Twain dwelled in the city of Hannibal, Missouri.

incorporate.en: We need to incorporate your suggestions into our plan.
incorporate.zh: 我们需要将你的建议纳入我们的计划中。

landlady.en: My landlady comes around every first day of the month to collect the rent.
landlady.zh: 月初我的女房东会来收租金

counterpart.en: Our manager will meet our rival company’s counterpart later today.

pendulum.en: "The pendulum of the grandfather clock swung back and forth."
pendulum.zh: 爷爷的座钟里的摆来回摆动。

sovereign.en: The queen is a sovereign, who rules her country.
sovereign.zh: 女王是一个君主，统治着她的国家。

duplicate.en: As a verb: I had to duplicate the report because I lost the original one.
duplicate.zh: 我不得不复制报告，因为我丢失了原件。
