installment.en: He bought the car on installment.

trifle.en: His contribution to the project was a mere trifle.
trifle.zh: 他对项目的贡献只是微不足道的小事。

migrate.en: Many birds migrate south for the winter.
migrate.zh: 许多鸟类冬天会向南迁移。

affluent.en: People in the city are usually more affluent than people in the country.

magnify.en: He used a lens to magnify the image.
magnify.zh: 他使用了一个镜头来放大这个图像。

redundant.en: This sentence is redundant so you can delete it.
redundant.zh: 这个句子是多余的，所以你可以删掉它。

mammal.en: A dolphin is a type of mammal that lives in the ocean.
mammal.zh: 海豚是一种生活在海洋中的哺乳动物。

trademark.en: Apple's logo is a recognized trademark worldwide.
trademark.zh: 苹果的logo是一个全球知名的商标。

aural.en: She has an excellent aural comprehension.
aural.zh: 她的听力理解能力非常好。

sensation.en: "She had a strange sensation in her stomach."
sensation.zh: 她的胃部有一种奇怪的感觉。

timely.zh: 他的到来真是恰逢其时。

subsidy.en: The official gave the company a subsidy so it could open two new factories.

probability.en: The probability of it raining tomorrow is high.

lofty.zh: 他给自己定下了崇高的目标。

tragic.en: The loss of lives in the war is truly tragic.
tragic.zh: 在这场战争中失去的生命真的是悲惨无比。

grin.zh: 他狡黠地向我露齿而笑。

grim.en: Despite the grim weather conditions, they decided to proceed with the outdoor concert.
grim.zh: 尽管天气恶劣，他们还是决定进行户外音乐会。

offspring.en: Parents often hope their offspring will follow in their footsteps.
offspring.zh: 父母常常希望他们的子女能继承他们的事业。

rumor.en: Carla was spreading rumors around the office.

overflow.en: As a verb: "Her heart overflowed with gratitude."

enrich.en: "Traveling can enrich our understanding of different cultures."
enrich.zh: 旅行可以丰富我们对不同文化的理解。

intrigue.en: Her mysterious past intrigued her new friend.

tangle.en: Careful with that fishing line, it could quickly become a tangle.
tangle.zh: 小心那条鱼线，它很快就会纠缠成一团。

orient.en: As a verb: "He oriented himself by the stars."
orient.zh: 他用星星来定位自己的位置。

handicap.en: Joe has a slight handicap, so he uses a walker to get around.

plea.en: The poor, hungry man made a plea for food.

cereal.en: **I eat cereal for breakfast every day.**

inhale.en: The camper inhaled the cool and fresh mountain air and felt relaxed.

handbook.en: Your employee handbook outlines the company's policies.
handbook.zh: 你的员工手册概述了公司的政策。

endurance.en: He shows great endurance in the face of hardships.
endurance.zh: 他面对困境展现出极大的忍耐力。

hospitality.en: The Joneses are known for their hospitality.
hospitality.zh: 琼斯一家为他们的热情好客而闻名。

blunder.en: He made his first blunder in politics by underestimating his opponent.
blunder.zh: 他对政敌的低估是他在政治上所犯的第一个大错误。

breach.en: He is being sued for breach of contract.

bewilder.en: The sudden question seemed to bewilder the man.
bewilder.zh: 这个突然的问题似乎使这个男人感到困惑。

diminish.en: His influence has significantly diminished over the years.
diminish.zh: 他的影响力这些年来大大减少了。

colonial.en: The colonial period was a time of great change in America.
colonial.zh: 殖民时期是美国发生重大变化的时期。

warfare.en: The country has experienced a long history of guerrilla warfare.
warfare.zh: 这个国家有着漫长的游击战争历史。

waggon.en: "John loaded the hay onto the waggon."
waggon.zh: 约翰把草料装上了马车。

vein.en: She traced the blue veins on his hand.
vein.zh: 她沿着他手上的青筋摩挲。

veil.en: The bride walked down the aisle with her face veiled.
veil.zh: 新娘蒙着面纱走下通道。

hierarchy.en: The company has a strict hierarchy with clearly defined roles.
hierarchy.zh: 公司有着严格的领导层次，角色分配清晰。

proceeding.en: The entire proceeding was recorded on camera.
proceeding.zh: 整个过程都被摄像机记录下来了。

hurl.en: He picked up a stone and hurled it at the car.
hurl.zh: 他捡起一块石头猛地扔向汽车。

nickname.en: "My friends gave me the nickname 'Sparky' because of my lively personality."
nickname.zh: 因为我活泼的性格，我朋友给我取了个“火花” 的昵称。

genre.en: She is considered a master in the comedy genre.

humanity.en: "The whole of humanity was shocked by the disaster."
humanity.zh: 整个人类对这场灾难感到震惊。

innovation.en: Rapid technological change requires substantial innovation on the part of manufacturers.
innovation.zh: “快速的技术变革要求制造商做出大量的创新。”

shutter.en: He installed the shutter to block out the sunlight.
shutter.zh: 他安装了百叶窗以挡住阳光。

alternate.en: The meeting is held on alternate Sundays.
alternate.zh: 这个会议每隔一个星期日举行。

skeptical.en: She was skeptical about his excuses.
skeptical.zh: 她对他的借口表示怀疑。

naive.en: "She has a naive belief in the power of love."
naive.zh: 她对爱情的力量有着天真的信念。

gasp.en: She gasped when she saw the horrific scene.
gasp.zh: 她看到那恐怖的场景时喘了口气

enlighten.en: Could you enlighten me on this subject?
enlighten.zh: 你能就这个主题给我一些启示吗?

deduct.en: I had to deduct my expenses from my checkbook.

portray.en: Her picture portrayed the house she grew up in when she was little.

profound.en: He has a profound understanding of the subject.
profound.zh: 他对这个主题有深厚的理解。

vocal.en: He is a vocal critic of the government.
vocal.zh: 他是政府的公开批评者。

overturn.en: The car skidded off the road and overturned.
overturn.zh: 汽车从路上滑下并翻了个头

hover.en: The hummingbird can hover in mid-air.
hover.zh: 蜂鸟可以在半空中悬停。

oak.en: The oak tree in our backyard is over 100 years old.
oak.zh: 我们后院的这棵橡树已经超过100年了。

contend.en: Stacy had to contend with a learning disability throughout high school.

oar.en: He paddled the boat with a single **oar**.

rehearse.en: Vick’s band rehearsed all week before their first show.

gamble.en: Many people like to go to casinos to gamble.

specification.en: The construction project will be carried out according to the detailed specification.
specification.zh: 这个建筑项目将按照详细的规格来进行。

rash.en: As a noun: He developed a rash after eating seafood.
rash.zh: 他吃了海鲜后长了皮疹。

cylinder.en: The chemist poured the solution into a cylinder.
cylinder.zh: 化学家把溶液倒入了试管中。

divine.en: She has the most divine smile.

foul.en: The smell in the room was foul.
foul.zh: 屋子里一股腐臭的气味。

intricate.en: The detective had to unravel the intricate plot of the mystery novel.
intricate.zh: 侦探必须解开这部悬疑小说复杂的情节。

agony.en: The boy yelled in agony when the puppy bit him.

contemplate.en: She sat on the park bench and contemplated the beauty of the setting sun.
contemplate.zh: 她坐在公园的长凳上，注视着夕阳的美丽。

zinc.en: Zinc is an essential mineral involved in numerous aspects of cellular metabolism.
zinc.zh: 锌是参与细胞代谢的多个环节的必需矿物质。

brittle.en: He tossed the brittle bone to the dog.

whirl.en: She whirled around to face him.

recede.en: As the tide finished its climb, it began to recede from the shore.
recede.zh: 潮水爬升完毕后，开始从海岸线后退。

dependence.en: Young children have a dependence on their parents.

veto.en: The president has the power to veto any bill passed by Congress.
veto.zh: 总统有权否决国会通过的任何法案。

disposition.en: He has a cheery disposition, always ready to help others.
disposition.zh: 他性情开朗，总是愿意帮助别人。

certify.en: The doctor certified his patient's death.
certify.zh: 医生确认了他的病人的死亡。

solitary.en: He chose a solitary life in the countryside after he retired.
solitary.zh: 他退休后选择了在乡下过着孤独的生活。

toxic.en: Some mushrooms are considered toxic and can cause death if ingested.
toxic.zh: 一些蘑菇被认为是有毒的，如果误食可能会导致死亡。

wrench.en: He loosened the lug nuts with a wrench. 他用扳手松开了螺丝帽。

puff.en: A puff of smoke came from the burnt match.

disk.en: The old disk record was full of scratches.

fiscal.en: The country has been in a fiscal deficit for the past few years.
fiscal.zh: 这个国家在过去几年一直在财政赤字中。

retrieve.en: She retrieved her mail from the mailbox.

code.en: I'm trying to debug the code.
code.zh: 我正在尝试调试这份代码。

legacy.en: The legacy of the ancient Egyptians can be seen in their monuments.

displace.en: Advances in technology could displace many traditional jobs.
displace.zh: 技术的进步可能会取代很多传统的工作。

ideology.en: Within the teachers’ ideology, there was a belief in the value of parent participation.

illusion.en: The oasis in the desert was just an illusion caused by the heat.
illusion.zh: 沙漠中的绿洲只是由热气引起的错觉。

proposition.en: His proposition sounds reasonable, but it would require a lot of work to implement.
proposition.zh: 他的提议听起来很合理，但是实施起来需要做很多工作。

confer.en: The committee will confer about the budget next week.
confer.zh: 委员会将于下周讨论预算。

manuscript.en: John gave his manuscript to the editor.
manuscript.zh: 约翰把他的手稿交给了编辑

wholesome.en: Exercise and a good diet are both crucial for maintaining a wholesome lifestyle.
wholesome.zh: 锻炼和良好的饮食对于保持有益健康的生活方式都非常关键。

edit.en: The teacher asked me to edit my essay for errors.
edit.zh: 老师要求我修改论文的错误。

cognitive.en: After her physical examination, her cognitive skills were tested.

expire.en: My driver's license will expire next month.
expire.zh: 我的驾驶执照下月就要过期了。

oppress.en: Free speech had been oppressed in his country.

closet.en: She keeps all her clothes tidy in the closet.
closet.zh: 她把所有衣服都整齐的放在衣柜里。

monster.en: He is a monster of selfishness.

wardrobe.en: She bought some new clothes to expand her wardrobe.

conscientious.en: He is a conscientious worker and always completes his tasks on time.
conscientious.zh: 他是个尽责的员工,总是准时完成任务。

extract.en: The dentist extracted the woman’s damaged tooth and put in a fake one.

obscure.en: The full moon was obscured by clouds.

ingenious.en: The boy came up with an ingenious solution to the math problem.
ingenious.zh: 这个男孩对数学问题提出了一个巧妙的解答。

privacy.en: Each student has his own privacy, and we should respect that.
privacy.zh: 每个学生都有他自己的隐私，我们应该尊重这一点。

heir.en: He is the legitimate heir to the throne.
heir.zh: 他是合法的王位继承者。

regime.en: He was a member of the old regime that had been overthrown in the election.

accessory.en: The accessory kit includes a battery and a charger.
accessory.zh: 配件套装包括一个电池和一个充电器。

antenna.en: The antenna on the roof receives signals for the television.
antenna.zh: 房顶上的天线接收电视信号。

torment.en: She tormented her little brother by taking his favorite toy.

depressed.en: She's been feeling a bit depressed lately.

militant.en: The militant group claimed responsibility for the bombing.
militant.zh: 激进的团体声称对爆炸事件负责。

dilute.en: You need to dilute the paint with a little water before you use it.
dilute.zh: 你在使用这种油漆之前需要用一些水将其稀释。

misfortune.en: The misfortune of some is the joy of others.
misfortune.zh: 一些人的不幸是其他人的快乐。

susceptible.en: Some people are more susceptible to stress than others.
susceptible.zh: 有些人比其他人更容易受到压力的影响

instrumental.en: His instrumental role in the project was widely recognized.
instrumental.zh: 他在这个项目中起到了关键作用，这一点得到了广泛的认可。

saturate.en: You need to saturate the sponge with water before use.
saturate.zh: 使用海绵之前需要先将其浸透。

abide.en: If you want to stay in this house, you have to abide by the rules.
abide.zh: 如果你想住在这个房子里，你必须遵守规则。

contrive.en: They contrived a clever plan to fool the guards.
contrive.zh: 他们巧妙的设计了一个计划来愚弄警卫。

superstition.en: Many people still hold some superstitions about the full moon.
superstition.zh: 许多人对满月仍然持有一些迷信观念。

owl.en: The owl is a nocturnal bird of prey.
owl.zh: 猫头鹰是一种夜行性的猛禽。

norm.en: It's the norm for people to shake hands when they meet for the first time.
norm.zh: 当人们首次见面时，握手是一种常规。

indignation.en: He felt a strong sense of indignation when he saw the bullying happening on the playground.
indignation.zh: 他看到操场上发生的欺凌行为时，强烈地感到愤慨。

brace.en: I need to brace the shelf with stronger supports.
brace.zh: 我需要用更强的支撑物固定这个架子。

prestige.en: The university has a great deal of prestige around the world.
prestige.zh: 这所大学在全世界有着很高的声望。

startle.en: The sudden noise made me startle.
startle.zh: 那突然的噪音使我惊吓了一跳。

repression.en: The government was known for its brutal repression of any sort of rebellion.
repression.zh: 政府以对任何形式的叛乱进行无情镇压而闻名。

feeble.en: The boy was too feeble to carry the object very far.

prose.en: "He has a very clear and crisp prose style."
prose.zh: 他的散文风格清晰而流畅。

oath.en: Judges must take an oath to be fair to everyone in court.

spacious.en: The living room in their new house is very spacious.
spacious.zh: 他们新房子的客厅非常宽敞。

virgin.en: The virgin goddess of the moon was known as Diana.

kidnap.en: The businessman was kidnapped for ransom.
kidnap.zh: 这位商人被绑架以赎金为交换。

whatsoever.en: The boy had no idea whatsoever how to finish the story.

clutch.en: She clutched her bag tightly as she walked in the dark.
clutch.zh: 她在黑暗中行走时，紧紧地握住了她的包

evacuate.en: During the flood, many families were evacuated to higher ground.

wink.en: She gave me a quick wink to show she was joking.
wink.zh: 她向我快速地眨了眨眼睛，表示她正在开玩笑。

commodity.en: Copper is an important commodity in the world's markets.
commodity.zh: 铜是世界市场上的重要商品。

obedient.en: The dog is very obedient and always follows his owner's commands.
obedient.zh: 这只狗非常听话，总是遵循主人的指令。

misery.en: "She witnessed the misery endured by the impoverished population."
misery.zh: 她目睹了贫穷人口所忍受的苦难。

blur.en: The fog will blur the sight of the road.
blur.zh: 雾气会使道路看起来模糊不清。

plausible.en: "His story seemed plausible, but I still had doubts."
plausible.zh: 他的话似乎可信，但我仍有疑问。

equator.en: The equator crosses the northern part of South America.

subtle.en: The changes in the policy were subtle and took a while to be noticeable.
subtle.zh: 政策的变更非常微妙，花了一段时间才被注意到。

overwhelm.en: The amount of homework her teacher assigned has overwhelmed her.

imperial.en: These old imperial coins were once used in the Roman Empire.

cozy.en: "The cabin has a cozy little living room with a fireplace."
cozy.zh: 小木屋里有一个带壁炉的舒适小客厅。

deadly.zh: 这种毒蛇被认为是致命的。

shipment.en: The shipment of goods will arrive tomorrow.

vicious.en: The dog is vicious and cannot be trusted around children.
vicious.zh: 这只狗很凶恶，不能让它接近孩子。

sociable.en: Many of my good friends are sociable, but I am shy.

obsolete.en: Since computers became inexpensive, typewriters have become obsolete.

interface.en: "The interface of the new software is user-friendly."
interface.zh: 新软件的接口用户友好。

hamper.en: His progress was hampered by his lack of money.
hamper.zh: 他的进步受到了他缺钱的阻碍。

decisive.en: His decisive action saved us from disaster.
decisive.zh: 他果断的行动使我们免于灾难。

concise.en: Please keep your explanation concise and to the point.

thesis.en: I'm writing a thesis on the works of Shakespeare.
thesis.zh: "我正在写一篇有关莎士比亚作品的论文。"

revive.en: Let's revive the tradition of family dinners.
revive.zh: 我们来重振家庭晚餐的传统

fiber.en: The mat was made from tiny fibers.

underlying.en: The underlying principle of this theory is quite simple.
underlying.zh: 这个理论的基本原理其实很简单。

gut.en: Thousands of bacteria live in your gut and help you digest food.

persecute.en: Many people were persecuted for their religious beliefs in the past.
persecute.zh: 很多人在过去因为宗教信仰而遭到迫害。

imperative.en: It was imperative for him to find a job.

robust.en: He has a robust constitution and never seems to get sick.
robust.zh: 他体格强壮，似乎从不生病。

linear.en: The city is linear, stretching along the coast.
linear.zh: 这个城市延伸在海岸线上，呈线性排布

peel.en: Be sure to peel the apple before you eat it.
peel.zh: 在你吃苹果之前记得要削皮。

denounce.en: The politician was quick to denounce the corruption within his party.
denounce.zh: 政客很快公开谴责了他的党内的腐败行为。

irrespective.en: Irrespective of the consequences, he always tells the truth.
irrespective.zh: 不管结果怎样，他总是说真话。

entity.en: "The corporation is legally an independent entity."
entity.zh: 那个企业在法律上是个独立的实体。

franchise.en: The fast food restaurant has a franchise near my home.

reign.en: The emperor’s reign lasted for only two years.

tempo.en: The tempo of the music was fast and upbeat.

descendant.en: She is a descendant of a famous poet.
descendant.zh: 她是一位著名诗人的后代。

kidney.en: Excessive drinking can cause kidney damage.
kidney.zh: 过量饮酒可导致肾脏受损。

stationery.en: I need to buy some new stationery for my office.
stationery.zh: 我需要为我的办公室买一些新的文具。

sneak.en: He managed to sneak into the movie theater without being seen.
sneak.zh: 他成功地潜行进电影院而未被看见。

ritual.en: "The graduation ceremony is an important ritual in many schools."
ritual.zh: 在很多学校，毕业典礼都是一项重要的仪式。

resolute.en: He was resolute in his decision to quit smoking.

reconcile.en: "They decided to reconcile after the long feud."
reconcile.zh: 他们决定在长期的争斗后和解。

tempt.en: I wasn’t hungry, but she tempted me with a piece of my favorite cake.

forthcoming.en: The forthcoming conference will gather top scientists from around the world.
forthcoming.zh: 即将到来的会议将聚集全球顶尖科学家。

perplex.zh: 他突然的问题让我感到困惑。

despise.en: He despises the people who brag about their wealth.
despise.zh: 他鄙视那些吹嘘自己财富的人。

indulge.en: "She often indulges in a good book on weekends."
indulge.zh: 她经常在周末沉溺于一本好书之中。

skull.en: The archaeologists found a skull in the ruins.
skull.zh: 考古学家在废墟中发现了一颗颅骨。

contaminate.en: The lake was contaminated when pollutants entered the water.

foremost.en: He was among the foremost of the artists in his day.
foremost.zh: 他是当代的首屈一指的艺术家之一。

consecutive.en: The king ruled for ten consecutive years.

groan.en: "His stomach began to groan from hunger."
groan.zh: 他的胃因为饥饿开始发出呻吟声。

merchandise.en: Our store has a new shipment of merchandise.
merchandise.zh: 我们的商店有新的货品到货了。

velvet.en: She wore a dress made of red velvet.
velvet.zh: 她穿着一件由红色丝绒制成的连衣裙。

apparatus.en: They are setting up the apparatus for the science experiment.
apparatus.zh: 他们正在为科学实验设置设备。

fracture.en: He suffered a fracture in his right arm during the accident.

deteriorate.en: The nation’s economy continued to deteriorate despite the politicians’ efforts.

induce.en: Running without good shoes may induce leg pain.

shrewd.en: He is a shrewd businessman who knows how to navigate the market.
shrewd.zh: 他是个精明的商人，知道如何驾驭市场。

safeguard.en: As parents, we have a responsibility to safeguard our children.
safeguard.zh: 作为父母，我们有责任保护我们的孩子。

diligent.en: Craig has always been a very diligent person at work.

aluminum.en: I bought an aluminum ladder because it's light and easy to carry.
aluminum.zh: 我买了一个铝制的梯子，因为它轻便易携。

indicative.en: High energy prices can be indicative of a shortage.
indicative.zh: 高能源价格可能是供应短缺的标志。

scrutiny.en: A scientist should always practice scrutiny with their work.

pop.en: "Pop" as a sound: "The balloon popped with a loud bang."
pop.zh: 气球突然爆裂发出一声巨响

tariff.en: Our tariff on imported wool makes foreign wool more expensive.

retention.en: "The school has a high retention rate; over 90% of students return for their sophomore year."
retention.zh: 这所学校的保留率很高，超过90%的学生会回来读大二。

inhibit.en: Poor reading skills will inhibit learning in a wide range of subject areas.

miniature.en: This is a miniature replica of the Eiffel Tower.
miniature.zh: 这是一个埃菲尔铁塔的迷你复制品。

evoke.en: His speech evoked a strong response from the audience.
evoke.zh: 他的演讲引起了观众的热烈反应。

embryo.en: Some doctors say that what a mother eats has a big effect on her embryo.

locomotive.en: The locomotive is at the front of the train.
locomotive.zh: 火车头位于火车的最前端。

tile.en: "The bathroom was lined with white tiles."
tile.zh: 浴室里面铺设了白色的瓷砖

inherent.en: Sweating is an inherent bodily function when exercising.

pastime.en: Reading is a pastime I really enjoy.
pastime.zh: 阅读是我非常享受的消遣方式。

intrinsic.en: He has an intrinsic sense of fairness.

lash.en: Her eyes are framed by long, dark lashes.
lash.zh: **名词**：她的眼睛被长长的深色睫毛所衬托。

surroundings.en: "He was not familiar with the surroundings."
surroundings.zh: 他对周围的环境不熟悉。

prudent.en: It's prudent to save a part of your income for emergencies.
prudent.zh: 储备一部分收入用于应急是明智的

notwithstanding.en: Notwithstanding your objections, we have decided to move forward with the project.

endorse.en: The committee will endorse their leader for the upcoming election.

clarity.en: The teacher explained the concept with great clarity.
clarity.zh: 老师非常清楚地解释了这个概念。

infrastructure.en: Power lines are important parts of a city’s infrastructure.

watt.en: This machine requires 100 watts to operate properly.
watt.zh: 这台机器需要100瓦特的功率才能正常运作。

buzz.en: Seoul buzzes from dawn till dusk.

notorious.en: This area of town is notorious for gang activity.

deprive.en: Because the child was bad, she was deprived of her dessert after dinner.

pedal.en: The piano player pressed down on the pedal.

heritage.en: Our cultural heritage must be preserved for future generations.
heritage.zh: 我们必须为后代保留我们的文化遗产。

pirate.en: The pirate seized control of the ship.
pirate.zh: 海盗夺取了船的控制权。

emigrate.en: Many people emigrate to the United States in search of a better life.
emigrate.zh: 很多人移居美国以寻求更好的生活。

alien.en: I felt completely alien to this new environment.
alien.zh: 我觉得这个新环境对我来说完全是陌生的。

linguistic.en: A linguistic way of studying culture focuses on words within that culture.

elite.en: He is a member of the political elite.

ornament.en: She wore a diamond ornament around her neck.
ornament.zh: 她脖子上戴着一个钻石装饰品。

ivory.en: The elephant’s long ivory tusks looked very impressive.

henceforth.en: "Henceforth, you will be known as Sir Edward."
henceforth.zh: 今后，你将被称为爱德华爵士。

murmur.en: "There was a murmur of agreement from the audience."
murmur.zh: 听众低声发出了同意的声音。

unify.en: With their good deeds, the children tried to unify the world.

disgrace.en: He fell into disgrace because of corruption.

barren.en: The soil is too barren to cultivate.
barren.zh: 这片土壤太过贫瘠，无法耕种。

foster.en: Mrs. Smith fostered her children's interest in music.
foster.zh: 史密斯太太鼓励孩子们对音乐的兴趣。

incidence.en: "The incidence of heart disease is increasing in developed countries."
incidence.zh: 在发达国家，心脏病的发生率正在增加。

cucumber.en: I like to add cucumber to my salad for a fresh taste.
cucumber.zh: 我喜欢在沙拉中加黄瓜，增添新鲜的口味。

aviation.en: "The aviation industry is undergoing a big change with the introduction of electric planes."
aviation.zh: 随着电动飞机的引入，航空业正在经历巨大的变革。

flatter.en: "She knew how to flatter her boss by skillfully complimenting his management style."
flatter.zh: 她知道如何通过巧妙地赞扬老板的管理风格来奉承他。

eclipse.en: There will be a total solar eclipse next Tuesday.
eclipse.zh: 下周二会有一次日全食。

commute.en: I usually commute to work on the train.

shepherd.en: The shepherd moved the sheep to another field.

sometime.en: We should catch up for a coffee sometime.
sometime.zh: 我们应该找个时间喝杯咖啡。

appall.en: Minerva was appalled when she read the email from her enemy.

stride.en: He strode across the room to the window.
stride.zh: 他大步走到房间的窗户跟前。

tramp.en: He is a tramp with no fixed address.
tramp.zh: 他是一个没有固定住址的流浪者。

distort.en: The man’s lawyer distorted the facts so that he would be set free.

discern.en: It's difficult to discern the truth when both parties are biased.
discern.zh: 当双方都有偏见时，很难辨别真相。

depict.en: The painting depicts a beautiful sunset by the sea.
depict.zh: 这幅画描绘了海边美丽的日落。

hop.en: The kangaroo quickly hopped away from danger.

vanity.en: Her vanity won’t allow her to pass a mirror without looking at herself.

integral.en: She is an integral member of our team.

lubricate.en: You should regularly lubricate the gears of your bike to keep it running smoothly.
lubricate.zh: 你应该定期给自行车齿轮上油，以保持其顺畅运行。

comet.en: That comet can only be seen once every seventy-six years.
comet.zh: 那颗彗星每七十六年才能被看见一次。

bully.en: As a noun: "Tom was a bully in high school."
bully.zh: 汤姆在高中时就是个恶霸。

mutter.en: He started to mutter about the price of popcorn in the cinema.
mutter.zh: 在电影院里，他开始对爆米花的价格嘀咕不休。

imaginative.en: Jake is an imaginative child who always dreams of exploring space.
imaginative.zh: 杰克是个有想象力的孩子，总是梦想着探索太空。

analytic.en: The analytic article criticized the new plan and presented one of its own.

celebrity.en: It was the highlight of the evening when the celebrities arrived.

dispatch.en: The rescue team was dispatched to the disaster area immediately.
dispatch.zh: 救援队立即被派遣到灾区。

cyberspace.en: I didn’t receive your email. It probably got lost in cyberspace.

trait.en: She has the physical traits of her mother.
trait.zh: 她有着母亲的身体特征

ashore.en: After a long day of fishing, Glen pulled his boat ashore, so it wouldn’t float away.

excerpt.en: I didn’t listen to the entire symphony online, but I did play an excerpt.

auditorium.en: People have gathered at the school auditorium to watch the play.

analytical.en: His analytical mind was quite remarkable.
analytical.zh: 他的分析思维非常出色。

lumber.en: The carpenter purchased some lumber to construct a new cabinet.
lumber.zh: 木匠购买了一些木材以建造新的橱柜。

idiot.en: Because he got lost in the forest, the man felt like an idiot.

tuition.en: Tuition fees have become a heated topic among students and their parents.
tuition.zh: 学费已经成为学生和他们的父母的热门话题。

adjoin.en: Our gardens adjoin at the rear.
adjoin.zh: 我们的花园在后面相邻。

muscular.en: He exercised regularly so that his body could become muscular.

hum.en: The man hummed his favorite song.

sparkle.en: The stars sparkled in the winter night’s sky.

memo.en: Please take note of the points in this memo.
memo.zh: 请注意这份备忘录中的要点。

collaborate.en: When they collaborated, they managed to finish their chores early.

displacement.en: He felt a slight displacement of his chair.
displacement.zh: 他感觉到了他的椅子微动。

casualty.en: There were no casualties in the car accident.
casualty.zh: 这次车祸没有造成人员伤亡。

gauge.en: As a verb - I tried to gauge his reaction to the news.
gauge.zh: 我试图判断他对这个消息的反应。

culprit.en: The police were still searching for the culprit from the robbery.

bibliography.en: Please include a bibliography at the end of your paper.
bibliography.zh: 请在论文的末尾附上参考书目。

generalize.en: Don't generalize from your own experience to everyone.
generalize.zh: 不要以自己的经验对所有人进行概括。

grease.en: When I was done working on the car, I had grease all over my hands.

allege.en: The newspaper alleged the mayor's corrupt practices.
allege.zh: 报纸声称市长有腐败行为。

trigger.en: The man had his finger on the trigger of the gun.

segregate.en: The system tends to segregate the rich from the poor.
segregate.zh: 这个系统倾向于将富人和穷人隔离开来。

withhold.en: He decided to withhold the information until the right moment. 他决定在合适的时候再公开那个信息。

banquet.en: We held a joyous banquet to celebrate our wedding anniversary.
banquet.zh: 我们举行了一个欢乐的宴会来庆祝我们的婚礼周年纪念。

reptile.en: Snakes and lizards are both types of reptiles.
reptile.zh: 蛇和蜥蜴都是爬行动物的一种。

hose.en: He used a hose to water the garden.

transit.zh: 货物在运输过程中丢失。

sentiment.en: "The general sentiment among the employees was of dissatisfaction."
sentiment.zh: 员工普遍的情绪是不满意

strife.en: There was a lot of strife between Jim and Lisa about what TV show to watch.

racket.en: 句子：Her father was certain that the business was a racket.
racket.zh: 她的父亲确信那个行业就是一个骗局。

magnitude.en: This was a discovery of great magnitude.

immune.en: He is immune to the chickenpox since he had it as a child.
immune.zh: 他小时候得过水痘，所以对此免疫了。

stern.en: She gave him a stern look, indicating that he wasn't supposed to be there.
stern.zh: 她给他一个严厉的眼神，表示他不应该在那里。

rotary.en: The rotary motion of the wheel makes the car move forward.
rotary.zh: 车轮的旋转使汽车向前移动。

ruby.en: She wore a necklace of rubies.
ruby.zh: 她戴着一串红宝石项链。

complicate.en: The bad weather complicated finishing the job quickly.

outfit.en: She wore a fashionable outfit to the party.
outfit.zh: 她穿了一套时尚的服装去参加派对。

massacre.en: The war witnessed a brutal massacre where thousands of innocent civilians lost their lives.
massacre.zh: 战争目睹了一场残酷的大屠杀，成千上万的无辜平民失去了生命。

negligible.en: The amount of money spent on the project so far is negligible.
negligible.zh: 到目前为止，投在这个项目上的资金微不足道。

setback.en: The project suffered a major setback when funding was cut.
setback.zh: 项目的资金被削减时遭遇了重大挫折。

impulse.en: I bought this dress on impulse.
impulse.zh: 我是冲动购买这件裙子的。

infectious.en: This infectious disease is spreading rapidly across the country.
infectious.zh: "这种传染病正在全国迅速蔓延。"

galaxy.en: 1.  "The Milky Way is one of countless galaxies in the universe."
galaxy.zh: 银河系是宇宙中无数星系之一。

rebellion.en: The peasants rose in rebellion against the king.

weary.en: Jane was weary after a long day of work.

peninsula.en: The state of Florida is an example of a peninsula.

adverse.en: The project was delayed due to adverse weather conditions.
adverse.zh: 项目由于恶劣的天气条件而延误。

bulletin.en: There was a live bulletin reporting on the economy of the city.

junction.en: Turn right at the next junction.

cannon.en: The old fort was equipped with several large cannons.
cannon.zh: 旧的堡垒配备了几门大炮。

latin.en: Latin is no longer spoken as a native language.
latin.zh: 拉丁语已经不再作为母语使用。

update.en: "You need to update your computer to the latest version of the operating system."
update.zh: 你需要将你的电脑更新到最新的操作系统版本。

nickel.en: The factory produces nickel and other metals.
nickel.zh: 这家工厂生产镍和其他金属。

accustom.en: You'll soon accustom yourself to the new routine.
accustom.zh: 你很快就会适应新的日常安排。

propaganda.en: "The government was accused of spreading propaganda about the benefits of its controversial policies."
propaganda.zh: 政府被指责传播关于其有争议政策好处的宣传。

sulphur.en: Sulphur is a basic input in the manufacturing of sulphuric acid. - 硫磺是制造硫酸的基本原料。

refuge.en: The cave provided a refuge from the storm.
refuge.zh: 这个洞穴是风暴的避难所。

certainty.en: There is a great deal of certainty that we will win the competition.
certainty.zh: 我们赢得比赛的可能性非常大。

spine.en: Our spine helps us to stand up nice and straight.

commend.en: "Her teacher commended her for the improvements in her work."
commend.zh: 她的老师表扬了她的工作成绩有所提升。

parasite.en: Mosquitoes are often parasites, drawing blood from humans.
parasite.zh: 蚊子常常是寄生虫，从人类身上吸取血液。

deficiency.en: Due to the deficiency of rainfall this year, we'll have to be conservative with our water usage.
deficiency.zh: 由于今年降雨量的缺乏，我们必须节约用水。

prick.en: There was a prick on her foot which turned out to be a thorn.
prick.zh: 她的脚上刺痛，原来是扎上了刺。

compatible.en: Jan and Fred are too different. They will never be compatible.

spectrum.en: The spectrum of light from a star is analyzed by the spectrograph.
spectrum.zh: 光谱仪分析来自星星的光谱。

valve.en: The mechanic removed the dirt to clear the engine valve.

refund.en: I asked for a refund because the shoes I bought were too tight.

blaze.en: The forest was set ablaze by the storm last night.
blaze.zh: 昨晚的风暴引发了森林大火。

multitude.en: A multitude of people attended the concert.
multitude.zh: 有大量的人参加了音乐会。

excel.en: Jenny excels at playing the piano.

fake.en: The model was wearing fake hair.

bizarre.en: My bizarre dreams make no sense to me when I am awake.

conspiracy.en: The businessman thought there was a conspiracy among his coworkers to get him fired.

archeology.en: He studied archeology to learn more about ancient Egyptian culture.

fossil.en: The expert arranged the fossils to build the skeleton of the dinosaur.

poke.en: Don't poke your nose into my affairs!

calorie.en: My sister is on a low-calorie diet for fitness training.

mercury.en: "Mercury is the smallest planet in the solar system."
mercury.zh: 水星是太阳系中最小的一颗行星

interact.en: It's important for children to interact with each other.
interact.zh: 儿童之间的互动是非常重要的。

seemingly.en: She shrugged off his seemingly harsh criticism with a smile.
seemingly.zh: 她笑着对他看似尖酸刻薄的批评不以为然。

attendant.en: He is an attendant at the gym.

pneumonia.en: Elaine got pneumonia after playing outside in the rain without a coat.

array.en: We saw a stunning array of colors as the sun set.
array.zh: 我们看到了太阳落山时色彩斑斓的景象

discriminate.en: We should never discriminate on the basis of color, religion, or nationality.
discriminate.zh: 我们绝不应该因肤色、宗教或民族而歧视他人。

repay.en: I must repay the money I borrowed from you.
repay.zh: 我必须偿还我从你那里借的钱。

monetary.en: A strong monetary policy is important for a country to be successful.

serial.en: The serial number of this product is on the bottom.
serial.zh: 这个产品的序列号在底部。

comic.en: This comic book is very popular among children.
comic.zh: 这本漫画书在儿童中非常受欢迎。

psychiatry.en: Studying psychiatry has taught me a lot about mental illness.

spouse.en: I live in a home with my spouse and our two children.

isle.en: There is a beautiful isle in the middle of the lake.
isle.zh: 湖中央有个美丽的小岛。

quota.en: The country has exceeded its quota of wheat production this year.
quota.zh: 今年这个国家已经超过了小麦产量的配额。

scorn.en: He felt a deep sense of scorn for them.
scorn.zh: 他对他们感到深深的鄙视。

sulfur.en: The smell of sulfur filled the air.
sulfur.zh: 空气中弥漫着硫磺的味道

grief.en: His sudden death caused great grief to his poor mother.
grief.zh: 他的突然去世给他可怜的母亲带来了巨大的悲痛。

unlikely.en: It is unlikely that he will turn up.

sprinkle.en: "She likes to sprinkle sugar on her cereal."

municipal.en: The municipal parking lot downtown can fit one hundred cars.

criterion.en: Each application is judged on its own merits and against a set of criteria.
criterion.zh: 每个申请都根据其自身的优点和一套标准进行评判。

essence.en: The essence of her argument is that the economy is improving.
essence.zh: 她的论点的核心是经济正在改善。

maneuver.en: In order to surprise the enemy, our troops performed an elaborate maneuver at dawn.
maneuver.zh: 为了惊讶敌人，我们的军队在黎明时分执行了一个精心策划的策略。

vegetarian.en: "I am a vegetarian, I don't eat meat."
vegetarian.zh: 我是素食主义者, 我不吃肉。

turbulent.en: The country is going through a turbulent period.
turbulent.zh: 这个国家正在经历一个动荡的时期。

precedent.en: This ruling will set a precedent for future cases.
precedent.zh: 这个裁决将为未来的案件设定先例。

dubious.en: The police thought that the man’s description of the crime was dubious.

intuition.en: I had an intuition that something was wrong.
intuition.zh: 我有种直觉，觉得有事情不对劲。

finite.en: The resources of the earth are finite.

amend.en: The countries were in agreement that the treaty needed to be amended.

parachute.en: He jumped out of the plane and deployed the parachute.
parachute.zh: 他跳出飞机, 打开了降落伞。

pharmacy.en: My mother sells medicine to people at the pharmacy.

monarch.en: Queen Elizabeth II is the monarch of the United Kingdom.
monarch.zh: 伊丽莎白二世女王是英国的君主。

archaeology.en: He enjoyed visiting the Great Pyramids of Egypt because he loves archaeology.

exempt.en: Some items are exempt from sales tax.

aesthetic.en: The dresses were noteworthy for their aesthetic design.

carbohydrate.en: Carbohydrates like rice are a good source of energy for active people.

eject.en: Press the button to eject the disc from your computer.
eject.zh: 按下按钮，从你的电脑中弹出光盘。

rim.en: The rim of the coffee cup was stained.
rim.zh: 咖啡杯的边缘沾上了污渍。

rip.en: He attempted to rip the paper off the package, but it was too well taped.
rip.zh: 他试图撕开包裹上的纸，但纸被胶带粘得太牢。

melody.en: She whistled a happy melody as she walked along the road.
melody.zh: 她一边走路一边吹着快乐的调子。

epoch.en: "The invention of gunpowder was an epoch in the history of warfare."
epoch.zh: 火药的发明是战争历史上的一个时代。

retail.en: "She opened her own retail shop after years of working for someone else."
retail.zh: 她在为别人工作了很多年后开了自己的零售店。

extravagant.en: She was known for her extravagant lifestyle.
extravagant.zh: 她以奢华的生活方式而闻名。

accommodate.zh: 这家酒店可以容纳500名客人。

polar.en: Polar bears live in the Arctic.

synthesis.en: The treaty is a synthesis of traditional and modern values.
synthesis.zh: 这项条约是传统和现代价值观的结合。

historian.en: The historian spent decades studying the ancient civilization.
historian.zh: 这位历史学家花了数十年的时间研究这个古代文明。

meditate.en: "You should find a quiet room to meditate."
meditate.zh: "你应该找个安静的房间进行冥想。"

moan.en: 动词形式：He often moans about his job.
moan.zh: 他经常抱怨自己的工作。

mode.en: Melissa turned the TV to quiet mode while she talked on the phone.

elapse.en: Several hours elapsed before the news was widely disseminated.
elapse.zh: 在新闻被广泛传播之前，好几个小时已经过去了。

symmetry.en: The symmetry of the human body is amazing.
symmetry.zh: 人体的对称性令人惊叹。

reap.en: Farmers are busy reaping the wheat in the fields.
reap.zh: 农民们正在田里忙着收割麦子。

presume.en: Since the girl raised her hand, the teacher presumed she knew the answer.

complement.en: The spicy flavors of the food are well complemented by the sweet wine.
complement.zh: 美食的辛辣口感被甜酒很好地补充了。

adhere.en: Chalk doesn't adhere well to a wet surface
adhere.zh: 在湿润的表面，粉笔不易粘附

mobilize.en: Thousands of soldiers were ready to mobilize for the fight.

mock.en: 动词: He often mocks his brother for being too sensitive.
mock.zh: 他经常取笑他的弟弟过于敏感。

facilitate.en: To facilitate the meeting, Melissa used a simple computer program.

undermine.en: The documents helped to undermine the workers’ trust in their bosses’ honesty.

poultry.en: He raises poultry and sells their meat for extra money.

blunt.en: The knife is so blunt that it can't cut through the meat.
blunt.zh: 这把刀太钝了，割不动肉。

analogy.en: The teacher drew an analogy between the heart and a pump.
analogy.zh: 老师将心脏与泵进行了类比。

hypothesis.en: His theory started as a hypothesis.
hypothesis.zh: 他的理论起初只是一个假设。

comprehend.en: "He could not comprehend why she did what she did."
comprehend.zh: 他无法理解她为何做了她所做的事。

legend.en: People say that a golden treasure is buried somewhere here, but now it remains a legend.
legend.zh: 人们说这里埋有一笔金色的宝藏，但现在它仍然是一个传说。

testify.en: He was called to testify about the project's progress before the board.
testify.zh: 他被召唤在董事会前作证该项目的进展。

apt.en: He is apt to forget things under stress.

reed.en: He constructed a small boat using reeds from the lake.
reed.zh: 他用湖中的芦苇造了一只小船。

reel.en: The movie is now on the reel.
reel.zh: 这部电影现在已经在胶片上了。

pathetic.en: It was a pathetic attempt to win her back.
pathetic.zh: 那是他为赢回她做的可怜努力。

overtime.en: Employees who work overtime get paid extra.
overtime.zh: 加班的员工能得到额外的支付。

predecessor.en: His predecessor left him a fine legacy.
predecessor.zh: 他的前任给他留下了丰富的遗产

odor.en: He knew there was a leak when he noticed the strong odor of natural gas.

trolley.en: She pushed a heavy trolley loaded with bags.
trolley.zh: 她推着一台装满包的重手推车。

captive.en: The soldiers held the enemy as a captive.
captive.zh: 士兵们把敌人控制为俘虏。

dividend.en: Most of the company's profits are paid out as dividends to shareholders.
dividend.zh: 公司的大部分利润都作为股息发放给股东。

stitch.en: She quickly took up a needle and began to stitch.
stitch.zh: 她迅速拿起针线开始缝补。

esteem.en: "He is held in high esteem by his colleagues."
esteem.zh: 他受到同事们的高度尊重。

shear.en: The farmer is shearing the sheep.

suppress.zh: 他抑制了自己的怒火和挫败感。

tumor.en: The doctor said the tumor was malignant.
tumor.zh: 医生说这个肿瘤是恶性的。

supervise.en: He supervised the construction of the new bridge.

fabulous.en: This strawberry is the best I’ve ever had. It’s fabulous.

vulnerable.en: The ceasefire has left the city vulnerable to attack.
vulnerable.zh: 停火使得城市容易受到攻击。

preach.en: He used to preach the gospel in the countryside.
preach.zh: 他过去常在乡村里传播福音。

donate.en: They donate money to charity every month.
donate.zh: 他们每个月都向慈善机构捐钱。

rein.en: The jockey pulled the reins to slow down his horse.
rein.zh: 骑师拉紧缰绳，让马慢下来。

overlap.en: Our work schedules overlap, so we can share a ride to work.
overlap.zh: 我们的工作时间重叠，所以我们可以共享一次工作日的乘车。

assassinate.en: The plot to assassinate the president was discovered just in time.
assassinate.zh: 刺杀总统的阴谋被及时发现。

crow.en: As a noun: The crow is known for its intelligence and adaptability.
crow.zh: 乌鸦以其聪明和适应性而闻名。

novelty.en: The novelty of the toy attracted the attention of the children.
novelty.zh: 这个新潮的玩具吸引了孩子们的注意。

situated.en: "The hotel is situated near the beach."

momentum.en: The campaign has been gaining momentum in recent weeks.
momentum.zh: 近几周来，这场运动的势头越来越猛。

discourse.en: The President's discourse covered a broad range of topics.
discourse.zh: 总统的发言涵盖了各种各样的话题

obstruct.en: The car broke down on the road and obstructed traffic for hours.

stairway.en: He ascended the stairway to his room.
stairway.zh: 他上楼梯进入他的房间。

cape.en: She wore a red silk cape to the masquerade.
cape.zh: 她穿了一件红色的丝绸披风去参加化妆舞会。

thanksgiving.en: We have a big family dinner every year on Thanksgiving.
thanksgiving.zh: 我们每年感恩节都会举行一个大家庭晚餐。

hijack.en: The terrorists attempted to hijack a plane.
hijack.zh: 恐怖分子试图劫持一架飞机。

princess.en: She is the princess of a small kingdom.
princess.zh: 她是一个小王国的公主。

elevate.en: We need to elevate the level of our discussion.
elevate.zh: 我们应该提高我们讨论的水平。

designate.en: I designate you as my official representative.
designate.zh: 我指定你为我的正式代表。

humiliate.en: I was humiliated when I tripped and fell down in front of the whole school.

canvas.en: The artist was staring at a blank canvas, waiting for inspiration.
canvas.zh: 那位艺术家盯着一块空白的画布，等待灵感的降临。

assault.en: "The victim was afraid to report the assault to the police."
assault.zh: 受害人害怕向警方报告这次袭击。

cherry.en: She picked a basket of cherries from the tree.
cherry.zh: 她从树上摘了一篮子樱桃

feminine.en: She has a very feminine voice.

heighten.en: The pleasant music heightened their enjoyment of the wonderful dinner.

plateau.en: The Tibetan Plateau in China is the highest plateau in the world.
plateau.zh: 中国的青藏高原是世界上最高的高原。

mischief.en: The children are always getting up to mischief when they're bored.
mischief.zh: 孩子们每当无聊的时候总爱胡闹。

reliance.en: "Our reliance on fossil fuels has caused many environmental problems."
reliance.zh: 我们对化石燃料的依赖引发了许多环境问题。

acrobat.en: There were acrobats at the circus that did impressive and complicated jumps.

transistor.en: "Transistor radios were a breakthrough in technology, they were small enough to take virtually anywhere."
transistor.zh: 晶体管收音机是技术的一大突破，它们小到可以几乎带到任何地方。

persevere.en: Despite the difficulties, she decided to persevere with her job.
persevere.zh: 尽管有困难，她决定坚持她的工作。

shatter.en: He dropped the glass, and it shattered on the floor.
shatter.zh: 他把杯子掉在地上，结果碎了一地。

glamour.en: The young woman showed of her glamour during the photo shoot.

ascertain.en: It's difficult to ascertain the truth.

compliment.en: I would like to **compliment** you on your excellent performance.
compliment.zh: 我想要赞美你的卓越表现。

imitation.en: He does an excellent imitation of the manager's mannerisms.
imitation.zh: 他对经理的习性模仿得很像

comply.en: All staff must comply with the safety regulations.
comply.zh: 所有员工必须遵守安全规定。

deviate.en: The plane had to deviate from its course to avoid the storm.
deviate.zh: 为避免暴风雨，飞机不得不偏离其航线。

saw.en: I saw a beautiful sunset yesterday.
saw.zh: 昨天我看见了美丽的日落。

affiliate.en: Many local radio stations are affiliated with national networks.
affiliate.zh: 许多当地的广播电台都附属于全国性的广播网络。

canoe.en: He paddled his canoe to the edge of the lake.

wedge.en: He used a wedge to stop the door from closing.
wedge.zh: 他用一个楔子阻止门关上。

alienate.en: His aloofness serves only to alienate him from his team. 他的冷漠只会使他与团队疏离。

plague.en: The bubonic plague was a disaster in medieval Europe.
plague.zh: 鼠疫在中世纪的欧洲是一场灾难。

retrospect.en: In retrospect, he made the right choice.
retrospect.zh: 回顾起来, 他做了正确的选择。

pamphlet.en: He picked up a tourist pamphlet from the hotel lobby.
pamphlet.zh: 他在酒店的大堂里拿了一份旅游宣传册。

artery.en: Arteries carry blood from the heart to all parts of the body.
artery.zh: 动脉将血从心脏输送到身体的每一个部位。

sponge.en: I need a new sponge to wash my dishes.
sponge.zh: 我需要一个新的海绵来清洗我的餐具。

insulate.en: We need to insulate the wires before we can finish the installation.
insulate.zh: 在我们完成安装之前，需要先给电线做绝缘处理。

petition.en: They sent a petition to the government requesting an investigation into the matter.
petition.zh: 他们向政府发送了一份请愿书，要求对此事进行调查。

vicinity.en: I live in the vicinity of the school.

jug.en: Please pour the milk into the jug.

precede.en: The movie was preceded by a short documentary.
precede.zh: 这部电影之前播放了一个短片纪录片。

stroll.en: My dog and I strolled through the park today.

differentiate.en: It was hard to differentiate between the identical twins.

plaster.en: I need to plaster the cut on my arm.
plaster.zh: 我需要在我胳膊上的切口处贴上创可贴。

metropolitan.en: New York is a hustling metropolitan city attracting millions of tourists each year.
metropolitan.zh: 纽约是一个繁忙的大都会城市，每年吸引数百万游客。

suspicious.en: Dad was suspicious of the caller on the line.

renovate.en: The old fire station was renovated into an apartment building.

deem.en: I deem his efforts as vital to the project's success.
deem.zh: 我认为他的努力对项目的成功至关重要。

conversion.en: The city discussed the conversion of the parking lot into a skateboard park.

slaughter.en: The slaughter of innocent people must be condemned.
slaughter.zh: 无辜的人们被屠杀是必须要谴责的。

maiden.en: She is a sweet maiden of sixteen.

stereo.en: I just bought a new stereo.
stereo.zh: 我刚买了一个新的立体声设备。

defy.en: The students got into trouble for defying their teacher’s rules.

doctrine.en: The professor was fired for not adhering to the university's doctrine.
doctrine.zh: 由于不遵守大学的教条，教授被解雇了。

sly.en: The sly fox stole the eggs from the nest.

pursuit.en: He left law school to devote more time to his musical pursuits.
pursuit.zh: 他离开了法学院，投入更多的时间在他的音乐追求上。

ruthless.en: He is a ruthless businessman who will stop at nothing to succeed.
ruthless.zh: 他是一名无情的商人，为了成功什么都愿意做。

lure.en: The promise of easy money is a lure to many people.
lure.zh: 简单得来的金钱对许多人都有吸引力。

thorn.en: Be careful with the rose, it has thorns.

deceit.en: His generosity was just a cloak for his deceit.
deceit.zh: 他的慷慨只是掩盖他的欺骗。

intermittent.en: I've been having intermittent problems with my computer.
intermittent.zh: 我的电脑一直有断断续续的问题。

outrage.en: He was outraged when his proposal was turned down.

scramble.zh: 战斗机被命令紧急起飞。

immerse.en: Immerse the cloth in the dye.

champagne.en: Let's toast to your success with a glass of champagne.
champagne.zh: 让我们举杯祝贺你的成功

proclaim.en: The government proclaimed a state of emergency after the flood.
proclaim.zh: "政府在洪水之后宣布进入紧急状态。"

predominant.en: Before cars were invented, horses were the predominant method of travel.

console.en: The developer used the console to check the system's status.
console.zh: 开发者用控制台来检查系统的状态。

clockwise.en: Turn the screw clockwise to tighten it.

overthrow.en: "The rebels attempted to overthrow the government."

stumble.en: She stumbles a lot when she is drunk.

cunning.en: A cunning plan was devised to rescue the hostage.
cunning.zh: 人们设计了一个狡猾的计划来营救人质。

stool.en: I don’t find stools very comfortable to sit on.

specialty.zh: 她的专长是意大利料理。

coherent.en: This was a coherent program for solving the flooding problem.

intercourse.en: Social intercourse is an indispensable part of life.
intercourse.zh: 社交是生活不可或缺的一部分。

ponder.en: I need some time to ponder your proposal.
ponder.zh: 我需要一些时间来考虑你的提议。

composite.en: "The bridge is made of a composite material that combines steel and concrete."
composite.zh: 这座桥是由钢和混凝土组合的复合材料制成的。

hinder.en: Bad weather hindered our travel plans.
hinder.zh: 恶劣的天气妨碍了我们的旅行计划。

scent.en: "The air is filled with the sweet scent of spring."
scent.zh: 空气中充满了甜美的春天气息。

trench.en: Soldiers dug a trench and took up positions there.
trench.zh: 士兵们挖了一条壕沟并在那里布置阵地

hike.en: I often hike in the mountains on the weekends.
hike.zh: 我经常在周末时去山上远足

smuggle.en: He was caught trying to smuggle drugs into the country.
smuggle.zh: 他被抓住试图向国内走私毒品。

sue.zh: 你如果敢的话就来起诉我！

audit.en: The government usually audits companies that report lower than usual incomes.

texture.en: Look at the fine texture of this silk.
texture.zh: 看看这丝绸的细腻质地。

bud.en: The buds on the tree are beginning to burst.
bud.zh: 树上的芽开始要爆发了。

cloak.en: She drew her cloak around her to keep out the cold.
cloak.zh: 她把披风围在身上以抵御寒冷。

bug.en: "There is a bug in this software that's causing difficulties."
bug.zh: 这个软件里有个bug，正在引发问题。

cricket.en: I love watching cricket on TV.
cricket.zh: 我喜欢看电视上的板球比赛。

ignite.en: Be careful with that match or you'll ignite the whole stack of papers.
ignite.zh: 小心那支火柴，否则你会把整堆纸都点燃。

revelation.en: The revelation of his true identity shocked everyone.
revelation.zh: 他真实身份的揭示使所有人都震惊。

quest.en: They embarked on a quest to discover the lost city.
quest.zh: 他们开始了寻找失落之城的追求。

dismay.en: She couldn't hide her dismay at the result.
dismay.zh: 她无法掩饰她对结果的失望。

expend.en: We expend a lot of time and effort on this project.
expend.zh: 我们在这个项目上花费了大量的时间和精力。

throne.en: The king sat on his throne.

inventory.en: Gwen was checking the inventory to make sure we had what we needed.

flush.en: Her cheeks were flush with embarrassment.

kit.en: Is there a first aid kit in your office?

turnover.en: The annual turnover of the company is over 10 million dollars.
turnover.zh: 这家公司的年营业额超过一千万美元。

mortal.en: As a mortal, we all have limited time on earth.
mortal.zh: 作为凡人，我们在地球上的时间都是有限的。

brutal.en: War is often a brutal and bloody affair.
brutal.zh: 战争通常是残酷和血腥的。

commemorate.en: We gather here to commemorate the founding of our school.
commemorate.zh: 我们在这里聚集，以纪念我们学校的创建。

drought.en: After three months of drought, the vegetation and trees started dying.

periodical.en: This information is published in the quarterly periodical.
periodical.zh: 这些信息是在季度期刊上发布的。

leaflet.en: They were handing out leaflets in the street.
leaflet.zh: 他们在街上分发小册子。

fringe.en: The city is on the fringe of the desert.
fringe.zh: 这个城市位于沙漠的边缘。

simulate.en: The flight simulator is used to simulate real flight conditions for pilot training.
simulate.zh: 飞行模拟器被用来模拟真实的飞行条件，用于飞行员训练。

inclusive.en: The price is inclusive of meals and accommodation.
inclusive.zh: 价格包含了餐饮和住宿费用。

spectacle.en: Niagara Falls is quite a spectacle.

ethnic.en: This is an ethnic museum which presents various cultures and histories.。
ethnic.zh: 这是一个展示各种文化和历史的民族博物馆。

intact.en: The ancient monument has miraculously remained intact for centuries.
intact.zh: 这座古代纪念碑奇迹般地保存完好，已有几个世纪了。

flaw.en: The flaw in the diamond reduced its value significantly.
flaw.zh: 钻石中的瑕疵大大降低了其价值。

assert.en: "I assert that this method is the most effective."
assert.zh: 我坚决宣称这个方法是最有效的。

climax.en: The climax of the movie left the audience in awe.
climax.zh: 电影的高潮部分让观众惊叹不已。

flap.en: As a noun: The letter had a red seal on the flap.
flap.zh: 信封的口子上封着红色的印章。

token.en: This coin is a token of my appreciation for your help.
token.zh: 这枚硬币是我对你的帮助表示感谢的象征

spectator.en: There were thousands of spectators at the big game.

hygiene.en: People who brush their teeth at least twice a day are practicing good hygiene.

conspicuous.en: His bright red hair made him conspicuous in the crowd.
conspicuous.zh: 他鲜艳的红发在人群中非常引人注目。

furious.en: Her sudden resignation left her boss furious.
furious.zh: 她突然的辞职让她的老板非常愤怒。

tan.en: As a noun: After spending the day at the beach, she had a beautiful tan.
tan.zh: 她在海滩上度过了一天，晒得皮肤黝黑。

tar.en: The road was paved with tar.

constrain.en: Jim cannot join us because he is constrained by previous plans.

blueprint.en: The architect drew up a blueprint for the new house.
blueprint.zh: 建筑师为新房子准备了设计蓝图。

interim.en: She will be acting head of the department in the interim. 她将在此过渡期间暂时担任部门主管。

glitter.en: The dress is covered in glitter.
glitter.zh: 这件衣服上面覆盖着亮片。

reflexion.en: The moonlight made a bright reflexion on the water.
reflexion.zh: 月光在水面上投下了明亮的反射。

geology.en: "He's studying geology at university, hoping to become a geologist."
geology.zh: 他在大学里学习地质学，希望成为一名地质学家。

hoist.en: They hoisted the flag at dawn.
hoist.zh: 他们在黎明时分升起了国旗。

numerical.en: Numerical analysis is a complex field of mathematics.
numerical.zh: 数值分析是数学的一个复杂领域。

eligible.en: Only people who bought tickets were eligible to win a prize.

glacier.en: The North Pole is covered by a huge glacier.

orientation.en: The orientation of the building allows plenty of sunshine.
orientation.zh: 这座建筑的朝向使得可以接收到充足的阳光。

build.en: They decided to build a new bridge over the river.
build.zh: 他们决定在河上建一座新桥。

math.en: I have a math test tomorrow.
math.zh: 我明天有一个数学考试

examination.en: She has an examination in mathematics tomorrow.

get.en: "I need to get a new dress for the party."
get.zh: 我需要为派对买一条新裙子。

lie.en: Whenever Pinocchio lied to his father, his nose grew.

hurt.en: He hurt his leg while playing football.

exam.en: I did some practice questions for the math exam on the board.

lend.en: My sister lost her pen, so I will lend her mine.

ride.en: I ride my bicycle to school every day.
ride.zh: 我每天都骑自行车上学。

leaf.en: The leaves are falling from the trees.

win.en: Our team will win the match.
win.zh: 我们的队伍将会赢得这场比赛。

daytime.en: The kids are only allowed to play outside in the daytime.

see.en: Steven does not want to see the scary picture.

dolphin.en: Intelligent dolphins have learned to communicate with humans.

grandparent.en: My grandparents live in the countryside.

surprised.en: He didn’t appear at all surprised when he read the article.

think.en: I think summer is the best season.

bother.en: Don't bother me when I'm working.
bother.zh: 我工作的时候不要打扰我。

completely.en: The house was completely destroyed in the fire.
completely.zh: 这座房子在火灾中被彻底摧毁。

shake.en: She began to shake with fear.

madam.en: "Would you like a cup of tea, madam?"

bike.en: He rides his bike to school every day.

sweden.en: I will be traveling to Sweden next month.

carefully.en: The baby carefully climbed down the stairs.

us.en: He gave us his phone number.
us.zh: 他给了我们他的电话号码。

educational.en: The government has increased its spending on educational programs.
educational.zh: 政府增加了对教育项目的投入。

surf.en: She loves to surf, regardless of weather.
surf.zh: 她喜欢冲浪，不论天气如何。

terrified.en: When I saw the ghost, I was absolutely terrified!

bring.en: Can you bring me the book?

grow.en: The plants grow quickly in the spring.
grow.zh: 植物在春天里快速生长。

goose.en: The goose is swimming in the pond.

beat.en: We have to beat the deadline.
beat.zh: 我们必须在截止日期前完成。

take.en: Please take the book on the table.

tenth.en: This is the tenth time you've been late this week.
tenth.zh: 这是你这周第十次迟到。

shelf.en: "I bought a new shelf for my room."
shelf.zh: 我为我的房间买了一个新的架子。

exciting.en: This is an exciting opportunity for us.
exciting.zh: 这对我们来说是一个令人兴奋的机会。

sell.en: I decided to sell my old car.
sell.zh: 我决定把我的旧车卖掉。

wake.en: I usually wake up at 6 a.m.

awake.en: As a verb: "I usually awake at six in the morning."
awake.zh: 我通常在早晨六点醒来。

hear.en: Michelle cannot hear what you are saying.

choose.en: She had to choose between two courses.
choose.zh: 她必须在两门课程中做出选择。

creativity.en: He has shown great creativity in his approach to the problem.
creativity.zh: 他对问题的处理显示出了极其显著的创造力。

mr.en: Mr. Smith is my English teacher.
mr.zh: 史密斯先生是我的英语老师。

scoop.en: She uses a scoop to measure the flour.

environmental.en: Environmental pollution is a global issue.
environmental.zh: 环境污染是全球性的问题。

wear.en: The man has to wear a suit to work.

could.en: When he was young, he could run very fast.
could.zh: 他年轻的时候能跑得很快。

grandfather.en: My grandfather was a renowned scholar.
grandfather.zh: 我的祖父是一个知名的学者。

hold.en: Damian will soon hold a degree in business administration.

dr.en: Dr. Smith is a very professional pediatrician.
dr.zh: 史密斯医生是一位非常专业的儿科医生。

dj.en: The DJ played my favorite song at the club.
dj.zh: DJ在夜店播放了我的最爱歌曲。

reusable.en: Saburo keeps his empty jelly jars because they are reusable for storing sewing supplies.

lose.en: I always lose my keys in the house.
lose.zh: 我总是在家里找不到钥匙。

ecosystem.en: The deforestation has caused damage to the local ecosystem.
ecosystem.zh: 过度的森林砍伐对当地的生态系统造成了破坏。

meet.en: I'm scheduled to meet with my manager tomorrow.
meet.zh: 我预定了明天和我的经理见面。

throw.en: He decided to throw the ball to his dog.
throw.zh: 他决定把球扔给他的狗。

actually.en: She is not his sister, but actually his girlfriend.
actually.zh: 她不是他的姐姐，而是他的女朋友。

warn.en: "The weather forecast warned of severe storms."
warn.zh: 天气预报警告有严重的暴风雨。

pc.en: He is surfing the internet on his PC.
pc.zh: 他在他的个人电脑上上网。

impolite.en: Roger is impolite to everyone he meets.

foot.en: I stepped on a thorn with my bare foot.

endangered.en: The whooping crane is an endangered species.

goddess.en: Greek mythology tells of many powerful goddesses, such as Athena, the goddess of wisdom.
goddess.zh: 希腊神话中讲述了很多强大的女神，比如智慧之神雅典娜。

suddenly.en: I was surprised when my friends suddenly shouted, “Happy birthday!”

blonde.en: My cousin is a blonde with blue eyes.

eat.zh: 我通常在早晨7点吃早餐

sweep.en: He is sweeping the floor with a broom.

lead.en: I will lead you to the right place.

indoors.en: She stayed indoors all day because of the rain.
indoors.zh: 由于下雨，她整天都待在室内。

mistake.en: My boss always yells at me when I make a mistake.

vcd.en: "I am converting my old home videos to VCD so they can be preserved."
vcd.zh: 我正在将我那些旧的家庭录像转成VCD，以便保存。

hang.en: Hang your coat on the rack.
hang.zh: 把你的外套挂在衣架上。

set.en: As a verb: "Please set the table for dinner."

program.en: She finished the teacher training program last year.
program.zh: 她在去年完成了教师培训程序。

steal.en: "He was caught trying to steal a car."
steal.zh: 他被抓到正试图偷一辆车。

rapidly.en: The train moved rapidly on the tracks.

dishonest.en: She was dishonest about her qualifications and got fired.
dishonest.zh: 她在个人资历上不诚实，结果被解雇了。

ms.en: "Ms. Taylor, could you please explain the math problem again?"
ms.zh: 泰勒小姐，你能再解释一下这个数学问题吗？

sing.en: "She loves to sing in the shower."
sing.zh: 她喜欢在淋浴的时候唱歌。

eleventh.en: He joined the team on the eleventh of May.
eleventh.zh: 他在五月的第十一天加入了我们的团队。

trader.en: The trader purchased several valuable antiques at the auction.
trader.zh: 这个商人在拍卖会上购买了几件珍贵的古董。

grey.en: Her hair has turned grey with age.
grey.zh: 她的头发因为年纪大而变灰了。

sandy.en: I love walking on a sandy beach.

satisfied.en: I am very satisfied with your work.

catch.en: Did you catch the ball during the baseball game?

drive.en: "Can you drive me to the airport?"
drive.zh: 你能开车送我去机场吗？

ring.en: He gave me a gold ring as a token of his love.
ring.zh: 他送给我一只金戒指，作为他的爱的象征。

banker.en: My neighbor works as a banker in a local bank.
banker.zh: 我的邻居在一家本地银行做银行家。

understand.en: Henry could not understand the message.

reader.en: The book is intended for the average reader.
reader.zh: 这本书是为普通读者写的

magician.en: The magician performed an amazing card trick.
magician.zh: 那个魔术师表演了一个令人惊奇的纸牌魔术。

mouse.en: There is a mouse in the kitchen.

know.en: "Do you know the answer to the quiz?"

speak.en: Can you speak a little louder? I can't hear you.
speak.zh: 你能不能再大声一点说话？我听不清楚。

mrs.zh: 史密斯夫人是我的老师。

feed.en: I feed my cat twice a day.

olympics.en: "The Olympics foster a sense of global unity that's all too rare these days."-
olympics.zh: 现在，很少有东西能像奥运会一样增强全球的团结感。

prediction.en: His prediction about the outcome was correct.
prediction.zh: 他对结果的预测是准确的。

listener.en: "The radio station has millions of listeners."
listener.zh: 这个广播电台有数百万的听众。

practise.en: You need to practise your English every day.

correctly.en: Always remember to use the equipment correctly.
correctly.zh: 一定要记得正确使用设备。

make.en: Can you make a cake for my birthday?
make.zh: 你可以为我的生日做个蛋糕吗？

oversee.en: His job was to oversee the progress of the construction project.

compassionate.en: The compassionate nurse tried to make the sick man feel comfortable.

irritable.en: She is irritable when she doesn’t get enough sleep.

reserved.en: He is a reserved personality and does not talk too much.
reserved.zh: 他是一个内向的人，不怎么爱说话。

tickle.en: I couldn't help laughing when he started to tickle me.
tickle.zh: 当他开始挠我痒的时候，我忍不住笑出来了。

flip.en: To turn on the lights, just flip this switch.

populate.en: Billions of people populate the Earth.

irrelevant.en: Your argument is completely irrelevant to the discussion.
irrelevant.zh: 你的论点与讨论完全无关。

foreseeable.en: It is not foreseeable that the situation will improve shortly.
foreseeable.zh: 目前尚无迹象表明局势将短期内好转。

vice versa.en: Students learn from their teachers, and vice versa.

inflate.en: I helped him inflate the balloons.

pollutant.en: Air pollutants are predominantly in urban areas.
pollutant.zh: 城市地区的空气污染物居多。

availability.en: The availability of affordable housing is a significant issue in the city.
availability.zh: 在这个城市，负担得起的房屋的可得性是一个重要的问题。

creation.en: We saw the creation of a new political party.

inclination.en: He has an inclination to disregard rules.

manor.en: The manor had over forty rooms and beautiful gardens.

vitality.en: Tom is admired for his boundless vitality.
vitality.zh: 汤姆因其无尽的活力而受到许多人的羡慕。

millennium.en: Stonehenge is believed to have been built about five millennia ago.

stark.en: There is a stark contrast between their test scores.

nordic.en: "Nordic countries are known for their social welfare systems."
nordic.zh: 北欧国家以他们的社会福利系统而闻名。

outlaw.en: The police passed out posters of the outlaw to all the people.

corps.en: He was a member of the diplomatic corps.

grassy.en: The sheep were grazing in a grassy field.
grassy.zh: 绵羊在长满草的田地里吃草。

paralysis.en: After the accident, he suffered from paralysis in his legs.
paralysis.zh: 事故后，他的腿部出现了麻痹。

distinctive.en: He has a very distinctive voice.

requisite.en: The requisite qualifications for this job are both a degree and experience in the field.
requisite.zh: 这份工作所需的资格是学位和领域经验。

limestone.en: The Great Pyramid of Giza in Egypt was built entirely of limestone.
limestone.zh: 埃及的吉萨大金字塔完全由石灰石建造。

inventive.en: The inventive student built a robot to help her with her chores.

deterioration.en: There has been a significant deterioration in air quality due to industrial pollution.
deterioration.zh: 由于工业污染，空气质量显著恶化。

brew.en: She likes to brew her own beer at home.
brew.zh: 她喜欢在家里自己酿制啤酒。

cosmopolitan.en: There are dozens of different types of restaurants in a cosmopolitan city.

disseminate.en: The organization disseminates information about the dangers of smoking.

irregularity.en: The doctor noted the irregularity of his patient's heartbeat.
irregularity.zh: 医生注意到他的病人心跳的不规则。

ethical.en: Many people believe that it is ethical to help others in need.

trustworthy.en: Mary is one of the most trustworthy people I’ve ever met.

bilingual.en: Since you already know English, after learning French you’ll be bilingual.

brood.en: The bird is guarding her brood.
brood.zh: 那只鸟正在保护她的一窝幼崽。

mandarin.en: Although John’s parents both spoke Mandarin, he could only speak English.

cholesterol.en: Eating fatty foods can increase your cholesterol.
cholesterol.zh: 吃油腻的食物可能会增加你的胆固醇。

mall.zh: 我们镇上新开了一个大型商场。

residential.en: The residential area is quiet and peaceful.
residential.zh: 这个居民区非常安静和平静。

collaboration.en: "The collaboration between the two tech companies led to the development of a revolutionary product."
collaboration.zh: 两家科技公司之间的协作导致了一种革命性产品的开发。

crank.en: He turned the crank and the machine began to work.
crank.zh: 他旋转曲柄，机器开始工作。

modification.en: The modification to the plans will require additional funds.
modification.zh: 对计划的修改将需要额外的资金。

avalanche.en: The avalanche destroyed the mountain village.

registration.en: "Early registration for the conference is closed now."
registration.zh: 会议的提前注册现在已经结束。

astrology.en: Jack, who studies astrology, believes that the stars can predict the future.

censor.en: The film has not yet passed the censor.
censor.zh: 这部电影还未通过审查。

combustion.en: The combustion of coal contributes to air pollution.
combustion.zh: 煤的燃烧导致了空气污染。

biodiversity.en: Biodiversity is a measure of the variety of organisms present in different ecosystems.
biodiversity.zh: 生物多样性是衡量不同生态系统中生物种类丰富程度的一个标准

overestimate.zh: 我觉得你过高地估计了你的说服力。

sanctuary.en: The church was made into a sanctuary for homeless people in the winter.

fitness.en: Regular exercise is the key to fitness.
fitness.zh: 定期锻炼是保持健康的关键。

alignment.zh: 在建筑图纸中，塔楼的排列保证了每个窗户都有完美的视野。

leopard.en: The swift leopard easily caught up with its prey.
leopard.zh: 迅捷的豹轻易地追上了它的猎物。

optimism.en: "Even in the face of difficulties, Jenny's optimism never waned."
optimism.zh: 即使面临困难，珍妮的乐观态度也从未减退。

cumulative.zh: 他在游戏中的累积得分令人印象深刻。
