supervisor.en: "The supervisor monitored the progress of the project regularly."
supervisor.zh: 监督者定期监控项目的进展。

buffalo.en: The buffalo charged through the field.
buffalo.zh: 那头水牛在田野中猛冲。

formulation.en: The project team is in the initial phase of **formulation**.
formulation.zh: 项目团队正在进行初步**制定**阶段。

flask.en: Fill the flask with boiling water.

complexity.en: The complexity of the problem perplexed him.
complexity.zh: 这个问题的复杂性使他困惑。

automatically.en: The man automatically smiled when he thought about his friend.

insane.en: He was declared insane by the court.

slumber.en: "The baby finally fell into a deep slumber after a lot of cajoling."
slumber.zh: 在哄了很久之后，婴儿终于进入了深度睡眠。

sinister.en: Bad guys in most movies have sinister laughs.

glossary.en: The book contains a detailed glossary of all technical terms used.
glossary.zh: 这本书包含了所有使用的技术术语的详尽词汇表。

continuity.en: The power outage interrupted continuity in production.
continuity.zh: 停电打断了生产的连续性。

obscene.en: He was arrested for downloading obscene material from the internet.
obscene.zh: 他因为下载淫秽物品而被捕。

metro.en: "I'd rather take the metro than drive to work."
metro.zh: 我宁愿乘地铁上班，也不愿驾车。

intensify.en: "The government has decided to intensify its efforts against crime."
intensify.zh: 政府决定加强打击犯罪的力度。

souvenir.en: He bought a souvenir from his trip to Paris.
souvenir.zh: 他从巴黎之旅中买了一件纪念品

grid.en: Draw a simple grid on the sheet of paper using a pencil.
grid.zh: 在纸上用铅笔画一个简单的网格。

veterinarian.en: Wanda became a veterinarian because she loves dogs.

foil.en: She foiled his attempt to cheat in the exam.
foil.zh: 她挫败了他作弊的企图。

postgraduate.en: "She is studying for her postgraduate degree in Psychology."
postgraduate.zh: 她正在攻读心理学的研究生学位。

stimulus.en: The stimulus package from the government helped to boost the economy.
stimulus.zh: 政府的刺激计划有助于提振经济

administrative.en: I work as an administrative assistant to the owner of the company.

extinction.en: The extinction of the dodo bird occurred in the 1600s.

aspiration.en: Her greatest aspiration was to become a doctor.
aspiration.zh: 她最大的愿望是成为医生。

pesticide.en: The farmer sprayed his crops with a pesticide to keep bugs away.

conserve.en: We must conserve our woodlands for future generations.
conserve.zh: 我们必须保护森林以供后代使用

promotion.en: She is responsible for the promotion of the new book.
promotion.zh: 她负责新书的宣传工作。

memorable.en: That was indeed a memorable performance.
memorable.zh: 那确实是一场难忘的演出。

context.en: They studied the context of the battle before giving their presentation.

clamp.en: "Please pass me the clamp, I need to fix these pipes."
clamp.zh: 请把夹子递给我，我需要把这些管子固定好。

handout.en: I collected a handout from the station for the new train schedule.
handout.zh: 我从车站收集了一份有关新火车时刻表的传单。

subscription.en: I have a subscription to that magazine.

slump.en: After the new competition entered the market, their sales went into a slump.
slump.zh: 在新竞争者进入市场后，他们的销售量出现了滑坡。

halve.en: We need to halve the cake so everyone gets a piece.
halve.zh: 我们需要把蛋糕切成两半，这样每个人都能分到一块。

nutritious.en: You should try to eat nutritious meals every day.
nutritious.zh: 你应该尽量每天吃富有营养的饭菜。

personalize.en: He personalized the woman’s exercises to give her a better workout.

perimeter.en: Measure the perimeter of the garden before planting the flowers. 在种植花朵之前，先测量花园的周长。

devastating.en: The tsunami had devastating effects on the seaside village.

passionate.en: He's very passionate about the project and could spend hours talking about it.
passionate.zh: 他对这个项目充满热情，可以花几个小时来谈论它。

frustration.en: He threw the phone down in frustration.
frustration.zh: 他气愤地把电话扔了下去。

seek.en: If I have a problem, I seek my sister’s advice.

consequent.en: His success was consequent upon his hard work.
consequent.zh: 他的成功来源于他的辛勤努力。

antibiotic.en: The doctor gave me a shot of an antibiotic when I got the flu.

stammer.en: He managed to stammer out a few words.
stammer.zh: 他结结巴巴地说出了几个字。

slander.en: He was accused of spreading slanders about his colleagues.
slander.zh: 他被指控对同事进行诽谤。

inescapable.en: She felt trapped in an inescapable situation.
inescapable.zh: 她感觉自己陷入了一个无法逃脱的境地。

industrious.en: Dennis was very industrious, so he never had problems finding a job.

hospitable.en: At dinner, my dad was very hospitable to my friends.

cork.en: He pulled the cork out of the wine bottle.

disappointing.zh: 这部电影真的令人失望

refreshment.en: After the meeting, light refreshments were served.
refreshment.zh: 会议过后，提供了一些小点心。

lime.en: The walls were whitewashed with lime.
lime.zh: 墙壁被石灰涂得白白的。

intent.en: Her intent is to visit Italy next summer.

afflict.en: The people are afflicted by the high rate of unemployment.
afflict.zh: 人们因高失业率而痛苦

defence.en: We should put up a strong defence against any forms of pollution to protect our environment.
defence.zh: 我们应该强烈防御任何形式的污染，保护我们的环境。

excavate.en: The team wishes to excavate the site in hope of finding fossils.

charcoal.en: He used charcoal to start the barbecue.

acceptable.en: This level of noise is acceptable to most people.
acceptable.zh: 这种噪音级别对大多数人来说是可以接受的。

confirmation.en: "I am waiting for your confirmation before proceeding with the project."
confirmation.zh: 我在等待你的确认后，再继续进行这个项目。

ceramic.en: The ceramic vase broke when it fell to the floor.
ceramic.zh: 这个陶瓷花瓶摔到地上时碎了

gleam.en: Her eyes were gleaming with happiness.
gleam.zh: 她的眼睛闪耀着幸福的光芒。

conformity.en: In every culture, there is a certain amount of conformity expected from each individual.
conformity.zh: 在每个文化中，都期望每个个人有一定的顺从性。

assimilation.en: The immigrants' assimilation into the American society took a couple of years.
assimilation.zh: 这些移民融入美国社会花了几年时间。

drainage.en: The builder has designed a new drainage system for the construction site.
drainage.zh: 建筑商为建筑工地设计了一个新的排水系统。

triumphant.zh: 胜利的团队庆祝他们的胜利。

marsh.en: The frog jumped from the lily pad into the marsh.
marsh.zh: 那只青蛙从睡莲叶子上跳进了湿地

baffle.zh: 这些指令把我彻底搞糊涂了。

demonstration.en: He gave a demonstration of how to cook the dish.
demonstration.zh: 他做了一个如何烹饪这道菜的示范。

enlist.en: In their final year at school, the students were asked to enlist in the military.

binoculars.en: He could see the ship on the horizon only if he used his binoculars.

proximity.en: All the trees in the proximity of the beach had been cut down.

minimal.en: We strive for minimal interruptions during the class.
minimal.zh: 我们努力让课程中的干扰减少到最低。

lava.en: The red-hot lava poured from the volcano.

courageous.en: He was courageous enough to confront the bully.
courageous.zh: 他足够勇敢，敢于面对那个恶霸。

overview.en: My brother gave me an overview of the important parts of the book.

seclude.en: She was secluded on an island for over a year.

sanitation.en: Proper sanitation is crucial to the health of a community.
sanitation.zh: 一个社区的卫生条件对其健康至关重要。

grove.en: The children love to play hide-and-seek in the grove.
grove.zh: 孩子们喜欢在小树林里玩捉迷藏

bead.en: She wears a necklace with red beads.
bead.zh: 她戴着一串有红色珠子的项链。

emulate.en: As a small boy, he always tried to emulate his big brother.

archive.en: All the city's historical documents are kept in the archive.
archive.zh: 所有市里的历史文件都在档案室里。

viscous.en: The ink in my pen is too viscous to flow smoothly.
viscous.zh: 我的钢笔里的墨水太黏稠，无法流畅地流动。

mainstream.en: Before punk rock music became part of the mainstream, only a few people liked it.

chapel.en: The wedding was held in a beautiful chapel.
chapel.zh: 婚礼在一个漂亮的小教堂里举行。

replenish.en: We planted nearly one hundred seeds to replenish the garden after the fire.

sustainable.en: We should pursue a more sustainable lifestyle.
sustainable.zh: 我们应当追求一种更为可持续的生活方式。

solidify.en: Place the mixture into the fridge to solidify for an hour.
solidify.zh: 把混合物放入冰箱冷藏一个小时，使其变得坚实。

transition.en: The transition from school to university can be difficult for many students.
transition.zh: 许多学生可能会觉得从学校转到大学是个困难的过渡

landmark.en: The Eiffel Tower is a famous landmark in Paris.
landmark.zh: 埃菲尔铁塔是巴黎的著名地标。

baron.en: After various profitable ventures, he became a railway baron.
baron.zh: 经过各种盈利的企业后，他成为了一位铁路大亨。

induction.en: The conclusion is based on the induction from experimental data.
induction.zh: 这个结论是基于实验数据的归纳得出的。

rental.en: 我在网上找到了这辆 rental car.
rental.zh: 我在网上找到了这辆出租车。

inheritance.en: Her generous inheritance from her uncle meant she could buy her own house.
inheritance.zh: 她从叔叔那里得到的丰厚遗产使她能够购买自己的房子。

diverge.en: "His views diverged sharply from those of his colleagues."
diverge.zh: 他的观点与同事们的截然不同。

meteorology.en: In order to understand the weather better, you should study meteorology.

gorilla.en: The gorilla is the largest primate in the world.
gorilla.zh: 大猩猩是世界上最大的灵长类动物。

sensory.en: Iris and Eric preferred the sensory thrill of watching movies in the theater.

ongoing.en: The development of plants is ongoing because it takes time for them to mature.

dissatisfied.en: I was dissatisfied with their decision to work on Sunday.

crystallize.en: The cold air caused the water droplets to crystallize.
crystallize.zh: 寒冷的空气导致水滴结晶化。

vomit.en: It is common for women to vomit when they are pregnant.

habitual.en: Smoking has become habitual for him, which is not good for health.
habitual.zh: 他习惯于吸烟，这对健康不好。

shrub.en: The garden was filled with beautiful shrubs and flowers.
shrub.zh: 这个花园里充满了美丽的灌木和花朵。

engrave.en: The couple engraved their names onto the old pine tree.

beforehand.en: He packed his luggage beforehand, so he was able to leave right away.

downsize.en: The company may need to downsize in order to survive. 该公司可能需要缩减规模以维持生存。

lawsuit.en: The company has threatened a lawsuit against the newspaper.
lawsuit.zh: 公司已威胁要对报纸提起诉讼。

mansion.en: This mansion once belonged to an oil tycoon.
mansion.zh: 这座豪宅曾经属于一个石油大亨。

humanistic.en: The school promotes a humanistic approach to education.
humanistic.zh: 这所学校推崇人本主义教育方法。

ascribe.en: We ascribe her success to hard work and a little luck.
ascribe.zh: 我们将她的成功归因于辛苦工作和一点运气。

cantonese.en: This TV show is in Cantonese with English subtitles.
cantonese.zh: 这部电视剧是广东话版，带有英文字幕。

arthritis.en: Agatha couldn’t play the piano anymore because of her arthritis.

intervention.en: The doctor made an early intervention in the disease.
intervention.zh: 医生对这个疾病进行了早期干预。

camouflage.en: The green and brown camouflage was best used for hiding in forests and jungles.

currently.en: "We are currently working on a new project."
currently.zh: 我们目前正在进行一个新项目。

invoice.en: I received an invoice for the books I ordered.
invoice.zh: 我收到了我订购的书的发票。

terrain.en: Cross-country runners have to learn to adapt to different terrains.
terrain.zh: 越野跑者必须学会适应不同的地形。

ornamental.en: The ornamental design of the cup makes it more attractive.
ornamental.zh: 杯子上的装饰图案使其更具吸引力。

federation.en: The Federation of Small Businesses is standing up for the rights of its members.
federation.zh: 小企业联合会正在维护其成员的权利

grocery.en: "I need to do some grocery shopping this afternoon."
grocery.zh: 我今天下午需要去买一些杂货

jerk.en: He gave the rope a jerk and the bell rang.
jerk.zh: 他猛地一拉绳子，铃就响了。

insecure.zh: 她对自己的外貌感到不自信。

fusion.en: Fusion cuisine combines elements from different culinary traditions.
fusion.zh: 融合烹饪将来自不同烹饪传统的元素结合在一起。

expectancy.en: The expectancy of a better future keeps them going.
expectancy.zh: 对更美好未来的期盼支撑着他们前进。

periphery.en: A beautiful floral pattern is on the periphery of the stationery.

aquarium.en: We took a trip to the aquarium and saw a scary shark.

debris.en: After the storm, the beach was littered with debris.
debris.zh: 暴风雨过后，海滩上散落着各种碎片。

terrace.en: Jane loves reading books on her terrace in the afternoon.
terrace.zh: 简爱在下午的时候在她的露台上看书。

extracurricular.en: He is involved in several extracurricular activities such as basketball and drama club.
extracurricular.zh: 他参与了几个课外活动，如篮球和戏剧俱乐部

pregnancy.en: During pregnancy, it is important to eat a balanced diet.
pregnancy.zh: 怀孕期间，保持均衡饮食很重要。

coexist.en: Our pets coexist in our home with few or no problems.

outweigh.en: Finding a warm place to sleep outweighed the need to find something to eat.

enact.en: The council enacted a law that would only allow buses to drive downtown.

deplete.en: All the driving he was doing was depleting his car’s fuel supply.

analogous.en: "The structure of the bird’s wing is analogous to that of the human arm."
analogous.zh: 鸟的翅膀的结构与人的手臂类似。

hectare.en: His family farm covered many hectares.

invasive.en: Invasive species pose a great threat to local biodiversity.
invasive.zh: 入侵物种对于当地的生物多样性构成了巨大的威胁。

aptitude.en: He has a natural aptitude for water skiing.

obscurity.en: His early life was spent in obscurity.
obscurity.zh: 他的早年生活在默默无闻中度过。

factual.en: John learns about history from factual books.

administrator.en: Everyone in the store did whatever the administrator asked them to do.

stuffy.en: I can't breathe in this stuffy room. I need to get some fresh air.
stuffy.zh: 我在这个闷热的房间里无法呼吸，我需要一些新鲜空气。

sensational.en: After years of research, they made a sensational discovery.
sensational.zh: 在数年的研究后，他们做出了轰动性的发现。

hazardous.en: This is a hazardous operation. You should wear protection equipment.
hazardous.zh: 这是一个危险的操作，你应该穿防护装备。

geographical.en: "Geographical features such as mountains and rivers shape the environment."
geographical.zh: 地理特征如山脉和河流塑造了环境。

humane.en: Helping build homes for poor people is very humane.

supervision.en: The construction project is under his supervision.
supervision.zh: 这个建筑项目在他的监督之下。

fragrance.en: She wears a perfume with a subtle fragrance.
fragrance.zh: 她涂抹了香味淡雅的香水。

elusive.en: The elusive fish only came out at night.

invoke.en: Before going into battle, the soldier invoked the name of his god for protection.

shareholder.en: The board of directors needs to consider the interest of the shareholders.
shareholder.zh: 董事会需要考虑股东的利益。

congested.en: Tom didn’t get home until after dark because the road was so congested.

penalize.en: The team was penalized when they broke the rules.

optic.en: Her blindness was caused by a problem with her optic nerve.

corporate.en: "Our corporate policy is to always put the customer first."
corporate.zh: “我们公司的政策是始终将客户放在第一位。”

sift.en: He sifted the flour into the bowl.

deter.en: Icy roads deter people from driving their cars.

hostility.en: He could feel the hostility of the crowd against him.
hostility.zh: 他能感觉到人群对他的敌意。

autobiography.en: I read an autobiography about my favorite entertainer.

regularity.en: The regularity of his routine was astonishing.
regularity.zh: 他日常生活的规律性令人惊奇。

viable.en: Her method of solving the math problem seemed viable.

inflict.en: War can inflict horrific physical and psychological damage.
inflict.zh: 战争可能造成骇人的身心伤害。

stance.en: My stance is that using oil and gas is bad for the environment.

animate.en: Rocks and machines are not animate things.

reputable.en: The service from the less-than-reputable company made her angry.

inadequate.en: The funding for our school is inadequate.

unrealistic.en: It's unrealistic to expect to never make any mistakes in life.
unrealistic.zh: 在生活中期望自己永不出错是不现实的。

intake.en: The doctor said I needed to increase my intake of fruits and vegetables.

mortality.en: The infant mortality rate in low-income countries remains high.
mortality.zh: 在低收入国家，婴儿死亡率依然很高。

coverage.en: The news coverage of the event was extensive.
coverage.zh: 这个事件的新闻报道非常广泛。

unbiased.en: The unbiased jury delivered a fair verdict.
unbiased.zh: 公正无私的陪审团做出了公正的裁决。

migration.en: There has been a large migration of people from rural areas into the cities.
migration.zh: 从乡村地区向城市有大量的人口迁移。

commencement.en: "The entrepreneur's commencement in the business world was marked with a brief ceremony."
commencement.zh: 这位企业家在商界的开端被一个简短的仪式所标识。

tighten.en: "You should tighten the rope to secure the goods."
tighten.zh: 你应该把绳子拉紧以稳固货物。

roam.en: Mobile phone users can roam internationally.
roam.zh: 手机用户可以实现国际漫游。

managerial.en: Nancy has a managerial position at the bank.

insignificant.en: Compared to the universe, our earth is insignificant.
insignificant.zh: 相比于宇宙，我们的地球微不足道。

willow.en: The willow's branches were swaying gently in the wind.
willow.zh: 柳树的枝条在风中轻轻摇曳。

ramble.en: I like to ramble through the woods on my day off.
ramble.zh: 我喜欢在休息日里在林中漫步。

inaccessible.en: The mountain peak is inaccessible because of the thick snow.
inaccessible.zh: 因为厚厚的积雪，山顶无法达到。

deform.en: The heat will deform the plastic.

informative.en: The travel guide had a lot of informative facts about the region.

elliptical.en: The planet moves in an elliptical orbit.
elliptical.zh: 这个星球以椭圆形轨道运行。

conceit.zh: 他的自大是他的失败之源。

modulate.en: He learned how to modulate his voice when speaking on the telephone.
modulate.zh: 他学会了如何在电话中调整自己的声音。

enlightenment.en: During the Age of Enlightenment, many philosophers championed the ideals of reason and liberty.
enlightenment.zh: 启蒙时代，很多哲学家都是理性和自由的倡导者。

mandatory.en: It’s mandatory that everyone be at least 16 to drive a car in the US.

caterpillar.en: After eating a lot of leaves, caterpillars change into butterflies.

patriot.en: He is a patriot at heart and will defend his country till the end.
patriot.zh: 他内心是一个爱国者，会到底防卫他的国家。

attire.en: Everyone wore their best attire to the president’s daughter’s wedding.

notation.en: This piece of music has a complex notation.
notation.zh: 这首音乐的符号很复杂

clan.en: The Scots originated from a Celtic clan.
clan.zh: 苏格兰人起源于一个凯尔特氏族。

impersonal.en: The boy felt scared on his first day at the big, impersonal high school.

marvel.en: I marvel at her ability to handle such a challenging job.
marvel.zh: 我对她处理如此具有挑战性的工作的能力感到惊奇。

interactive.en: The website is designed to be interactive.
interactive.zh: 这个网站设计成了交互式的。

consistency.en: Her consistency in archery meant that our team had a chance to win.

ordeal.en: Driving in the snowstorm was an ordeal she’d never forget.

primate.en: Primates use their hands for such tasks as swinging from branches.

batter.en: "He dipped the chicken in the batter and fried it."
batter.zh: 他将鸡肉擦上面糊后炸熟。

metallic.en: This metallic taste in my mouth is annoying.
metallic.zh: 我嘴里这股金属味真烦人

postulate.en: We must postulate a basic principle before we can proceed in this discussion.
postulate.zh: 我们必须在这次讨论中先假定一个基本原则。

audible.en: The sound of the drums was audible from miles away.

instructor.en: Jerry is a certified ski instructor.
instructor.zh: 杰瑞是一名有资质的滑雪教练。

deceptive.en: The scary-looking man’s appearance is deceptive; he is actually very nice.

outcry.en: There was a public outcry against the decision.
outcry.zh: 对那个决定有很大的公众抗议声音。

fiery.en: The fiery blaze burned all night long.

willful.en: A willful child never accepts defeat.
willful.zh: 任性的孩子从不接受失败。

mint.en: He planted some mint in the garden.
mint.zh: 他在花园里种了一些薄荷。

chaotic.en: The first day of school can be chaotic for a new student.

brag.en: He had strong muscles and bragged about them to the entire class.

exemplary.en: His exemplary behavior set a good example for the rest of us.
exemplary.zh: 他的模范行为是我们其他人的好榜样。

stray.en: The puppy must've strayed from its mother.
stray.zh: 这只小狗一定是离开了它的妈妈。

intriguing.en: This book is the most intriguing one I have ever read.
intriguing.zh: 这是我读过的最有趣的书。

sodium.en: Sodium is a common mineral found in many foods, such as processed meats, canned soups, and even some dairy products.
sodium.zh: 钠是许多食品中常见的矿物，如加工肉类、罐头汤，甚至一些乳制品。

palate.en: You can touch your palate with your tongue.

rivalry.en: There's always been a rivalry between the two families.
rivalry.zh: 这两个家族一直存在着竞争关系。

mimic.en: The hunter mimicked a duck’s call and shot the two ducks that called back.

whereby.en: This is the method whereby we can control the whole system.
whereby.zh: 这就是我们可以控制整个系统的方法。

renown.en: Michael is a singer of great renown in New Zealand.

negotiation.en: "During the negotiation, both parties agreed to make concessions."
negotiation.zh: 在谈判中，双方都同意做出让步。

electrode.en: Please connect the electrical wire to the electrode.

enrollment.en: University enrollment has increased this year.
enrollment.zh: 今年大学的入学人数增加了。

devoid.en: The movie was devoid of any violence, so it was a perfect movie for the family.

presidency.en: He declared his candidacy for the presidency.

stick.en: He picked up a stick to defend himself.
stick.zh: 他拿起一根棒子来保护自己。

tread.en: She treaded carefully on the narrow path.
tread.zh: 她小心翼翼地走在狭窄的小路上。

temperate.en: In Peru, the weather is temperate and rarely gets too hot or cold.

coefficient.en: The coefficient of friction between the two surfaces was very low.
coefficient.zh: 这两个表面之间的摩擦系数很低。

mast.en: The mast of the ship was towering above us.
mast.zh: 船的桅杆高高耸立在我们头上。

uneven.en: "The road surface is uneven, please drive carefully."
uneven.zh: 这条路面不平，请小心驾驶。

twig.en: They started the fire with a handful of dry twigs.

stew.en: She prepared a beef stew for dinner.
stew.zh: 她为晚餐准备了一锅炖牛肉

landing.en: The man is in charge of leading the landing in the warzone.

courier.en: Before trains, most couriers used horses to travel.

cramp.en: After the marathon, Jenny got a terrible cramp in her calf muscle.

solitude.en: John lives a life of solitude because he doesn’t get along well with people.

monastery.en: The monks at this monastery are famous for their bread and music.

devour.en: The lion devoured its prey whole.
devour.zh: 狮子一口咽下了它的猎物。

gaseous.en: The solid ice melted into liquid water and then evaporated into a gaseous state.
gaseous.zh: 固态的冰融化成了液态的水，然后又蒸发成了气态。

cavity.en: Please, help me check if I have a cavity in my tooth.
cavity.zh: 请帮我检查我是否有蛀牙。

abolition.en: "The abolition of slavery was a milestone in human rights history."
abolition.zh: 废除奴隶制是人权历史上的一个里程碑。

asteroid.en: In 1908, a giant asteroid hit Siberia.

agonize.en: She agonized over the decision for days.
agonize.zh: 她为这个决定苦恼了好几天。

prevailing.en: "The prevailing winds in this region are northerly.”
prevailing.zh: 这一地区的主要风向参北。

overload.en: Don't overload the boat or it will sink.
overload.zh: 不要让船过载，否则它会沉。

proponent.en: He was a proponent of using environmentally-friendly products.

mechanics.en: He is studying the mechanics of human movement.
mechanics.zh: 他正在研究人体运动的力学。

stunt.en: The man jumped over the cars as a promotional stunt.

errand.en: He couldn’t go to practice because he had several errands to do.

sled.en: Marvin likes to ride his sled down the hill in winter.

narrate.en: This story was written by John, but Aaron is narrating it to the crowd.

kindle.en: He managed to kindle a fire despite the wet conditions. 他尽管在潮湿的环境下，还是设法点燃了一堆火。

catalyst.en: In chemistry, enzymes are considered as natural catalysts helping speed up the reactions.
catalyst.zh: 在化学中，酵素被视为自然的触媒，它们可以加速反应。

cynical.en: The man became cynical after being lied to many times.

outermost.en: "He lives in the outermost part of the city."

vow.en: He made a vow to quit smoking.

noted.en: "The detective noted that the door was unlocked."
noted.zh: 侦探注意到门是未加锁的。

undertaking.en: He gave me his assurance that he would deliver the project on time; that was a significant undertaking.
undertaking.zh: 他向我保证会按时完成项目，这是一个重要的承诺。

grasshopper.en: There is a grasshopper in the garden.

saturation.en: Water has a saturation point of absorbing salt.
saturation.zh: 水对盐的吸收具有饱和点。

traverse.en: They had to traverse a dense forest to reach the village.
traverse.zh: 他们必须穿越一片茂密的森林才能到达村庄。

impending.en: The student was nervous about her impending test.

precipitate.en: Don't be precipitate - think it through before you make a decision.
precipitate.zh: 别急躁，做决定前要深思熟虑。

prioritize.en: We need to prioritize our tasks to be more productive.
prioritize.zh: 我们需要分配工作的优先级来提高效率

improvise.en: There was no meat for the pizza, so we improvised with what was in the fridge.

graphite.en: The pencil you use is made of graphite.
graphite.zh: 你使用的铅笔是由石墨制成的。

flank.en: The soldier was stationed on the eastern flank of the battalion.
flank.zh: 士兵被驻扎在营队的东侧。

blink.en: Don't blink your eyes or you will miss it.
blink.zh: 别眨眼睛，不然你会错过它的。

rite.en: Special masks are worn during the rite when a new baby is born.

realization.en: "The realization of her lifelong dream made her extremely happy."
realization.zh: 实现了她终生的梦想，她感到极度快乐

contamination.en: The river has suffered severe contamination from industrial waste.
contamination.zh: 这条河遭受了重度的工业废料污染。

criteria.en: The criteria for this job include experience and skill in management.
criteria.zh: 这个工作的标准包括管理经验和技能。

raft.en: He sailed across the Pacific Ocean on a raft.

flake.en: Snow flakes started to fall from the sky.

tornado.en: During a tornado, the safest place to be is underground.

cosmos.en: He is interested in the mysteries of the cosmos.
cosmos.zh: 他对宇宙的奥秘感兴趣。

incredulous.en: She was incredulous that monkeys could ever drive a car.

hull.en: The hull of the ship needs major repairs after the storm.
hull.zh: 暴风雨之后，那艘船的船体需要大修。

pathological.en: The pathological liar could not even tell the truth about unimportant matters.

selective.en: The university has a selective admissions process.
selective.zh: 这所大学有选择性的招生过程。

regiment.en: She joined a women's regiment during the war.
regiment.zh: 她在战争期间加入了一个女性的军团。

kerosene.en: Many people in poor countries cook on kerosene stoves.

oyster.en: He cracked open the oyster and found a pearl.
oyster.zh: 他打开牡蛎，找到了一颗珍珠。

perch.en: "The bird was perched high in the tree."

canyon.en: The canyon was so deep that the ground inside was covered in shadow.

permanence.en: Poor results threaten the permanence of the new system.

vent.en: He opened the vent to let out the steam.
vent.zh: 他打开排风孔以释放蒸汽。

haunt.en: "During the Halloween season, the old castle is believed to be haunted by ghosts."
haunt.zh: 在万圣节期间，人们相信古老的城堡总是被鬼魂出没。

needy.en: He's always been there for me when I was feeling needy.
needy.zh: 当我需要帮助时，他总是在我身边。

trance.en: The woman’s powerful eyes often put men in a trance.

gothic.en: The cathedral is a magnificent Gothic structure.
gothic.zh: 这座大教堂是一座宏伟的哥特式建筑。

fort.en: The soldiers ended the day with the construction of a wooden fort.
fort.zh: 士兵们在木头堡垒的建造下结束了一天。

advisory.en: Our firm provides advisory services to small businesses.
advisory.zh: 我们的公司为小企业提供咨询服务。

frail.en: He is too frail to leave the hospital.

decree.en: The king issued a decree ordering all his subjects to pay higher taxes.
decree.zh: 国王颁布法令，要求所有臣民增加纳税。

proficient.en: "With years of practice, he has become proficient at playing piano."
proficient.zh: 经过多年的练习，他已经精通钢琴演奏了。

malice.en: His eyes were full of malice.

subsist.en: Some people are forced to subsist on only a few dollars a month.

aroma.en: I love the aroma of coffee in the morning.

viral.en: The girl was in bed for a week when she had a viral infection.

skeletal.en: We studied the skeletal system in anatomy class.

heed.en: You should heed the advice on the sign and not drive so fast.

awareness.en: I have no awareness of what's going on around me.
awareness.zh: 我对周围发生的事情一无所知。

longevity.zh: 他的长寿让每个人都感到惊讶。

authoritative.en: This book is an authoritative source on ancient Egypt’s Queen Nefertiti.

flavor.en: The flavor of the ice cream was very good.

brighten.en: "His smile can always brighten up my day."
brighten.zh: 他的笑容总能让我的一天变得明亮。

premature.en: Mark’s celebration was premature because the ball hadn’t fallen in the hole.

venom.en: A snake’s venom can be used to cure the illnesses it creates.

exposition.en: His ideas were set forth in the first chapter with clear exposition.
exposition.zh: 他的想法在第一章里被清晰地阐述出来。

depot.en: He waited for his mother to arrive at the depot.

buck.en: He sold his old car for a thousand bucks.
buck.zh: 他把他的旧车卖了一千美元。

iceberg.en: The ship narrowly avoided a collision with an iceberg.

rupture.en: The earthquake caused a rupture in the water main, flooding the streets.
rupture.zh: 地震导致了主要的水管破裂，洪水淹没了街道。

authorize.en: The city council may "authorize" the mayor to sign the contract.
authorize.zh: 市议会可能授权市长签订合同。

groom.en: The groom looked happy as he walked with his new wife.

journalism.en: Before becoming a teacher, she worked in journalism.

kernel.en: The kernel of a nut is the edible part that we eat.
kernel.zh: 果仁是我们吃的坚果的可食用部分。

unprecedented.zh: 这场地震力度前所未有。

prehistoric.en: The scientists found prehistoric pots used by the people in the area.

facet.en: "Each facet of the problem requires careful consideration."
facet.zh: 问题的每个方面都需要仔细考虑。

sharply.en: His health has declined sharply in recent months.
sharply.zh: 他最近几个月的健康状况急剧下降。

legislature.en: The senator had served ten years in the national legislature.

arid.en: Not many plants grow in the arid desert.

irregular.en: The quick brown fox has an irregular jumping pattern.
irregular.zh: 那只敏捷的棕色狐狸跳跃的模式很不规则。

recharge.en: I need to recharge my phone, it's almost dead.
recharge.zh: 我需要给我的手机充电，它快没电了。

legislate.en: Senators have to legislate fairly so most people will enjoy the benefits.

chronicle.en: "The magazine started as a weekly chronicle of pop culture."
chronicle.zh: 该杂志起初是一份流行文化的每周纪事。

mesolithic.en: During the Mesolithic period, people started to settle and form communities.
mesolithic.zh: 在中石器时代，人们开始定居并形成社区。

muse.en: As a noun: The poet declared the sunset as his muse for his new poem.
muse.zh: 诗人将日落视为他新诗的灵感源泉。

lessen.en: "I am trying to lessen my dependence on technology."
lessen.zh: 我正在尝试减少对科技的依赖。

anthropology.en: In anthropology class, I learned about simple tools that ancient cultures used.

absorption.en: The absorption of water is vital to the survival of plants.
absorption.zh: 植物吸收水分对于其生存至关重要。

ware.en: The new ware in the local market is attracting a lot of customers.
ware.zh: 本地市场中的新商品吸引了很多顾客。

defense.en: The city has a strong defense against invaders.
defense.zh: 这座城市对侵略者有坚强的防御。

validate.en: Winning first prize will validate all of Tony’s hard work.

gradient.en: The gradient of this hill is quite steep, so be careful when hiking.
gradient.zh: 这座小山的坡度很陡，所以在徒步时要小心。

shovel.en: She used a shovel to dig the garden.

accounting.en: He works for an accounting firm.

align.en: The crowd seemed to align themselves with the protestors.

wasp.en: Be careful of the wasp nest in the attic - one sting can be very painful.
wasp.zh: 在阁楼上小心蜂巢——一次蜇伤会非常痛。

luminous.en: The moon was luminous against the nighttime sky.
luminous.zh: 月亮在夜空中显得明亮。

warp.en: The woman put the clock above the fireplace, and the heat warped it.

wither.en: Many plants will wither in the hot summer without adequate water.
wither.zh: 在炙热的夏天，许多植物会因为没有足够的水而枯萎。

artifact.en: We studied artifacts from an ancient Chinese settlement.

regenerate.en: Doctors hope the treatment will regenerate damaged tissue.
regenerate.zh: 医生们希望这个治疗能够使受损组织再生。

glorify.en: She always seeks to glorify herself in front of others.
glorify.zh: 她总是喜欢在别人面前抬高自己。

disarm.en: The government was succesful in its attempt to disarm the rebels.
disarm.zh: 政府成功地让叛乱分子解除了武装。

intellect.en: His superior intellect helped him excel in school.
intellect.zh: 他卓越的理解力帮助他在学校中表现优秀。

hoe.en: He was using a hoe to make the soil loose.

capability.en: Our team has the capability to finish the project on time.
capability.zh: 我们团队有能力按时完成这个项目。

publicize.en: They hired a PR firm to publicize the launch of their new product.
publicize.zh: 他们雇佣了一家公关公司来宣传他们新产品的发布。

vault.en: The bank has a large vault where all the money is kept.
vault.zh: 银行有一个大保险库，所有的钱都在那儿存放。

microbe.en: The first step in curing a disease is finding the microbe that causes it.

fahrenheit.en: When the temperature dropped to 32° Fahrenheit, it started snowing.

diplomat.en: He is a career diplomat and served as the foreign minister previously.
diplomat.zh: 他是个职业外交官，之前曾任外交部长。

refrigerate.en: Supermarkets refrigerate fruit to make it last long.

spatial.zh: 他对空间的感知能力很强。

ridicule.en: The other students ridicule Peter’s foreign accent.

sieve.en: He's sieving the flour into a large bowl.
sieve.zh: 他正在把面粉筛入大碗中。

quarterly.en: "The company publishes a quarterly report on their profits."
quarterly.zh: 这家公司发布了一份关于他们每季度盈利的报告。

abbey.en: When the monk returned to the abbey, he went immediately to his bedroom.

faucet.en: Turn off the faucet when you are done brushing your teeth.

lengthen.en: She decided to lengthen her dress by an inch. 彼女はドレスを1インチ延ばすことにしました。
lengthen.zh: 她决定把她的裙子延长一英寸。

subdue.en: The police managed to subdue the angry mob with tear gas.
subdue.zh: 警察用催泪瓦斯成功地制服了愤怒的暴民。

turtle.en: The green sea turtle swims swiftly in the ocean.
turtle.zh: 那只绿海龟在海洋里迅速地游着。

definitive.en: This library has the definitive collection of books on ancient Egypt.

groove.en: The vinyl record has a scratch on its groove.
groove.zh: 这张黑胶唱片的沟槽上有一道划痕。

quantum.en: The physics student studied quantum mechanics.

decorative.en: She added some decorative pillows to the couch.
decorative.zh: 她在沙发上添加了一些装饰性的枕头。

counselor.en: "She is a counselor who specializes in helping teenagers with their relationship issues."
counselor.zh: 她是一位专门帮助青少年处理他们的人际关系问题的咨询师。

gourmet.en: In order to get a gourmet meal, you have to eat at an expensive restaurant.

humanitarian.en: He quit his job to join a humanitarian group providing aid during the disaster.
humanitarian.zh: 他辞去工作，加入了一个在灾难中提供援助的人道主义团体。

outlive.zh: 他的记忆将超越他的生命。

innate.en: He had the innate desire to please his teachers.

gratify.en: Bonnie was gratified after receiving her gift from her parents.

tract.en: On the other side of the mountains, there was a long tract of forest.

bestow.en: The honor was bestowed upon him by the Queen.

aggregate.en: The company totaled its aggregate sales for the entire year.

forsake.en: I will never forsake my duties as a father.
forsake.zh: 作为父亲，我决不会放弃我的职责。

navigate.en: She navigated the ship across the ocean.

pore.en: The skin's pores get clogged with oils.
pore.zh: 皮肤上的毛孔被油脂堵塞了。

ambient.en: The machine operates well in the ambient temperature.
ambient.zh: 这台机器在环境温度下运行良好。

dual.en: The dual role of women as workers and mothers is now widely accepted.
dual.zh: 女性既是工作者又是母亲的双重角色现在被广泛接受了。

overt.en: His overt display of wealth was distasteful.
overt.zh: 他公开炫耀财富的做法令人讨厌。

utensil.en: Please wash the utensils after dinner.

puddle.en: When the ice melted, it formed a puddle.

molecular.en: Molecular biology is a rapidly developing field of science.
molecular.zh: 分子生物学是一个发展迅速的科学领域。

morale.en: To improve our family’s morale, mom suggested going on a picnic.

cram.en: He crammed all of his shirts into the top drawer of the dresser.

backup.en: "Make a backup of your files to avoid losing your work."
backup.zh: 为了避免丢失你的工作，对你的文件做一个备份。

hardy.en: Despite the harsh winter weather, the small hardy shrubs continued to grow.
hardy.zh: 尽管冬天的天气恶劣，那些小而坚韧的灌木仍在生长。

subconscious.en: His subconscious fear of spiders caused him to avoid the basement.
subconscious.zh: 他对蜘蛛的潜意识中的恐惧，使他避开了地下室。

yeast.en: I forgot to put yeast in the bread recipe.
yeast.zh: 我忘了在面包配方中加酵母。

sterile.en: The hospital room looked quite sterile.

pueblo.en: We visited the ancient pueblo while we were in Santa Fe.
pueblo.zh: 我们在Santa Fe的时候参观了那个古老的普韦布洛。

intuitive.en: He has an intuitive understanding of the situation.
intuitive.zh: 他对这个情况有直觉的理解。

paraphrase.en: The students were asked to paraphrase the story they had just heard.

reef.en: He walked along the reef and looked at the water below.

scorch.en: "Be careful not to scorch the cake when you bake it."
scorch.zh: 你烤蛋糕的时候要小心别烤焦。

mound.en: There was a mound of clothes on the teenager’s messy floor.

tactic.en: Sam thought of a good tactic to attract more business.

pharaoh.en: The pharaohs ruled Egypt for thousands of years.

critique.en: My job is to critique the food at various restaurants.

malicious.en: He was accused of spreading malicious gossip.
malicious.zh: 他被指控散布恶毒的谣言。

concentric.en: The target was a series of concentric circles.

aquatic.en: The dolphin is an aquatic mammal.

slick.en: Be careful, the floor is slick with oil.
slick.zh: 小心，地板上的油让它变得很滑。

superintendent.en: Our superintendent has set new rules for student behavior.
superintendent.zh: 我们的校长设定了新的学生行为规定。

epic.en: The poet wrote an epic about the great discoveries of the past thousand years.

moor.en: The hikers got lost in the expansive moor.
moor.zh: 徒步者们在广阔的荒野中迷路了。

meteorological.en: The thunderstorm was so large that it became a great meteorological event.

daisy.en: The field was dotted with daisies.

gnaw.en: The rabbit continued to gnaw on the carrot.
gnaw.zh: 那只兔子继续啃食胡萝卜。

addictive.en: I think this game is very addictive.

sac.en: There is an air sac in a bird's body that aids in respiration.
sac.zh: 鸟的身体内有一个气囊，帮助它们呼吸。

nectar.en: Bees use nectar to make their honey.

favor.en: "Could you do me a favor and pass the salt?"
favor.zh: 你能帮我个忙，把盐给我递过来吗？

momentary.en: He felt a momentary pang of regret.
momentary.zh: 他感到一阵瞬息的后悔。

metabolic.en: Fish have a very high metabolic rate.

admiration.en: Her courage and determination won the admiration of all her friends.
admiration.zh: 她的勇气和决心赢得了所有朋友的敬佩。

planetary.en: Our planetary system consists of eight planets.
planetary.zh: 我们的行星系统由八大行星组成。

harmonious.en: The furniture and the paintings create a harmonious ambiance in the house.
harmonious.zh: 家具和画作在房子中创造了一个和谐的氛围。

filament.en: The filament in the bulb has burnt out, so the light went off.
filament.zh: 灯泡中的细丝烧断了，所以灯灭了。

counseling.en: After going through a traumatic event, she sought counseling.
counseling.zh: 她经历了创伤性事件后，寻求了咨询服务。

communal.en: On the weekends, Theo and his son picked up trash in the communal park.

inanimate.en: The world is comprised of animate and inanimate objects.
inanimate.zh: 世界由有生命和无生命的物体组成。

lush.en: The lush jungle was filled with plants, trees, and vines.

jeopardize.en: Don't jeopardize your health by smoking.
jeopardize.zh: 不要因为抽烟而使您的健康处于危险之中。

pinpoint.en: The navigation system in my car is able to pinpoint my exact location.

generalization.en: She made several sweeping generalizations about men.
generalization.zh: 她对男性做出了几个概括性的总结。

hustle.zh: 别只是坐在那儿，快点行动！

incense.en: As a noun: "The air was filled with the scent of burning incense."
incense.zh: 空气中弥漫着燃烧的香味。

ranch.en: John inherited a large ranch from his grandfather.
ranch.zh: 约翰从他的祖父那里继承了一个大农场。

discord.en: There was much discord between the experts on the talk show.

folklore.en: India’s folklore has stories about great warriors written in long poems.

laborious.en: It was a laborious task, but she was determined to finish it.
laborious.zh: 那是一项费力的任务，但她决心完成它。

glamorous.en: This is a glamorous party full of high-profile guests.
glamorous.zh: 这是一个聚集了很多知名人士的豪华派对。

disprove.en: The scientist disproved the theory that the sun moved around the Earth.

rugged.en: Their car couldn’t make it far along the rugged roads.

soothe.en: "The mother sang a lullaby to soothe her crying baby."
soothe.zh: 妈妈唱了一首摇篮曲安抚哭闹的宝宝。

etiquette.en: When in Asian countries, bowing is a form of etiquette.

obsess.en: After watching the Star Wars movies, Ike obsessed about becoming a Jedi.

salmon.en: I've got some salmon in the fridge that I need to use.
salmon.zh: 我冰箱里有些三文鱼，我需要用掉。

destined.en: They are destined to be together.

luxurious.en: This is a luxurious house furnished with fine art and antiques.
luxurious.zh: 这是一个富丽堂皇的房子，里面陈设着精美的艺术品和古董。

bogus.en: He pointed out that the documentation is bogus.
bogus.zh: 他指出那份文件材料是假的。

tusk.en: Sadly, some people hunt elephants and remove their tusks to sell them.

harp.en: He loves to play the harp in his free time.
harp.zh: 他在闲暇时喜欢弹竖琴。

poignant.en: The girls cried at the end of the poignant movie.

immortal.en: He longed for the secret that would make him immortal.
immortal.zh: 他渴望得到那能让他不朽的秘诀。

jagged.en: The swimmer was hurt when he fell on the jagged rocks.

con.en: It was unfair of the fortune teller to con me out of 500 dollars.

ideological.en: The citizens of England had ideological differenes about its government.

eventual.en: The constant training and planning led the team to an eventual victory.

cub.en: The lion cub was crying for its mother.

jurisdiction.en: We did not have jurisdiction to bring the criminal to trial.

harass.en: The young girl would often harass her baby brother.

reflective.en: 这种情况真是需要我仔细反思。
reflective.zh: This situation really requires my reflective consideration.

rewarding.en: I find teaching a very rewarding experience.
rewarding.zh: 我觉得教学是一种非常有价值的体验。

benefactor.en: The student’s benefactor gave him money to spend on his studies.

appetizing.en: The appetizing plate of cookies was gone in half an hour.

utopia.en: Many people dream of a utopia where there is no war or poverty.
utopia.zh: 很多人都梦想有一个没有战争和贫穷的乌托邦。

successively.en: "The classes were successively taught by three different teachers."
successively.zh: 这些课程是由三位不同的教师依次教授的。

grumble.en: The children always grumble about the food in the canteen.
grumble.zh: 孩子们总是抱怨食堂的食物。

streak.en: He is on a winning streak in the poker game.
streak.zh: 他在扑克游戏中胜利连连。

rebuke.en: The teacher rebuked the student for not doing his homework.
rebuke.zh: 老师斥责这个学生没有完成家庭作业。

partition.en: The shop has put up a partition to separate the two areas.
partition.zh: 商店在两个区域之间设立了隔墙。

sever.en: He severed the string using scissors.

speck.en: A speck of blood appeared where the mosquito had bit him.

pouch.en: I keep my money in a small pouch.

termite.en: The wood we found was full of termites.

martyr.en: He was a martyr to his cause.

resignation.en: After months of contemplation, he finally handed in his resignation.
resignation.zh: 经过几个月的考虑，他最终递交了辞职信。

dreary.en: After the fire, this section of forest is rather dreary.

sprint.en: The kids didn’t want to be late to class, so they sprinted to the bus stop.

ethics.en: The act of stealing certainly doesn’t go against some people’s ethics.

bridle.en: As a noun - I bought a new bridle for my horse.
bridle.zh: 我为我的马买了一个新的马勒。

remorse.en: When I realized what I had done, I felt remorse for my actions.

waver.en: The candles on the table wavered in the breeze.
waver.zh: 桌上的蜡烛在微风中摇曳。

thrash.en: He thrashed the table with his hand in anger.
thrash.zh: 他愤怒地猛烈拍打桌子。

relieved.en: She felt relieved when she heard the good news.
relieved.zh: 她听到好消息后感到了宽慰。

woe.en: "The woe of homeless people is unimaginable."
woe.zh: 无家可归的人们的痛苦是不可想象的。

prophecy.en: The prophecy foretold of a great disaster.
prophecy.zh: 预言预告了一场大灾难。

authorization.en: "She gave me authorization to use her credit card."
authorization.zh: 她授权我使用她的信用卡。

certification.en: "He received his certification as a trainer last week."
certification.zh: 他上周获得了培训师的认证。

majestic.en: The rich people lived in a big, majestic house.

stabilize.en: Efforts are being made to stabilize the economy.
stabilize.zh: 正在采取努力稳定经济。

falsehood.en: He was caught in a web of deceit and falsehood.
falsehood.zh: 他被一张由谎言和虚假编织的网罗住了。

consciousness.en: The drug can alter your state of consciousness.
consciousness.zh: 这种药物可以改变你的意识状态。

shriek.en: As soon as she saw the spider, she let out a shriek.
shriek.zh: 她一看见那只蜘蛛就尖叫起来。

intricacy.en: The intricacy of the issue makes it hard to solve.
intricacy.zh: 这个问题的复杂性使得它难以解决。

stranded.en: When the plane left, my sister and I were stranded in China.

reaffirm.en: He reaffirmed his commitment to the agreement.
reaffirm.zh: 他再次确认他对协议的承诺。

anthem.en: Everyone sings the national anthem before the baseball game starts.

cellular.en: She used a microscope to see the activity at a cellular level.

inexhaustible.en: The sun is an inexhaustible source of energy.
inexhaustible.zh: 太阳是取之不尽的能源。

exaggeration.en: His claim about the product is a pure exaggeration.
exaggeration.zh: 他对商品的评价纯粹是夸大其词。

sneer.en: He sneered at people who liked to watch soap operas.
sneer.zh: 他嘲笑那些喜欢看肥皂剧的人。

scribble.en: I scribbled a rough diagram of our plan and gave it to him.

moderately.en: She was moderately pleased with the results.

butt.en: He fell down on his butt on the slippery floor.
butt.zh: 他在滑的地板上摔了个屁股。

archaic.en: To be competitive, we must update our archaic equipment.

scotch.en: John is drinking a glass of Scotch.
scotch.zh: 约翰正在喝一杯苏格兰威士忌。

brute.en: He fell into the hands of a brute who beat him severely.
brute.zh: 他落入了一个残暴的人的手中，被他狠狠地打了一顿。

partiality.en: She has a partiality for walking to school instead of driving.

wavy.en: The child drew wavy lines all over the piece of paper.

immobile.en: The heavy box was immobile, no matter how hard she pushed.
immobile.zh: 那个沉重的箱子怎么推也不动

perspire.en: I usually perspire a lot when I am at athletics practice.

monstrous.en: The monstrous waves crashed onto the shore.
monstrous.zh: 恐怖的海浪砸在了岸边。

utopian.en: His utopian vision of world peace is unlikely to be realized.
utopian.zh: 他关于世界和平的乌托邦式想象，不太可能实现。

ransom.en: He kidnapped the prince and demanded $1 million as a ransom.

malfunction.en: The computer is malfunctioning and I can't access my files.
malfunction.zh: 计算机出现故障，我无法访问我的文件。

fret.en: As a verb: "Don't fret about the exam, you've prepared well."
fret.zh: 别对考试忧虑，你准备得很好。

crumble.en: He was trying to crumble the cookies into small pieces.
crumble.zh: 他正在试图把饼干捏成小块。

delusion.en: He's under the delusion that he will be promoted soon.
delusion.zh: 他在幻想自己很快就会升职。

charitable.en: I give money each year to a charitable foundation.

phenomenal.en: The child’s ability to play the piano is nothing short of phenomenal.

untreated.en: The untreated wood will decay over time.
untreated.zh: 未经处理的木头会随着时间的推移而腐烂。

affectionate.zh: 他给了她一个充满爱意的拥抱。

hasten.en: "We must hasten the production process to meet the deadline."我们必须加快生产过程以赶得上截至日期。
hasten.zh: 我们必须加快生产过程以赶得上截至日期。

dispensable.en: His attitude made him dispensable to the team.
dispensable.zh: 他的态度使他对团队成为可有可无的人。

constructive.en: Her constructive suggestions were greatly appreciated.
constructive.zh: 她的建设性建议受到了高度赞赏。

mariner.en: The old mariner used his telescope to find the shore.

infamous.en: That news channel is infamous for presenting biased information.

prune.en: He pruned the overgrown shrubs in his garden.
prune.zh: 他修剪了花园中过度生长的灌木。

outburst.en: There was an outburst of cheers when the comedian took the stage.

mobility.en: "Physical mobility can be severely limited in people with disabilities."
mobility.zh: 残疾人的身体流动性可能受到严重限制。

hymn.en: The gentle melody of the hymn soothes our hearts.
hymn.zh: 圣歌的优美旋律抚慰我们的心灵。

aristocracy.en: Most members of the aristocracy were very well fed.

incompatibility.en: There's a certain incompatibility between two software packages in my computer.
incompatibility.zh: 我的电脑有两个软件包存在某种不兼容。

vehement.en: Gina was vehement when she found out that Liz was bad in school.

tyrant.en: "He ruled over the country like a tyrant."
tyrant.zh: 他像一个暴君般统治这个国家。

decency.en: She had the decency to apologize for her rude behavior.
decency.zh: 他有诚意对她的粗鲁行为道歉。

ken.en: Ken always helps me with my homework.
ken.zh: Ken 总是帮我做家庭作业。

raisin.en: She sprinkled raisins over the salad.
raisin.zh: 她在沙拉上撒上了葡萄干。

flammable.en: Be careful with that blanket near the candle. It is extremely flammable.

complacency.en: His complacency annoys those who strive for better results.
complacency.zh: 他的自满态度令那些为了获得更好成果而努力的人感到烦恼。

riotous.en: After winning the championship, the fans had a riotous celebration.
riotous.zh: 在赢得冠军后，粉丝们进行了放纵的庆祝。

informal.en: They had an informal meeting to talk about their experiences.

frantic.en: The cat became frantic when I tried to give it a bath.

glucose.en: People with diabetes need to check their glucose levels.

justifiable.en: He left work early for a justifiable reason.
justifiable.zh: 他因为一个合理的原因提前下班了。

citation.en: Can you give me a citation for that statistic?
citation.zh: 你能给我一个关于那个统计数据的引用吗？

destine.en: He seems to be destined for a successful career.
destine.zh: 他似乎注定要有一个成功的职业生涯。

unreasonable.en: It’s unreasonable to expect a quick result.
unreasonable.zh: 指望快速得到结果是不合理的。

constraint.en: There is a constraint on the amount of money we can spend on the project.
constraint.zh: 我们在这个项目上可以花费的资金有限制

backslide.en: You've made so much progress in your diet, don't backslide now.
backslide.zh: 你在饮食方面已经取得了大量的进步，现在不要退步。

irreversible.en: Once made, the damage is often irreversible.
irreversible.zh: 一旦造成，伤害通常是无法逆转的。

equilibrium.en: He lost his equilibrium and fell off the ladder.
equilibrium.zh: 他失去平衡，从梯子上摔下来。

appreciative.en: He showed an appreciative smile after receiving the gift.
appreciative.zh: 在收到礼物后，他露出了感激的笑容。

dodge.en: He managed to dodge the bullet.

predestine.en: Life's events are predestined and beyond our control.
predestine.zh: 生活中的事件都是命中注定的，超出了我们的控制。

inflame.en: The tax increase will infame the public’s frustration with the government.

prod.en: The bully prodded me in the chest with her finger.

fury.en: In his fury, he knocked over the chair.
fury.zh: 他愤怒至极，把椅子打翻了。

cyclone.en: Hundreds of homes were damaged by the cyclone.

jealousy.en: He couldn't hide his jealousy when he saw her with another man.
jealousy.zh: 当他看到她和另一个男人在一起时，他无法掩藏自己的嫉妒情绪。

impulsive.en: He made an impulsive decision to quit his job.
impulsive.zh: 他冲动地决定辞掉他的工作。

adversity.en: He overcame great adversity in his life, and his story is an inspiration to us.
adversity.zh: 他在生活中克服了很大的困难，他的故事对我们充满了鼓舞。

inadvertent.en: She made an inadvertent error when she knocked over the nail polish.

martial.en: Karate is a martial art that began many years ago in Japan.

justification.en: There is no justification for treating people in that way.
justification.zh: 没有理由以这种方式对待别人。

repeal.en: The law was finally repealed after a long debate.
repeal.zh: 一场漫长的辩论后，这项法律最终被废除。

nausea.en: The doctor said the medicine would help get rid of her nausea.

onset.en: At the onset of the battle, the enemy wasn’t prepared for such a large attack.

outmoded.en: Black and white television sets are outmoded.

skyrocket.en: The prices have skyrocketed in the last two years.
skyrocket.zh: 过去两年货价已经暴涨。

physiological.en: Physiological needs are basic needs for human survival.
physiological.zh: 生理需要是人类生存的基本需求。

titanic.en: Her political career fell into titanic ruin overnight.
titanic.zh: 她的政治生涯在一夜之间变得破败不堪。

optimist.en: Joe was an optimist, so he believed he would get the job that he wanted.

obstinate.en: Despite the warnings, he remained obstinate and continued his unhealthy lifestyle.
obstinate.zh: 尽管有警告，他还是固执地继续他的不健康生活方式。

repetitive.en: He finds his job very repetitive.
repetitive.zh: 他发现他的工作重复性很强。

imminent.en: "Scientists say that an earthquake is imminent in this region."
imminent.zh: 科学家们说这个地区即将发生地震。

energize.en: We need something to energize the team.
energize.zh: 我们需要一些东西来激励团队。

mournful.en: Her eyes were full of mournful expression.
mournful.zh: 她的眼里充满了悲伤的表情。

bliss.en: Every time he sees his girlfriend, he feels a sense of bliss.

innocence.en: Everyone who met her found her innocence to be charming.

idealism.en: His politics are driven by pure idealism.
idealism.zh: 他的政治行为是纯粹的理想主义驱动的。

abase.en: He wouldn't abase himself by apologizing.他不会屈尊道歉。
abase.zh: 他不会贬低自己去道歉。

explicitly.en: He explicitly told me to arrive by 8:00.
explicitly.zh: 他明确地告诉我要在8点前到达

brink.en: We are on the brink of war.
brink.zh: 我们正处在战争的边缘。

enchant.en: The beautiful woman enchanted everybody in the room.

generosity.en: "His generosity was apparent to all who knew him."
generosity.zh: 他的慷慨为所有认识他的人所知。

electromagnetic.en: Different colors of light come from different levels of electromagnetic energy.

compelling.en: The evidence against him was compelling.
compelling.zh: 针对他的证据令人信服。

proverb.en: An old proverb says, "Every cloud has a silver lining."
proverb.zh: 有句古谚语说：“凡事皆有其好处。”

admonish.en: The teacher admonished Mark because he was chewing gum in class.

peril.en: The whole economic situation is in peril due to the current lockdown.
peril.zh: 由于当前的封锁，整个经济形势处于危险之中。

bribe.en: The businessman offered a bribe to the official to win the contract.
bribe.zh: 商人向官员行贿以赢得合同。

marshal.en: The marshal led the parade through the city streets.
marshal.zh: 元帅带领队伍穿过城市的街道。

underrepresented.en: Women are still underrepresented in the tech industry.
underrepresented.zh: 在技术行业，女性依然未充分代表。

resourceful.en: Even in the most difficult situations, he has always been resourceful, always finding a way out.
resourceful.zh: 即使在最困难的情况下，他也总是富有资源，总能找到解决的办法。

dictator.en: He ruled the country like a dictator.
dictator.zh: 他像一个独裁者统治这个国家。

compliance.en: The bratty child never shows compliance with her mother’s rules.

coup.en: At the end of the 18th century, Napoleon Bonaparte staged a coup to overthrow a group that had control of France.

impartial.zh: 法官必须是公正无私的。

persistence.en: Persistence is the key to success in any endeavor.

peck.en: The bird pecked at its food.

snob.en: He's such a snob that he won't associate with people who are not from his wealthy class.这个人非常势利，他不会和非富裕阶层的人交往。
snob.zh: 他非常势利，只会和同样来自富裕阶层的人打交道。

homely.en: She's a homely woman with a pleasant smile.
homely.zh: 她是一位有着愉快微笑的朴素女性。

overcast.en: The sky was overcast in the morning, but by noon it was bright again.

plunder.en: The thieves plundered the village of all its valuable items.
plunder.zh: 强盗们将村子里所有珍贵的物品都掠夺了。

apprentice.en: Mark is an apprentice chef at the restaurant.

scripture.en: His daily routine included reading the scripture.
scripture.zh: 他的日常活动包括阅读经文

equate.en: She equated the man’s messy appearance with a lack of responsibility.

yacht.en: They are sailing around the world in their 50-foot yacht.
yacht.zh: 他们正乘着他们的50英尺游艇环游世界。

growl.en: The dog began to growl when a stranger approached.
growl.zh: 当陌生人靠近时，狗开始咆哮。

dampen.en: The rain will dampen the picnic.

tact.en: Since both sides would not agree, it required someone with tact to make peace.

festive.en: Dean’s favorite part of Christmas is the festive clothing that people wear.

hoarse.en: Her voice was hoarse from shouting.
hoarse.zh: 她因为大喊大叫声音变得嘶哑。

diligence.en: Diligence is the mother of good luck.

affirmation.en: Her smile was an affirmation of her joy.
affirmation.zh: 她的微笑是她喜悦之情的肯定。

outdated.en: The computer software is outdated and cannot meet our current needs.
outdated.zh: 这个电脑软件已经过时，无法满足我们现在的需求。

hone.en: Lisa honed her chess skills through hours and hours of practice.

pious.en: He is a pious man who regularly attends church.
pious.zh: 他是一名虔诚的人，经常去教堂。

hoop.en: The boys tried to toss the ball through the basketball hoop.

propulsion.en: The propulsion lifted the rocket into the sky.

deviation.en: The slight deviation in the flight path led the plane to a completely different city.
deviation.zh: 轻微的航线偏差把飞机带到了一个完全不同的城市。

credible.en: She has provided credible explanation for her actions.
credible.zh: 她为她的行动提供了可信的解释。

squat.en: "The children squat down to play a game."
squat.zh: 这些孩子们蹲下来玩游戏

defensive.en: He always gets defensive when I mention his father's business.
defensive.zh: 每当我提及他父亲的生意，他总是显得防备心强。

thump.en: They heard the thump when the bowling ball hit the floor.

unsettle.en: The dark clouds in the sky unsettled Beth.

dilapidated.en: Paint peeled off of the old dilapidated apartment building.

reconciliation.en: "The two countries achieved reconciliation after many years of conflict."
reconciliation.zh: 多年冲突后两国实现了和解

filth.en: There was tons of filth and trash on the shore of the river.

corruption.en: The city is riddled with corruption and crime.
corruption.zh: 这个城市充斥着腐败和犯罪。

retard.en: "The bad weather may retard our progress."
retard.zh: 恶劣的天气可能会延迟我们的进程。

enviable.en: He has an enviable position in the company.
enviable.zh: 他在公司中有着令人羡慕的地位。

agitation.en: His nervous agitation kept him awake all night.
agitation.zh: 他的紧张不安使他整晚都没有睡觉。

saturated.en: Leigh’s hair became saturated in the rainstorm.

amnesty.en: She was denied amnesty for her involvement in the war.

autograph.en: Everybody wanted the movie star’s autograph.

tumult.en: She couldn’t hear her friend over the tumult of the other excited guests.

scarcity.en: The scarcity of water in this region makes farming difficult.
scarcity.zh: 这个地区水源稀缺，使得农业变得困难。

advocacy.en: Janine’s strong advocacy for the event made people want to attend.

unstable.en: The old bridge is unstable and might collapse.
unstable.zh: 那座旧桥不稳定，可能会倒塌。

implicate.en: The man was implicated in the theft at the store.

ultrasonic.en: The ultrasonic device is used to clean the laboratory tools.
ultrasonic.zh: 这个超声波设备被用来清洗实验室工具。

commentator.en: According to many commentators, this winter has been one of the coldest in the last century.

congregate.en: Seeing a group of birds congregate in the sky is an awesome sight.

essentially.en: "Essentially, we're looking at a fairly normal situation here."
essentially.zh: 从本质上说，我们正在面对的是一个相当正常的情况。

gloom.en: The room was filled with gloom.

oracle.en: The king went to the oracle to ask if going to war was a good idea.

wrath.en: He was shaking with wrath after he was insulted.
wrath.zh: 他被侮辱后愤怒得发抖。

seizure.en: Bright flashing lights can cause seizures in children.

trot.en: The toddler started to trot towards his mother.
trot.zh: 小孩开始向他的母亲小跑过去

blacksmith.en: The blacksmith pounded the piece of metal until it was flat.

ginger.en: I like to add ginger to my tea for extra flavor.
ginger.zh: 我喜欢在我的茶里加点儿姜以增加口感。

preparatory.zh: 他在一所预备学校教书。

announcer.en: The announcer said that the train would be late.

dissatisfy.en: He was dissatisfied with his meal.

hidden.en: The hidden camera recorded everything in the parking lot.

corpse.en: The police found a corpse in the river.
corpse.zh: 警察在河中发现了一具尸体。

unethical.en: It's considered unethical to accept gifts from a potential client.
unethical.zh: 接受潜在客户的礼物是被视为不道德的。

mow.en: I mow our lawn every weekend.

automate.en: When the bank automated, it started installing ATM machines.

persian.en: The last great Persian empire was ruled by the Pahlavi dynasty.
persian.zh: 最后一个伟大的波斯帝国由巴列维王朝统治。

fortress.en: The ancient fortress still stands firm against the ravages of time.
fortress.zh: 这座古老的要塞依然屹立不倒，抵抗着时间的侵蚀。

firsthand.en: If you want firsthand knowledge, ask someone who saw it.

turbulence.en: The plane experienced some turbulence but landed safely.
turbulence.zh: 飞机经过一段气流的颠簸，但安全着陆了。

testament.en: The beautiful performance was a testament to the singer’s natural talents.

pumpkin.en: I just bought a pumpkin for Halloween.
pumpkin.zh: 我刚买了一个南瓜，准备万圣节。

earnings.en: The company reported a significant increase in its quarterly earnings.
earnings.zh: 该公司报道其季度盈利有显著增长。

miner.en: The miner is working in the coal mine.
miner.zh: 这名矿工正在煤矿工作。

deafen.en: The bomb explosion could deafen a person temporarily.

ammunition.zh: 士兵们在战斗中的弹药用完了。

hitchhike.en: She didn’t have a car, so she hitchhiked several miles to her brother’s home.

alteration.en: The house needs some major alterations before we move in.
alteration.zh: 在我们搬入之前，这房子需要进行一些大的改动。

outnumber.en: "The enemy soldiers outnumber us two to one."
outnumber.zh: 敌兵的数量是我们的两倍。

segregation.en: Racial segregation was abolished in the US in the 1960s.
segregation.zh: 种族隔离在1960年代的美国被废止了。

graffiti.en: The wall was covered with colorful graffiti.

bitterly.en: He bitterly regretted ever mentioning the subject.
bitterly.zh: 他非常后悔提起过那个话题。

dacron.en: The shirt is made of Dacron which is very breathable.
dacron.zh: 这件衬衫是用Dacron制作的，非常透气。

radial.en: He was working on the radial engine of the old aircraft.
radial.zh: 他正在修理旧飞机的径向引擎。

surgical.en: The doctor performed a surgical procedure to remove the tumor.
surgical.zh: 医生进行了手术以切除肿瘤。

footnote.en: "There is a footnote at the bottom of the page explaining the scientific term."
footnote.zh: 书的底部有个脚注，解释了这个科学术语。

prohibition.en: The prohibition on smoking in public places has helped to promote health.
prohibition.zh: 在公共场合禁止吸烟有助于促进健康。

mister.en: "Mister Smith, could you please tell me the time?"
mister.zh: 史密斯先生，您能告诉我现在几点了吗？

lighten.en: Can you lighten this room by switching on the light?
lighten.zh: 你能通过打开灯来照亮这个房间吗？

prevention.en: "The best prevention against disease is a healthy diet and regular exercise."
prevention.zh: 对抗病症的最好预防就是健康的饮食和规律的运动。

thief.en: A thief broke into our home and took my mother’s jewelry.

ineffective.en: The policy has proved to be wholly ineffective.
ineffective.zh: 这项政策被证明是完全无效的。

hinduism.en: Hinduism is one of the oldest religions in the world.
hinduism.zh: 印度教是世界上最古老的宗教之一。

appealing.en: "The idea of a long vacation is very appealing to me."
appealing.zh: 长假期这个想法对我非常有吸引力。

caretaker.en: My grandmother’s caretaker helps her get around the house.

demography.en: If you study demography, you’ll see huge population growth in some areas of the world.

hearty.en: He gave me a hearty welcome.

medicaid.en: John's family is low income, so they qualify for Medicaid.
medicaid.zh: 约翰的家庭收入较低，所以他们有资格申请 Medicaid。

omission.en: Mike was upset because of the omission of his name during the ceremony.

puritan.en: He has puritan values, always living a frugal and disciplined life.
puritan.zh: 他有清教徒的价值观，总是过着简朴和有纪律的生活。

notification.en: I received a notification about the change in schedule.
notification.zh: 我收到了关于改变日程的通知。

heater.en: The heater isn't working. We'll have to call a technician.
heater.zh: 热水器坏了，我们得找技术人员来修。

shortcut.en: We got to the house early because we took a shortcut through the forest.

representation.en: The movie is a representation of a typical American family.
representation.zh: 这部电影是对于典型美国家庭的描绘。

frankly.en: Frankly, I don't think your plan will work.
frankly.zh: 坦白地说，我觉得你的计划不会奏效

mafia.en: The Mafia controls the city's underworld.
mafia.zh: 黑手党控制着这个城市的黑社会。

messiah.en: Christians believe that Jesus is the Messiah.
messiah.zh: 基督徒们相信耶稣就是弥赛亚。

bipartisan.en: The bill is the result of bipartisan cooperation.
bipartisan.zh: 这项法案是两党合作的成果。

coastline.en: He noticed that most of the cities in Australia are on the coastline.

lentil.en: Danni made her special soup with lentils when her husband was sick.

sabbath.en: Today is the Sabbath, and we must not do any work.
sabbath.zh: 今天是安息日，我们不可以做任何工作。

profess.en: He professed to be an expert in physics.

barricade.en: The police set up a barricade to control the crowd.
barricade.zh: 警方设置了路障以控制人群。

thoughtless.en: His thoughtless comments hurt her feelings.
thoughtless.zh: 他那不经思考的评语伤了她的心。

overboard.en: Tom and Gary slipped on the wet floor and fell overboard.

mitten.en: She lost one of her mittens in the snow.
mitten.zh: 她在雪地里丢失了其中一只连指手套。

insulator.en: "The wire is covered with an insulator to prevent electric shocks."
insulator.zh: 电线被绝缘体包裹，防止电击。

elevation.en: The elevation of the sun above the horizon is getting higher.
elevation.zh: 太阳在地平线上方的升高程度越来越高。

delightful.en: The concert was a delightful experience.
delightful.zh: 音乐会是一次让人愉悦的体验

bite.en: The boy took a big bite of his hamburger.

vigil.en: He had a vigil in front of the tomb for three days.

finely.en: The coffee beans need to be finely ground before brewing.
finely.zh: 在煮咖啡前，咖啡豆需要被细致地磨碎。

zionism.en: "Zionism became a well-organized movement in the 20th century."
zionism.zh: 在20世纪，锡安主义成为了一个组织严密的运动。

itch.en: The rough fabric in his shirt made his neck itch.

known.en: Bob is known throughout the neighborhood as a burglars.

contestant.en: The contestant with the highest score wins the game.
contestant.zh: 得分最高的选手赢得比赛。

ranger.en: Peter wanted to be a ranger because he liked spending time outside.

bourgeois.en: She has a bourgeois mentality, always worried about her social status.
bourgeois.zh: 她有一种中产阶级的心态，总是担心自己的社会地位。

hiv.en: HIV is a major global public health issue.
hiv.zh: HIV是全球公共卫生的重大问题。

secrecy.en: The secrecy of the big organization made the government nervous.

tulip.en: She planted some tulip bulbs in the garden.
tulip.zh: 她在花园里种了一些郁金香球茎。

psychiatrist.en: John had to see a psychiatrist for his depression.
psychiatrist.zh: 约翰因为抑郁症不得不去看精神科医生。

awfully.zh: 这部电影令人极度无聊。

depressing.zh: 今天的天气真令人沮丧。

geographic.en: The geographic diversity of this country is truly amazing.
geographic.zh: 这个国家的地理多样性真是惊人。

hack.en: The bank's security was compromised in a hack last year.
hack.zh: 去年这个银行的安全系统在一次黑客攻击中被破坏。

inseparable.en: Denise and Diana have been inseparable since they first met.

inadequacy.en: The inadequacy of the school's sports facilities was a constant source of frustration.
inadequacy.zh: 学校体育设施的不足常常让人感到挫败。

upcoming.en: The kids were worried about their upcoming exam.

vat.en: The VAT rate in China is 13 percent for general goods.
vat.zh: 在中国，普通商品的增值税率是13%。

uranium.en: Uranium-based nuclear power is used for electricity generation.
uranium.zh: 基于铀的核电用于发电。

nazism.en: "Nazism caused one of the most tragic genocides in history during World War II."
nazism.zh: 在二战期间，纳粹主义造成了历史上最悲剧的种族灭绝事件。

milky.en: During the day, the sky was a milky blue.
milky.zh: 白天的时候，天空是牛奶般的蓝色。

shadowy.en: The path led into a shadowy forest and we couldn't see much in front of us.
shadowy.zh: 小路通向一个阴暗的森林，我们几乎看不清前方。

earthen.en: The house’s roof was made of earthen tiles.

investigation.en: The police have launched an investigation into the incident.
investigation.zh: 警方已开始对这一事件展开调查。

rainforest.en: The rainforest is home to many animals.

permissible.en: Smoking is not permissible in the library.
permissible.zh: 在图书馆里抽烟是不被允许的。

delegation.en: Our company has sent a delegation to attend the international business conference.
delegation.zh: 我们公司派出了一个代表团参加国际商务会议。

wizard.en: The wizard made gold fall from the sky.

dynamo.en: The dynamo of the bicycle generates electricity to light up the bulb.
dynamo.zh: 自行车上的发电机产生电力以点亮灯泡。

bend.en: You need to bend the wire into a loop.
bend.zh: 你需要把线弯成一个环。

detached.en: He lived in a detached house near the park.
detached.zh: 他在公园附近的一座独立式的房子里住着。

disrespect.en: He showed disrespect by arguing with his boss during a meeting.

clatter.en: As a verb: "The dishes clattered in the sink."
clatter.zh: 碗碟在洗碗池里发出嘈杂声。

accountable.en: Political leaders are accountable to the people they represent.

heating.en: The heating system in our house is very efficient.
heating.zh: 我们家的供暖系统非常高效。

anew.en: Although he had failed his driving test, he decided to try it anew.

whitewash.en: They tried to whitewash the situation by claiming it was a misunderstanding.
whitewash.zh: 他们试图用称这只是一个误会来粉饰真相。

metallurgy.en: Copper has been important in the metallurgy for thousands of years.
metallurgy.zh: 铜在冶金学中的重要性已经有几千年的历史了

sol.en: Sol was the sun god in ancient Roman mythology.
sol.zh: 在古罗马神话中，Sol是太阳神。

evolutionary.en: The evolutionary process helps species adapt to their environments.
evolutionary.zh: 进化过程帮助物种适应他们的环境。

slightly.en: The weather is slightly warmer today than yesterday.
slightly.zh: 今天的天气比昨天稍微暖和一些。

airway.en: Since he was sick, mucus would occasionally get stuck in his airway.

deduction.en: The police made a deduction that the thief had entered by the window.
deduction.zh: 警方推测小偷是从窗户进入的。

shady.en: We found a shady spot to have our picnic.
shady.zh: 我们找到一个阴凉的地方来野餐。

dependant.en: He has a wife and two children as his dependants.
dependant.zh: 他有一个妻子和两个孩子依赖他。

slab.en: I looked at various slabs of stone to decorate my house.

likeness.en: There is a remarkable likeness between them.
likeness.zh: 他们之间有显著的相似性。

gazette.en: Alice wants to write for a gazette when she’s older.

stockbroker.en: My friend works as a stockbroker at a major Wall Street firm.
stockbroker.zh: 我的朋友在华尔街的一家大公司做股票经纪人。

pier.en: "We walked along the pier, watching the ships coming in."
pier.zh: 我们沿着码头走，看着船只陆续进港。

narration.en: She delivered a riveting narration of her life's journey.
narration.zh: 她对自己人生旅程的叙述令人全神贯注。

isolation.en: Due to the pandemic, many people are experiencing isolation.
isolation.zh: 由于大流行病，许多人都正在经历隔离。

severity.en: The doctor assessed the severity of her symptoms before prescribing treatment.
severity.zh: 医生在开药前，对她的症状严重程度进行了评估。

hrh.en: "HRH Prince Charles is known for his environmental advocacy."
hrh.zh: 皇子查尔斯殿下因其环保倡导而闻名。

daring.en: "She made a daring decision to climb the Mount Everest alone."
daring.zh: 她做出了独自攀登珠穆朗玛峰的大胆决定。

pedlar.en: The pedlar was selling toys in the market.
pedlar.zh: 这个小贩在市场上卖玩具。

revel.en: They revelled in the freedom of the weekend.
revel.zh: 他们尽情享受周末的自由。

catholicism.en: His family converted to Catholicism when he was a child.
catholicism.zh: 他在孩提时代的时候，他的家族转信了天主教

astonishment.en: She looked at me in astonishment.

misplace.en: I misplaced my wallet, and I didn’t find it until a week later.

monolingual.en: In today’s global economy, being monolingual limits your opportunities.

jingle.en: The keys began to jingle in his pocket.
jingle.zh: 他口袋里的钥匙开始叮当响。

halloween.en: Children dress up and go trick or treating on Halloween.
halloween.zh: 孩子们会在万圣节那天穿上化妆服去玩‘不给糖就捣蛋’的游戏。

donor.en: He is a regular donor to several charities.
donor.zh: 他是几个慈善组织的常年捐赠者。

contingent.en: The movie star stood in front of an entire contingent of photographers.

allah.en: Allah is the only deity worshiped in Islam.
allah.zh: 阿拉是伊斯兰教唯一崇拜的神

chronology.en: We learned the chronology of World War II in history class.

payroll.en: "The company uses an online system to handle its payroll."
payroll.zh: 公司使用在线系统来处理工资发放。

exploration.en: "The mission to Mars was a great feat of space exploration."
exploration.zh: 对火星的探索任务是太空探索的一项伟大壮举。

theorem.en: Pythagoras' Theorem is fundamental in geometry.
theorem.zh: 勾股定理在几何学中占据了基础地位。

insomnia.en: Nate’s insomnia prevented him from getting enough rest.

eskimo.en: The Eskimo people have adapted to survive in the harsh Arctic environment.
eskimo.zh: 爱斯基摩人能够适应严酷的北极环境以生存下去。

panther.en: The panther is known for its strength and agility.
panther.zh: 豹以其力量和敏捷性而闻名。

hiss.en: The wind was hissing in the trees.
hiss.zh: 风在树林里发出嘶嘶声。

distinguished.en: She is a distinguished professor at Harvard.
distinguished.zh: 她是哈佛大学上的杰出教授

hindi.en: I am learning to speak Hindi.

m.a: 单词 "a" 没有词根。 单词 "a" 没有词缀。
m.abandon: "Abandon"来自于法语"abandonner"，而法语中的"abandonner"则来自于Old French的"abandoner"。在最初的Old French中含意为 "放弃"，延伸至现在的英文中，其意义并无太大改变。 "Abandon"没有前缀，词根是"-bandon"，后缀没有；其他含"-bandon"的单词很少。"Abandon"的形容词是
m.ability: "Ability" 的词根来源于拉丁词 "habilitas"，意思是便利、适宜。由此词根衍生出的其他单词有："ability", "habilitation", "rehabilitation" 等。 单词 "Ability"，-ity 是后缀，表示形容词转变为名词。相同后缀的其他单词包括："possibility", "reality", "actual
m.able: "Able"的词根为"habit", 源自拉丁词"habere"，意思是有，拥有。再衍生出来，表示有做某事的能力。 单词 "Able" 的词缀就是 "-able"。这个词缀用在许多动词后面，表示具有某种性质，有能力或可能做某事。类似的单词有 "likeable" （可爱的）、 "doable" （可做的）和 "changeable" （可变的）等。
m.abnormal: "Abnormal" 的词根来自拉丁词 "abnormis" （偏离正常的）, "ab-" 意为“远离”,"-normis"来自"norma"表示“规范”。 在“abnormal”这个单词中，"ab-"作为前缀表示“远离”，"-normal"是词根，“-al”是形容词后缀。其他含有相同词缀的单词例如"abhor"、“absent”和“abandon”。
m.aboard: "Aboard"的词根为古英语 "bord"，意为 "边，边缘，船的一侧"。无明显的词缀。 "Aboard"没有明显的词缀。
m.abolish: "Abolish"这个词源于拉丁语的 "abolere"，其中，"ab-"是相对于的意思，"olere"是增长的意思，所以整体的含义是“做相反的动作，停止增长”，从而转化为废止、取消的意思。 "Abolish"中， "ab-"是前缀，表示相反；"-lish"则是后缀，常常表示动词。
m.abortion: "Abortion"源自拉丁语"abortio"，意为流产或者丧失，由词根"abor"（指的是流产或者终止）衍生而来。 "Abortion"的词缀组成为"abort-" 和 "-ion"。 "abort-" 是词根，意为早产或堕胎，而"-ion"是后缀，用于将动词转化为名词。
m.about: "About"来自古英语"onbutan"，意为“在外部”，最初用于表示“在……之外”。 "About"没有词缀，它是一个单独的词汇。
m.above: "above" 是一个原型词，没有词根衍生。 "above" 也没有前缀或后缀。是一个不包含词缀的单词。
m.abroad: "Abroad"是由"ab-"（表示远离）和"-road"（道路）连接而成，表示远离的道路，从而引申为远离本国，去国外的意思。 "Abroad"无词缀，是一个完整的词。
m.abrupt: "abrupt" 来自拉丁词根 "ab-"（表示“离开”）和 "rumpere"（表示“打破”），所以原意是“破袭发生”。 "abrupt" 的前缀是 "ab-"，表示“离开”，后缀 "-t"是形容词后缀。
m.absence: Absence 的词根来自于拉丁语 "absens"，意为 "离开，缺席"。其他衍生单词有：absent, absentee, absently 等。 Absence 的词缀主要有前缀 "ab-" 和后缀 "-sence"。"ab-" 是拉丁语的一个常见前缀，表示"离开，不在"， "-sence" 作为一个后缀，常见于表示状况或质地类的单词。例如：prese
m.absent: "Absent" 的词根为-Latin "ab- + esse" ，意为“远离存在”。 "Absent" 有一个词缀 "-ent"，这是在法语中形成动词的词缀。
m.absolute: "Absolute"的词根是"absolut", 来自拉丁语"absolutus"，意为“完成，固定”，表示完成、固定或无可挑剔的含义。 "Absolute"包含"a-"前缀(来自拉丁语"ab-"，表示"离开")和"-ute"后缀。
m.absorb: "absorb" 的词根主要来自拉丁语 "sorbere"，意为 "吸入"。 由此词根衍生出来的其他单词有：absorbable(可吸收的), absorbance(吸光度), absorption(吸收, 吸引) 等。 “absorb”这个单词中，"ab-" 是前缀，表示 "away"， "sorb" 是词根，意为 "suck in"。 相同前缀的单词有：
m.abstract: Abstract 来源于拉丁词根 "abs-" (away from) 和 "trahere" (draw or pull)，即表示“拉离”或“抽出”。 相似词根的单词有：abstraction (抽象), distract (使分心), extract (提取), contract (合同), retract (撤回). Abstract 没有前缀或后缀。
m.absurd: Absurd的拉丁语词根是'surdus'，意思是'聋的，不听话的'。据推测，这个词初始化可能是用来形容那些不听从建议或警告，行为看起来愚蠢或不符合逻辑的人。 Absurd 可以被拆解为 a-bsurd，其中 'a-'是一个表示否定之意的前缀，bsurd 对应了拉丁文词根'surdus'与之相关的含义。
m.abundant: "Abundant" 的词根是拉丁词 "abundare"，意思是“充足、丰富”。 其他由此词根衍生出来的单词有例如 abundance（丰富，多；大量），abundantly（丰富地；大量地）。 "Abundant" 的词缀包括前缀 "ab-"，中缀 "-und-" 和后缀 "-ant"。“ab-”的意思是“来自”，“-ant”在此处表示形容词。
m.abuse: "Abuse"的词根来自拉丁语，ab-表示"错误"，-us-frice表示"使用"。由此衍生出诸如abuser（滥用者）等词。 "Abuse"没有词缀，是一个简单的英语单词。

m.academy: "Academy"这个词汇由古希腊地名 "Akademos"或"Akademia"发展而来，是一个公园或校园的名字，因为古希腊哲学家柏拉图在那里讲学，后人就用这个地名来指代教育或学术机构。 "Academy"这个单词没有明显的词缀，不过名词后面的"-y"可以理解为名词后缀，通常用于表示机构或地点，比如library (图书馆)，bakery (面包店)。

m.accent: "Accent"来自于拉丁词根"accentus"，ac- 表示“向上”或“向前”，而 -centus 是由 "cantus" 演变而来，意为 "song"。如一首歌的旋律中的高潮部分被强调一样，"accent" 被用来表示 "发音的重音部分"。 "Accent"没有前缀或后缀，整个单词是一个词根的单词。
m.accept: Accept这个单词来自于拉丁词根 "cept", 意为“拿，取”。有许多其他的英语单词都含有这个词根，如：concept, deceive, exception等。 单词"accept"没有前缀，后缀-cept是词根，表示“拿取”。
m.access: "Access"的词根是拉丁语 "accessus"，意为"approach, entering"，由"ac-" （向前）+ "-cedere" （去）组合而成。 "Access"没有前、后缀，基本上对应原始拉丁词的直接形态。
m.accessible: "accessible" 是由词根 "access" 衍生出来的，"access" 的含义是"进入"或"接近"。 "accessible" 的词缀有 -ible，表示形容词，意为"……能够被……"，和"access" 连在一起，整体意思就是"能够接触或者能够达到的"。

m.accommodation: 这个词的词根 "-com-" 来自拉丁文，意为 "一起"，词根 "mod-" 意为测量，调整。"-ation" 是名词后缀。 前缀 "-ac" 指向，"-com-" 一起，词根 "-mod-" 测量，调整，后缀 "-ation" 表示行动或结果。
m.accompany: "Accompany" 中包含词根 -compan-, 是拉丁语 word "com-"（一起，共享）和 "panis"（面包）的组合。"Com-" 是一种共享的含义，"panis" 是指面包，整个单词的字面意思是共享面包，暗示共同生活或经历。 衍生单词有：companion (同伴，伙伴)， company (公司，团队)，companionable。 "
m.accomplish: "Accomplish"是由前缀 "ac-" （表示"向"或"使"）和词根 "-compli-" （表示"填满" "完成"）组成。同样的词根我们可以在 "complete" 和 "complement" 中看到。 前缀 "ac-" 表示"使"; 词根 "-compli-" 表示"完成"; 后缀 "-ish" 通常使词变为动词。
m.account: "Account"来源于拉丁语 "computare"，意思是“计算”，事实上，"account"本身没有直接的词根，但是可以找到一些相关的单词如：accountant(会计)，accountable(有责任的)。 "Account"没有前缀和后缀，它是一个完整的词。
m.accountant: "Accountant" 的词根为 "account-", 意为 "计算"，"计账"。 "Accountant" 的后缀 -ant 表示人或事物的角色，例如：“assistant (助手)”。
m.accumulate: Accumulate 的词根为 cumulus，是拉丁语，原意是“堆”，“堆积”。 "Accumulate" 的词缀为 "ac-"，表示“做什么”；以及 "-ulate"，这是一个动词后缀，表示“使…”，所以 "accumulate" 整体来看是“使…堆积”。
m.accuracy: Accuracy 起源于Latin词根 "accuratus"，意思是 "做得正确的，精确的"，接着通过Old French和Middle English 发展成现在的 "accuracy"。 Accuracy 是由词根 "accurate" 加上后缀 "-cy" 组成的。 "-cy" 是一个常见的后缀，表示状态或质量。
m.accuse: Accuse来自于拉丁文"accusare"，含义是“call to account”，意为追究责任。 这个单词没有前缀或后缀。Accuse是单词的基本形式。
m.accustomed: Accustomed来自于拉丁词根"custom"，意为"习惯"。它是"accustomed"的词根。 Accustomed有一个前缀"ac-"（表示 “向，到，加强”） 和后缀“-ed”（用于形成过去分词或形容词）。
m.ache: "Ache" 源于古英语的 "acan" 或者中古英语的 "aken"，都意味着痛苦或疼痛。 "Ache" 是没有词缀的词，它本身是词根。在某些情况下，我们可以在其后面加上 "-y" 形成形容词 "achy"，意味着有疼痛的。
m.achieve: "achieve" 来自于拉丁语"ad capiendum"，这个词根的意思是"去得"。 此词无前缀或后缀，是一个基础动词。
m.achievement: 单词 "Achievement" 的词根是"chieve"，它源自拉丁词 "capere"，意为“抓住、捕获”。衍生出一些与抓住、获得有关的单词，如 "achieve"、“chieftain”等。 "Achievement"的前缀 "a-" 来源于拉丁语，表示朝向、趋势。其后缀 "-ment" 用于构成名词，表示行为或结果。如 "amusement"（娱乐）
m.acid: "Acid" 来自于拉丁词根 "acidus"，意为酸。 其他由 "acidus" 衍生出来的词包括 "acidic" (酸的)，"acidity" (酸性)。 "Acid" 不具有词缀，是一个无词缀的单字。

m.acquire: "Acquire" 的词根是 Latin 語源 "acquirere"，其中 "ad-"（表示运动的趋向和方向）和 "quaerere"（搜索，追求） 组成。表示需要用一定的方法和手段收集、购买或获得某样东西。 从这个词根衍生出来的其他词汇有：acquisition (n. 获得, 购置), inquirer (n. 质问者, 调查者) 等。 "Acquir
m.acquisition: "Acquisition"来自于拉丁文 "acquisitio"，是由-acquirere（获取）派生出的名词。 "Acquisition"的词缀包含了前缀 "ac-"（表示向/朝一个方向）和动词后缀 "-ion"（表示动作或过程）。词根 "quisit-" 表示"寻求"。
m.acre: “Acre”来自于古英语词“æcer”，意为开放的土地，与古低地德语和中低地德语的相似词“akker”一致。 Acre没有词缀。
m.across: Across的词根为cross，源自古英语"cruc-"，意思是"交叉"或"横穿"。 "Across"没有额外的前后缀。

m.activity: "Activity" 的词根是 "act"，是拉丁语 "actum" 的过去分词，意为行动、做。 衍生词有： action(行动), actor (演员), exact (精确的), proactive (积极主动的). "Activity" 的词缀主要是 "-ity"，它是一个后缀，表示状态或质量。 类似的单词有： reality (现实), qualit
m.actor: "Actor"源于拉丁词根"act-"，意为"do"（做），这个词根在很多与行动或行为有关的英语单词中都能找到，比如"active"（积极的）、"activity"（活动）、"action"（行动）。 "Actor"的词缀比较简单，它只有一个名词后缀"-or"，这个后缀通常用来形成表示人或事物执行某种行动的名词，如"editor"（编辑）、"creator"

m.acute: "Acute" 的词根为 "-cut-"，源自拉丁语"acutus"，意为“尖锐的”。 其他衍生单词：cutlass（弯刀）、cuticle（表皮） "Acute"这个单词没有词缀。

m.adapt: "Adapt"的词根是来自于拉丁词"aptare"，意为"适应"，又来自于"apte"，意为"合适"。 "Adapt"的词缀包括前缀 ad-（意思是“接近，朝向”）和词根 -apt-（名词变形aptitude的意思是“能力，天赋”）。
m.adaptation: Adaptation这个词源自于拉丁词根"adapt"，意思是"使适应"，后面加上后缀"-ation"变成名词，表示“动作或过程”。 Adaptation的词缀包括前缀 "ad-"，表示"到，使"，词根 "apt", 有"适合"之意，和后缀"-ation"，是从动词变化到名词的常用后缀，表示行动或过程。

m.admire: "Admire"的词根来自于拉丁词"admirari"，意思是“感到惊奇”，因此你可以看到“admire”和“miracle”（奇迹）有类似的词根。 "Admire"没有前后缀，它是由"ad-"（接近）和 "-mirari"（惊奇）组成。
m.admission: "Admission" 的词根是 "miss"，这个词根来源于拉丁语，意为“发送，让...进入”。例如： "mission"（任务）， "missile" （导弹）等。 "Admission"的前缀是 "ad-" 表示“向，朝”，后缀 "-ion" 表示行为或结果，其他单词例如 "addiction"（上瘾）， "adventure"（冒险）等都包含了 "a
m.admit: "Admit"来自拉丁语 "admittere"， 其中"ad-" （到，朝向）和"mittere" （发送）。由此词根派生的其他单词有"commit", "emit", "submit" 等。 "Admit"没有前后缀，是由词根"ad-" 和"mit"组成。具有相同词根的其他单词有："omit", "submit", "permit"等。

m.adopt: 该词来自于拉丁词"adoptare"，指“选择并接受”。 "Adopt"由前缀"ad-"和词根"-opt" 组成。“ad-”表示“向，接近”，而“-opt”来源于拉丁词“optare”，表示“选择”。也就是选择并接受的意思。
m.adore: "Adore"的词根是"ador-", 这个词根来源于拉丁文"adorare"，意为"敬拜"。 这个单词没有前缀或后缀，只有动词后缀“-e”。
m.adult: "Adult" 来自拉丁词根 "adultus"，意思是"grow, nourish"，代表“成长、养育”。 "Adult" 是一个没有词缀的单纯词根。
m.advance: "Advance"的词根是拉丁词"ante"，意思是"在前面"，代表在时间、空间等方面的前进。 "Advance"无前缀，后缀为"-ance"，用以生成名词。例如像是 significance, dominance。

m.adventure: "Adventure"的词根来自拉丁语 "adventura"，意为“即将发生的事情”。 单词 "Adventure" 中， "ad-" 是前缀，表示“向前，朝向”； "ventur" 是词根，源于拉丁语 "venire" 意为“来”。

m.advertisement: "Advertisement" 的词根为 "advert"，源自拉丁语 "advertere"，意为“转向”，"advertisement" 则获取了“使注意力转向”的含义，即吸引注意。 其他由这个词根衍生出来的单词：advertise, advert, advertiser等。 这个单词的后缀是 "-ment"，表示名词，通常用来表达抽象名词，代表行为或结
m.advice: "Advice"的词根是"-vis-"，来源于拉丁语的 "videre"，意思是"看"。可以理解为建议是对某件事的看法或观察。 "Advice" 没有明显的词缀。
m.advise: "Advise"的词根来自老法语"aviser"，意思是“思考、观察”。 "Advise"没有明显的词缀。 历史和文化背景: "Advise"这个单词最初来源于法语，后来进入英语，用于形容专业或者有经验的人给出的建议。
m.advocate: "Advocate"的词根为 "voc," "voc" 是拉丁词根，在英语中一般表示 "call" 或 "voice"，表示"呼叫"或"声音"。源于拉丁语词汇 "advocare"，意思是 "呼唤" 或 "召集"。 "Advocate"的词缀为前缀 "ad-" 和词根 "-voc-". "ad-" 表示"向"或"使"，"-voc-" 表示"呼叫"或"声音"。
m.aeroplane: Aeroplane这个词由两部分构成：“aero-”和“-plane”。"Aero-"来源于希腊语"ἀήρ"（aēr），意思是"air"（空气）。"-plane"来自于拉丁语"planus"，意思是 flat 或 level，可以理解为飞机切过空中平的意思。 Aeroplane 没有前缀和后缀，只有词根和组合。
m.affair: "Affair" 来自法语的 "à faire"，意为要做的事情。 "Affair" 是一个完整的单词，没有词缀。
m.affect: affect 是拉丁语 afficere 的过去分词形式，afficere 表示"影响、改变"。 该单词并没有词缀使用。
m.affection: "Affection" 由拉丁词根 affectio 组成，意为"参与、感觉"。 "-tion" 是一个常见的后缀，一般用于将动词变为名词，出现在很多词汇中，如 "education", "information" 等。
m.afford: 词根来自于古英语的 'gefadian'，意为 'succeed in doing something'。没有从这个词根派生出其他词汇。 'Afford' 没有前缀和后缀。它是一个单一的词根词。

m.again: "Again" 这个副词没有显著的词根。 像 "Again" 这样的单词，本身就是一个完整的词，没有词缀。
m.against: "Against" 来源于古英语 "on ġēan"，意为"再次，对着"。这里的词根 "ġēan" 意为"再次，相反"。 "Against" 没有前缀或后缀，它是个完整的单词。

m.ahead: "Ahead" 是由 "a-" 和 "head" 组成的单词。"a-" 这个前缀来源于旧英语，有“在...之上”之意，"head" 代表“头、前方”。 "Ahead" 不包含词缀。

m.aim: "Aim" 的词根来自于旧法语的 'aesmer'，意为估计或相信。 "Aim" 是一个没有词缀的单词。

m.aircraft: "Aircraft" 是由 "air" 和 "craft" 两个部分组成的复合词。在这里，"air" 指的是"空气"，"craft" 可以理解为"运载工具"。
m.airline: "Airline"是由两个部分合成的："air"（空气）和"line"（线，路线） "Airline"没有词缀，并且是由两个单词合并构成的。
m.airmail: 在"Airmail"这个单词中，没有词根，它是由两个单词合在一起组成的复合词： "air"（空中）和 "mail"（邮件）。这表明这是借助飞行发送邮件的方法。 "Airmail"这不是通过前缀或后缀构造出来的单词，它是由两个完整的单词组成的。
m.airplane: "Airplane" 很直接清晰，"air"（空气）+ "plane"（平面）。"Plane" 原意为“平面”，在此用于表示采用空气动力的飞行器。 "Airplane" 由两个英文原始词“air”和“plane”组成，没有特别的词缀。
m.airport: Airport 是由两个单词组成的复合词：'air' (空气) 和 'port' (港口)。所以'airport' 直接翻译为空气的港口，它的确是空中交通的“港口”。 Airport 中没有特定的词缀，但可以看作是两个词的复合：'air' 和 'port'。
m.airspace: "Airspace"是由两个单词组成的复合词： "air"（空气）和 "space"（空间）。并无具体的词根。 "Airspace"没有特殊的词缀。这是一个复合词，由 "air" 和 "space" 合并而来。
m.alarm: "Alarm"源于拉丁词汇"alarma"，原意是"到武器"，暗指战斗的信号。这个词由 "ad-"（表示方向或运动）和 "arma"（表示武器）两部分构成。 "Alarm"没有词缀，它是一个词根词。

m.alcohol: Alcohol comes from the Arabic word 'al-kuhl', which means 'the kohl'. 这个单词没有词缀，‘alcohol’就是整个词根。
